# loan_amortization.rb
require 'axlsx'
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'date'

class LoanAmortizationCalculator
  def initialize(principal, annual_interest_rate, loan_term_years, start_date = Date.today)
    @principal = BigDecimal(principal.to_s)
    @annual_interest_rate = BigDecimal(annual_interest_rate.to_s)
    @loan_term_months = loan_term_years * 12
    @start_date = start_date
    @monthly_interest_rate = @annual_interest_rate / 12 / 100
  end

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    # PMT formula: P * (r(1+r)^n) / ((1+r)^n - 1)
    if @monthly_interest_rate.zero?
      @principal / @loan_term_months
    else
      factor = (1 + @monthly_interest_rate) ** @loan_term_months
      (@principal * @monthly_interest_rate * factor) / (factor - 1)
    end
  end

  def generate_schedule
    monthly_payment = calculate_monthly_payment
    balance = @principal
    schedule = []
    current_date = @start_date

    @loan_term_months.times do |period|
      interest_payment = balance * @monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest_payment
      
      # Adjust last payment to avoid rounding errors
      if period == @loan_term_months - 1
        principal_payment = balance
        monthly_payment = principal_payment + interest_payment
      end

      balance -= principal_payment

      schedule << {
        period: period + 1,
        date: current_date,
        payment: monthly_payment.round(2),
        principal: principal_payment.round(2),
        interest: interest_payment.round(2),
        balance: balance.round(2).abs  # Ensure positive balance
      }

      current_date = next_month(current_date)
    end

    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(filename = "loan_amortization_schedule.xlsx")
    schedule = generate_schedule
    total_payment = schedule.sum { |payment| payment[:payment] }
    total_interest = schedule.sum { |payment| payment[:interest] }

    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Amortization Schedule") do |sheet|
        # Add header with loan details
        sheet.add_row(["Loan Amortization Schedule"])
        sheet.add_row(["Principal: $#{@principal.round(2)}"])
        sheet.add_row(["Annual Interest Rate: #{@annual_interest_rate}%"])
        sheet.add_row(["Loan Term: #{@loan_term_months / 12} years (#{@loan_term_months} months)"])
        sheet.add_row(["Monthly Payment: $#{calculate_monthly_payment.round(2)}"])
        sheet.add_row(["Total Payments: $#{total_payment.round(2)}"])
        sheet.add_row(["Total Interest: $#{total_interest.round(2)}"])
        sheet.add_row([])  # Empty row for spacing

        # Add schedule headers
        sheet.add_row(["Period", "Payment Date", "Payment", "Principal", "Interest", "Remaining Balance"])

        # Add schedule data
        schedule.each do |payment|
          sheet.add_row([
            payment[:period],
            payment[:date].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            payment[:payment],
            payment[:principal],
            payment[:interest],
            payment[:balance]
          ])
        end

        # Add summary row
        sheet.add_row([])
        sheet.add_row(["Totals", "", total_payment.round(2), @principal.round(2), total_interest.round(2), ""])

        # Style the worksheet
        sheet.styles do |s|
          # Header styles
          header_style = s.add_style(b: true, sz: 14)
          subtitle_style = s.add_style(b: true)
          currency_style = s.add_style(num_fmt: 4)  # Currency format
          
          # Apply styles
          sheet.rows[0].style = header_style
          (1..6).each { |i| sheet.rows[i].cells[0].style = subtitle_style }
          sheet.rows[7].style = subtitle_style  # Column headers
          
          # Apply currency format to numeric columns
          schedule_start_row = 8
          schedule_end_row = schedule_start_row + schedule.size - 1
          
          # Format payment, principal, interest, and balance columns
          (2..5).each do |col_idx|
            sheet.col_style(col_idx, currency_style, row_offset: schedule_start_row)
          end
          
          # Format summary row
          (2..4).each do |col_idx|
            sheet.rows[schedule_end_row + 2].cells[col_idx].style = currency_style
          end
        end
      end

      p.serialize(filename)
    end

    puts "Amortization schedule exported to #{filename}"
    filename
  end

```ruby
# app/services/adyen_service.rb
require 'adyen'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class AdyenService
  def initialize
    @adyen = Adyen::Client.new
    configure_adyen
  end

  # Конфігурація Adyen клієнта
  def configure_adyen
    @adyen.api_key = ENV['ADYEN_API_KEY']
    @adyen.env = ENV['ADYEN_ENVIRONMENT']&.to_sym || :test
    @adyen.live_url_prefix = ENV['ADYEN_LIVE_URL_PREFIX'] if ENV['ADYEN_LIVE_URL_PREFIX']
  end

  # Створення платежної сесії для Drop-in
  def create_payment_session(amount, currency, reference, return_url, merchant_account = nil)
    merchant_account ||= ENV['ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT']

    request = {
      amount: {
        value: amount, # сума в мінімальних одиницях валюти (наприклад, центах)
        currency: currency
      },
      reference: reference,
      merchantAccount: merchant_account,
      returnUrl: return_url,
      channel: 'Web',
      countryCode: 'UA', # код країни за замовчуванням
      shopperLocale: 'uk-UA' # локаль покупця
    }

    response = @adyen.checkout.payments_api.sessions(request)
    response.to_h
  end

  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  def get_payment_status(psp_reference)
    response = @adyen.checkout.payments_api.get_payment_details(psp_reference)
    response.to_h
  end

  # Перевірка HMAC-підпису для сповіщень
  def valid_hmac_signature?(notification_request)
    # Отримуємо HMAC ключ з environment variables
    hmac_key = ENV['ADYEN_HMAC_KEY']
    return false unless hmac_key

    # Перевіряємо кожен елемент в notificationItems
    notification_request['notificationItems']&.each do |item|
      notification_item = item['NotificationRequestItem']
      return false unless valid_notification_hmac(notification_item, hmac_key)
    end

    true
  end

  private

  def valid_notification_hmac(notification_item, hmac_key)
    # Поля для перевірки HMAC (у визначеному порядку)
```

```ruby
    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @api_token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(

    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @api_token
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/api/merchant/invoice/status?invoiceId=#{invoice_id}",
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Set webhook URL for receiving payment status updates
  def set_webhook(webhook_url)
    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @api_token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(

    )

    end

  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'faraday'

require 'openssl'

class WayForPay
  attr_reader :merchant_account, :merchant_secret_key, :api_url
  
  def initialize
    @merchant_account = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT']
    @merchant_secret_key = ENV['WAYFORPAY_SECRET_KEY']
    @api_url = ENV['WAYFORPAY_API_URL'] || 'https://api.wayforpay.com/api'
  end
  
  def create_invoice(order_params)
    params = {
      transactionType: 'CREATE_INVOICE',
      merchantAccount: @merchant_account,
      merchantDomainName: order_params[:merchant_domain_name],
      orderReference: order_params[:order_reference],
      orderDate: order_params[:order_date].to_i,
      amount: order_params[:amount],
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      productName: order_params[:product_name],
      productCount: order_params[:product_count],
      productPrice: order_params[:product_price],
      clientFirstName: order_params[:client_first_name],
      clientLastName: order_params[:client_last_name],
      clientEmail: order_params[:client_email],
      clientPhone: order_params[:client_phone],
      serviceUrl: order_params[:service_url],
      returnUrl: order_params[:return_url]
    }
    
    params[:merchantSignature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    response = Faraday.post("#{@api_url}/pay") do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = params.to_json
    end
    
    JSON.parse(response.body) if response.success?
  end
  
  def verify_signature(params)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    received_signature = params['merchantSignature']
    
    expected_signature == received_signature
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_signature(params)
    signature_string = [
      params[:merchantAccount],
      params[:merchantDomainName],
      params[:orderReference],
      params[:orderDate],
      params[:amount],
      params[:currency],
      params[:productName],
      params[:productCount],
      params[:productPrice]
    ].compact.join(';')
    
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('md5', @merchant_secret_key, signature_string)
  end
end
```

    @liqpay_signature = @liqpay.cnb_signature(liqpay_params)

      status: 'pending',
      liqpay_order_id: @order.id,
      liqpay_data: @liqpay_data
    )

    @payment = @order.payments.last

    data = params[:data]
    signature = params[:signature]

    unless valid_signature?(data, signature)
      render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: :bad_request
      return
    end

    decoded_data = decode_liqpay_data(data)
    order_id = decoded_data['order_id']
    
    @order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    unless @order
      render json: { error: 'Order not found' }, status: :not_found
      return
    end

    @payment = @order.payments.find_by(liqpay_order_id: order_id)
    if @payment
      update_payment_status(@payment, decoded_data)
      render json: { status: 'success' }
    else
      render json: { error: 'Payment not found' }, status: :not_found
    end

    expected_signature = LiqPay.new.str_to_sign(ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'] + data + ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'])

```ruby
# wayforpay_client.rb
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'openssl'
require 'httparty'

class WayForPayClient
  PURCHASE_URL = ENV['WAYFORPAY_PURCHASE_URL'] || 'https://secure.wayforpay.com/pay'

  def initialize(merchant_account, secret_key)
    @merchant_account = merchant_account
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end

  # Generate signature for request
  def generate_signature(fields)
    signature_string = fields.join(';')
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(OpenSSL::Digest.new('md5'), @secret_key, signature_string)
  end

  # Create payment form data
  def create_payment(params)
    # Required parameters
    required_params = {
      merchantAccount: @merchant_account,
      merchantDomainName: params[:merchant_domain_name] || 'yourdomain.com',
      orderReference: params[:order_reference],
      orderDate: params[:order_date],
      amount: params[:amount],
      currency: params[:currency],
      productName: Array(params[:product_name]),
      productCount: Array(params[:product_count]),
      productPrice: Array(params[:product_price])
    }

    # Optional parameters
    optional_params = {
      clientFirstName: params[:client_first_name],
      clientLastName: params[:client_last_name],
      clientEmail: params[:client_email],
      clientPhone: params[:client_phone],
      serviceUrl: params[:service_url] || ENV['WAYFORPAY_SERVICE_URL'],
      returnUrl: params[:return_url]
    }

    # Merge all parameters
    all_params = required_params.merge(optional_params.compact)

    # Flatten arrays for signature calculation
    signature_fields = [
      all_params[:merchantAccount],
      all_params[:merchantDomainName],
      all_params[:orderReference],
      all_params[:orderDate].to_s,
      all_params[:amount].to_s,
      all_params[:currency],
      all_params[:productName].join(';'),
      all_params[:productCount].join(';'),
      all_params[:productPrice].join(';')
    ]

    # Add optional fields to signature if present
    [:clientFirstName, :clientLastName, :clientEmail, :clientPhone].each do |field|
      signature_fields << all_params[field] if all_params[field]
    end

    # Generate signature
    all_params[:merchantSignature] = generate_signature(signature_fields)

    # Generate HTML form
    generate_payment_form(all_params)
  end

  private

  def generate_payment_form(params)
    form_fields = params.map do |key, value|
      if value.is_a?(Array)
        value.map { |v| "<input type='hidden' name='#{key}[]' value='#{v}'/>" }.join("\n")
      else
        "<input type='hidden' name='#{key}' value='#{value}'/>"
      end
    end.join("\n")

    <<~HTML
      <form method="POST" action="#{PURCHASE_URL}" id="wayforpay_payment_form">
        #{form_fields}
        <input type="submit" value="Pay Now"/>
      </form>
      <script>
        document.getElementById('wayforpay_payment_form').submit();
      </script>
    HTML
  end
end
```

```ruby
# iban_validator.rb
require 'iban-tools'

class UkrainianIBANValidator
  # Ukrainian IBAN format: UAkk bbbb bbcc cccc cccc cccc cccc cccc
  # Where:
  # - UA: Country code
  # - kk: Check digits
  # - bbbbbb: Bank MFO code (6 digits)
  # - cccc...: Account number (remaining characters)
  
  UKRAINIAN_IBAN_LENGTH = 29
  MFO_CODE_START_POSITION = 6
  MFO_CODE_LENGTH = 6
  
  def self.valid?(iban)
    # Remove any whitespace and convert to uppercase
    cleaned_iban = iban.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Check basic format requirements
    return false unless cleaned_iban.match?(/\AUA\d{27}\z/)
    
    # Validate using iban-tools gem
    IBANTools::IBAN.valid?(cleaned_iban)
  end
  
  def self.extract_mfo_code(iban)
    return nil unless valid?(iban)
    
    cleaned_iban = iban.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Extract MFO code (positions 6-11 after removing country code and check digits)
    # IBAN format: UAkk bbbb bbcc cccc cccc cccc cccc cccc
    # After cleaning: UAkkbbbbbbcccccccccccccccccccc
    # MFO code starts at position 4 (0-based) and is 6 characters long
    cleaned_iban[4, MFO_CODE_LENGTH]
  end
  
  def self.validate_and_extract(iban)
    {
      valid: valid?(iban),
      mfo_code: extract_mfo_code(iban)
    }
  end
end

# Example usage:
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Test with a valid Ukrainian IBAN example
  test_iban = "UA 21 399622 000000260000012345678"
  
  puts "Testing IBAN: #{test_iban}"
  result = UkrainianIBANValidator.validate_and_extract(test_iban)
  
  puts "Valid: #{result[:valid]}"
  puts "MFO Code: #{result[:mfo_code]}"
  
  # Test with invalid IBAN
  invalid_iban = "UA21 399622 00000026000001234567" # Too short
  puts "\nTesting invalid IBAN: #{invalid_iban}"
  result2 = UkrainianIBANValidator.validate_and_extract(invalid_iban)
  
  puts "Valid: #{result2[:valid]}"
  puts "MFO Code: #{result2[:mfo_code]}"
end
```

This implementation provides:

1. **Gemfile** specifying the `iban-tools` gem which handles IBAN validation according to international standards
2. **UkrainianIBANValidator** class with three main methods:
   - `valid?` - validates the IBAN format and checksum
   - `extract_mfo_code` - extracts the 6-digit bank MFO code from a valid IBAN
   - `validate_and_extract` - returns both validation result and MFO code

The Ukrainian IBAN structure is:
- **UA** - Country code
- **kk** - Check digits (2 digits)
- **bbbb bb** - Bank MFO code (6 digits)
- **cccc cccc cccc cccc cccc** - Account number (19 characters)

The code first validates the basic format (29 characters, starts with UA) and then uses the `iban-tools` gem for proper checksum validation. If valid, it extracts the MFO code from positions 6-11 (after the country code and check digits).

      handle_error(response)
    end
  end
  
  # Fetch exchange rates for today
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Array of exchange rate objects
  def fetch_today_rates
    fetch_rates(Date.today)
  end
  
  # Find specific currency rate for a given date
  # @param currency_code [String, Integer] Currency code (e.g., 'USD', 840, 'EUR', 978)
  # @param date [Date, String] The date to fetch rate for
  # @return [Hash, nil] Currency rate object or nil if not found
  def find_currency_rate(currency_code, date)
    rates = fetch_rates(date)
    rates.find do |rate|
      rate['r030'].to_s == currency_code.to_s || 
      rate['cc'].to_s.downcase == currency_code.to_s.downcase
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_date(date)
    case date
    when Date
      date
    when String
      Date.parse(date)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Date must be a Date object or string in YYYY-MM-DD format"
    end
  rescue ArgumentError
    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid date format. Use YYYY-MM-DD"
  end
  
  def build_url(date)
    "#{BASE_URL}?date=#{date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}&json"
  end
  
  def parse_response(xml_response)
    # The API returns XML, but we request JSON format with the 'json' parameter
    begin
      JSON.parse(xml_response)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      # Fallback to XML parsing if JSON fails (though API should return JSON)
      parse_xml_response(xml_response)
    end
  end
  
  def parse_xml_response(xml_response)
    # Simple XML parsing as fallback
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response) rescue nil
    return [] unless doc
    
    doc.xpath('//currency').map do |currency|
      {
        'r030' => currency.xpath('r030').text.to_i,
        'txt' => currency.xpath('txt').text,
        'rate' => currency.xpath('rate').text.to_f,
        'cc' => currency.xpath('cc').text,
        'exchangedate' => currency.xpath('exchangedate').text
      }
    end
  end
  
  def handle_error(response)
    case response.code
    when 404
      raise "Exchange rates not found for the specified date"
    when 400
      raise "Invalid date format or parameters"
    when 500
      raise "National Bank of Ukraine API server error"
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates: HTTP #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'base64'

class PrivatBankBusinessClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://acp.privatbank.ua/api'

  def initialize(merchant_id, password, terminal_id = nil)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @password = password
    @terminal_id = terminal_id
  end

  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    timestamp = generate_timestamp
    data = {
      "oper" => "cmt",
      "wait" => 0,
      "test" => 0,
      "payment" => {
        "id" => generate_transaction_id,
        "props" => [
          {
            "name" => "cardnum",
            "value" => ""
          },
          {
            "name" => "country",
            "value" => "UA"
          }
        ]
      }
    }

    make_request('balance', data, timestamp)
  end

  # Get account statement for a date range
  def get_statement(start_date, end_date, card_number = "")
    timestamp = generate_timestamp
    data = {
      "oper" => "cmt",
      "wait" => 0,
      "test" => 0,
      "payment" => {
        "id" => generate_transaction_id,
        "props" => [
          {
            "name" => "sd",
            "value" => start_date.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")
          },
          {
            "name" => "ed",
            "value" => end_date.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")
          },
          {
            "name" => "cardnum",
            "value" => card_number
          },
          {
            "name" => "country",
            "value" => "UA"
          }
        ]
      }
    }

    make_request('rest', data, timestamp)
  end

  private

  def generate_timestamp
    Time.now.utc.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S")
  end

  def generate_transaction_id
    SecureRandom.hex(10)
  end

  def generate_signature(data_string, timestamp)
    # Create signature using merchant password
    sign_string = data_string + timestamp + @password
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest(sign_string).upcase
  end

  def make_request(operation, data, timestamp)
    # Convert data to JSON string for signature generation
    data_string = data.to_json.gsub(/\s+/, "")
    
    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data_string, timestamp)

    # Prepare request headers
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json; charset=UTF-8',
      'User-Agent' => 'Ruby PrivatBank Client'
    }

    # Prepare request body
    request_body = {
      "oper" => operation,
      "wait" => 0,
      "test" => 0,
      "merchant" => {
        "id" => @merchant_id,
        "signature" => signature
      }
    }

    # Add terminal ID if provided
    request_body["merchant"]["terminal"] = @terminal_id if @terminal_id
    
    # Add data and timestamp
    request_body["data"] = data_string
    request_body["timestamp"] = timestamp

    # Make API request
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/#{operation}",
      headers: headers,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      begin
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        { "error" => "Failed to parse response", "raw_response" => response.body }
      end
    else
      { "error" => "HTTP Error: #{response.code}", "message" => response.message }
    end
  end
end
```

class CheckboxFiscalReceiptIssuer
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.checkbox.in.ua/api/v1'

  end

  def issue_receipt(payment_data)

    receipt_payload = build_receipt_payload(payment_data)

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/receipts/sell",
      headers: headers,
      body: receipt_payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  end

      round_payment: payment_data[:round_payment] || false,
      related_receipt_id: payment_data[:related_receipt_id] || nil
    }.compact
  end

  def build_goods(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {

          code: item[:code] || item[:sku],
          name: item[:name],
          price: item[:price],
          barcode: item[:barcode],

        provider_type: payment[:provider_type] || 'OCTOPUS', # Payment service provider

        payment_system: payment[:payment_system] || nil
      }.compact
    end
  end

      return { valid: false, error: "Невірний формат IBAN. Має бути UA29 символів" }

    unless iban.validation_errors.empty?
      return { valid: false, error: "IBAN не пройшов валідацію: #{iban.validation_errors.join(', ')}" }
    end
    
    unless iban.valid?
      return { valid: false, error: "IBAN недійсний" }
    end
    
    # Витягуємо код МФО (позиції 9-14 після UA00)
    mfo_code = cleaned_iban[6..11]
    
    # Отримуємо назву банку
    bank_name = BANK_MFO_CODES[mfo_code] || "Невідомий банк (МФО: #{mfo_code})"
    
    {
      valid: true,
      iban: cleaned_iban,
      mfo_code: mfo_code,
      bank_name: bank_name,
      country_code: cleaned_iban[0..1],
      check_digits: cleaned_iban[2..3],
      account_number: cleaned_iban[12..-1]
    }

    result[:valid] ? result[:mfo_code] : nil

```ruby
    # Перевірка статусу платежу
    def check_payment_status(order_id)
      params = {
        order_id: order_id,
        merchant_id: Fondy.configuration.merchant_id
      }
      
      signature = generate_signature(params)
      params[:signature] = signature
      
      response = post('/status/order_id', body: { request: params.to_json })
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Перевірка підпису відповіді від Fondy
    def verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
      # Копіюємо параметри без підпису
      params_to_verify = callback_params.dup
      received_signature = params_to_verify.delete('signature')
      
      # Генеруємо підпис для перевірки
      calculated_signature = generate_signature(params_to_verify)
      
      # Порівнюємо підписи
      ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(
        calculated_signature,
        received_signature.to_s
      )
    end
    
    private
    
    # Підготовка параметрів для запиту
    def prepare_params(order_params)
      default_params = {
        merchant_id: Fondy.configuration.merchant_id,
        order_desc: 'Payment for order',
        currency: 'UAH',
        server_callback_url: order_params[:callback_url] || default_callback_url,
        response_url: order_params[:response_url] || default_response_url,
        lang: 'uk'
      }
      
      default_params.merge(order_params)
    end
    
    # Генерація підпису
    def generate_signature(params)
      # Сортуємо параметри за ключами в алфавітному порядку
      sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
      
      # Формуємо рядок для підпису
      string_to_sign = Fondy.configuration.secret_key + '|' + 
                      sorted_params.map { |k, v| "#{v}" }.join('|')
      
      # Обчислюємо SHA-1 хеш
      Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(string_to_sign)
    end
    
    # Обробка відповіді від API
    def handle_response(response)
      if response.success?
        json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
        
        if json_response['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
          { success: true, data: json_response['response'] }
        else
          { success: false, error: json_response['response']['error_message'] }
        end
      else
        { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      { success: false, error: "JSON Parse Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
    
    def default_callback_url
      # URL для серверних callback'ів
      Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.fondy_callback_url(host: ENV['APP_HOST'])
    end
    
    def default_response_url
      # URL для перенаправлення користувача після платежу
      Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.payment_result_url(host: ENV['APP_HOST'])
    end
  end
```

```ruby
class PortmoneClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.portmone.com.ua/gateway/'

  def initialize(payee_id, login, password)
    @payee_id = payee_id
    @login = login
    @password = password
  end

  def create_payment_link(amount, description, order_number, success_url, failure_url, email = nil, phone = nil)
    params = {
      payeeId: @payee_id,
      shopOrderNumber: order_number,
      billAmount: amount,
      description: description,
      successUrl: success_url,
      failureUrl: failure_url,
      lang: 'uk'
    }

    # Опційні параметри
    params[:emailAddress] = email if email
    params[:phoneNumber] = phone if phone

    response = Faraday.post("#{BASE_URL}/") do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      req.body = URI.encode_www_form(params)
    end

    if response.success?
      # Повертаємо URL для перенаправлення користувача
      response.headers['location'] || "#{BASE_URL}?#{URI.encode_www_form(params)}"
    else
      raise "Помилка створення платіжного посилання: #{response.status}"
    end
  end

  def verify_payment(order_number)
    params = {
      method: 'result',
      payeeId: @payee_id,
      login: @login,
      password: @password,
      shopOrderNumber: order_number
    }

    response = Faraday.post("#{BASE_URL}/") do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      req.body = URI.encode_www_form(params)
    end

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка перевірки платежу: #{response.status}"
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(xml_response)
    # Спрощений парсинг XML відповіді
    # У реальному додатку краще використовувати Nokogiri для парсингу XML
    doc = Hash.from_xml(xml_response) rescue {}
    
    result = {
      status: doc.dig('response', 'bill', 'status')&.downcase,
      amount: doc.dig('response', 'bill', 'billAmount')&.to_f,
      order_number: doc.dig('response', 'bill', 'shopOrderNumber'),
      payment_id: doc.dig('response', 'bill', 'shopBillNumber'),
      error_message: doc.dig('response', 'error', 'message')
    }
    
    result[:success] = result[:status] == 'paid'
    result
  end
```

# tax_calculator.rb
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'bigdecimal/util'
require 'i18n'

I18n.config.available_locales = :en

class SoleProprietorTaxCalculator
  # Tax rates as of 2024 (in percentages)
  SINGLE_TAX_RATE = BigDecimal('5')  # 5% for 3rd group
  MINIMUM_SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION = BigDecimal('1541')  # Minimum ЄСВ per month in UAH
  
  # Income thresholds for social contribution calculation
  MINIMUM_WAGE = BigDecimal('8000')  # Minimum monthly wage in UAH
  MAXIMUM_SOCIAL_BASE = BigDecimal('27000')  # Maximum base for social contribution
  
  def initialize(quarterly_income, months_in_quarter = 3)
    @quarterly_income = quarterly_income.to_d
    @months_in_quarter = months_in_quarter
    validate_inputs
  end
  
  def calculate
    {
      quarterly_income: format_amount(@quarterly_income),
      single_tax: format_amount(calculate_single_tax),
      social_contribution: format_amount(calculate_social_contribution),
      total_tax_burden: format_amount(calculate_total_tax_burden),
      net_income: format_amount(calculate_net_income),
      effective_tax_rate: format_percentage(calculate_effective_tax_rate)
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_inputs
    if @quarterly_income.negative?
      raise ArgumentError, "Quarterly income cannot be negative"
    end
    
    if @months_in_quarter < 1 || @months_in_quarter > 3
      raise ArgumentError, "Months in quarter must be between 1 and 3"
    end
  end
  
  def calculate_single_tax
    @quarterly_income * (SINGLE_TAX_RATE / 100)
  end
  
  def calculate_social_contribution
    # Social contribution is calculated based on minimum wage or actual income
    monthly_income = @quarterly_income / @months_in_quarter
    
    # For 3rd group, social contribution is 1541 UAH per month minimum
    # If monthly income exceeds minimum wage, calculate based on actual income
    if monthly_income > MINIMUM_WAGE
      social_base = [monthly_income, MAXIMUM_SOCIAL_BASE].min
      monthly_social_contribution = social_base * BigDecimal('0.22')  # 22% social contribution rate
    else
      monthly_social_contribution = MINIMUM_SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION
    end
    
    monthly_social_contribution * @months_in_quarter
  end
  
  def calculate_total_tax_burden
    calculate_single_tax + calculate_social_contribution
  end
  
  def calculate_net_income
    @quarterly_income - calculate_total_tax_burden
  end
  
  def calculate_effective_tax_rate
    return 0 if @quarterly_income.zero?
    (calculate_total_tax_burden / @quarterly_income) * 100
  end
  
  def format_amount(amount)
    I18n.t('number.currency.format.format') % amount.round(2)
  end
  
  def format_percentage(percentage)
    "#{percentage.round(2)}%"
  end
end

class NBUQRGenerator
  # Стандартні коди полів за специфікацією НБУ
  FIELD_CODES = {
    version: '001',
    encoding: '1',
    bic: '002',
    receiver_name: '003',
    receiver_account: '004',
    receiver_edrpou: '005',
    payment_amount: '006',
    payment_purpose: '007',
    comment: '008'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(bic:, receiver_name:, receiver_account:, receiver_edrpou:, 
                 payment_amount: nil, payment_purpose: nil, comment: nil)
    @bic = bic
    @receiver_name = receiver_name
    @receiver_account = receiver_account
    @receiver_edrpou = receiver_edrpou
    @payment_amount = payment_amount
    @payment_purpose = payment_purpose
    @comment = comment
  end

  def generate_qr_string
    # Основний формат за стандартом НБУ
    qr_data = []

    # Версія специфікації (завжди 001)
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:version], '001')

    # Кодування (1 - UTF-8)
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:encoding], '1')

    # БІК банку отримувача
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:bic], @bic)

    # Найменування отримувача
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:receiver_name], @receiver_name)

    # Рахунок отримувача
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:receiver_account], @receiver_account)

    # ЄДРПОУ отримувача
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:receiver_edrpou], @receiver_edrpou)

    # Сума платежу (опціонально)
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:payment_amount], @payment_amount) if @payment_amount

    # Призначення платежу (опціонально)
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:payment_purpose], @payment_purpose) if @payment_purpose

    # Коментар (опціонально)
    qr_data << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:comment], @comment) if @comment

# ukrainian_qr_generator.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'base64'

class UkrainianQRGenerator
  # Required fields for NBU QR standard
  REQUIRED_FIELDS = %w[version charSet name bank account amount currency]
  
  # Optional fields
  OPTIONAL_FIELDS = %w[edrpou purpose details]
  
  # Supported character sets
  CHAR_SETS = {
    utf8: '1',
    windows1251: '2'
  }
  
  # Supported currencies
  CURRENCIES = {
    uah: '980',
    usd: '840',
    eur: '978'
  }
  
  def initialize(options = {})
    @options = {
      version: '1',
      charSet: CHAR_SETS[:utf8],
      name: '',
      bank: '',
      account: '',
      amount: '0.00',
      currency: CURRENCIES[:uah],
      edrpou: '',
      purpose: '',
      details: ''
    }.merge(options)
    
    validate_required_fields
  end
  
  def generate_qr_code(format: :svg, size: 300, **qr_options)
    qr_string = build_qr_string
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string, **qr_options)
    
    case format
    when :svg
      qr.as_svg(offset: 0, color: '000', shape_rendering: 'crispEdges', module_size: 6, standalone: true)
    when :png
      qr.as_png(size: size)
    when :ansi
      qr.as_ansi
    when :string
      qr_string
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported format: #{format}. Supported formats: :svg, :png, :ansi, :string"
    end
  end
  
  def save_to_file(filename, format: :svg, **options)
    qr_content = generate_qr_code(format: format, **options)
    
    case format
    when :svg
      File.write(filename, qr_content)
    when :png
      qr_content.save(filename)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "File saving only supported for :svg and :png formats"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_required_fields
    REQUIRED_FIELDS.each do |field|
      value = @options[field.to_sym]
      if value.nil? || value.to_s.empty?
        raise ArgumentError, "Required field '#{field}' is missing or empty"
      end
    end
    
    # Validate account format (IBAN for Ukraine)
    unless @options[:account].to_s.match?(/^UA\d{27}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Account must be a valid Ukrainian IBAN (UA followed by 27 digits)"
    end
    
    # Validate amount format
    unless @options[:amount].to_s.match?(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be a valid decimal number"
    end
  end
  
  def build_qr_string
    fields = []
    
    # Required fields in order
    fields << "version=#{@options[:version]}"
    fields << "charSet=#{@options[:charSet]}"
    fields << "name=#{encode_field(@options[:name])}"
    fields << "bank=#{encode_field(@options[:bank])}"
    fields << "account=#{@options[:account]}"
    fields << "amount=#{format_amount(@options[:amount])}"
    fields << "currency=#{@options[:currency]}"
    
    # Optional fields
    fields << "edrpou=#{@options[:edrpou]}" unless @options[:edrpou].empty?
    fields << "purpose=#{encode_field(@options[:purpose])}" unless @options[:purpose].empty?
    fields << "details=#{encode_field(@options[:details])}" unless @options[:details].empty?
    
    fields.join('|')
  end
  
  def encode_field(field)
    # For UTF-8 character set, we need to properly handle encoding
    if @options[:charSet] == CHAR_SETS[:utf8]
      # Remove or replace problematic characters
      field.to_s.gsub('|', ' ')  # Pipe character is used as separator
            .gsub('=', ' ')      # Equal sign is used in key=value pairs
            .strip
    else
      field.to_s
    end
  end
  
  def format_amount(amount)
    # Ensure amount has exactly 2 decimal places
    sprintf('%.2f', amount.to_f)
  end
end

```ruby
require 'sqlite3'

class Database
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    db = SQLite3::Database.new(ENV['DATABASE_PATH'])
    
    db.execute <<-SQL
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipts (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        utility_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
        payment_id VARCHAR(100),
        transaction_id VARCHAR(100),
        status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
        receipt_data TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
    SQL

    db.close
    @logger.info("Database initialized successfully")
  rescue SQLite3::Exception => e
    @logger.error("Database error: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  def save_receipt(receipt_data)
    db = SQLite3::Database.new(ENV['DATABASE_PATH'])
    
    query = <<-SQL
      INSERT INTO receipts (user_id, utility_type, amount, payment_id, transaction_id, status, receipt_data)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    SQL
    
    db.execute(query, [
      receipt_data[:user_id],
      receipt_data[:utility_type],
      receipt_data[:amount],
      receipt_data[:payment_id],
      receipt_data[:transaction_id],
      receipt_data[:status],
      receipt_data[:receipt_data].to_json
    ])
    
    receipt_id = db.last_insert_row_id
    db.close
    
    @logger.info("Receipt saved with ID: #{receipt_id}")
    receipt_id
  rescue SQLite3::Exception => e
    @logger.error("Error saving receipt: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  def get_receipts_by_user(user_id)
    db = SQLite3::Database.new(ENV['DATABASE_PATH'])
    
    receipts = db.execute("
      SELECT * FROM receipts 
      WHERE user_id = ? 
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
    ", [user_id])
    
    db.close
    receipts.map do |row|
      {
        id: row[0],
        user_id: row[1],
        utility_type: row[2],
        amount: row[3],
        payment_id: row[4],
        transaction_id: row[5],
        status: row[6],
        receipt_data: JSON.parse(row[7] || '{}'),
        created_at: row[8]
      }
    end
  rescue SQLite3::Exception => e
    @logger.error("Error fetching receipts: #{e.message}")
    []
  end
```

```ruby
    params = {

    }

      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      
      # Обробка відповіді
      handle_response(response)

    end
  end

  private

  def validate_parameters(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    raise "Сума має бути додатнім числом" unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise "Валюта не підтримується" unless ['UAH', 'USD', 'EUR'].include?(currency.upcase)
    raise "Номер картки не може бути пустим" if card_number.to_s.strip.empty?

  end

  def normalize_card_number(card_number)
```

require 'liqpay'

class LiqPayPayout
  def initialize(public_key = nil, private_key = nil)
    @public_key = public_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']
    @private_key = private_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    
    validate_credentials!
    
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: @public_key,
      private_key: @private_key
    )
  end

  # Main method to perform payout
  def payout_to_card(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name, options = {})
    validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    
    payout_params = build_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name, options)
    
    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('p2pcredit', payout_params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise "Payout failed: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # Check payout status
  def check_status(order_id)
    response = @liqpay.api('status', {
      order_id: order_id
    })
    
    {
      status: response['status'],
      order_id: response['order_id'],
      amount: response['amount'],
      currency: response['currency'],
      description: response['description'],
      err_code: response['err_code'],
      err_description: response['err_description']
    }
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    unless @public_key && @private_key
      raise "LiqPay credentials not found. Please set LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY and LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY environment variables."
    end
  end

  def validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    raise "Amount must be positive" unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise "Currency is required" if currency.to_s.empty?
    raise "Card number is required" if card_number.to_s.empty?
    raise "Recipient name is required" if recipient_name.to_s.empty?
    
    # Basic Ukrainian card number validation (starts with 4 for Visa, 5 for MasterCard)
    unless card_number.to_s.match(/^(4|5)\d{15}$/)
      raise "Invalid card number format. Ukrainian cards should be 16 digits starting with 4 or 5."
    end
  end

  def build_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name, options)
    {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      amount: amount.to_f,

```ruby
require 'faraday'

class FondyPayment
  # Fondy API endpoints
  API_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/url/'
  CALLBACK_URL = 'https://yourdomain.com/fondy/callback' # Replace with your callback URL
  
  # Your merchant credentials (replace with actual values)
  MERCHANT_ID = 'your_merchant_id'
  SECRET_KEY = 'your_secret_key'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id = nil, secret_key = nil)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id || MERCHANT_ID
    @secret_key = secret_key || SECRET_KEY
  end
  
  # Generate payment URL
  def generate_payment_url(order_params)
    # Required parameters
    required_params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
      amount: order_params[:amount], # Amount in cents
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'USD',
      merchant_id: @merchant_id
    }
    
    # Optional parameters
    optional_params = {
      server_callback_url: order_params[:callback_url] || CALLBACK_URL,
      response_url: order_params[:response_url],
      lang: order_params[:lang] || 'en',
      product_id: order_params[:product_id],
      required_rectoken: order_params[:required_rectoken] || 'N'
    }
    
    # Merge all parameters
    params = required_params.merge(optional_params).compact
    
    # Add signature
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    # Send request to Fondy API
    response = send_request(params)
    
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if json_response['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        json_response['response']['checkout_url']
      else
        raise "Fondy API Error: #{json_response['response']['error_message']}"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.status}"
    end
  end
  
  # Verify callback signature
  def verify_signature(callback_params)
    # Extract signature from callback
    received_signature = callback_params.delete('signature')
    
    # Generate our own signature from the received parameters
    generated_signature = generate_signature(callback_params)
    
    # Compare signatures
    received_signature == generated_signature
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Sort parameters alphabetically by key
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    
    # Create signature string: secret_key + | + param1=value1|param2=value2...
    signature_string = @secret_key + '|' + sorted_params.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('|')
    
    # Generate SHA-1 hash and encode in base64
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(digest, @secret_key, signature_string)
    
    Base64.strict_encode64(signature)
  end
  
  def send_request(params)
    conn = Faraday.new(url: API_URL) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
    
    conn.post do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = { request: params }.to_json
    end
  end
end
```

class PrivatBankInstallment
  # API endpoints (test and production)
  TEST_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'
  PRODUCTION_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password, test_mode: true)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
    @base_url = test_mode ? TEST_BASE_URL : PRODUCTION_BASE_URL
  end
  
  # Step 1: Create installment payment
  def create_payment(order_params)
    endpoint = '/installment'
    url = @base_url + endpoint
    
    # Required parameters for installment payment
    params = {
      operation: 'Create',
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: order_params[:order_id],
      amount: format_amount(order_params[:amount]),
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      details: order_params[:description],
      signature: generate_signature(order_params)
    }.merge(order_params.slice(:products, :clientInfo, :deliveryInfo))
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Step 2: Check payment status
  def check_payment_status(order_id)
    endpoint = '/check'
    url = @base_url + endpoint
    
    params = {
      operation: 'Check',
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: order_id,
      signature: generate_check_signature(order_id)
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Step 3: Process payment callback (webhook)
  def handle_callback(request_body)
    data = JSON.parse(request_body)
    
    # Verify signature
    unless valid_callback_signature?(data)
      return { success: false, error: 'Invalid signature' }
    end
    
    case data['state']
    when 'Approved'
      # Payment approved, complete the order
      handle_approved_payment(data)
    when 'Declined'
      # Payment declined
      handle_declined_payment(data)
    when 'Expired'
      # Payment expired
      handle_expired_payment(data)
    else
      { success: false, error: 'Unknown payment state' }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_amount(amount)
    # Convert to kopeck (smallest currency unit)
    (amount.to_f * 100).to_i
  end
  
  def generate_signature(order_params)
    data = [
      @merchant_password,
      order_params[:order_id],
      format_amount(order_params[:amount]),
      order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      order_params[:description].to_s
    ].join('')
    
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(data)
  end
  
  def generate_check_signature(order_id)
    data = [
      @merchant_password,
      order_id
    ].join('')
    
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(data)
  end
  
  def valid_callback_signature?(data)
    signature_data = [
      @merchant_password,
      data['orderId'],
      data['amount'],
      data['currency'],
      data['state']
    ].join('')
    
    expected_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_data)
    expected_signature == data['signature']
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}", response: response.body }
    end
  end

      success: true,

      amount: data['amount'].to_f / 100, # Convert back from kopeck
      currency: data['currency'],
      payment_id: data['paymentId'],
      message: 'Payment approved successfully'
    }
  end
  
  def handle_declined_payment(data)
    # Update order status to declined
    {
      success: false,
      order_id: data['orderId'],
      error: 'Payment declined by bank',
      reason: data['reason']
    }
  end
  
  def handle_expired_payment(data)
    # Update order status to expired
    {
      success: false,
      order_id: data['orderId'],
      error: 'Payment expired'
    }
  end

    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end
  
  # Create a payment request
  def create_payment(params)
    # Required parameters
    required_params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      amount: params[:amount], # Amount in cents (e.g., 1000 = 10.00 UAH)
      currency: params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      description: params[:description],
      order_id: params[:order_id] || generate_order_id,
      customer_email: params[:customer_email],
      customer_phone: params[:customer_phone],
      success_url: params[:success_url],
      fail_url: params[:fail_url],
      callback_url: params[:callback_url],
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }
    
    # Optional parameters
    optional_params = {
      customer_first_name: params[:customer_first_name],
      customer_last_name: params[:customer_last_name],
      customer_country: params[:customer_country],
      customer_city: params[:customer_city],
      customer_address: params[:customer_address],
      lang: params[:lang] || 'ru'
    }
    
    # Merge all parameters
    request_params = required_params.merge(optional_params)
    
    # Generate signature
    request_params[:signature] = generate_signature(request_params)
    
    # Send request to iPay.ua
    response = Faraday.post(CREATE_PAYMENT_URL) do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = request_params.to_json
    end
    
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if result['result'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          payment_id: result['payment_id'],
          payment_url: result['payment_url'],
          order_id: request_params[:order_id]
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: result['error_message'] || 'Payment creation failed'
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.status}"
      }
    end
  rescue Faraday::Error => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Connection error: #{e.message}"
    }
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Invalid response format: #{e.message}"
    }
  end
  
  # Check payment status by payment_id
  def check_status(payment_id)
    request_params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      payment_id: payment_id,
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }
    
    # Generate signature
    request_params[:signature] = generate_signature(request_params)
    
    # Send request to iPay.ua
    response = Faraday.post(CHECK_STATUS_URL) do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = request_params.to_json
    end

```ruby
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }

    # Генеруємо підпис
```

    @client_id = client_id

      orders_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      orders.concat(orders_data['payload']['Orders'] || [])
      
      next_token = orders_data['payload'].dig('NextToken')

      # Rate limiting - be respectful of API limits
      sleep(1)
    end

    orders

      total_orders: orders.size,

    missing << 'SP_API_REFRESH_TOKEN' if @refresh_token.nil? || @refresh_token.empty?

# shipment_creator.rb
require 'fedex'
require 'httparty'
require 'pdf-reader'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'fileutils'

class FedExShipmentCreator
  def initialize
    # Load credentials from environment variables
    @fedex = Fedex::Shipment.new(
      key: ENV['FEDEX_KEY'],
      password: ENV['FEDEX_PASSWORD'],
      account_number: ENV['FEDEX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER'],
      meter: ENV['FEDEX_METER_NUMBER'],
      mode: ENV['FEDEX_MODE'] || 'production' # 'production' or 'test'
    )
  end

  def create_shipment(shipment_details)
    begin
      # Create shipment request
      shipment = @fedex.ship(
        shipper: shipper_info(shipment_details[:shipper]),
        recipient: recipient_info(shipment_details[:recipient]),
        packages: package_info(shipment_details[:packages]),
        service_type: shipment_details[:service_type] || 'FEDEX_GROUND',
        packaging_type: shipment_details[:packaging_type] || 'YOUR_PACKAGING',
        label_specification: {
          image_type: 'PDF',
          label_stock_type: 'PAPER_4X6'
        }
      )

      # Extract tracking number and label data
      tracking_number = shipment.tracking_number
      label_data = shipment.label.data

      # Save the label as PDF
      label_filename = save_label(label_data, tracking_number)

      {
        success: true,
        tracking_number: tracking_number,
        label_filename: label_filename,
        total_charge: shipment.total_charge,
        master_tracking_number: shipment.master_tracking_number
      }

    rescue Fedex::RateError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "FedEx API Error: #{e.message}"
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def shipper_info(shipper_details)
    {
      name: shipper_details[:name],
      company: shipper_details[:company],
      phone_number: shipper_details[:phone],
      address: shipper_details[:address][:street],
      city: shipper_details[:address][:city],
      state: shipper_details[:address][:state],
      postal_code: shipper_details[:address][:zip_code],
      country_code: shipper_details[:address][:country] || 'US'
    }
  end

  def recipient_info(recipient_details)
    {
      name: recipient_details[:name],
      company: recipient_details[:company],
      phone_number: recipient_details[:phone],
      address: recipient_details[:address][:street],
      city: recipient_details[:address][:city],
      state: recipient_details[:address][:state],
      postal_code: recipient_details[:address][:zip_code],
      country_code: recipient_details[:address][:country] || 'US',
      residential: recipient_details[:residential] || false
    }
  end

  def package_info(packages)
    Array(packages).map do |pkg|
      {
        weight: { units: pkg[:weight_unit] || 'LB', value: pkg[:weight] },
        dimensions: {
          length: pkg[:length],
          width: pkg[:width],
          height: pkg[:height],

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# dhl_tracker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'time'

Dotenv.load

class DHLTracker
  BASE_URL = 'https://api-eu.dhl.com/track/shipments'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'DHL-API-Key' => @api_key
    }
  end

  def track_parcel(tracking_number, service = 'express')
    params = {
      trackingNumber: tracking_number,
      service: service
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, headers: @headers, query: params)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.parsed_response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(data)
    return { error: 'No shipment data found' } unless data['shipments']

    shipment = data['shipments'].first
    return { error: 'Invalid shipment data' } unless shipment

    {
      tracking_number: shipment['id'],
      service: shipment['service'],
      origin: {
        address: shipment['origin']['address'] rescue 'Unknown',
        country: shipment['origin']['countryCode'] rescue 'Unknown'
      },
      destination: {
        address: shipment['destination']['address'] rescue 'Unknown',
        country: shipment['destination']['countryCode'] rescue 'Unknown'
      },
      status: shipment['status']['status'] rescue 'Unknown',
      description: shipment['status']['description'] rescue 'Unknown',
      estimated_delivery: parse_date(shipment['estimatedTimeOfDelivery']) rescue nil,
      events: parse_events(shipment['events'] || [])
    }
  end

  def parse_events(events)
    events.map do |event|
      {
        timestamp: parse_date(event['timestamp']),
        location: event['location']['address']['addressLocality'] rescue 'Unknown location',
        description: event['description'],
        status: event['statusCode']
      }
    end.sort_by { |event| event[:timestamp] }.reverse # Most recent first
  end

  def parse_date(date_string)
    Time.parse(date_string) if date_string
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    case response.code
    when 400
      { error: 'Invalid tracking number or parameters' }
    when 401
      { error: 'Invalid API key' }
    when 404
      { error: 'Tracking number not found' }
    when 429
      { error: 'Rate limit exceeded' }
    when 500
      { error: 'DHL API server error' }
    else
      { error: "Unknown error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}" }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'dhl/api'
require 'dotenv'
require 'date'

Dotenv.load

class DHLExpressTracker
  def initialize(site_id = nil, password = nil)
    @site_id = site_id || ENV['DHL_SITE_ID']
    @password = password || ENV['DHL_PASSWORD']
    
    validate_credentials!
    
    @client = DHL::API.new(
      site_id: @site_id,
      password: @password,
      test: ENV['DHL_TEST_MODE'] == 'true'
    )
  end

  def track(tracking_number)
    puts "🔄 Відстеження посилки DHL Express: #{tracking_number}"
    puts "=" * 50
    
    begin
      response = @client.track(tracking_number)
      
      if response.success?
        display_shipment_info(response.data)
      else
        puts "❌ Помилка при відстеженні: #{response.error_message}"
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "❌ Виникла помилка: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    unless @site_id && @password
      raise ArgumentError, "Не вказано облікові дані DHL. Встановіть змінні оточення DHL_SITE_ID та DHL_PASSWORD або передайте їх у конструктор."
    end
  end

  def display_shipment_info(shipment_data)
    # Основна інформація про посилку
    shipment = shipment_data[:shipment] || shipment_data['shipment']
    
    if shipment.nil?
      puts "❌ Інформація про посилку не знайдена"
      return
    end

    puts "📦 Інформація про посилку:"
    puts "Номер відстеження: #{shipment[:tracking_number] || shipment['tracking_number']}"
    puts "Статус: #{shipment[:status] || shipment['status']}"
    puts "Послуга: #{shipment[:service] || shipment['service']}"
    
    if shipment[:weight]
      puts "Вага: #{shipment[:weight]} #{shipment[:weight_unit]}"
    end
    
    puts "\n📍 Події доставки:"
    puts "-" * 30

    events = shipment[:events] || shipment['events'] || []
    
    if events.empty?
      puts "ℹ️ Події відсутні"
      return
    end

    # Сортуємо події за датою (від найновіших до найстаріших)
    sorted_events = events.sort_by do |event| 
      DateTime.parse(event[:timestamp] || event['timestamp'] || Time.now.to_s)
    end.reverse

    sorted_events.each_with_index do |event, index|
      display_event(event, index + 1)
    end
  end

  def display_event(event, number)
    timestamp = event[:timestamp] || event['timestamp']
    description = event[:description] || event['description']
    location = event[:location] || event['location']
    status_code = event[:status_code] || event['status_code']

    time = if timestamp
             DateTime.parse(timestamp).strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")
           else
             "Не вказано"
           end

    puts "#{number}. 📍 #{description}"
    puts "   🕐 #{time}"
    puts "   📍 #{location}" if location && !location.empty?
    puts "   🔢 Код статусу: #{status_code}" if status_code
    puts ""
  end
end

# Приклад використання

  # Перевіряємо наявність номера відстеження

    puts "Приклад: ruby track_dhl_express.rb 1234567890"
    exit(1)
  end

  # Створюємо трекер і відстежуємо посилку
  tracker = DHLExpressTracker.new
  tracker.track(tracking_number)
end
```

      else

        response = woocommerce_api.post('products', product.to_api_params)
        if response.success?
          product.id = response.parsed_response['id']
          product
        else
          handle_api_error(response)
          nil
        end
      else
        product
      end
    end

    def update(id, attributes)
      product = new(attributes.merge(id: id))
      if product.valid?
        response = woocommerce_api.put("products/#{id}", product.to_api_params)
        if response.success?
          product
        else
          handle_api_error(response)
          nil
        end

    end

```ruby
class ShippingComparator
  CARRIERS = ['USPS', 'UPS', 'FedEx']  # Add/remove carriers as needed

  def initialize
    # Set your EasyPost API key (store in .env file for security)
    EasyPost.api_key = ENV['EASYPOST_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key_here'
  end

  def compare_rates(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, carrier_accounts = [])
    begin
      # Create addresses
      from_address = EasyPost::Address.create(from_address_params)
      to_address = EasyPost::Address.create(to_address_params)

      # Create parcel
      parcel = EasyPost::Parcel.create(parcel_params)

      # Create shipment
      shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
        to_address: to_address,
        from_address: from_address,
        parcel: parcel,
        carrier_accounts: carrier_accounts
      )

      # Get rates
      shipment.rates

      # Filter rates by available carriers and sort by price
      available_rates = shipment.rates.select { |rate| CARRIERS.include?(rate.carrier) }
                                .sort_by { |rate| rate.rate.to_f }

      if available_rates.empty?
        puts "No shipping rates available for the specified carriers."
        return nil
      end

      puts "Available Shipping Rates:"
      available_rates.each_with_index do |rate, index|
        puts "#{index + 1}. #{rate.carrier} - #{rate.service}: $#{rate.rate} (Est. delivery: #{rate.delivery_days || 'N/A'} days)"
      end

      available_rates

    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      puts "Error getting shipping rates: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def buy_cheapest_label(shipment, rates)
    return nil if rates.nil? || rates.empty?

    cheapest_rate = rates.first
    puts "\nSelected cheapest rate: #{cheapest_rate.carrier} - #{cheapest_rate.service}: $#{cheapest_rate.rate}"

    begin
      # Purchase the label
      shipment.buy(rate: cheapest_rate)
      
      puts "Label purchased successfully!"
      puts "Tracking URL: #{shipment.tracker.public_url}" if shipment.tracker
      puts "Label URL: #{shipment.postage_label.label_url}"
      
      shipment
    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      puts "Error purchasing label: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def create_shipment_and_buy_cheapest(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, carrier_accounts = [])
    # Create addresses
    from_address = EasyPost::Address.create(from_address_params)
    to_address = EasyPost::Address.create(to_address_params)

    # Create parcel
    parcel = EasyPost::Parcel.create(parcel_params)

    # Create shipment
    shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
      to_address: to_address,
      from_address: from_address,
      parcel: parcel,
      carrier_accounts: carrier_accounts
    )

    # Get and compare rates
    rates = compare_rates(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, carrier_accounts)
    
    # Buy the cheapest label
    buy_cheapest_label(shipment, rates) if rates
  end
```

# usps_address_validator.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class USPSAddressValidator
  USPS_API_BASE_URL = 'https://secure.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'
  
  # Address components for validation
  Address = Struct.new(:address1, :address2, :city, :state, :zip5, :zip4, :error, keyword_init: true)
  
  def initialize(usps_user_id = nil)
    @usps_user_id = usps_user_id || ENV['USPS_USER_ID']
    validate_credentials
  end
  
  # Main method to validate and normalize an address
  def validate_address(raw_address)
    # Clean and prepare the address data
    address_data = prepare_address_data(raw_address)
    
    # Validate required fields
    return Address.new(error: 'Missing required fields: address1, city, state, and zip5 are required') unless valid_address_data?(address_data)
    
    # Make API request
    response = make_api_request(address_data)
    
    # Parse and return result
    parse_api_response(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    Address.new(error: "API Error: #{e.message}")
  end
  
  # Batch validation for multiple addresses
  def validate_addresses(addresses)
    addresses.map { |addr| validate_address(addr) }
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    raise 'USPS User ID is required. Set USPS_USER_ID environment variable or pass as argument' unless @usps_user_id
  end
  
  def prepare_address_data(raw_address)
    {
      address1: raw_address[:address1]&.strip&.upcase,
      address2: raw_address[:address2]&.strip&.upcase,
      city: raw_address[:city]&.strip&.upcase,
      state: raw_address[:state]&.strip&.upcase,
      zip5: raw_address[:zip5]&.strip,
      zip4: raw_address[:zip4]&.strip
    }
  end
  
  def valid_address_data?(address_data)
    address_data[:address1].present? && 
    address_data[:city].present? && 
    address_data[:state].present? && 
    address_data[:zip5].present?
  end
  
  def make_api_request(address_data)
    xml_request = build_xml_request(address_data)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(USPS_API_BASE_URL, query: {
      API: 'Verify',
      XML: xml_request
    })
    
    raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" unless response.success?
    response
  end
  
  def build_xml_request(address_data)
    <<~XML
      <AddressValidateRequest USERID="#{@usps_user_id}">
        <Revision>1</Revision>
        <Address ID="0">
          <Address1>#{escape_xml(address_data[:address2])}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{escape_xml(address_data[:address1])}</Address2>
          <City>#{escape_xml(address_data[:city])}</City>
          <State>#{escape_xml(address_data[:state])}</State>
          <Zip5>#{escape_xml(address_data[:zip5])}</Zip5>
          <Zip4>#{escape_xml(address_data[:zip4])}</Zip4>
        </Address>
      </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end
  
  def escape_xml(text)
    return '' unless text.present?
    
    text.to_s.gsub('&', '&')
           .gsub('<', '<')
           .gsub('>', '>')
           .gsub('"', '"')
           .gsub("'", ''')
  end
  
  def parse_api_response(response)
    xml_doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    
    # Check for errors
    error = xml_doc.at_xpath('//Error')
    if error
      error_description = error.at_xpath('Description')&.text || 'Unknown error'
      return Address.new(error: "USPS Error: #{error_description}")
    end
    
    address_node = xml_doc.at_xpath('//Address')
    
    Address.new(
      address1: address_node.at_xpath('Address2')&.text&.strip,
      address2: address_node.at_xpath('Address1')&.text&.strip,
      city: address_node.at_xpath('City')&.text&.strip,
      state: address_node.at_xpath('State')&.text&.strip,
      zip5: address_node.at_xpath('Zip5')&.text&.strip,
      zip4: address_node.at_xpath('Zip4')&.text&.strip
    )
  rescue StandardError => e
    Address.new(error: "Parse Error: #{e.message}")
  end
end

```ruby
# lib/google_merchant_exporter.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'

class GoogleMerchantExporter
  GOOGLE_NAMESPACE = 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
  
  def initialize(products, options = {})
    @products = products
    @options = options
  end
  
  def to_xml
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.rss('version' => '2.0', 
              'xmlns:g' => GOOGLE_NAMESPACE) do
        xml.channel do
          add_channel_info(xml)
          @products.each do |product|
            add_product_item(xml, product)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end
  
  def save_to_file(filename)
    File.write(filename, to_xml)
  end
  
  private
  
  def add_channel_info(xml)
    xml.title @options[:title] || 'Product Feed'
    xml.link @options[:link] || 'https://example.com'
    xml.description @options[:description] || 'Product feed for Google Merchant Center'
  end
  
  def add_product_item(xml, product)
    xml.item do
      # Обов'язкові поля
      xml['g'].id product.id.to_s
      xml.title product.title
      xml.description product.description
      xml.link product.url
      xml['g'].image_link product.image_url
      xml['g'].condition 'new' # або 'used', 'refurbished'
      xml['g'].availability availability_mapping(product.availability)
      xml['g'].price "#{product.price} #{product.currency}"
      xml['g'].brand product.brand
      
      # Додаткові поля
      add_optional_fields(xml, product)
    end
  end
  
  def add_optional_fields(xml, product)
    # GTIN (Global Trade Item Number)
    xml['g'].gtin product.gtin if product.gtin
    
    # MPN (Manufacturer Part Number)
    xml['g'].mpn product.mpn if product.mpn
    
    # Категорія товару
    xml['g'].product_type product.category if product.category
    
    # Стать (для одягу)
    xml['g'].gender product.gender if product.gender
    
    # Вікова група
    xml['g'].age_group product.age_group if product.age_group
    
    # Колір
    xml['g'].color product.color if product.color
    
    # Розмір
    xml['g'].size product.size if product.size
    
    # Матеріал
    xml['g'].material product.material if product.material
    
    # Паттерн
    xml['g'].pattern product.pattern if product.pattern
    
    # Валюта та країна
    xml['g'].currency product.currency if product.currency
    xml['g'].country product.country if product.country
    
    # Обробка замовлень
    xml['g'].shipping do
      xml['g'].country product.shipping_country if product.shipping_country
      xml['g'].service product.shipping_service if product.shipping_service
      xml['g'].price product.shipping_price if product.shipping_price
    end if product.shipping_required?
  end
  
  def availability_mapping(availability)
    case availability.to_s.downcase
    when 'in_stock', 'available'
      'in stock'
    when 'out_of_stock'
      'out of stock'
    when 'preorder'
      'preorder'
    else
      'out of stock'
    end
  end
end
```

      description: 'Product catalogue export',

  def perform(excel_file_path, import_batch_id = nil)
    import_batch = ImportBatch.find(import_batch_id) if import_batch_id
    
    begin
      logger.info "Starting product import from: #{excel_file_path}"
      
      # Update batch status to processing
      import_batch&.update!(status: 'processing', started_at: Time.current)
      
      # Open the Excel file
      spreadsheet = Roo::Excelx.new(excel_file_path)
      
      # Assume first sheet contains the data
      sheet = spreadsheet.sheet(0)
      
      # Get headers (first row)
      headers = sheet.row(1).map(&:downcase).map(&:strip)
      
      # Validate required columns
      required_columns = ['sku', 'name', 'price']
      missing_columns = required_columns - headers
      
      if missing_columns.any?
        error_message = "Missing required columns: #{missing_columns.join(', ')}"
        import_batch&.update!(status: 'failed', error_message: error_message, completed_at: Time.current)
        raise ArgumentError, error_message
      end
      
      products = []
      skipped_rows = []
      processed_count = 0
      successful_count = 0
      
      # Start from row 2 (skip headers)
      (2..sheet.last_row).each do |row_num|
        row_data = sheet.row(row_num)
        row_hash = headers.zip(row_data).to_h
        
        # Skip empty rows
        next if row_hash.values.all?(&:blank?)
        
        processed_count += 1
        
        begin
          # Parse and validate data
          sku = row_hash['sku'].to_s.strip
          name = row_hash['name'].to_s.strip
          price = parse_price(row_hash['price'])
          
          # Skip if required fields are missing
          if sku.blank? || name.blank?
            skipped_rows << { row: row_num, reason: 'Missing SKU or Name' }
            next
          end
        
          # Check if product exists
          existing_product = Product.find_by(sku: sku)
          
          if existing_product
            # Update existing product
            existing_product.update!(name: name, price: price)
            successful_count += 1
          else
            # Create new product for batch insert
            products << Product.new(
              sku: sku,
              name: name,
              price: price,
              created_at: Time.current,
              updated_at: Time.current
            )
          end
          
        rescue => e
          skipped_rows << { row: row_num, reason: e.message }
          logger.error "Error processing row #{row_num}: #{e.message}"
        end
        
        # Batch insert every 1000 records to manage memory
        if products.size >= 1000
          import_results = Product.import(products, validate: false)
          successful_count += import_results.ids.size
          products = []
        end
        
        # Update progress periodically
        if row_num % 500 == 0
          import_batch&.update!(processed_rows: row_num - 1)
        end
      end
      
      # Import any remaining products
      if products.any?
        import_results = Product.import(products, validate: false)
        successful_count += import_results.ids.size
      end
      
      # Final update
      import_batch&.update!(
        status: 'completed',
        processed_rows: processed_count,
        successful_rows: successful_count,
        skipped_rows: skipped_rows.size,
        error_rows: skipped_rows,
        completed_at: Time.current
      )
      
      logger.info "Product import completed: #{successful_count} successful, #{skipped_rows.size} skipped"
      
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Product import failed: #{e.message}"
      logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")

        completed_at: Time.current

    end

```ruby
    # Перевірка формату EAN-13 (13 цифр)
    return false unless code.is_a?(String) && code.match?(/^\d{13}$/)

    sum = 0
    
    digits[0..11].each_with_index do |digit, index|
      sum += index.even? ? digit : digit * 3
    end
    
    check_digit = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
    check_digit == digits[12]

def generate_ean13(base_code)
  base_code = base_code.to_s
  raise ArgumentError, "Базова частина має містити 12 цифр" unless base_code.match?(/^\d{12}$/)
  
  digits = base_code.chars.map(&:to_i)
  sum = 0
  
  digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
    sum += index.even? ? digit * 1 : digit * 3
  end
  
  check_digit = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
  "#{base_code}#{check_digit}"
end
```

```ruby
        total_records: products_data.size,
        processed_records: 0
      )

      results = import_products_in_batches(products_data, import_log)
      
      import_log.update!(
        status: 'completed',
        completed_at: Time.current,
        processed_records: results[:processed],
        failed_records: results[:failed],
        processing_time: Time.current - start_time
      )

      # Очистка файлу після імпорту
      File.delete(file_path) if File.exist?(file_path)
      
      notify_user(user_id, import_log.id) if user_id
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      import_log.update!(
        status: 'failed',
        error_message: e.message,
        completed_at: Time.current
      )
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def import_products_in_batches(products_data, import_log)
    batch_size = 1000
    processed = 0
    failed = 0

    products_data.each_slice(batch_size) do |batch|
      batch_results = Parallel.map(batch, in_threads: 4) do |product_data|
        import_single_product(product_data)
      end

      batch_processed, batch_failed = batch_results.reduce([0, 0]) do |(p, f), result|
        [p + result[:processed], f + result[:failed]]
      end

      processed += batch_processed
      failed += batch_failed

      import_log.update!(
        processed_records: processed,
        failed_records: failed
      )
    end

    { processed: processed, failed: failed }
  end

  def import_single_product(product_data)
    product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(sku: product_data[:sku])
    product.assign_attributes(product_data)
    
    if product.save
      { processed: 1, failed: 0 }
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Помилка збереження товару #{product_data[:sku]}: #{product.errors.full_messages}"
      { processed: 0, failed: 1 }
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Помилка імпорту товару #{product_data[:sku]}: #{e.message}"
    { processed: 0, failed: 1 }
  end

  def notify_user(user_id, import_id)
    user = User.find_by(id: user_id)
    return unless user

    # Відправка email або повідомлення
    UserMailer.import_completed(user, import_id).deliver_later
  end
end
```

    }

```ruby
        image.quality(85)

        thumbnails[size_name] = generate_url(thumbnail_key)

        temp_file.unlink
      end
    end
```

```ruby
class CartAbandonmentCheckJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(user_id)
    redis = Redis.new
    cart_key = "cart:#{user_id}"
    
    cart_data = redis.get(cart_key)
    return unless cart_data

    cart = JSON.parse(cart_data)
    
    # Перевіряємо, чи кошик не оновлювався більше години
    last_updated = Time.parse(cart['updated_at'])
    if Time.now.utc - last_updated > 1.hour && !cart['abandoned']
      # Позначаємо як покинутий
      cart['abandoned'] = true
      cart['abandoned_at'] = Time.now.utc.iso8601
      redis.set(cart_key, cart.to_json)
      
      # Запускаємо процес нагадування
      CartReminderService.new(user_id, cart).send_reminder
    end
  end
```

class EtsyAPIClient

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, access_token = nil)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = access_token
    
    @oauth_client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      client_id,
      client_secret,
      site: API_BASE_URL,
      authorize_url: '/oauth/connect',
      token_url: '/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )
  end
  
  # Отримання URL для авторизації
  def authorization_url(redirect_uri, scopes = [])
    @oauth_client.auth_code.authorize_url(
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      scope: scopes.join(' '),
      response_type: 'code'
    )
  end
  
  # Обмін коду авторизації на токен доступу
  def get_access_token(auth_code, redirect_uri)
    token = @oauth_client.auth_code.get_token(
      auth_code,
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )
    @access_token = token.token
    token
  end

  def make_request(endpoint, method = :get, params = {})
    raise "Access token required" unless @access_token
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => @client_id
    }
    
    url = "#{API_BASE_URL}#{endpoint}"
    
    case method
    when :get
      response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers, query: params)
    when :post
      response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: params.to_json)
    when :put
      response = HTTParty.put(url, headers: headers, body: params.to_json)
    when :delete
      response = HTTParty.delete(url, headers: headers)
    else
      raise "Unsupported HTTP method: #{method}"
    end
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
