class UkrainianSanctionsChecker
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  
  # Official sources for Ukrainian sanctions data
  SANCTIONS_SOURCES = [
    'https://sanctions.nazk.gov.ua/api/sanction/',  # Official NSDC API
    'https://data.gov.ua/dataset/1c7f3815-3259-4e3c-bf0c-18fe3db19d1c'  # Open data portal
  ]
  
  def initialize(company_name)
    @company_name = company_name.to_s.strip
    @sanctions_list = nil
  end
  
  def check
    return { error: 'Company name cannot be empty' } if @company_name.empty?
    
    load_sanctions_data
    search_results = search_company_in_sanctions
    
    {
      company_name: @company_name,
      on_sanctions_list: search_results.any?,
      matches: search_results,
      checked_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
      data_source: 'Ukrainian NSDC Sanctions List'
    }
  end
  
  def check!
    result = check
    raise "Check failed: #{result[:error]}" if result[:error]
    result
  end
  
  private
  
  def load_sanctions_data
    # Try to fetch from the official API first
    @sanctions_list = fetch_from_api || fetch_from_webpage || load_backup_data
  end
  
  def fetch_from_api
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(SANCTIONS_SOURCES[0], timeout: 30)
      if response.success?
        return parse_api_response(response.body)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "API fetch failed: #{e.message}"
    end
    nil
  end
  
  def fetch_from_webpage
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(SANCTIONS_SOURCES[1], timeout: 30)
      if response.success?
        return parse_webpage_response(response.body)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Webpage fetch failed: #{e.message}"
    end
    nil
  end
  
  def parse_api_response(json_data)
    begin
      data = JSON.parse(json_data)
      # Adjust parsing based on actual API response structure
      data.is_a?(Array) ? data : data['results'] || data['sanctions'] || []
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      []
    end
  end
  
  def parse_webpage_response(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    sanctions = []
    
    # Try to find data tables or lists with sanction information
    doc.css('table tr').each do |row|
      cells = row.css('td')
      next if cells.empty?
      
      # Extract company name from table cells (adjust selectors as needed)
      company_cell = cells[0] || cells[1] # Adjust index based on actual structure
      company_name = company_cell.text.strip if company_cell
      
      sanctions << { name: company_name } if company_name && !company_name.empty?
    end
    
    sanctions
  end
  
  def load_backup_data
    # Fallback to a local cache or empty array
    puts "Using backup data - consider updating the data source"
    []
  end
  
  def search_company_in_sanctions
    return [] unless @sanctions_list.is_a?(Array)
    
    matches = []
    normalized_search = normalize_name(@company_name)
    
    @sanctions_list.each do |sanction|
      next unless sanction[:name]
      
      normalized_sanction = normalize_name(sanction[:name])
      
      # Basic exact match
      if normalized_sanction == normalized_search
        matches << {
          matched_name: sanction[:name],
          match_type: 'exact',
          original_data: sanction
        }
      # Partial match for subsidiaries or similar names
      elsif normalized_sanction.include?(normalized_search) || 
            normalized_search.include?(normalized_sanction)
        matches << {
          matched_name: sanction[:name],
          match_type: 'partial',
          original_data: sanction
        }
      end
    end
    
    matches
  end
  
  def normalize_name(name)
    name.to_s.downcase.gsub(/[^a-zа-яєіїґ0-9]/, '').strip
  end
end

require 'httparty'

class EHealthSickLeave
  # API endpoints (these are typically provided by eHealth documentation)
  BASE_URL = 'https://e-health.gov.ua/api'
  AUTH_URL = "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/token"
  SICK_LEAVE_URL = "#{BASE_URL}/sick-leaves"

  def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, private_key_path:, certificate_path:)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(private_key_path))
    @certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(certificate_path))
    @access_token = nil
  end

  # Step 1: Authenticate and get access token
  def authenticate
    jwt_token = generate_jwt_token
    
    response = HTTParty.post(AUTH_URL, 
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      },
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_assertion_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer',
        client_assertion: jwt_token,
        scope: 'sick_leave_write'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
      true
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Step 2: Generate JWT token for authentication
  private def generate_jwt_token
    payload = {
      iss: @client_id,
      sub: @client_id,
      aud: AUTH_URL,
      exp: 5.minutes.from_now.to_i,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      jti: SecureRandom.uuid
    }

    JWT.encode(payload, @private_key, 'RS256', { x5c: [@certificate.to_pem] })
  end

  # Step 3: Create sick leave request
  def create_sick_leave(sick_leave_data)
    unless @access_token
      authenticate
    end

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(SICK_LEAVE_URL, 
      headers: headers,
      body: sick_leave_data.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Sick leave creation failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

require_relative '../config/ehealth_config'

class EHealthApiClient
  def initialize
    @config = EHealth::Config
    @connection = Faraday.new(url: @config.base_url) do |f|
      f.request :multipart
      f.request :url_encoded
      f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      f.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    end
  end

  # Отримання access token
  def get_access_token
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(@config.private_key_path))
    
    payload = {
      iss: @config.client_id,
      aud: @config.base_url,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300
    }
    
    assertion = JWT.encode(payload, private_key, 'RS256')
    
    response = @connection.post('/api/oauth/token') do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      req.body = URI.encode_www_form({
        grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
        assertion: assertion,
        client_id: @config.client_id,
        client_secret: @config.client_secret
      })
    end
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання токену: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Створення медичної декларації
  def create_medical_declaration(declaration_data)
    access_token = get_access_token
    
    response = @connection.post('/api/declarations') do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{access_token}"
      req.body = declaration_data.to_json
    end
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання статусу декларації
  def get_declaration_status(declaration_id)
    access_token = get_access_token
    
    response = @connection.get("/api/declarations/#{declaration_id}") do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{access_token}"
    end
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "Помилка API: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
      puts error_message
      { error: error_message, status: response.status }
    end
  end
end

require 'kalyna'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class KalynaEncryptor
  # Kalyna block sizes (in bits)
  BLOCK_SIZES = {
    128 => 16,  # 16 bytes
    256 => 32,  # 32 bytes
    512 => 64   # 64 bytes
  }.freeze

  def initialize(key_size: 256, block_size: 128)
    unless BLOCK_SIZES.key?(key_size) && BLOCK_SIZES.key?(block_size)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid key size or block size. Supported sizes: #{BLOCK_SIZES.keys}"
    end
    
    @key_size = key_size
    @block_size = block_size
    @block_bytes = BLOCK_SIZES[block_size]
  end

  # Generate a random Kalyna key
  def generate_key
    Kalyna::Key.new(@key_size, @block_size)
  end

  # Encrypt a file for a recipient
  def encrypt_file(input_file, output_file, recipient_public_key = nil)
    # Generate a random symmetric key for Kalyna
    kalyna_key = generate_key
    
    # Encrypt the symmetric key with recipient's public key (if provided)
    encrypted_key_data = if recipient_public_key
      encrypt_key_with_rsa(kalyna_key.to_bytes, recipient_public_key)
    else
      # If no public key provided, just base64 encode the key
      Base64.strict_encode64(kalyna_key.to_bytes)
    end

    # Read and encrypt the file content
    file_content = File.binread(input_file)
    encrypted_content = encrypt_data(file_content, kalyna_key)

    # Write encrypted data to output file
    File.open(output_file, 'wb') do |f|
      # Write header with key information
      f.write([@key_size, @block_size].pack('NN'))
      
      # Write encrypted key
      key_data = encrypted_key_data.force_encoding('ASCII-8BIT')
      f.write([key_data.bytesize].pack('N'))
      f.write(key_data)
      
      # Write encrypted content
      f.write(encrypted_content)
    end

    puts "File encrypted successfully: #{input_file} -> #{output_file}"
    puts "Key size: #{@key_size} bits, Block size: #{@block_size} bits"
  end

  # Decrypt a file (for completeness)
  def decrypt_file(input_file, output_file, private_key = nil)
    File.open(input_file, 'rb') do |f|
      # Read header
      key_size, block_size = f.read(8).unpack('NN')
      
      # Read encrypted key
      key_length = f.read(4).unpack('N').first
      encrypted_key_data = f.read(key_length)
      
      # Decrypt the symmetric key
      kalyna_key_bytes = if private_key
        decrypt_key_with_rsa(encrypted_key_data, private_key)
      else
        Base64.strict_decode64(encrypted_key_data)
      end
      
      kalyna_key = Kalyna::Key.from_bytes(kalyna_key_bytes, key_size, block_size)
      
      # Read and decrypt the content
      encrypted_content = f.read
      decrypted_content = decrypt_data(encrypted_content, kalyna_key)
      
      # Write decrypted content
      File.binwrite(output_file, decrypted_content)
    end

    puts "File decrypted successfully: #{input_file} -> #{output_file}"
  end

  private

  # Encrypt data using Kalyna in CBC mode
  def encrypt_data(data, key)
    # Pad data to block size
    padded_data = pad_data(data, @block_bytes)
    
    # Generate random IV
    iv = OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(@block_bytes)
    
    # Encrypt using Kalyna in CBC mode
    cipher = Kalyna.new(key, :CBC)
    encrypted = cipher.encrypt(padded_data, iv)
    
    # Return IV + encrypted data
    iv + encrypted
  end

  # Decrypt data using Kalyna in CBC mode
  def decrypt_data(encrypted_data, key)
    # Extract IV and encrypted content
    iv = encrypted_data[0...@block_bytes]
    content = encrypted_data[@block_bytes..-1]
    
    # Decrypt
    cipher = Kalyna.new(key, :CBC)
    decrypted = cipher.decrypt(content, iv)
    
    # Remove padding
    unpad_data(decrypted)
  end

  # Pad data to block size using PKCS7
  def pad_data(data, block_size)
    padding_length = block_size - (data.bytesize % block_size)
    padding_length = block_size if padding_length == 0
    padding = padding_length.chr * padding_length
    data + padding
  end

  # Remove PKCS7 padding
  def unpad_data(data)
    padding_length = data.bytes.last
    data[0...-padding_length]
  end

# kalina_encryptor.rb

require 'kalina_cipher'
require 'bindata'
require 'openssl'

class KalinaFileEncryptor
  BLOCK_SIZE = 16  # Розмір блоку для Калини (128 біт)
  
  def initialize(key, iv)
    @key = key
    @iv = iv
    @cipher = KalinaCipher.new(key, iv)
  end
  
  def encrypt_file(input_file, output_file)
    # Перевірка розміру ключа (має бути 256 біт = 32 байти)
    validate_key_size
    
    File.open(input_file, 'rb') do |input|
      File.open(output_file, 'wb') do |output|
        # Записуємо IV на початок файлу для використання при розшифруванні
        output.write(@iv)
        
        # Обробляємо файл по блоках
        while block = input.read(BLOCK_SIZE)
          # Доповнюємо останній блок якщо потрібно
          padded_block = pad_block(block)
          
          # Шифруємо блок
          encrypted_block = @cipher.encrypt(padded_block)
          
          # Записуємо зашифрований блок
          output.write(encrypted_block)
        end
      end
    end
    
    puts "Файл успішно зашифровано: #{output_file}"
  end
  
  def decrypt_file(input_file, output_file)
    File.open(input_file, 'rb') do |input|
      File.open(output_file, 'wb') do |output|
        # Читаємо IV з початку файлу
        file_iv = input.read(BLOCK_SIZE)
        @cipher.iv = file_iv
        
        # Обробляємо зашифрований файл по блокам
        while encrypted_block = input.read(BLOCK_SIZE)
          # Розшифровуємо блок
          decrypted_block = @cipher.decrypt(encrypted_block)
          
          # Записуємо розшифрований блок
          output.write(decrypted_block)
        end
      end
    end
    
    puts "Файл успішно розшифровано: #{output_file}"
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_key_size
    unless @key.bytesize == 32
      raise ArgumentError, "Ключ має бути розміром 256 біт (32 байти)"
    end
  end
  
  def pad_block(block)
    # Доповнення PKCS7
    padding_size = BLOCK_SIZE - block.bytesize
    padding = padding_size.chr * padding_size
    block + padding
  end

**Реалізація (kupyna.rb):**
```ruby
require 'bindata'
require 'openssl'

class Kupyna
  # Константи згідно ДСТУ 7564
  BLOCK_SIZE = 512
  DIGEST_SIZE = 256 # 256 біт = 32 байти
  
  def initialize
    @buffer = ""
    @total_length = 0
  end
  
  def update(data)
    @buffer << data
    process_blocks while @buffer.bytesize >= BLOCK_SIZE / 8
    self
  end
  
  def digest
    # Доповнення повідомлення
    padded = pad_message(@buffer)
    
    # Обробка блоків
    state = initial_state
    padded.bytes.each_slice(BLOCK_SIZE / 8) do |block|
      state = process_block(state, block)
    end
    
    # Фінальне перетворення
    final_state = final_transform(state)
    
    # Повернення гешу (32 байти для Kupyna-256)
    final_state.flatten.pack('C*')
  end
  
  def hexdigest
    digest.unpack1('H*')
  end
  
  private
  
  def initial_state
    Array.new(8) { Array.new(8, 0) }
  end
  
  def pad_message(message)
    # Доповнення за стандартом SHA: додаємо біт '1', потім нулі, потім довжину повідомлення
    bit_length = @total_length + message.bytesize * 8
    padded = message.dup
    padded << "\x80"
    
    # Додаємо нулі до довжини, що залишає 64 біти для довжини повідомлення
    padding_size = (BLOCK_SIZE / 8) - ((padded.bytesize + 8) % (BLOCK_SIZE / 8))
    padded << "\0" * padding_size
    
    # Додаємо довжину повідомлення у бітах (64-бітне big-endian число)
    padded << [bit_length >> 64].pack('Q>') # старші 64 біти
    padded << [bit_length & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF].pack('Q>') # молодші 64 біти
    
    padded
  end
  
  def process_block(state, block)
    # Це спрощена імітація - реальна Kupyna має складніші перетворення
    # У реальній реалізації тут були б:
    # 1. Перетворення T (нелінійне байтове перетворення)
    # 2. Перетворення π (перестановка байтів)
    # 3. Перетворення τ (циклічний зсув рядків)
    # 4. Перетворення χ (модифіковане множення матриць)
    
    # Тимчасова заглушка - використовуємо XOR для демонстрації
    block_matrix = block.each_slice(8).to_a
    
    8.times do |i|
      8.times do |j|
        state[i][j] ^= block_matrix[i][j] || 0
      end
    end
    
    # Імітація раундових перетворень (спрощено)
    10.times do |round|
      state = round_function(state, round)
    end
    
    state
  end
  
  def round_function(state, round)
    # Спрощена імітація раундової функції
    # У реальній Kupyna тут були б складні перетворення
    new_state = Array.new(8) { Array.new(8, 0) }
    
    8.times do |i|
      8.times do |j|
        # Просте перетворення для демонстрації
        new_state[i][j] = (state[i][j] + state[j][i] + round) & 0xFF
      end
    end
    
    new_state
  end
  
  def final_transform(state)
    # Фінальне перетворення (спрощено)
    final_state = Array.new(8) { Array.new(8, 0) }
    
    8.times do |i|
      8.times do |j|
        final_state[i][j] = state[i][j] ^ state[7-i][7-j]
      end
    end
    
    final_state
  end
end

require 'kupyna'

class UkrainianKupynaHash
  # Supported hash sizes (in bits)
  SUPPORTED_SIZES = [256, 384, 512]
  
  def initialize(digest_size = 256)
    unless SUPPORTED_SIZES.include?(digest_size)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported digest size. Supported sizes: #{SUPPORTED_SIZES.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    @digest_size = digest_size
    @kupyna = Kupyna.new(digest_size)
  end
  
  # Hash a string
  def hash_string(text)
    @kupyna.digest(text)
  end
  
  # Hash a file
  def hash_file(file_path)
    File.open(file_path, 'rb') do |file|
      @kupyna.digest(file.read)
    end
  end
  
  # Get hash as hexadecimal string
  def hexdigest_string(text)
    @kupyna.hexdigest(text)
  end
  
  # Get file hash as hexadecimal string
  def hexdigest_file(file_path)
    File.open(file_path, 'rb') do |file|
      @kupyna.hexdigest(file.read)
    end
  end
  
  # Reset the hash computation
  def reset
    @kupyna.reset
  end
  
  # Update hash incrementally
  def update(data)
    @kupyna.update(data)
    self
  end
  
  # Finalize and get the hash
  def final
    @kupyna.digest
  end
  
  # Get the digest size in bytes
  def digest_length
    @digest_size / 8
  end
end

    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(
      ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID'],

    )
    @from_number = ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER']

    verification_code = SecureRandom.random_number(1000000).to_s.rjust(6, '0')
    
    # Зберігання коду (з timestamp для терміну дії)
    @verification_codes[phone_number] = {
      code: verification_code,
      created_at: Time.now,
      attempts: 0
    }
    
    # Відправка SMS через Twilio
    message = @client.messages.create(
      body: "Ваш код підтвердження: #{verification_code}. Код дійсний 10 хвилин.",
      from: @from_number,
      to: phone_number
    )

  rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
    { success: false, error: e.message }
  end

  # Перевірка введеного коду
  def verify_code(phone_number, entered_code)
    stored_data = @verification_codes[phone_number]
    
    # Перевірка чи код існує

    # Перевірка терміну дії (10 хвилин)
    if Time.now - stored_data[:created_at] > 600 # 10 хвилин у секундах
      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number)
      return { success: false, error: 'Термін дії коду минув' }
    end

    # Збільшення лічильника спроб
    stored_data[:attempts] += 1
    
    # Перевірка коду

      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number) # Видаляємо після успішної перевірки

    else
      { success: false, error: 'Невірний код' }

  end

require 'telegram/bot'

  def initialize
    @token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new('orders.db')
    @db.results_as_hash = true
  end

  def run
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.listen do |message|
        case message
        when Telegram::Bot::Types::Message
          handle_message(bot, message)
        when Telegram::Bot::Types::CallbackQuery
          handle_callback(bot, message)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(bot, message)
    user_id = message.from.id
    register_user(message.from) unless user_exists?(user_id)

    case message.text
    when '/start'
      send_welcome(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/help'
      send_help(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/myorders'
      send_user_orders(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
    when '/status'
      request_order_number(bot, message.chat.id)
    else
      if message.text&.start_with?('#')
        check_order_status(bot, message.chat.id, message.text)
      else
        send_unknown_command(bot, message.chat.id)
      end
    end
  end

  def handle_callback(bot, callback)
    data = callback.data
    chat_id = callback.message.chat.id

    case data
    when 'my_orders'
      send_user_orders(bot, chat_id, callback.from.id)
    when 'check_status'
      request_order_number(bot, chat_id)
    end

  def register_user(user_info)

      [user_info.id, user_info.username, user_info.first_name, user_info.last_name]
    )
  end

  def user_exists?(telegram_id)

class WhatsAppTemplateSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0'

  def initialize(phone_number_id, access_token)
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @access_token = access_token
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Send a template message to a recipient
  # @param to [String] Phone number in international format (e.g., "1234567890")
  # @param template_name [String] Name of the approved template
  # @param language_code [String] Language code (e.g., "en", "es")
  # @param components [Array] Optional components for the template
  # @return [Hash] API response
  def send_template_message(to, template_name, language_code: 'en', components: [])
    # Format phone number with country code (remove any non-digit characters)
    formatted_to = to.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: formatted_to,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Add components if provided
    payload[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Helper method to create header component
  def self.create_header_component(parameters)
    {
      type: 'header',
      parameters: parameters
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create body component
  def self.create_body_component(parameters)
    {
      type: 'body',
      parameters: parameters
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create parameter with text
  def self.create_text_parameter(text)
    {
      type: 'text',
      text: text
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create parameter with currency
  def self.create_currency_parameter(amount, currency_code = 'USD')
    {
      type: 'currency',
      currency: {
        fallback_value: amount,
        code: currency_code,
        amount_1000: (amount.to_f * 1000).to_i
      }
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create parameter with date/time
  def self.create_date_time_parameter(timestamp)
    {
      type: 'date_time',
      date_time: {
        fallback_value: timestamp.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')
      }
    }
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response.parsed_response['messages'].first['id'],
        response: response.parsed_response
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: response.parsed_response['error'],
        status_code: response.code
      }
    end
  end

require 'fcm'

class FirebaseMessagingService
  def initialize(server_key)
    @fcm = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на один пристрій
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }

    response = @fcm.send([device_token], options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на кілька пристроїв
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }

    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на тему (topic)
  def send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }

    response = @fcm.send_to_topic(topic, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення з додатковими параметрами
  def send_advanced_notification(device_tokens, options)
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Підписка пристрою на тему
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_token, topic)
    response = @fcm.topic_subscription(topic, [device_token])
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Відписка пристрою від теми
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_token, topic)
    response = @fcm.topic_unsubscription(topic, [device_token])
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      if body['failure'] == 0
        { success: true, message: 'Notification sent successfully', response: body }
      else
        { success: false, message: "Failed to send some notifications", response: body }
      end
    else
      { success: false, message: "HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}", response: response }
    end
  end
end

class WebpushService
  class WebpushError < StandardError; end
  
  def self.send_notification(subscription, message, options = {})
    begin
      # Convert subscription to webpush format if it's an ActiveRecord object
      subscription_data = subscription.respond_to?(:to_webpush) ? subscription.to_webpush : subscription
      
      # Default options
      default_options = {
        message: JSON.generate(message),
        vapid: {
          public_key: ENV['VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY'],
          private_key: ENV['VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY'],
          subject: ENV['VAPID_SUBJECT'] || 'mailto:admin@example.com'
        }
      }
      
      # Merge with provided options
      push_options = default_options.merge(options)
      
      # Send the notification
      response = Webpush.payload_send(push_options.merge(subscription: subscription_data))
      
      # Check if the subscription is expired or invalid
      if response&.is_a?(Net::HTTPGone) || response&.is_a?(Net::HTTPNotFound)
        handle_expired_subscription(subscription)
        return false
      end
      
      true
    rescue Webpush::InvalidSubscription, Webpush::ExpiredSubscription => e
      handle_expired_subscription(subscription)
      false
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error "Webpush error: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
  
  def self.send_notification_to_all(subscriptions, message, options = {})
    subscriptions.map do |subscription|
      send_notification(subscription, message, options)
    end
  end
  
  def self.broadcast_notification(message, options = {})
    subscriptions = PushSubscription.all
    send_notification_to_all(subscriptions, message, options)
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.handle_expired_subscription(subscription)
    if subscription.respond_to?(:destroy)
      subscription.destroy
      Rails.logger.info "Removed expired push subscription: #{subscription.endpoint}"
    end
  end
end

# lib/mailchimp_service.rb
require 'mailchimp_api'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class MailchimpService
  class MailchimpError < StandardError; end

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['MAILCHIMP_API_KEY']
    @audience_id = ENV['MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID']
    
    validate_configuration
    @client = Mailchimp::API.new(@api_key)
  end

  def add_subscriber(email, options = {})
    validate_email(email)
    
    subscriber_data = {
      email_address: email,
      status: 'subscribed'
    }.merge(options)

    begin
      response = @client.lists.subscribe(@audience_id, subscriber_data)
      {
        success: true,
        subscriber_id: response['id'],
        email: response['email_address']
      }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListAlreadySubscribedError
      { success: false, error: 'Email is already subscribed' }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListDoesNotExistError
      { success: false, error: 'Mailchimp audience not found' }
    rescue Mailchimp::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "Mailchimp API error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  def get_subscriber(email)
    begin
      response = @client.lists.member_info(@audience_id, [{ email: email }])
      member = response['data'].first
      member ? { found: true, status: member['status'] } : { found: false }
    rescue Mailchimp::Error => e
      { found: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_configuration
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
      raise MailchimpError, 'MAILCHIMP_API_KEY environment variable is not set'
    end
    
    if @audience_id.nil? || @audience_id.empty?
      raise MailchimpError, 'MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID environment variable is not set'
    end
  end

  def validate_email(email)
    unless email =~ /\A[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\z/
      raise MailchimpError, 'Invalid email format'
    end
  end
end

class MailchimpService
  class MailchimpError < StandardError; end

  def initialize
    @client = Mailchimp::API.new(ENV['MAILCHIMP_API_KEY'])
    @audience_id = ENV['MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID'] # ID вашої аудиторії
  end

  def subscribe_user(email, options = {})
    raise MailchimpError, "Email не може бути пустим" if email.blank?
    raise MailchimpError, "ID аудиторії не встановлено" if @audience_id.blank?

    merge_vars = {
      'FNAME' => options[:first_name],
      'LNAME' => options[:last_name]
    }.compact

    begin
      response = @client.lists.subscribe(
        @audience_id,
        { 'email' => email.downcase.strip },
        merge_vars,
        'html', # Тип email (html/text)
        options[:double_optin] || false, # Підтвердження підписки
        options[:update_existing] || true, # Оновлювати існуючих підписників
        options[:send_welcome] || false # Надсилати вітальний email
      )

      {
        success: true,
        email: response['email'],
        unique_email_id: response['euid'],
        leid: response['leid']
      }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListAlreadySubscribedError
      { success: false, error: "Користувач вже підписаний" }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListDoesNotExistError
      { success: false, error: "Аудиторія не знайдена" }
    rescue Mailchimp::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка Mailchimp: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Неочікувана помилка: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Перевіряє статус підписки користувача
  def subscription_status(email)
    begin
      member_info = @client.lists.member_info(@audience_id, [{ 'email' => email }])
      member = member_info['data'].first

      return { status: 'not_found' } unless member

      {
        status: member['status'],
        email: member['email'],
        timestamp: member['timestamp']
      }
    rescue Mailchimp::EmailNotExistsError
      { status: 'not_found' }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { status: 'error', error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Видаляє підписника з аудиторії
  def unsubscribe_user(email)
    begin
      @client.lists.unsubscribe(@audience_id, { 'email' => email })
      { success: true }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/jobs/support_ticket_creator_job.rb
class SupportTicketCreatorJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(email_raw)
    email = Mail.read_from_string(email_raw)
    
    SupportTicket.transaction do
      support_ticket = create_support_ticket_from_email(email)
      process_attachments(email, support_ticket) if support_ticket.persisted?
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to create support ticket from email: #{e.message}"
    # Consider sending a failure notification
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_support_ticket_from_email(email)
    subject = email.subject.presence || "Support Request from #{email.from&.first}"
    
    SupportTicket.create!(
      subject: subject.truncate(255),
      description: extract_email_body(email),
      requester_email: extract_requester_email(email),
      metadata: {
        original_subject: email.subject,
        received_at: email.date,
        message_id: email.message_id
      }
    )
  end
  
  def process_attachments(email, support_ticket)
    email.attachments.each do |attachment|
      next unless valid_attachment?(attachment)
      
      ticket_attachment = support_ticket.ticket_attachments.build(
        filename: attachment.filename,
        content_type: attachment.content_type,
        file_size: attachment.body.decoded.bytesize
      )
      
      # Save file using Active Storage
      ticket_attachment.file.attach(
        io: StringIO.new(attachment.body.decoded),
        filename: sanitize_filename(attachment.filename),
        content_type: attachment.content_type
      )
      
      ticket_attachment.save!
    end
  end
  
  def extract_email_body(email)
    if email.text_part
      email.text_part.body.decoded
    elsif email.html_part
      # Strip HTML tags for plain text
      ActionController::Base.helpers.strip_tags(email.html_part.body.decoded)
    else
      email.body.decoded
    end
  end
  
  def extract_requester_email(email)
    email.from&.first || email.reply_to&.first || 'unknown@example.com'
  end
  
  def valid_attachment?(attachment)
    return false if attachment.filename.blank?
    return false if attachment.body.decoded.bytesize > 25.megabytes # Size limit
    
    # Add more security checks as needed
    true
  end
  
  def sanitize_filename(filename)
    # Remove any path components and sanitize the filename
    File.basename(filename).gsub(/[^0-9A-Za-z.\-]/, '_')
  end
end

require 'sendgrid-ruby'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

class SendGridEmailSender
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['SENDGRID_API_KEY']
    @client = SendGrid::API.new(api_key: @api_key).client
  end

  # Send email using a dynamic template
  # @param to_email [String] Recipient email address
  # @param template_id [String] SendGrid dynamic template ID
  # @param dynamic_template_data [Hash] Data to populate the template
  # @param from_email [String] Sender email address
  # @param from_name [String] Sender name (optional)
  # @param subject [String] Email subject (optional, can be set in template)
  # @param reply_to [String] Reply-to email (optional)
  # @return [Boolean] true if successful, false otherwise
  def send_email(
    to_email:, 
    template_id:, 
    dynamic_template_data: {},
    from_email: nil,
    from_name: nil,
    subject: nil,
    reply_to: nil
  )
    from_email ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL']
    from_name ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_NAME']

    # Validate required parameters
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
      raise "SendGrid API key is required. Set SENDGRID_API_KEY environment variable or pass api_key parameter."
    end

    if from_email.nil? || from_email.empty?
      raise "From email is required. Set SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL environment variable or pass from_email parameter."
    end

    # Create mail object
    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.subject = subject if subject
    
    # Add recipient
    personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
    personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: to_email))
    personalization.dynamic_template_data = dynamic_template_data
    mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    
    # Set template ID
    mail.template_id = template_id
    
    # Set reply-to if provided
    mail.reply_to = SendGrid::Email.new(email: reply_to) if reply_to

    # Send email
    response = @client.mail._('send').post(request_body: mail.to_json)
    
    if response.status_code.to_i >= 200 && response.status_code.to_i < 300
      puts "Email sent successfully to #{to_email}"
      true
    else
      puts "Failed to send email. Status: #{response.status_code}, Body: #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error sending email: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  # Send email to multiple recipients with personalized data
  # @param recipients [Array<Hash>] Array of recipient hashes with email and personal data
  # @param template_id [String] SendGrid dynamic template ID
  # @param from_email [String] Sender email address
  # @param from_name [String] Sender name (optional)
  # @return [Boolean] true if successful, false otherwise
  def send_bulk_email(recipients:, template_id:, from_email: nil, from_name: nil)
    from_email ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL']
    from_name ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_NAME']

    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.template_id = template_id

    # Add each recipient with their personalized data
    recipients.each do |recipient|
      personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
      personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: recipient[:email]))
      personalization.dynamic_template_data = recipient[:data] || {}
      mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    end

    response = @client.mail._('send').post(request_body: mail.to_json)
    
    if response.status_code.to_i >= 200 && response.status_code.to_i < 300
      puts "Bulk email sent successfully to #{recipients.size} recipients"
      true
    else
      puts "Failed to send bulk email. Status: #{response.status_code}, Body: #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error sending bulk email: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class WhatsAppMessenger
  BASE_URL = "https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0"

  def initialize
    @access_token = ENV['WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @phone_number_id = ENV['WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID']
    validate_credentials
  end

  # Надсилання шаблонного повідомлення
  def send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code = "en", components = [])
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    body = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: format_phone_number(to_phone_number),
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Додаємо компоненти якщо вони є
    body[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надсилання шаблону з параметрами
  def send_template_with_parameters(to_phone_number, template_name, parameters, language_code = "en")
    components = [{
      type: 'body',
      parameters: parameters.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
    }]

    send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code, components)
  end

  # Приклад: шаблон з кнопками
  def send_template_with_buttons(to_phone_number, template_name, button_parameters, language_code = "en")
    body_parameters = button_parameters[:body] || []
    buttons = button_parameters[:buttons] || []

    components = []

    # Додаємо тіло повідомлення з параметрами
    unless body_parameters.empty?
      components << {
        type: 'body',
        parameters: body_parameters.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
      }
    end

    # Додаємо кнопки
    unless buttons.empty?
      components << {
        type: 'button',
        index: 0,
        sub_type: 'quick_reply',
        parameters: buttons.map { |button| { type: 'payload', payload: button[:payload] } }
      }
    end

    send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code, components)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{message_id}"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання інформації про шаблони
  def get_templates(business_account_id = ENV['WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID'])
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{business_account_id}/message_templates"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    raise "WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set" unless @access_token
    raise "WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID is not set" unless @phone_number_id
  end

  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Видаляємо всі нечислові символи крім +
    phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "HTTP #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
      raise WhatsAppAPIError.new(error_message, response.code, response.body)
    end
  end
end

# Клас для обробки помилок API
class WhatsAppAPIError < StandardError
  attr_reader :status_code, :response_body

  def initialize(message, status_code, response_body)
    super(message)
    @status_code = status_code
    @response_body = response_body
  end
end

  end

  # Надсилання листа з динамічним шаблоном
  def send_dynamic_template(to_email, template_id, dynamic_data, from_email = nil, from_name = nil, subject = nil)
    from_email ||= ENV['DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL'] || 'noreply@example.com'
    from_name ||= ENV['DEFAULT_FROM_NAME'] || 'Your App'
    
    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.subject = subject if subject
    
    # Додаємо отримувача
    personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
    personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: to_email))
    personalization.dynamic_template_data = dynamic_data
    mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    
    # Встановлюємо шаблон
    mail.template_id = template_id

    begin
      response = @sendgrid.client.mail._('send').post(request_body: mail.to_json)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання листа кільком отримувачам
  def send_bulk_dynamic_template(recipients, template_id, dynamic_data_proc, from_email = nil, from_name = nil)
    from_email ||= ENV['DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL'] || 'noreply@example.com'
    from_name ||= ENV['DEFAULT_FROM_NAME'] || 'Your App'
    
    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.template_id = template_id

    # Додаємо кожного отримувача з його динамічними даними
    recipients.each do |recipient|
      personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
      personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: recipient[:email]))
      
      # Використовуємо proc для отримання динамічних даних для кожного отримувача
      dynamic_data = dynamic_data_proc.call(recipient)
      personalization.dynamic_template_data = dynamic_data
      
      mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    end

    begin
      response = @sendgrid.client.mail._('send').post(request_body: mail.to_json)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу доставки (потребує додаткового плану SendGrid)
  def get_email_stats(start_date = Date.today - 7, end_date = Date.today)
    query_params = {
      'start_date' => start_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
      'end_date' => end_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    }

    begin
      response = @sendgrid.client.stats.get(query_params: query_params)
      JSON.parse(response.body) if response.status_code == '200'
    rescue => e
      { error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.status_code.start_with?('2')
      { 
        success: true, 
        message_id: JSON.parse(response.body)['message_id'],
        status_code: response.status_code
      }
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: response.body,
        status_code: response.status_code
      }
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# fcm_notification_service.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'json'

class FCMNotificationService
  attr_reader :fcm_client

  # Initialize with your Firebase Server Key
  def initialize(server_key)
    @fcm_client = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: body
    }

    message = {
      to: device_token,
      notification: notification,
      data: data
    }

    send_notification(message)
  end

  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: body
    }

    message = {
      registration_ids: device_tokens,
      notification: notification,
      data: data
    }

    send_notification(message)
  end

  # Send notification to a topic
  def send_to_topic(topic_name, title, body, data = {})
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: body
    }

    message = {
      condition: "'#{topic_name}' in topics",
      notification: notification,
      data: data
    }

    send_notification(message)
  end

  # Send custom notification with advanced options
  def send_custom_notification(message_payload)
    send_notification(message_payload)
  end

  # Subscribe device to a topic
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_tokens, topic_name)
    fcm_client.topic_subscription(device_tokens, topic_name)
  end

  # Unsubscribe device from a topic
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_tokens, topic_name)
    fcm_client.topic_unsubscription(device_tokens, topic_name)
  end

  private

  def send_notification(message)
    begin
      response = fcm_client.send(message)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      result = {
        success: true,
        status_code: response[:status_code],
        message_id: body['message_id'],
        multicast_id: body['multicast_id'],
        success_count: body['success'],
        failure_count: body['failure'],
        canonical_ids: body['canonical_ids'],
        results: body['results']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        status_code: response[:status_code],
        error: response[:body]
      }
    end
  end
end

class TicketAttachment < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :support_ticket
  has_one_attached :file
  
  validates :file, presence: true
  validate :validate_file_type
  
  private
  
  def validate_file_type
    return unless file.attached?
    
    allowed_types = %w[image/jpeg image/png image/gif application/pdf 
                      text/plain application/msword application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document]
    
    unless allowed_types.include?(file.content_type)
      errors.add(:file, 'must be a JPEG, PNG, GIF, PDF, or text file')
    end
    
    if file.blob.byte_size > 10.megabytes
      errors.add(:file, 'size must be less than 10MB')
    end
  end
end

# teams_webhook_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class TeamsWebhookSender
  def initialize(webhook_url)
    @webhook_url = webhook_url
    validate_webhook_url
  end

  def send_simple_message(title, message, theme_color = '0076D7')
    payload = {
      '@type' => 'MessageCard',
      '@context' => 'https://schema.org/extensions',
      'themeColor' => theme_color,
      'title' => title,
      'text' => message
    }

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  def send_advanced_message(title, sections = [], potential_actions = [], theme_color = '0076D7')
    payload = {
      '@type' => 'MessageCard',
      '@context' => 'https://schema.org/extensions',
      'themeColor' => theme_color,
      'title' => title,
      'sections' => sections,
      'potentialAction' => potential_actions
    }

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  def send_payload(payload)
    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        @webhook_url,
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
        }
      )

      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      puts "HTTP Error: #{e.message}"
      false
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_webhook_url
    unless @webhook_url&.start_with?('https://')
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid webhook URL. Must start with https://'
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      puts "Message sent successfully!"
      true
    when 400
      puts "Bad request: #{response.body}"
      false
    when 401
      puts "Unauthorized: Invalid webhook URL"
      false
    when 404
      puts "Webhook URL not found"
      false
    when 500..599
      puts "Server error: #{response.body}"
      false
    else
      puts "Unexpected response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  end
end

# apns_notification_sender.rb
require 'apnotic'
require 'jwt'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'json'

class APNSNotificationSender
  def initialize(team_id:, key_id:, key_file:, bundle_id:, pool_size: 5, timeout: 30)
    @team_id = team_id
    @key_id = key_id
    @key_file = key_file
    @bundle_id = bundle_id
    @pool_size = pool_size
    @timeout = timeout
    
    # Create a connection pool for better performance
    @connection_pool = ConnectionPool.new(size: pool_size, timeout: timeout) do
      create_apns_connection
    end
  end

  # Send a push notification to a single device
  def send_notification(device_token, title: nil, body: nil, badge: nil, sound: 'default', 
                       custom_data: {}, category: nil, thread_id: nil, mutable_content: false,
                       content_available: false, priority: 10, expiration: nil, topic: nil)
    
    notification = build_notification(
      device_token: device_token,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      badge: badge,
      sound: sound,
      custom_data: custom_data,
      category: category,
      thread_id: thread_id,
      mutable_content: mutable_content,
      content_available: content_available,
      priority: priority,
      expiration: expiration,
      topic: topic
    )

    @connection_pool.with do |connection|
      response = connection.push(notification)
      
      if response.ok?
        puts "Notification sent successfully!"
        return true
      else
        puts "Failed to send notification: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
        handle_error_response(response)
        return false
      end
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error sending notification: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  # Send the same notification to multiple devices
  def send_bulk_notifications(device_tokens, **notification_params)
    results = {}
    
    device_tokens.each do |token|
      results[token] = send_notification(token, **notification_params)
    end
    
    results
  end

  # Close all connections in the pool
  def close_connections
    @connection_pool.shutdown { |conn| conn.close }
  end

  private

  def create_apns_connection
    # Generate JWT token for authentication
    token = generate_jwt_token
    
    Apnotic::Connection.new(
      auth_method: :token,
      cert_path: StringIO.new(@key_file),
      key_id: @key_id,
      team_id: @team_id,
      token: token,
      url: Rails.env.production? ? Apnotic::Connection::PRODUCTION_URL : Apnotic::Connection::DEVELOPMENT_URL
    )
  end

  def generate_jwt_token
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(@key_file)
    
    payload = {
      iss: @team_id,
      iat: Time.now.to_i
    }
    
    headers = {
      kid: @key_id
    }
    
    JWT.encode(payload, private_key, 'ES256', headers)
  end

  def build_notification(device_token:, title:, body:, badge:, sound:, custom_data:, 
                        category:, thread_id:, mutable_content:, content_available:, 
                        priority:, expiration:, topic:)
    notification = Apnotic::Notification.new(device_token)
    notification.topic = topic || @bundle_id
    
    # Basic notification payload
    notification.alert = {
      title: title,
      body: body
    } if title && body
    
    notification.badge = badge if badge
    notification.sound = sound
    notification.category = category if category
    notification.thread_id = thread_id if thread_id
    notification.mutable_content = mutable_content ? 1 : 0
    notification.content_available = content_available ? 1 : 0
    notification.priority = priority
    notification.expiration = expiration if expiration
    
    # Custom data
    notification.custom_payload = custom_data unless custom_data.empty?
    
    notification
  end

  def handle_error_response(response)
    case response.status
    when '400'
      puts "Bad request - check the notification payload"
    when '403'
      puts "There was an error with the certificate or token"
    when '405'
      puts "The request used a bad :method value. Only POST requests are supported"
    when '410'
      puts "The device token is no longer active for the topic"
    when '413'
      puts "The notification payload was too large"
    when '429'
      puts "The server received too many requests for the same device token"
    when '500'
      puts "Internal server error"
    when '503'
      puts "The server is shutting down and unavailable"
    end
  end
end

        return true
      else
        puts "Помилка при надсиланні сповіщення: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
        return false
      end
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка з'єднання: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  # Надіслати сповіщення кільком пристроям
  def send_bulk_notifications(device_tokens, message, **options)
    results = {}
    
    device_tokens.each do |device_token|
      results[device_token] = send_notification(device_token, message, options)
    end
    
    results
  end

  # Перевірити статус з'єднання
  def healthy?
    @connection_pool.with do |connection|
      connection.ssl_session_reused?
    end
  rescue
    false
  end

  private

  def create_connection
    Apnotic::Connection.new(
      auth_method: :token,
      cert_path: @key_file,
      key_id: @key_id,
      team_id: @team_id,
      url: connection_url
    )
  end

  def connection_url
    @environment == :development ? 
      'https://api.sandbox.push.apple.com' : 
      'https://api.push.apple.com'
  end

  def build_notification(device_token, message, options)
    Apnotic::Notification.new(device_token).tap do |notification|
      notification.alert = {
        title: options[:title] || "Сповіщення",
        body: message
      }
      
      # Основні параметри сповіщення
      notification.badge = options[:badge] if options[:badge]
      notification.sound = options[:sound] || "default"
      notification.category = options[:category] if options[:category]
      notification.thread_id = options[:thread_id] if options[:thread_id]
      
      # Додаткові дані
      notification.custom_payload = options[:custom_payload] || {}
      notification.content_available = options[:content_available] || false
      notification.mutable_content = options[:mutable_content] || false
      
      # Пріоритет сповіщення
      notification.priority = options[:priority] || 10
      
      # Час життя сповіщення (у секундах)
      notification.expiration = options[:expiration] if options[:expiration]
      
      # Topic (Bundle ID)
      notification.topic = options[:topic] if options[:topic]
    end
  end

module MessengerBot
  include Facebook::Messenger

  # Handle incoming messages
  Bot.on :message do |message|
    puts "Received message: #{message.inspect}"

    # Extract message details
    sender_id = message.sender['id']
    text = message.text
    message_id = message.id

    # Process the message and generate response
    response_text = process_message(text)

    # Send reply
    Bot.deliver(
      {
        recipient: { id: sender_id },
        message: { text: response_text }
      },
      access_token: ENV['FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    )
  end

  # Handle postbacks (button clicks, etc.)
  Bot.on :postback do |postback|
    sender_id = postback.sender['id']
    payload = postback.payload

    response_text = handle_postback(payload)

    Bot.deliver(
      {
        recipient: { id: sender_id },
        message: { text: response_text }
      },
      access_token: ENV['FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    )
  end

  # Handle message deliveries
  Bot.on :delivery do |delivery|
    puts "Message delivered to user: #{delivery.recipient_ids}"
  end

  # Handle message reads
  Bot.on :read do |read|
    puts "Message read by user: #{read.sender['id']}"
  end

  private

  def self.process_message(text)
    # Simple response logic - customize this based on your needs
    case text.downcase
    when 'hello', 'hi', 'hey'
      "Hello! How can I help you today?"
    when 'help'
      "I'm a bot that can help you. Try saying 'hello' or ask me a question!"
    when 'time'
      "The current time is #{Time.now.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}"
    when 'date'
      "Today's date is #{Date.today.strftime('%B %d, %Y')}"
    else
      "Thanks for your message: '#{text}'. I'm still learning!"
    end
  end

  def self.handle_postback(payload)
    case payload
    when 'GET_STARTED'
      "Welcome! I'm your friendly bot. How can I assist you today?"
    when 'HELP'
      "Here's how I can help you..."
    else
      "Action received: #{payload}"
    end
  end

class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :verify_facebook_signature, only: [:webhook]
  
  def webhook
    if params['hub.mode'] == 'subscribe' && params['hub.verify_token']
      verify_webhook
    else
      process_messages
      head :ok
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def verify_webhook
    challenge = FacebookMessenger.verify_webhook(
      params['hub.mode'],
      params['hub.verify_token'],
      params['hub.challenge']
    )
    
    if challenge
      render plain: challenge
    else
      head :forbidden
    end
  end
  
  def verify_facebook_signature
    body = request.body.read
    signature = request.headers['X-Hub-Signature']
    
    unless FacebookMessenger.verify_signature(body, signature)
      head :unauthorized
      return
    end
    
    request.body.rewind
  end
  
  def process_messages
    entries = params['entry']
    
    entries.each do |entry|
      messaging_events = entry['messaging']
      
      messaging_events.each do |event|
        if event['message'] && event['message']['text']
          process_message(event)
        elsif event['postback']
          process_postback(event)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  def process_message(event)
    # Створюємо запис повідомлення
    message = Message.create_from_webhook(event)
    
    # Обробляємо повідомлення в фоновому завданні
    MessageProcessorJob.perform_later(message.id)
  end
  
  def process_postback(event)
    # Обробка постбеків (кнопки, меню тощо)
    PostbackProcessorJob.perform_later(event)
  end
end

  rescue Net::IMAP::NoResponseError => e
    puts "Помилка підключення: #{e.message}"
  end

  def fetch_new_emails
    connect
    
    # Пошук непрочитаних листів
    @imap.search(['UNSEEN']).each do |message_id|
      process_email(message_id)
    end
    
    disconnect
  end

  def process_email(message_id)
    envelope = @imap.fetch(message_id, 'ENVELOPE')[0].attr['ENVELOPE']
    body_data = @imap.fetch(message_id, 'BODY[TEXT]')[0]
    
    email_data = {
      message_id: envelope.message_id,
      subject: envelope.subject,
      from: envelope.from[0].mailbox + '@' + envelope.from[0].host,
      to: envelope.to[0].mailbox + '@' + envelope.to[0].host,
      date: envelope.date,
      body: body_data ? body_data.attr['BODY[TEXT]'] : 'Немає тексту'
    }

    unless @database.email_exists?(email_data[:message_id])
      @database.save_email(email_data)
      puts "Збережено новий лист: #{email_data[:subject]}"
      
      # Позначити лист як прочитаний
      @imap.store(message_id, '+FLAGS', [:Seen])

    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка обробки листа #{message_id}: #{e.message}"
  end

  def disconnect
    @imap.logout
    @imap.disconnect
    @database.close

  end

# lib/mail_processor.rb
require 'mail'
require 'fileutils'

class MailProcessor
  def initialize(database)
    @database = database
    FileUtils.mkdir_p('attachments')
  end

  def process_message(message, mailbox)
    mail = Mail.read_from_string(message)

    return if @database.email_exists?(mail.message_id)

    email_data = extract_email_data(mail)
    email_id = @database.save_email(email_data)

    process_attachments(mail, email_id) if mail.attachments.any?

    puts "Processed email: #{mail.subject} (ID: #{mail.message_id})"
  end

  private

  def extract_email_data(mail)
    {
      message_id: mail.message_id,
      subject: mail.subject || '',
      from: Array(mail.from).join(', '),
      to: Array(mail.to).join(', '),
      date: mail.date,
      body_text: extract_body_text(mail),
      body_html: extract_body_html(mail),
      attachments_count: mail.attachments.size
    }
  end

  def extract_body_text(mail)
    if mail.text_part
      mail.text_part.decoded
    elsif mail.body
      mail.body.decoded
    else
      ''
    end
  end

  def extract_body_html(mail)
    if mail.html_part
      mail.html_part.decoded
    else
      ''
    end
  end

  def process_attachments(mail, email_id)
    mail.attachments.each do |attachment|
      filename = sanitize_filename(attachment.filename)
      file_path = "attachments/#{email_id}_#{filename}"

      File.binwrite(file_path, attachment.body.decoded)

      @database.save_attachment(email_id, {
        filename: filename,
        content_type: attachment.content_type,
        size: File.size(file_path),
        file_path: file_path
      })
    end
  end

  def sanitize_filename(filename)
    filename.gsub(/[^0-9A-Za-z.\-]/, '_')
  end
end

# voice_call_sender.rb
require 'twilio-ruby'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class VoiceCallSender
  def initialize
    # Initialize Twilio client with credentials from environment variables
    account_sid = ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID']
    auth_token = ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
    
    unless account_sid && auth_token
      raise "Missing Twilio credentials. Please set TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID and TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN environment variables."
    end
    
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
  end

  def send_voice_call(to_phone_number, message, from_phone_number = nil)
    # Use provided from number or try to get from environment variable
    from_phone_number ||= ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER']
    
    unless from_phone_number
      raise "Missing Twilio phone number. Please provide a from_phone_number or set TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER environment variable."
    end

    # Validate phone numbers
    validate_phone_number(to_phone_number, "To")
    validate_phone_number(from_phone_number, "From")

    begin
      # Create the voice call with text-to-speech
      call = @client.calls.create(
        to: to_phone_number,
        from: from_phone_number,
        twiml: generate_twiml(message)
      )

      puts "Voice call initiated successfully!"
      puts "Call SID: #{call.sid}"
      puts "Status: #{call.status}"
      puts "From: #{from_phone_number}"
      puts "To: #{to_phone_number}"
      puts "Message: #{message}"
      
      call
    rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
      puts "Error sending voice call: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_twiml(message)
    # Generate TwiML for text-to-speech
    <<~TWIML
      <Response>
        <Say voice="alice">#{escape_xml(message)}</Say>
      </Response>
    TWIML
  end

  def escape_xml(text)
    # Basic XML escaping for the message
    text.gsub('&', '&')
        .gsub('<', '<')
        .gsub('>', '>')
        .gsub('"', '"')
        .gsub("'", ''')
  end

  def validate_phone_number(phone_number, field_name)
    unless phone_number =~ /^\+[1-9]\d{1,14}$/
      raise "Invalid #{field_name} phone number format. Please use E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890)"
    end
  end
end

# turbo_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class TurboSMS
  include HTTParty
  
  # TurboSMS API endpoints
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.turbosms.ua'
  BALANCE_URL = "#{BASE_URL}/user/balance.json"
  MESSAGES_URL = "#{BASE_URL}/message/send.json"
  MESSAGE_STATUS_URL = "#{BASE_URL}/message/status.json"
  
  def initialize(api_token = nil)
    @api_token = api_token || ENV['TURBOSMS_API_TOKEN']
    raise "API token is required" unless @api_token
    
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Send SMS to Ukrainian number
  # phone: Ukrainian phone number in format 380XXXXXXXXX
  # message: Text message to send (up to 1520 characters for one SMS)
  # options: Additional options (sender, validity_period, etc.)
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    # Validate Ukrainian phone number
    validate_phone_number(phone)
    
    # Prepare message data
    message_data = {
      recipients: [phone],
      sms: {
        sender: options[:sender] || ENV['TURBOSMS_SENDER'] || 'TurboSMS',
        text: message
      }
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters
    message_data[:sms][:start_time] = options[:start_time] if options[:start_time]
    message_data[:sms][:validity] = options[:validity_period] if options[:validity_period]
    
    response = self.class.post(
      MESSAGES_URL,
      headers: @headers,
      body: message_data.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Send multiple SMS messages at once
  def send_bulk_sms(phones, message, options = {})
    raise "Phones must be an array" unless phones.is_a?(Array)
    
    phones.each { |phone| validate_phone_number(phone) }
    
    message_data = {
      recipients: phones,
      sms: {
        sender: options[:sender] || ENV['TURBOSMS_SENDER'] || 'TurboSMS',
        text: message
      }
    }
    
    message_data[:sms][:start_time] = options[:start_time] if options[:start_time]
    message_data[:sms][:validity] = options[:validity_period] if options[:validity_period]
    
    response = self.class.post(
      MESSAGES_URL,
      headers: @headers,
      body: message_data.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check account balance
  def balance
    response = self.class.get(BALANCE_URL, headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      data['balance'] if data.is_a?(Hash)
    else
      raise "Failed to get balance: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Check message status by ID
  def message_status(message_id)
    response = self.class.post(
      MESSAGE_STATUS_URL,
      headers: @headers,
      body: { message_id: message_id }.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_phone_number(phone)
    # Ukrainian phone number validation: 380 followed by 9 digits
    unless phone.to_s.match?(/^380\d{9}$/)
      raise "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format. Expected: 380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "API Error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
      raise error_message
    end
  end
end

# sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class TurboSmsSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.turbosms.ua'.freeze
  
  def initialize(token = nil)
    @token = token || ENV['TURBOSMS_TOKEN']
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Отримання балансу
  def balance
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}/user/balance.json", headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Відправка SMS
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    # Форматуємо номер телефону в український формат
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone)
    
    payload = {
      recipient: formatted_phone,
      message: message,
      sms: {
        sender: options[:sender] || ENV['SMS_SENDER'] || 'TurboSMS'
      }
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/message/send.json",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def message_status(message_id)
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}/message/status.json", 
                           headers: @headers,
                           query: { message_id: message_id })
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Приводимо номер до формату 380XXXXXXXXX
    phone = phone.to_s.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')
    
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      "38#{phone}"
    elsif phone.start_with?('380')
      phone
    elsif phone.start_with?('80')
      "3#{phone}"
    else
      phone
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}", body: response.body }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { error: 'Invalid JSON response', body: response.body }
  end
end

  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.sms.ru'.freeze

    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
  end
  
  def send_sms(phone, message, from = nil)
    # Форматуємо номер телефону (видаляємо всі нецифрові символи)
    formatted_phone = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Параметри запиту
    params = {
      api_id: @api_key,
      to: formatted_phone,
      msg: message,
      json: 1
    }
    
    # Додаємо ім'я відправника, якщо вказано
    params[:from] = from if from && !from.empty?
    
    # Виконуємо запит до API
    response = HTTParty.post("#{API_BASE_URL}/sms/send", body: params)
    
    # Парсимо відповідь
    result = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if result['status'] == 'OK'
      # Перевіряємо статус кожного SMS
      sms_status = result['sms'][formatted_phone]
      
      if sms_status['status'] == 'OK'

      else
        { success: false, error: sms_status['status_text'] }
      end
    else
      { success: false, error: result['status_text'] }
    end
  rescue => e
    { success: false, error: e.message }
  end
  
  # Метод для перевірки балансу
  def balance
    response = HTTParty.get("#{API_BASE_URL}/my/balance", query: { api_id: @api_key, json: 1 })
    result = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if result['status'] == 'OK'
      result['balance']
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання балансу: #{result['status_text']}"
    end
  end
  
  # Метод для перевірки статусу SMS
  def sms_status(sms_id)
    response = HTTParty.get("#{API_BASE_URL}/sms/status", query: { 
      api_id: @api_key, 
      sms_id: sms_id,
      json: 1 
    })
    
    result = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if result['status'] == 'OK'

    else

    end
  end

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.sms.net.bd'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHASMS_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required. Set ALPHASMS_API_KEY environment variable or pass it to initialize." unless @api_key
  end

  def send_sms(to, message, sender_id = nil)
    # AlphaSMS requires sender ID to be alphanumeric, 3-11 characters
    sender_id ||= ENV['ALPHASMS_SENDER_ID'] || 'SENDER'

    # Validate sender ID format
    unless valid_sender_id?(sender_id)
      raise "Sender ID must be alphanumeric and 3-11 characters long"
    end

    # Validate phone number format (basic validation)
    unless valid_phone_number?(to)
      raise "Invalid phone number format. Use international format (e.g., +88017XXXXXXXX)"
    end

    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/sendsms"
    
    payload = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      msg: message,
      to: to
    }

    # Only add sender_id if provided (optional parameter)
    payload[:sender_id] = sender_id if sender_id

    response = HTTParty.post(
      endpoint,
      body: payload,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_balance
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/user/balance"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      endpoint,
      query: { api_key: @api_key },
      headers: { 'Accept' => 'application/json' }
    )

    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if data['error'] == '0'
        { success: true, balance: data['balance'].to_f }
      else
        { success: false, error: data['error'] }
      end
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end

    # AlphaSMS requires alphanumeric sender ID, 3-11 characters
    sender_id =~ /\A[a-zA-Z0-9]{3,11}\z/ && !sender_id.match(/\d{12,}/)
  end

  def valid_phone_number?(phone)

      sms_message ||= viber_message

      if viber_response[:success]
        @logger.info("Viber message sent successfully to #{phone}")
        return viber_response
      else
        @logger.warn("Viber failed for #{phone}, falling back to SMS. Error: #{viber_response[:error]}")
        sms_response = send_sms(phone, sms_message, options)

require 'httparty'

class ESputnikAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  # Base configuration
  base_uri 'https://esputnik.com/api/v1'
  
  def initialize(username = nil, password = nil)
    @username = username || ENV['ESPUTNIK_USERNAME']
    @password = password || ENV['ESPUTNIK_PASSWORD']
    
    if @username.nil? || @password.nil?
      raise "Missing eSputnik credentials. Set ESPUTNIK_USERNAME and ESPUTNIK_PASSWORD environment variables."
    end
    
    self.class.basic_auth(@username, @password)
    self.class.headers('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
  end
  
  # Add or update a contact
  def add_contact(contact_data)
    endpoint = '/contact'
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: contact_data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Contact added/updated successfully"
      return JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response, "Failed to add/update contact")
    end
  end
  
  # Get contact by email
  def get_contact_by_email(email)
    endpoint = "/contact/email/#{URI.encode_www_form_component(email)}"
    
    response = self.class.get(endpoint)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    elsif response.code == 404
      nil # Contact not found
    else
      handle_error(response, "Failed to get contact")
    end
  end
  
  # Add contact to group
  def add_contact_to_group(contact_id, group_id)
    endpoint = "/contact/#{contact_id}/groups"
    body = { groupIds: [group_id] }
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: body.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Contact added to group successfully"
      true
    else
      handle_error(response, "Failed to add contact to group")
    end
  end
  
  # Send email campaign
  def send_campaign(campaign_data)
    endpoint = '/message/email'
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: campaign_data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Campaign sent successfully"
      return JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response, "Failed to send campaign")
    end
  end
  
  # Get list of email campaigns
  def get_campaigns(start_index: 0, max_rows: 50)
    endpoint = "/campaigns?startIndex=#{start_index}&maxRows=#{max_rows}"
    
    response = self.class.get(endpoint)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response, "Failed to get campaigns")
    end
  end
  
  # Get campaign statistics
  def get_campaign_stats(campaign_id)
    endpoint = "/campaign/#{campaign_id}/statistics"
    
    response = self.class.get(endpoint)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response, "Failed to get campaign statistics")
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_error(response, message)
    error_details = JSON.parse(response.body) rescue { 'message' => response.body }
    
    error_message = "#{message}: #{response.code} - #{error_details['message'] || response.message}"
    puts error_message
    raise error_message
  end
end

require 'httparty'
