class VodafoneUkraineMessaging
  # Vodafone Ukraine API endpoints
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.vodafone.ua'
  SMS_ENDPOINT = '/sms/v1/messages'
  VIBER_ENDPOINT = '/viber/v1/messages'
  
  def initialize(api_key, sender_name = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @sender_name = sender_name
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    payload = {
      recipient: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      message: message,
      sender: options[:sender] || @sender_name,
      messageId: options[:message_id] || generate_message_id,
      validity: options[:validity] || 60, # validity in minutes
      priority: options[:priority] || 'NORMAL'
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}#{SMS_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response, 'SMS')
  end
  
  # Send Viber message
  def send_viber(phone_number, message, options = {})
    payload = {
      recipient: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      message: message,
      sender: options[:sender] || @sender_name,
      messageId: options[:message_id] || generate_message_id,
      validity: options[:validity] || 60,
      ttl: options[:ttl] || 3600, # time to live in seconds
      caption: options[:caption] || '',
      action: options[:action] || 'none',
      imageUrl: options[:image_url] || '',
      buttonCaption: options[:button_caption] || '',
      buttonAction: options[:button_action] || ''
    }.compact # Remove nil values
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}#{VIBER_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response, 'Viber')
  end
  
  # Check message status
  def check_status(message_id, message_type = 'sms')
    endpoint = message_type.downcase == 'viber' ? VIBER_ENDPOINT : SMS_ENDPOINT
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}#{endpoint}/#{message_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Failed to check status: #{response.code} - #{response.body}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/billing/v1/balance",
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Failed to get balance: #{response.code} - #{response.body}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Ensure phone number is in international format
    phone = phone_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      "38#{phone}" # Convert Ukrainian format to international
    elsif phone.start_with?('+')
      phone[1..-1] # Remove leading +
    elsif phone.start_with?('38')
      phone
    else
      "38#{phone}" # Assume it's Ukrainian number without country code
    end
  end
  
  def generate_message_id
    "#{Time.now.to_i}#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
  
  def handle_response(response, message_type)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: result['messageId'],
        status: result['status'],
        details: result
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "#{message_type} sending failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}",
        status_code: response.code
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Failed to parse response: #{e.message}",
      raw_response: response.body
    }
  end

  end

    # Валідація номеру телефону

    }

    begin
      # Відправка запиту до API lifecell

        "#{@base_url}/sms/send",

        headers: {

      { success: false, error: "Невідома помилка: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

# viber_sender.rb
require 'infobip_api'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class ViberSender
  def initialize(api_key = nil, base_url = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['INFOBIP_API_KEY']
    @base_url = base_url || ENV['INFOBIP_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.infobip.com'
    
    validate_credentials
    
    # Configure the API client
    configuration = InfobipApi::Configuration.new do |config|
      config.api_key['APIKeyHeader'] = @api_key
      config.host = @base_url.gsub('https://', '')
      config.scheme = 'https'
      config.debugging = ENV['DEBUG'] == 'true'
    end
    
    @api_client = InfobipApi::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    @viber_api = InfobipApi::ViberApi.new(@api_client)
  end

  def send_viber_message(phone_number, message, options = {})
    begin
      # Validate Ukrainian phone number format
      validate_ukrainian_phone_number(phone_number)
      
      # Prepare the message request
      viber_message = InfobipApi::ViberTextMessage.new(
        from: options[:from] || ENV['VIBER_SENDER_NAME'] || 'MyApp',
        to: phone_number,
        text: message
      )
      
      # Add optional parameters
      viber_message.validity_period = options[:validity_period] if options[:validity_period]
      viber_message.validity_period_time_unit = options[:validity_period_time_unit] if options[:validity_period_time_unit]
      
      if options[:callback_data]
        viber_message.callback_data = options[:callback_data]
      end
      
      if options[:tracking_data]
        viber_message.tracking_data = options[:tracking_data]
      end
      
      # Send the message
      response = @viber_api.send_viber_message(viber_message)
      
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response.messages.first&.message_id,
        status: response.messages.first&.status&.description,
        response: response
      }
      
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Infobip API Error: #{e.message}",
        code: e.code,
        response: e.response_body
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end
  
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = @viber_api.get_viber_message_logs(
        message_id: message_id
      )
      
      {
        success: true,
        status: response.results.first&.status,
        details: response.results.first
      }
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Infobip API Error: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    unless @api_key
      raise ArgumentError, "API key is required. Set INFOBIP_API_KEY environment variable or pass as parameter"
    end
    
    unless @base_url
      raise ArgumentError, "Base URL is required. Set INFOBIP_BASE_URL environment variable or pass as parameter"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_ukrainian_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Ukrainian phone number validation: +380 followed by 9 digits
    ukrainian_pattern = /^\+380\d{9}$/
    cleaned_number = phone_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    unless cleaned_number.match?(ukrainian_pattern)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format. Expected: +380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end
end

    }

          'to' => formatted_phone,
          'messageId' => options[:message_id] || generate_message_id,
          'content' => {

          },

        }
      ]

    when /\A380\d{9}\z/

    when /\A0\d{9}\z/
      "38#{phone}"
    when /\A\d{9}\z/
      "380#{phone}"
    when /\A\+380\d{9}\z/

    else

    end

require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'securerandom'

Dotenv.load

class LifecellOTPSender
  # Lifecell SMS API configuration
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.lifecell.com.ua'.freeze
  SMS_ENDPOINT = '/rest/sendSMS'.freeze
  
  def initialize(login = nil, password = nil)
    @login = login || ENV['LIFECELL_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['LIFECELL_PASSWORD']
    
    validate_credentials
  end
  
  # Generate a random OTP (One-Time Password)
  def generate_otp(length = 6)
    SecureRandom.random_number(10**length).to_s.rjust(length, '0')
  end
  
  # Send OTP via SMS
  def send_otp(phone_number, message = nil, otp_length = 6)
    otp = generate_otp(otp_length)
    message ||= "Your verification code is: #{otp}"
    
    response = send_sms(phone_number, message)
    
    if response.success?
      { success: true, otp: otp, message: 'OTP sent successfully' }
    else
      { success: false, error: "Failed to send OTP: #{response['description']}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Send regular SMS (can be used for other messages too)
  def send_sms(phone_number, message)
    # Format phone number if needed (Ukrainian format)
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    payload = {
      login: @login,
      password: @password,
      recipient: formatted_phone,
      message: message,
      sender: 'OTP Service' # Can be customized or use short code if available
    }
    
    HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{SMS_ENDPOINT}",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
  end
  
  # Check account balance
  def check_balance
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/rest/balance",
      body: {
        login: @login,
        password: @password
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      { success: true, balance: response['balance'] }
    else
      { success: false, error: "Failed to check balance: #{response['description']}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    if @login.nil? || @password.nil?
      raise ArgumentError, "Login and password must be provided either as arguments or via LIFECELL_LOGIN and LIFECELL_PASSWORD environment variables"
    end
  end
  
  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Remove any non-digit characters
    cleaned_phone = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Ensure Ukrainian format (380XXXXXXXXX)
    if cleaned_phone.start_with?('0')
      "38#{cleaned_phone}"
    elsif cleaned_phone.start_with?('380')
      cleaned_phone
    else
      # Assume it's already in international format
      cleaned_phone
    end
  end
end

# alert_notifier.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class AlertNotifier
  ALERTS_API_BASE = 'https://alerts.com.ua/api'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ALERTS_API_KEY']
    @last_checked = {}
  end

  # Get current alerts from the API
  def fetch_current_alerts
    response = HTTParty.get("#{ALERTS_API_BASE}/states", 
      headers: { 'X-API-Key' => @api_key }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error fetching alerts: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      {}
    end
  end

  # Parse alerts and identify changed oblasts
  def check_for_new_alerts
    current_alerts = fetch_current_alerts
    new_alerts = []

    current_alerts.each do |oblast_id, oblast_data|
      oblast_name = oblast_data['name']
      is_active = oblast_data['alert'] || false
      last_alert_status = @last_checked[oblast_id]

      # Check if alert status changed
      if last_alert_status.nil? || last_alert_status != is_active
        new_alerts << {
          oblast_id: oblast_id,
          oblast_name: oblast_name,
          alert_active: is_active,
          changed_at: Time.now
        }
      end

      @last_checked[oblast_id] = is_active
    end

    new_alerts
  end

  # Notify users about alerts in their oblasts
  def notify_users(alert_changes)
    alert_changes.each do |alert|
      users_to_notify = User.where(oblast_id: alert[:oblast_id])
      
      users_to_notify.each do |user|
        send_notification(user, alert)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def send_notification(user, alert)
    message = generate_message(alert)
    
    # Send via different channels based on user preferences
    send_push_notification(user, message) if user.push_notifications_enabled?
    send_sms(user, message) if user.sms_notifications_enabled?
    send_email(user, message) if user.email_notifications_enabled?
  end

  def generate_message(alert)
    if alert[:alert_active]
      "🚨 Повітряна тривога в #{alert[:oblast_name]}! Шукайте укриття."
    else
      "✅ Відбій повітряної тривоги в #{alert[:oblast_name]}."
    end
  end

  def send_push_notification(user, message)
    # Implementation for Firebase Cloud Messaging
    fcm = FCM.new(ENV['FCM_SERVER_KEY'])
    registration_ids = [user.fcm_token]
    
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: 'Повітряна тривога',
        body: message,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: {
        alert_type: 'air_raid',
        timestamp: Time.now.to_i
      }
    }
    
    fcm.send(registration_ids, options)
  end

  def send_sms(user, message)
    # Implementation for Twilio SMS
    client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(
      ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID'],
      ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
    )
    
    client.messages.create(
      from: ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER'],
      to: user.phone_number,
      body: message
    )
  rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
    puts "SMS sending failed: #{e.message}"
  end

  def send_email(user, message)
    # Implementation for email notifications
    mail = Mail.new do
      from    ENV['EMAIL_FROM']
      to      user.email
      subject 'Повітряна тривога - сповіщення'
      body    message
    end
    
    mail.delivery_method :smtp, {
      address: ENV['SMTP_ADDRESS'],
      port: ENV['SMTP_PORT'],
      user_name: ENV['SMTP_USERNAME'],
      password: ENV['SMTP_PASSWORD'],
      authentication: 'plain',
      enable_starttls_auto: true
    }
    
    mail.deliver
  end
end

# app/services/diia_notification_service.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'jwt'
require 'openssl'
require 'dotenv/load'

class DiiaNotificationService
  class DiiaError < StandardError; end

  def initialize
    @base_url = ENV['DIIA_API_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.diia.gov.ua'
    @partner_id = ENV['DIIA_PARTNER_ID']
    @private_key_path = ENV['DIIA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH']
    @kid = ENV['DIIA_KEY_ID']
    
    validate_config!
  end

  # Надсилання push-сповіщення
  def send_push_notification(user_identifier, title, message, data = {})
    endpoint = '/api/v1/notifications/push'
    payload = build_notification_payload(user_identifier, title, message, data)
    
    response = make_authenticated_request(:post, endpoint, payload)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу сповіщення
  def get_notification_status(notification_id)
    endpoint = "/api/v1/notifications/#{notification_id}/status"
    
    response = make_authenticated_request(:get, endpoint)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_config!
    required_vars = ['DIIA_PARTNER_ID', 'DIIA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH', 'DIIA_KEY_ID']
    missing_vars = required_vars.select { |var| ENV[var].nil? || ENV[var].empty? }
    
    unless missing_vars.empty?
      raise DiiaError, "Missing required environment variables: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    unless File.exist?(@private_key_path)
      raise DiiaError, "Private key file not found: #{@private_key_path}"
    end
  end

  def build_notification_payload(user_identifier, title, message, data)
    {
      userIdentifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      message: message,
      data: data,
      # Додаткові параметри можна додати за потребою
      # expirationTime: (Time.now + 24.hours).iso8601,
      # priority: "high"
    }
  end

  def make_authenticated_request(method, endpoint, payload = {})
    headers = build_headers(endpoint, method.to_s.upcase, payload)
    
    case method
    when :post
      HTTParty.post(
        "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
        headers: headers,
        body: payload.to_json
      )
    when :get
      HTTParty.get(
        "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
        headers: headers
      )
    else
      raise DiiaError, "Unsupported HTTP method: #{method}"
    end
  end

  def build_headers(endpoint, http_method, payload = {})
    token = generate_jwt_token(endpoint, http_method, payload)
    
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def generate_jwt_token(endpoint, http_method, payload = {})
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(@private_key_path))
    
    payload = {
      iss: @partner_id,
      aud: @base_url,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300, # Токен дійсний 5 хвилин
      method: http_method,
      path: endpoint
    }
    
    headers = { kid: @kid }
    
    JWT.encode(payload, private_key, 'RS256', headers)
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise DiiaError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise DiiaError, "Authentication failed"
    when 403
      raise DiiaError, "Access forbidden"
    when 404
      raise DiiaError, "Resource not found"
    when 429
      raise DiiaError, "Rate limit exceeded"
    when 500..599
      raise DiiaError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise DiiaError, "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

Dotenv.load

class MobizonSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.mobizon.com/service/message'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MOBIZON_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required. Set MOBIZON_API_KEY environment variable" unless @api_key
  end

  # Send SMS to a single recipient
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    params = {
      recipient: format_phone_number(phone),
      text: message,
      apiKey: @api_key
    }.merge(options)

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/sendSmsMessage",
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send SMS to multiple recipients
  def send_bulk_sms(phones, message, options = {})
    recipients = phones.is_a?(Array) ? phones.join(',') : phones
    recipients = format_phone_numbers(recipients)

    params = {
      recipient: recipients,
      text: message,
      apiKey: @api_key
    }.merge(options)

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/sendSmsMessage",
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get SMS status by message ID
  def get_sms_status(message_id)
    params = {
      id: message_id,
      apiKey: @api_key
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/getSMSStatus",
      query: params
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      'https://api.mobizon.com/service/user/getownbalance',
      query: { apiKey: @api_key }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Remove all non-digit characters and ensure proper formatting
    phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
  end

  def format_phone_numbers(phones)
    if phones.is_a?(String)
      phones.split(',').map { |p| format_phone_number(p) }.join(',')
    else
      phones.map { |p| format_phone_number(p) }.join(',')
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}", 
        message: response.body 
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { 
      success: false, 
      error: 'Invalid JSON response', 
      message: response.body 
    }
  end
end

  # Nova Poshta SMS API base URL
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    validate_api_key!
  end

    validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
    validate_message!(message)

    response = make_api_request(payload)

    handle_response(response)
  end

      }
    }

    response = make_api_request(payload)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get SMS delivery report
  def get_sms_delivery_report(start_date: nil, end_date: nil)
    start_date ||= Date.today - 7
    end_date ||= Date.today

    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'SMS',
      calledMethod: 'getSMSStatus',
      methodProperties: {
        DateTimeFrom: start_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
        DateTimeTo: end_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')
      }
    }

    response = make_api_request(payload)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get SMS balance
  def get_balance
    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'SMS',
      calledMethod: 'getSMSBalance',
      methodProperties: {}
    }

    response = make_api_request(payload)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_api_key!
    raise ArgumentError, 'API key is required. Set NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY environment variable or pass api_key parameter' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end

  def validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
    # Basic Ukrainian phone number validation
    unless phone_number =~ /^(\+38|38)?(0\d{9})$/
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid Ukrainian phone number format. Expected format: +380XXXXXXXXX or 0XXXXXXXXX'
    end
  end

  def validate_message!(message)
    if message.nil? || message.strip.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, 'Message cannot be empty'
    end

    if message.length > 160
      raise ArgumentError, 'Message is too long. Maximum 160 characters allowed'
    end
  end

  def build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'SMS',
      calledMethod: 'save',
      methodProperties: {
        Sender: options[:sender] || 'NovaPoshta',
        DateTime: options[:send_date] || Time.now.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S'),
        PhoneNumber: normalize_phone_number(phone_number),
        Message: message
      }
    }
  end

  def normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Convert to standard Ukrainian format: +380XXXXXXXXX
    phone_number.gsub(/^(\+38|38)?(0\d{9})$/, '+38\2')
  end

  def make_api_request(payload)
    HTTParty.post(

      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {

        'Accept' => 'application/json'

      end
    else

        success: false,
        errors: ["HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"]
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    {
      success: false,
      errors: ["JSON Parse Error: #{e.message}"]
    }
  rescue => e
    {
      success: false,
      errors: ["Request Error: #{e.message}"]
    }
  end
end

# binotel_caller.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class BinotelCaller
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api/2.0'

  def initialize(api_key = nil, api_secret = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_secret.nil?
      raise "Binotel API credentials not found. Set BINOTEL_API_KEY and BINOTEL_API_SECRET environment variables."
    end
  end

  # Make a call with a voice message
  def call_with_voice_message(customer_phone, voice_message_url, options = {})
    endpoint = '/calls/make-call-with-voice-message'
    
    params = {
      customerNumber: format_phone_number(customer_phone),
      voiceMessageURL: voice_message_url,
      generalTrackingID: options[:tracking_id] || generate_tracking_id,
      cli: options[:caller_id] # Optional: specify caller ID
    }.compact

    response = make_request(endpoint, params)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Call initiated successfully!"
      puts "Call ID: #{response['callID']}"
      puts "Status: #{response['status']}"
      return response
    else
      puts "Failed to initiate call: #{response['status']}"
      puts "Error: #{response['message']}" if response['message']
      return nil
    end
  end

  # Get call status
  def call_status(call_id)
    endpoint = '/calls/status'
    
    params = {
      callID: call_id
    }

    response = make_request(endpoint, params)
    response.success? ? response : nil
  end

  private

  def make_request(endpoint, params)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}.json"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Basic #{base64_credentials}"
      }
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def base64_credentials
    Base64.strict_encode64("#{@api_key}:#{@api_secret}")
  end

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Remove any non-digit characters and ensure proper formatting
    phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
  end

  def generate_tracking_id
    "call_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
end

      repeat: options[:repeat] || 1,        # кількість повторень
      callback_url: options[:callback_url]  # URL для зворотного виклику
    }.compact

    response = make_request(endpoint, params)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Дзвінок успішно ініційовано!"
      puts "ID дзвінка: #{response['callID']}"
      puts "Статус: #{response['status']}"
      return response
    else
      puts "Помилка при здійсненні дзвінка: #{response['status']}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  # Отримання статусу дзвінка
  def call_status(call_id)
    endpoint = '/calls/status'
    params = { callID: call_id }
    
    response = make_request(endpoint, params)
    response if response.success?
  end

  # Список останніх дзвінків
  def call_history(options = {})
    endpoint = '/calls/history'
    params = {
      limit: options[:limit] || 10,
      offset: options[:offset] || 0
    }
    
    response = make_request(endpoint, params)
    response if response.success?
  end

  private

  def make_request(endpoint, params)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, 
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Basic #{auth_token}"
      }
    )
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def auth_token
    Base64.strict_encode64("#{@api_key}:#{@api_secret}")
  end

**Implementation**
```ruby
# product_indexer.rb
require 'bundler/setup'
require 'fast_stemmer'
require 'stopwords/filter'

class ProductIndexer
  # Common English stop words
  STOP_WORDS = %w[
    a an and are as at be but by for if in into is it no not of on or such 
    that the their then there these they this to was will with
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @stemmer = FastStemmer
    @filter = Stopwords::Filter.new(STOP_WORDS)
  end

  def process_description(description)
    return [] unless description.is_a?(String)
    
    # Tokenize: split into words and clean
    words = description.downcase.split(/\W+/).reject(&:empty?)
    
    # Remove stop words
    filtered_words = @filter.filter(words)
    
    # Stem remaining words
    filtered_words.map { |word| @stemmer.stem(word) }
  end

  def index_product(product_id, description)
    terms = process_description(description)
    
    # Create index mapping terms to product IDs
    index = {}
    terms.each do |term|
      index[term] ||= []
      index[term] << product_id
    end
    
    index
  end

  # Batch index multiple products
  def index_products(products)
    # products should be a hash: { product_id => description }
    master_index = {}
    
    products.each do |product_id, description|
      product_index = index_product(product_id, description)
      
      # Merge into master index
      product_index.each do |term, ids|
        master_index[term] ||= []
        master_index[term] += ids
        master_index[term].uniq! # Remove duplicates
      end
    end
    
    master_index
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  indexer = ProductIndexer.new
  
  # Sample product data
  products = {
    1 => "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog with a red collar",
    2 => "A quick and easy solution for lazy programmers",
    3 => "Brown leather collar for dogs and cats"
  }
  
  # Index all products
  index = indexer.index_products(products)
  
  puts "Search Index:"
  index.each do |term, product_ids|
    puts "#{term}: #{product_ids.join(', ')}"
  end
  
  # Test searching
  puts "\nSearch results for 'lazy':"
  lazy_stemmed = FastStemmer.stem('lazy')
  puts "Stemmed term: #{lazy_stemmed}"
  puts "Products: #{index[lazy_stemmed]&.join(', ') || 'None'}"
  
  puts "\nSearch results for 'collar':"
  collar_stemmed = FastStemmer.stem('collar')
  puts "Stemmed term: #{collar_stemmed}"
  puts "Products: #{index[collar_stemmed]&.join(', ') || 'None'}"
end
```

**Key Features:**

1. **Gem Dependencies**: Uses `fast-stemmer` for efficient stemming and `stopwords-filter` for stop word removal.

2. **Stemming**: Converts words to their root form (e.g., "jumps" → "jump", "collars" → "collar")

3. **Stop Word Removal**: Filters out common English words that don't add search value

4. **Case Normalization**: Converts all text to lowercase before processing

5. **Tokenization**: Splits text on non-word characters

6. **Index Building**: Creates inverted index mapping terms to product IDs

## Implementation

# language_detector.rb
require 'cld3'

class LanguageDetector
  def initialize
    @detector = CLD3::NNetLanguageIdentifier.new(0, 1000)
  end

  # Detect the language of a single comment
  def detect_language(comment)
    return nil if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?
    
    result = @detector.find_language(comment)
    {
      language: result.language,
      probability: result.probability,
      reliable?: result.reliable?,
      text: comment
    }
  end

  # Detect languages for multiple comments
  def detect_languages(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| detect_language(comment) }
  end

  # Get language statistics from multiple comments
  def language_stats(comments)
    results = detect_languages(comments)
    stats = Hash.new(0)
    
    results.each do |result|
      next unless result
      stats[result[:language]] += 1
    end
    
    stats.transform_values { |count| (count.to_f / results.compact.size * 100).round(2) }
  end
end

# Example usage and testing

  # Sample user comments in different languages
  comments = [
    "Hello, this is a great post! Thanks for sharing.",
    "Bonjour, merci pour cet article très intéressant.",
    "Hola, este es un comentario en español.",
    "这是一条中文评论，谢谢你的分享。",
    "こんにちは、素晴らしい記事ですね。",
    "Привет, спасибо за интересную статью.",
    "",  # Empty comment
    nil  # Nil comment
  ]
  
  puts "Language Detection Results:"
  puts "=" * 50
  
  comments.each_with_index do |comment, index|
    puts "Comment #{index + 1}: #{comment.to_s[0..50]}..."
    result = detector.detect_language(comment)
    
    if result
      puts "  Language: #{result[:language]}"
      puts "  Probability: #{(result[:probability] * 100).round(2)}%"
      puts "  Reliable: #{result[:reliable?]}"
    else
      puts "  Unable to detect language (empty or invalid comment)"
    end
    puts
  end
  
  # Show statistics
  puts "Language Statistics:"
  puts "=" * 50
  stats = detector.language_stats(comments.compact.reject(&:empty?))
  stats.each do |lang, percentage|
    puts "#{lang}: #{percentage}%"
  end
end

require 'ruby-stemmer'
require 'stopwords'

class ProductIndexer
  def initialize
    @stemmer = Stemmer::Stemmer.new
    @stopwords_filter = Stopwords::Snowball::Filter.new("en")
  end

  # Виконує попередню обробку тексту: нижній регістр, токенізація, 
  # видалення стоп-слів та стемінг
  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Перетворення до нижнього реєстру
    normalized_text = text.downcase
    
    # Токенізація (розділення на слова)
    tokens = normalized_text.split(/\W+/)
    
    # Видалення стоп-слів
    filtered_tokens = @stopwords_filter.filter(tokens)
    
    # Стемінг кожного токена
    stemmed_tokens = filtered_tokens.map { |token| @stemmer.stem(token) }
    
    # Видалення порожніх токенів
    stemmed_tokens.reject!(&:empty?)
    
    stemmed_tokens
  end

  # Індексація описів товарів
  def index_products(products)
    indexed_data = {}
    
    products.each_with_index do |product, index|
      product_id = product[:id] || index
      description = product[:description] || ""
      
      # Попередня обробка тексту
      processed_tokens = preprocess_text(description)
      
      # Додаємо до індексу
      indexed_data[product_id] = {
        original_description: description,
        processed_tokens: processed_tokens,
        token_count: processed_tokens.size
      }
    end
    
    indexed_data
  end

  # Пошук токенів у індексі
  def search_tokens(indexed_data, query)
    query_tokens = preprocess_text(query)
    
    results = indexed_data.select do |product_id, data|
      # Перевіряємо чи всі токени запиту присутні в описі товару
      query_tokens.all? { |token| data[:processed_tokens].include?(token) }
    end
    
    results.keys
  end
end

require 'ffi/aspell'
require 'colorize'

class SpellChecker
  def initialize(lang: 'en')
    @speller = FFI::Aspell::Speller.new(lang)
  end

  def check_text(text)
    words = extract_words(text)
    errors = []
    
    words.each do |word, position|
      unless @speller.correct?(word)
        suggestions = @speller.suggestions(word).first(5)
        errors << {
          word: word,
          position: position,
          suggestions: suggestions
        }
      end
    end
    
    errors
  end

  def check_text_with_context(text)
    errors = check_text(text)
    return [] if errors.empty?
    
    lines = text.split("\n")
    results = []
    
    errors.each do |error|
      line_num = error[:position][:line]
      char_pos = error[:position][:char]
      line = lines[line_num]
      
      # Виділяємо слово в контексті
      start_pos = [0, char_pos - 20].max
      end_pos = [line.length, char_pos + error[:word].length + 20].min
      context = line[start_pos...end_pos]
      
      # Підсвічуємо помилкове слово
      highlighted_context = context.gsub(error[:word], error[:word].red)
      
      results << {
        word: error[:word],
        line: line_num + 1,
        context: highlighted_context,
        suggestions: error[:suggestions]
      }
    end
    
    results
  end

  def correct_text(text)
    errors = check_text(text)
    corrected_text = text.dup
    
    # Сортуємо помилки в зворотньому порядку, щоб не зміщувати позиції
    errors.sort_by { |error| -error[:position][:char] }.each do |error|
      if error[:suggestions].any?
        # Використовуємо перше предложення для виправлення
        replacement = error[:suggestions].first
        position = error[:position]
        line_start = text.split("\n")[0...position[:line]].sum { |l| l.length + 1 }
        start_index = line_start + position[:char]
        corrected_text[start_index, error[:word].length] = replacement
      end
    end
    
    corrected_text
  end

  private

  def extract_words(text)
    words = []
    text.split("\n").each_with_index do |line, line_num|
      # Використовуємо регулярний вираз для виділення слів
      line.scan(/\b[a-zA-Z']+\b/) do |word|
        char_pos = Regexp.last_match.offset(0).first
        words << [word.downcase, { line: line_num, char: char_pos }]
      end
    end
    words
  end
end

# spell_checker.rb
require 'ffi/hunspell'

class SpellChecker
  def initialize(language: 'en_US', dictionary_path: nil, affix_path: nil)
    @language = language
    
    # Try to find dictionary files automatically or use provided paths
    if dictionary_path && affix_path
      @dictionary_path = dictionary_path
      @affix_path = affix_path
    else
      find_dictionary_files
    end
    
    @hunspell = FFI::Hunspell.dict(@affix_path, @dictionary_path)
  end
  
  def check_word(word)
    @hunspell.check?(word)
  end
  
  def suggest_corrections(word)
    @hunspell.suggest(word)
  end
  
  def check_text(text)
    words = text.split(/\b/)
    results = []
    
    words.each do |word|
      # Skip non-word characters and very short strings
      next if word.strip.empty? || word =~ /^\W+$/ || word.length < 2
      
      clean_word = word.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z']/, '').downcase
      next if clean_word.empty?
      
      if check_word(clean_word)
        results << { word: word, correct: true, suggestions: [] }
      else
        suggestions = suggest_corrections(clean_word)
        results << { word: word, correct: false, suggestions: suggestions }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  def spell_check_with_context(text)
    results = check_text(text)
    
    puts "Spell Check Results:"
    puts "=" * 50
    
    incorrect_words = results.select { |r| !r[:correct] }
    
    if incorrect_words.empty?
      puts "✓ No spelling errors found!"
    else
      puts "Found #{incorrect_words.size} potential error(s):"
      puts
      
      incorrect_words.each do |result|
        puts "Word: '#{result[:word]}'"
        if result[:suggestions].any?
          puts "Suggestions: #{result[:suggestions].first(5).join(', ')}"
        else
          puts "No suggestions available"
        end
        puts "-" * 30
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  private
  
  def find_dictionary_files
    # Common locations for hunspell dictionaries
    possible_paths = [
      '/usr/share/hunspell',
      '/usr/local/share/hunspell',
      '/opt/local/share/hunspell',
      "#{Dir.home}/.local/share/hunspell",
      './dictionaries'
    ]
    
    possible_paths.each do |path|
      dict_file = File.join(path, "#{@language}.dic")
      aff_file = File.join(path, "#{@language}.aff")
      
      if File.exist?(dict_file) && File.exist?(aff_file)
        @dictionary_path = dict_file
        @affix_path = aff_file
        return
      end
    end
    
    raise "Could not find dictionary files for #{@language}. Please install hunspell dictionaries or provide custom paths."
  end
  
  def close
    @hunspell.close if @hunspell
  end
end

    PROMPT

      }.to_json
    )

class SentimentAnalyzer
  POSITIVE_WORDS = %w[
    good great excellent amazing wonderful fantastic awesome superb perfect
    love like nice cool brilliant outstanding marvelous terrific splendid
    delightful satisfying impressive superior quality valuable best better
    satisfied happy pleased delighted joyful positive
  ].freeze

  NEGATIVE_WORDS = %w[
    bad terrible awful horrible disappointing poor worst useless waste terrible
    hate dislike awful disgusting frustrating annoying boring terrible cheap
    broken damaged defective faulty problematic wrong error failed mistake
    negative unhappy disappointed unsatisfied poor
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @classifier = ClassifierReborn::Bayes.new(
      'positive', 
      'negative', 
      'neutral'
    )
    
    setup_stopwords_filter
    train_classifier
  end

  def analyze(review_text)
    return 'neutral' if review_text.nil? || review_text.strip.empty?
    
    cleaned_text = preprocess_text(review_text)
    sentiment = @classifier.classify(cleaned_text)
    
    # Додатковий аналіз для підвищення точності
    final_sentiment = refine_sentiment(sentiment, cleaned_text)
    final_sentiment
  end

  def analyze_batch(reviews)
    reviews.map { |review| { review: review, sentiment: analyze(review) } }
  end

  private

  def setup_stopwords_filter
    @filter = Stopwords::Filter.new
  end

  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Очищення тексту
    cleaned = text.downcase
                 .gsub(/[^\w\s]/, '')     # Видалення спеціальних символів
                 .gsub(/\d+/, '')         # Видалення чисел
                 .squeeze(' ')            # Видалення зайвих пробілів
                 .strip
    
    # Видалення стоп-слів
    words = cleaned.split(' ')
    filtered_words = @filter.filter(words)
    filtered_words.join(' ')
  end

  def train_classifier
    # Навчання на базових прикладах
    train_positive_examples
    train_negative_examples  
    train_neutral_examples
  end

  def train_positive_examples
    positive_examples = [
      "This product is absolutely amazing and works perfectly!",
      "I love this item, it's high quality and durable.",
      "Excellent value for money, highly recommended.",
      "Great product, exceeds expectations.",
      "Wonderful experience, will buy again.",
      "Outstanding performance and quality.",
      "Perfect solution for my needs.",
      "Very satisfied with this purchase.",
      "Impressive features and design.",
      "Best product I've ever used."
    ]

    positive_examples.each do |example|
      @classifier.train_positive(preprocess_text(example))
    end
  end

  def train_negative_examples
    negative_examples = [
      "Terrible product, stopped working after one day.",
      "Poor quality, complete waste of money.",
      "Very disappointed with this purchase.",
      "Does not work as described, awful experience.",
      "Worst product ever, avoid at all costs.",
      "Broken upon arrival, terrible quality.",
      "Useless and frustrating to use.",
      "Complete disappointment, not worth it.",
      "Poor craftsmanship and design.",
      "Horrible customer service and product."
    ]

    negative_examples.each do |example|
      @classifier.train_negative(preprocess_text(example))
    end
  end

  def train_neutral_examples
    neutral_examples = [
      "The product arrived on time as expected.",
      "It works as described in the manual.",
      "Standard quality for this price range.",
      "The item is exactly what I ordered.",
      "Average product, nothing special.",
      "Meets basic requirements adequately.",
      "Standard features and performance.",
      "The product functions normally.",
      "Typical quality for this category.",
      "Received the package without issues."
    ]

    neutral_examples.each do |example|
      @classifier.train_neutral(preprocess_text(example))
    end
  end

  def refine_sentiment(sentiment, text)
    words = text.split(' ')
    
    positive_count = words.count { |word| POSITIVE_WORDS.include?(word) }
    negative_count = words.count { |word| NEGATIVE_WORDS.include?(word) }
    
    # Якщо різниця між позитивними та негативними словами значна, коригуємо результат
    if positive_count - negative_count >= 2
      'positive'
    elsif negative_count - positive_count >= 2
      'negative'
    else
      sentiment
    end
  end

  end
  
  def self.time_ago_in_words(from_time, include_seconds = false)

  def self.distance_of_time_in_words(from_time, to_time, options = {})
    # Use ActiveSupport's built-in method
    from_time = from_time.to_time if from_time.respond_to?(:to_time)
    to_time = to_time.to_time if to_time.respond_to?(:to_time)
    
    distance_in_minutes = ((to_time - from_time).abs / 60).round
    distance_in_seconds = (to_time - from_time).abs.round
    
    case distance_in_minutes
    when 0..1
      return (distance_in_minutes == 0) ? 'less than a minute' : '1 minute' unless options[:include_seconds]
      
      case distance_in_seconds
      when 0..4 then 'less than 5 seconds'
      when 5..9 then 'less than 10 seconds'
      when 10..19 then 'less than 20 seconds'
      when 20..39 then 'half a minute'
      when 40..59 then 'less than a minute'
      else '1 minute'
      end
    when 2..44 then "#{distance_in_minutes} minutes"
    when 45..89 then 'about 1 hour'
    when 90..1439 then "about #{(distance_in_minutes.to_f / 60.0).round} hours"
    when 1440..2879 then '1 day'

    end
  end

# main.rb
class NumberToWords
  ONES = %w[zero one two three four five six seven eight nine]
  TEENS = %w[ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen]
  TENS = %w[zero ten twenty thirty forty fifty sixty seventy eighty ninety]
  THOUSANDS = ['', 'thousand', 'million', 'billion', 'trillion']

  def self.convert(number)
    return ONES[0] if number == 0
    
    if number < 0
      return "negative #{convert(-number)}"
    end
    
    words = []
    chunk_count = 0
    
    while number > 0
      chunk = number % 1000
      number /= 1000
      
      if chunk != 0
        chunk_words = convert_chunk(chunk)
        chunk_words += " #{THOUSANDS[chunk_count]}" if chunk_count > 0
        words.unshift(chunk_words)
      end
      
      chunk_count += 1
    end
    
    words.join(' ').strip
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.convert_chunk(number)
    return '' if number == 0
    
    words = []
    
    # Handle hundreds
    if number >= 100
      words << "#{ONES[number / 100]} hundred"
      number %= 100
    end
    
    # Handle tens and ones
    if number >= 20
      words << TENS[number / 10]
      number %= 10
      words << ONES[number] if number > 0
    elsif number >= 10
      words << TEENS[number - 10]
    elsif number > 0
      words << ONES[number]
    end
    
    words.join(' ')
  end
end

  TIME_UNITS = {

        format_unit(time_diff.to_i, :second)
      elsif time_diff < 3600
        format_unit((time_diff / 60).to_i, :minute)
      elsif time_diff < 86400

      elsif time_diff < 604800
        format_unit((time_diff / 86400).to_i, :day)
      elsif time_diff < 2592000
        format_unit((time_diff / 604800).to_i, :week)
      elsif time_diff < 31536000
        format_unit((time_diff / 2592000).to_i, :month)
      else
        format_unit((time_diff / 31536000).to_i, :year)
      end
    end

    private

    # Форматує одиницю часу з правильною множиною/одниною

      unit_name = pluralize_unit(count, unit)
      "#{count} #{unit_name} ago"
    end

    # Повертає правильну форму іменника (однина/множина)
    def pluralize_unit(count, unit)
      if count == 1
        TIME_UNITS[unit] # однина
      else

      end
    end
  end

class NumberToWords
  ONES = %w[zero one two three four five six seven eight nine]
  TEENS = %w[ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen]
  TENS = %w[zero ten twenty thirty forty fifty sixty seventy eighty ninety]
  THOUSANDS = %w[thousand million billion trillion quadrillion]

  def self.convert(number)
    return 'zero' if number == 0
    return 'negative ' + convert(-number) if number < 0
    
    words = []
    remaining = number
    
    # Обробка мільйонів, тисяч і одиниць
    if remaining >= 1_000_000_000_000_000
      quadrillions = remaining / 1_000_000_000_000_000
      words << convert_under_thousand(quadrillions) + ' quadrillion'
      remaining %= 1_000_000_000_000_000
    end
    
    if remaining >= 1_000_000_000_000
      trillions = remaining / 1_000_000_000_000
      words << convert_under_thousand(trillions) + ' trillion'
      remaining %= 1_000_000_000_000
    end
    
    if remaining >= 1_000_000_000
      billions = remaining / 1_000_000_000
      words << convert_under_thousand(billions) + ' billion'
      remaining %= 1_000_000_000
    end
    
    if remaining >= 1_000_000
      millions = remaining / 1_000_000
      words << convert_under_thousand(millions) + ' million'
      remaining %= 1_000_000
    end
    
    if remaining >= 1_000
      thousands = remaining / 1_000
      words << convert_under_thousand(thousands) + ' thousand'
      remaining %= 1_000
    end
    
    if remaining > 0
      words << convert_under_thousand(remaining)
    end
    
    words.join(' ').gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
  end

  private

  def self.convert_under_thousand(number)
    return '' if number == 0
    
    words = []
    remaining = number
    
    # Сотні
    if remaining >= 100
      hundreds = remaining / 100
      words << ONES[hundreds] + ' hundred'
      remaining %= 100
    end
    
    # Десятки та одиниці
    if remaining >= 20
      tens = remaining / 10
      words << TENS[tens]
      remaining %= 10
      
      if remaining > 0
        words[-1] += '-' + ONES[remaining]
        remaining = 0
      end
    elsif remaining >= 10
      words << TEENS[remaining - 10]
      remaining = 0
    end
    
    # Одиниці
    if remaining > 0
      words << ONES[remaining]
    end
    
    words.join(' ')
  end
end

    }

               .strip
  end

  def build_vocabulary
    all_words = @documents.flat_map { |doc| doc.split(' ') }
    Set.new(all_words.reject { |word| word.length < 2 }).to_a.sort
  end
  
  # Розбиття документа на токени
  def tokenize(document)
    document.split(' ')
  end
  
  # Обчислення TF (Term Frequency) для одного документа
  def term_frequency(document, term)
    tokens = tokenize(document)
    term_count = tokens.count(term)
    term_count.to_f / tokens.length
  end
  
  # Обчислення IDF (Inverse Document Frequency) для терму
  def inverse_document_frequency(term)
    documents_containing_term = @documents.count { |doc| tokenize(doc).include?(term) }
    return 0 if documents_containing_term == 0
    
    Math.log(@documents.size.to_f / documents_containing_term)
  end

  def tfidf(document, term)
    tf = term_frequency(document, term)
    idf = inverse_document_frequency(term)
    tf * idf
  end

    rows = @documents.map do |doc|
      @vocabulary.map { |term| tfidf(doc, term) }
    end

  end

    tf = {}

require 'obscenity'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Список додаткових слів для фільтрації (можна розширювати)
  CUSTOM_BLACKLIST = [
    'stupid', 'idiot', 'moron', 'dumb', 'loser'
  ].freeze

  # Список довадливих слів, які можна використовувати
  WHITELIST = [
    'assistant', 'classic', 'grass', 'pass' # слова, що містять частини нецензурних слів
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Основний метод для фільтрації тексту
  def filter(text, replacement: '[цензура]')
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    # Перевірка та фільтрація тексту
    if profane?(text)
      Obscenity.sanitize(text, replacement: replacement)
    else
      text
    end
  end

  # Перевірка чи містить текст нецензурну лексику
  def profane?(text)
    Obscenity.profane?(text.to_s.downcase)
  end

  # Отримання списку нецензурних слів у тексті
  def profane_words(text)
    Obscenity.offensive(text.to_s.downcase)
  end

  # Додавання кастомних слів до чорного списку
  def add_to_blacklist(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    new_blacklist = (Obscenity.config.blacklist + words).uniq
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = new_blacklist
    end
  end

  # Додавання слів до білого списку
  def add_to_whitelist(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    new_whitelist = (Obscenity.config.whitelist + words).uniq
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.whitelist = new_whitelist
    end
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = Obscenity::Base.blacklist + CUSTOM_BLACKLIST
      config.whitelist = WHITELIST
      config.replacement = :garbled # варіанти: :default, :garbled, :vowels, :nonconsonants
    end
  end
end

require 'obscenity'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Default profanity list (Obscenity gem comes with its own list)
  # You can customize this list as needed
  DEFAULT_PROFANITY_LIST = [
    'ass', 'asshole', 'bastard', 'bitch', 'bullshit', 'crap', 'damn',
    'dick', 'fuck', 'hell', 'shit', 'piss', 'slut', 'whore'
  ].freeze

  def initialize(custom_words: [], replacement: '***', strict_mode: false)
    @replacement = replacement
    @strict_mode = strict_mode
    
    # Configure Obscenity gem
    configure_obscenity(custom_words)
  end

  # Filter profanity in a single comment
  def filter(comment)
    return '' if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    if @strict_mode
      # More aggressive filtering
      filter_aggressive(comment.to_s)
    else
      # Standard filtering using Obscenity gem
      Obscenity.sanitize(comment.to_s)
    end
  end

  # Check if comment contains profanity without filtering
  def profane?(comment)
    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    Obscenity.profane?(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Get list of profane words found in comment
  def profane_words(comment)
    return [] if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    Obscenity.offensive(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Batch filter multiple comments
  def filter_multiple(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| filter(comment) }
  end

  # Add custom profanity words
  def add_custom_words(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    current_list = Obscenity.config.blacklist
    Obscenity.configure { |config| config.blacklist = current_list + words }
  end

  # Remove words from profanity list
  def remove_words(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    current_list = Obscenity.config.blacklist
    Obscenity.configure { |config| config.blacklist = current_list - words }
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity(custom_words)
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = DEFAULT_PROFANITY_LIST + custom_words
      config.replacement = @replacement
      config.whitelist = []  # Words that should never be filtered
    end
  end

  def filter_aggressive(comment)
    # Split into words and filter each one
    words = comment.split(/\b/)
    filtered_words = words.map do |word|
      if Obscenity.profane?(word)
        @replacement
      else
        # Check for leet speak variations (e.g., f*ck, f**k, etc.)
        contains_profanity?(word) ? @replacement : word
      end
    end
    filtered_words.join
  end

  def contains_profanity?(word)
    # Simple leet speak detection for common profanity patterns
    leet_patterns = [
      /f[*@!#]+u[*@!#]+c[*@!#]+k/i,    # f**k, f@ck, etc.
      /s[*@!#]+h[*@!#]+i[*@!#]+t/i,    # sh*t, sh!t, etc.
      /b[*@!#]+i[*@!#]+t[*@!#]+c[*@!#]+h/i, # b*tch, b!tch, etc.
      /a[*@!#]+s[*@!#]+s/i,            # a**s, a$$, etc.
      /d[*@!#]+a[*@!#]+m[*@!#]+n/i     # d*mn, d@mn, etc.
    ]
    
    leet_patterns.any? { |pattern| word =~ pattern }
  end

# document_embedder.rb
require 'pg'
require 'pgvector'
require 'openai'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class DocumentEmbedder
  def initialize
    @openai_client = OpenAI::Client.new(access_token: ENV['OPENAI_API_KEY'])
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    @conn = PG.connect(
      host: ENV['DB_HOST'] || 'localhost',
      port: ENV['DB_PORT'] || 5432,
      dbname: ENV['DB_NAME'] || 'vector_db',
      user: ENV['DB_USER'] || 'postgres',
      password: ENV['DB_PASSWORD'] || 'password'
    )
    
    # Enable pgvector extension
    @conn.exec('CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector')
    
    # Create documents table with vector column
    @conn.exec(<<~SQL)
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        embedding VECTOR(1536), -- OpenAI embeddings are 1536-dimensional
        metadata JSONB,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
      )
    SQL
    
    # Create index for efficient similarity search
    @conn.exec('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS documents_embedding_idx ON documents USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops)')
  end

  def generate_embedding(text)
    response = @openai_client.embeddings(
      parameters: {
        model: 'text-embedding-ada-002',
        input: text
      }
    )
    
    if response['data'] && response['data'][0]
      response['data'][0]['embedding']
    else
      raise "Failed to generate embedding: #{response}"
    end
  end

  def add_document(content, metadata = {})
    embedding = generate_embedding(content)
    
    # Convert embedding array to PostgreSQL vector format
    embedding_vector = Pgvector.encode(embedding)
    
    result = @conn.exec_params(
      'INSERT INTO documents (content, embedding, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING id',
      [content, embedding_vector, metadata.to_json]
    )
    
    result[0]['id']
  end

  def search_similar_documents(query_text, limit: 5)
    query_embedding = generate_embedding(query_text)
    query_vector = Pgvector.encode(query_embedding)
    
    # Use cosine similarity search
    results = @conn.exec_params(<<~SQL, [query_vector, limit])
      SELECT 
        id,
        content,
        metadata,
        embedding <=> $1 as similarity,
        1 - (embedding <=> $1) as cosine_similarity
      FROM documents 
      ORDER BY embedding <=> $1
      LIMIT $2
    SQL
    
    results.map do |row|
      {
        id: row['id'].to_i,
        content: row['content'],
        metadata: JSON.parse(row['metadata'] || '{}'),
        distance: row['similarity'].to_f,
        cosine_similarity: row['cosine_similarity'].to_f
      }
    end
  end

  def list_documents(limit: 10)
    results = @conn.exec_params('SELECT id, content, metadata FROM documents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $1', [limit])
    
    results.map do |row|
      {
        id: row['id'].to_i,
        content: row['content'],
        metadata: JSON.parse(row['metadata'] || '{}')
      }
    end
  end

  def close
    @conn.close if @conn
  end
end

require 'stanford-core-nlp'
require 'nokogiri'

class EntityExtractor
  ENTITY_TYPES = {
    'PERSON' => 'Person',
    'ORGANIZATION' => 'Organization', 
    'LOCATION' => 'Location',
    'CITY' => 'Location',
    'STATE_OR_PROVINCE' => 'Location',
    'COUNTRY' => 'Location'
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    setup_stanford_nlp
  end

  def setup_stanford_nlp
    # Set the path to Stanford NLP models (you'll need to download these)
    StanfordCoreNLP.use :english
    StanfordCoreNLP.model_files = {}
    StanfordCoreNLP.default_jars = [
      'joda-time.jar',
      'xom.jar',
      'stanford-corenlp-4.5.0.jar',
      'stanford-corenlp-4.5.0-models.jar',
      'jollyday.jar',
      'bridge.jar'
    ]
    
    @pipeline = StanfordCoreNLP.load(:tokenize, :ssplit, :pos, :lemma, :ner, :parse, :coref)
  end

  def extract_from_text(text)
    return {} if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?

    text = clean_text(text)
    annotation = StanfordCoreNLP::Annotation.new(text)
    @pipeline.annotate(annotation)

    entities = extract_entities(annotation)
    group_entities(entities)
  end

  def extract_from_url(url)
    # Extract text from a web page
    response = HTTParty.get(url)
    return {} unless response.success?

    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
    
    # Remove script and style elements
    doc.css('script, style').remove
    
    # Extract text from paragraphs and headings
    text_elements = doc.css('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6')
    article_text = text_elements.map(&:text).join("\n")
    
    extract_from_text(article_text)
  end

  def extract_from_html(html_content)
    # Extract text from HTML content
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html_content)
    doc.css('script, style').remove
    article_text = doc.css('body').text
    
    extract_from_text(article_text)
  end

  private

  def clean_text(text)
    # Basic text cleaning
    text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
  end

  def extract_entities(annotation)
    entities = []
    sentences = annotation.get(:sentences)
    
    sentences.each do |sentence|
      tokens = sentence.get(:tokens)
      current_entity = nil
      
      tokens.each do |token|
        ner_tag = token.get(:named_entity_tag).to_s
        word = token.get(:original_text).to_s
        
        if ENTITY_TYPES.key?(ner_tag) && ner_tag != 'O'
          if current_entity && current_entity[:type] == ner_tag
            # Continue the current entity
            current_entity[:text] += " #{word}"
          else
            # Start a new entity
            entities << current_entity if current_entity
            current_entity = {
              text: word,
              type: ner_tag,
              category: ENTITY_TYPES[ner_tag]
            }
          end
        else
          # End the current entity
          entities << current_entity if current_entity
          current_entity = nil
        end
      end
      
      entities << current_entity if current_entity
    end
    
    entities.compact
  end

  def group_entities(entities)
    grouped = {
      people: [],
      organizations: [],
      locations: []
    }
    
    entities.each do |entity|
      case entity[:category]
      when 'Person'
        grouped[:people] << entity[:text]
      when 'Organization'
        grouped[:organizations] << entity[:text]
      when 'Location'
        grouped[:locations] << entity[:text]
      end
    end
    
    # Remove duplicates and sort
    grouped.transform_values! { |v| v.uniq.sort }
    grouped
  end
end

# readability_calculator.rb
require 'engtagger'

class ReadabilityCalculator
  attr_reader :text
  
  def initialize(text)
    @text = text.to_s
  end
  
  # Calculate Flesch Reading Ease score
  # Formula: 206.835 - 1.015 * (total_words / total_sentences) - 84.6 * (total_syllables / total_words)
  def flesch_reading_ease
    return 0 if text.strip.empty?
    
    words = extract_words
    sentences = extract_sentences
    syllables = count_syllables(words)
    
    # Avoid division by zero
    return 0 if words.empty? || sentences.empty?
    
    words_per_sentence = words.size.to_f / sentences.size
    syllables_per_word = syllables.to_f / words.size
    
    206.835 - (1.015 * words_per_sentence) - (84.6 * syllables_per_word)
  end
  
  # Interpret the Flesch score and provide a readability level
  def flesch_interpretation(score = nil)
    score ||= flesch_reading_ease
    
    case score
    when 90..100 then "Very Easy (5th grade)"
    when 80...90 then "Easy (6th grade)"
    when 70...80 then "Fairly Easy (7th-8th grade)"
    when 60...70 then "Standard (9th-10th grade)"
    when 50...60 then "Fairly Difficult (11th-12th grade)"
    when 30...50 then "Difficult (College level)"
    when 0...30 then "Very Difficult (College graduate)"
    else "Score out of range"
    end
  end
  
  def statistics
    words = extract_words
    sentences = extract_sentences
    syllables = count_syllables(words)
    
    {
      word_count: words.size,
      sentence_count: sentences.size,
      syllable_count: syllables,
      words_per_sentence: words.size.to_f / [sentences.size, 1].max,
      syllables_per_word: syllables.to_f / [words.size, 1].max,
      flesch_score: flesch_reading_ease,
      readability_level: flesch_interpretation
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def extract_words
    # Remove punctuation and split into words
    text.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, '').downcase.split
  end
  
  def extract_sentences
    # Simple sentence splitting - can be improved for edge cases
    text.split(/[.!?]+/).reject(&:empty?)
  end
  
  def count_syllables(words)
    total_syllables = 0
    
    words.each do |word|
      total_syllables += syllables_in_word(word)
    end
    
    total_syllables
  end
  
  def syllables_in_word(word)
    # Basic syllable counting algorithm
    # Count vowel groups, but be aware of silent 'e' and other exceptions
    word = word.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z]/, '')
    
    return 1 if word.empty?
    
    # Count vowel groups
    vowel_count = word.scan(/[aeiouy]+/).size
    
    # Adjust for silent 'e' at the end
    if word.end_with?('e') && vowel_count > 1
      vowel_count -= 1
    end
    
    # Ensure at least one syllable
    [vowel_count, 1].max
  end
end

class ReadabilityCalculator
  def initialize
    @tagger = EngTagger.new
  end

  # Основний метод для обчислення індексу читабельності Флеша
  def flesch_reading_ease(text)
    sentences = split_into_sentences(text)
    words = split_into_words(text)
    syllables = count_total_syllables(words)
    
    return 0 if sentences.empty? || words.empty?
    
    # Формула Флеша: 206.835 - 1.015 * (слова/речення) - 84.6 * (склади/слово)
    words_per_sentence = words.length.to_f / sentences.length
    syllables_per_word = syllables.to_f / words.length
    
    206.835 - (1.015 * words_per_sentence) - (84.6 * syllables_per_word)
  end

  # Розбиває текст на речення
  def split_into_sentences(text)
    return [] if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?
    
    # Простий метод розбиття на речення (можна покращити за допомогою гемів)
    sentences = text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip.split(/[.!?]+/)
    sentences.reject { |s| s.strip.empty? }
  end

  # Розбиває текст на слова
  def split_into_words(text)
    return [] if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?
    
    # Видаляємо пунктуацію та розбиваємо на слова
    clean_text = text.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, ' ').gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
    clean_text.downcase.split(' ')
  end

  # Підраховує загальну кількість складів у тексті
  def count_total_syllables(words)
    words.sum { |word| count_syllables_in_word(word) }
  end

  # Підраховує кількість складів в одному слові
  def count_syllables_in_word(word)
    return 0 if word.nil? || word.empty?
    
    word = word.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z]/, '')
    return 1 if word.empty?
    
    # Додаємо кінцеву 'e' для обробки мовчазних 'e'
    word += 'e' if word.end_with?('e')
    
    # Підрахунок голосних груп
    vowel_groups = word.scan(/[aeiouy]+/i)
    
    # Мінімум 1 склад на слово
    syllable_count = vowel_groups.length
    syllable_count = 1 if syllable_count == 0
    
    # Коригування для спеціальних випадків
    syllable_count -= 1 if word.end_with?('e') && syllable_count > 1
    syllable_count -= 1 if word.end_with?('le') && word.length > 2 && !word.end_with?('lle')
    
    syllable_count
  end

    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']
    raise "Anthropic API key not found. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable." unless @api_key
  end
  
  def summarize_ticket(ticket_content, max_tokens: 500, model: 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229')

    truncated_content = truncate_content(ticket_content, 8000)
    
    prompt = build_summarization_prompt(truncated_content)
    
    response = send_to_claude(prompt, max_tokens, model)
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  def summarize_multiple_tickets(tickets, max_tokens: 300, model: 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229')
    summaries = []
    
    tickets.each_with_index do |ticket, index|
      puts "Summarizing ticket #{index + 1}/#{tickets.length}..."
      summary = summarize_ticket(ticket, max_tokens: max_tokens, model: model)
      summaries << summary
    end
    
    summaries
  end
  
  private
  
  def truncate_content(content, max_length)
    # Simple truncation - you might want more sophisticated token counting
    if content.length > max_length
      content[0...max_length] + "\n\n[Content truncated due to length]"
    else
      content
    end
  end
  
  def build_summarization_prompt(ticket_content)
    <<~PROMPT
      You are a support team assistant. Please analyze the following support ticket and provide a concise summary with the following structure:
      
      1. **Main Issue**: One sentence describing the core problem
      2. **Key Details**: 2-3 bullet points with important technical details or symptoms
      3. **User's Goal**: What the user is trying to accomplish
      4. **Urgency Level**: Low, Medium, High, or Critical
      5. **Suggested Category**: Bug, Feature Request, How-to Question, Account Issue, etc.
      
      Support Ticket Content:
      #{ticket_content}
      
      Please provide the summary in a clear, structured format that's easy for support agents to quickly understand.
    PROMPT
  end
  
  def send_to_claude(prompt, max_tokens, model)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => @api_key,
      'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01'
    }
    
    body = {
      model: model,
      max_tokens: max_tokens,
      messages: [
        {
          role: 'user',
          content: prompt
        }
      ]
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      ANTHROPIC_API_URL,
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    unless response.success?
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
    
    response
  end
  
  def parse_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    data.dig('content', 0, 'text')
  end

class SupportSummarizer
  def initialize
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(access_token: ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])
  end

  def summarize_support_request(customer_message, max_tokens: 1000)
    prompt = build_prompt(customer_message)
    
    response = @client.messages(
      parameters: {
        model: "claude-3-sonnet-20240229",
        max_tokens: max_tokens,
        messages: [
          {
            role: "user",
            content: prompt
          }
        ]
      }
    )

  end

  def summarize_multiple_requests(requests, batch_size: 5)
    summaries = []
    
    requests.each_slice(batch_size) do |batch|
      batch_summaries = batch.map do |request|
        {
          original: request,
          summary: summarize_support_request(request)
        }
      end
      summaries.concat(batch_summaries)
      
      # Затримка між партіями, щоб уникнути перевищення лімітів API
      sleep(1) if batch.size == batch_size
    end
    
    summaries
  end

      - Категорія:
      - Короткий підсумок:

      Звернення клієнта:
      #{customer_message}
    PROMPT
  end

  def extract_summary(response)

      response['content'].first['text']

  def summarize_long_request(customer_message, chunk_size: 2000)
    # Розбиваємо довгий текст на частини
    chunks = split_text_into_chunks(customer_message, chunk_size)
    
    if chunks.size == 1
      summarize_support_request(customer_message)
    else
      summarize_chunked_request(chunks)
    end

  def split_text_into_chunks(text, chunk_size)
    words = text.split(/\s+/)
    chunks = []
    current_chunk = []
    current_size = 0

    words.each do |word|
      if current_size + word.length > chunk_size && !current_chunk.empty?
        chunks << current_chunk.join(' ')
        current_chunk = []
        current_size = 0
      end
      current_chunk << word
      current_size += word.length
    end

    chunks << current_chunk.join(' ') unless current_chunk.empty?
    chunks
  end

      summarize_support_request(chunk, max_tokens: 500)

require 'chronic'
require 'active_support/time'
require 'time'

class NaturalDateParser
  def self.parse(date_string, options = {})
    # Set default context if not provided
    context = options[:context] || :future
    
    # Configure Chronic with some common defaults
    Chronic.time_class = options[:time_zone] ? Time.find_zone(options[:time_zone]) : Time
    
    # Preprocess the input to handle common variations
    normalized_string = normalize_date_string(date_string)
    
    # Parse using Chronic
    parsed_time = Chronic.parse(normalized_string, 
                               context: context,
                               guess: options.fetch(:guess, true),
                               ambiguous_time_range: options.fetch(:ambiguous_time_range, 6))
    
    # Handle time zone conversion if specified
    if parsed_time && options[:time_zone]
      time_zone = Time.find_zone(options[:time_zone])
      parsed_time = parsed_time.in_time_zone(time_zone) if time_zone
    end
    
    parsed_time
  end
  
  def self.normalize_date_string(date_string)
    return "" unless date_string
    
    # Convert to lowercase for consistency
    normalized = date_string.downcase.strip
    
    # Handle common variations and abbreviations
    replacements = {
      /\bnext\s+week\b/ => 'in 1 week',
      /\blast\s+week\b/ => '1 week ago',
      /\bnext\s+month\b/ => 'in 1 month',
      /\blast\s+month\b/ => '1 month ago',
      /\bnoon\b/ => '12:00',
      /\bmidnight\b/ => '00:00',
      /\btoday\b/ => 'this day',
      /\btomorrow\b/ => 'next day',
      /\byesterday\b/ => 'last day',
      /\b(\d+)\s*am\b/i => '\1am',
      /\b(\d+)\s*pm\b/i => '\1pm',
      /\bat\s+(\d)/ => ' \1' # Remove 'at' before times for better parsing
    }
    
    replacements.each do |pattern, replacement|
      normalized.gsub!(pattern, replacement)
    end
    
    normalized
  end
  
  # Helper method to parse with specific context
  def self.parse_future(date_string, options = {})
    parse(date_string, options.merge(context: :future))
  end
  
  def self.parse_past(date_string, options = {})
    parse(date_string, options.merge(context: :past))
  end
  
  # Validate if a string can be parsed as a natural language date
  def self.valid?(date_string)
    !parse(date_string).nil?
  end
end

class NaturalDateParser
  def self.parse(date_string, options = {})
    # Додаємо поточний контекст часу для кращого розпізнавання
    context = options[:context] || :future
    
    # Обробляємо спеціальні випадки, які Chronic може не розпізнати ідеально
    normalized_string = normalize_date_string(date_string)
    
    # Використовуємо Chronic для розбору
    time = Chronic.parse(normalized_string, 
                        context: context,
                        guess: options.fetch(:guess, true),
                        ambiguous_time_range: options.fetch(:ambiguous_time_range, 6))
    
    # Якщо час не вказаний, встановлюємо за замовчуванням поточний час
    if time && !contains_time?(date_string)
      time = time.change(hour: Time.now.hour, min: Time.now.min, sec: Time.now.sec)
    end
    
    time
  end
  
  def self.parse!(date_string, options = {})
    result = parse(date_string, options)
    raise "Could not parse date: #{date_string}" if result.nil?
    result
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.normalize_date_string(date_string)
    string = date_string.downcase.strip
    
    # Замінюємо поширені варіанти написання
    replacements = {
      /next\s+(mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun)/ => '\1day next week',
      /last\s+(mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun)/ => '\1day last week',
      /this\s+(mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun)/ => 'this \1day',
      /tomorrow/ => 'next day',
      /yesterday/ => 'last day',
      /today/ => 'this day',
      /noon/ => '12:00',
      /midnight/ => '00:00',
      /(\d+)\s*(am|pm)/ => '\1 \2', # Видаляємо зайві пробіли
      /at\s+(\d+)/ => 'at \1:00' # Додаємо :00 якщо вказано тільки години
    }
    
    replacements.each do |pattern, replacement|
      string = string.gsub(pattern, replacement)
    end
    
    string
  end
  
  def self.contains_time?(date_string)
    date_string.downcase =~ /(\d{1,2}:\d{2}|am|pm|noon|midnight|\d+\s*(am|pm))/
  end

      # Апостроф
      "'" => '', 'ʼ' => '', 'ʹ' => '',
      
      # М'який знак
      'Ь' => '', 'ь' => ''
    }.freeze

    # Спеціальні випадки на початку слова
    SPECIAL_START_CASES = {
      'Є' => 'Ye', 'є' => 'ye',
      'Ї' => 'Yi', 'ї' => 'yi',
      'Й' => 'Y', 'й' => 'y',
      'Ю' => 'Yu', 'ю' => 'yu',

      normalized_text = Unicode.normalize_KC(text)
      result = []
      words = normalized_text.split(/(\s+)/)

        end

    def transliterate_word(word)
      return word if word.empty?
      
      chars = word.chars
      result = []
      prev_char = nil
      
      chars.each_with_index do |char, index|

        is_word_start = index == 0 || (prev_char && !letter?(prev_char))
        
        # Обробка спеціальних випадків на початку слова

          result << ''

        elsif char == 'ь' || char == 'Ь'
          # М'який знак не транслітерується

# config/initializers/ukrainian_pluralization.rb

# Ukrainian pluralization rules for Rails I18n
# Rules based on the Unicode CLDR: https://www.unicode.org/cldr/cldr-aux/charts/42/supplemental/language_plural_rules.html

module UkrainianPluralization
  # Ukrainian pluralization rule:
  # one: n mod 10 is 1 and n mod 100 is not 11
  # few: n mod 10 in 2..4 and n mod 100 not in 12..14
  # many: n mod 10 is 0 or n mod 10 in 5..9 or n mod 100 in 11..14
  # other: fractional numbers (not used for integers)

  def self.rule
    lambda do |count|
      if count.is_a?(Numeric)
        mod10 = count % 10
        mod100 = count % 100

        if mod10 == 1 && mod100 != 11
          :one
        elsif mod10.between?(2, 4) && !mod100.between?(12, 14)
          :few
        elsif mod10 == 0 || mod10.between?(5, 9) || mod100.between?(11, 14)
          :many
        else
          :other
        end
      else
        :other
      end
    end
  end
end

# ukrainian_phone_normalizer.rb
require 'phonelib'

class UkrainianPhoneNormalizer
  # Known Ukrainian mobile operators and their codes
  OPERATORS = {
    'Kyivstar' => ['39', '50', '66', '67', '68', '96', '97', '98'],
    'Vodafone' => ['95', '99', '50', '66', '67', '68'],
    'Lifecell' => ['63', '73', '93', '67', '68'],
    '3mob' => ['50', '66', '67', '68'],
    'intertelecom' => ['89', '94']
  }.freeze

  def self.normalize(phone_number)
    # Parse the phone number using Phonelib
    parsed = Phonelib.parse(phone_number)
    
    # Check if it's a valid Ukrainian number
    return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid Ukrainian phone number' } unless parsed.valid_for_country?('UA')
    
    # Get the international format
    normalized = parsed.international
    
    # Extract the national number without country code
    national_number = parsed.national.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Get the operator
    operator = detect_operator(national_number)
    
    {
      valid: true,
      normalized: normalized,
      operator: operator,
      national_format: parsed.national,
      e164_format: parsed.e164
    }
  end
  
  def self.detect_operator(national_number)
    # Ukrainian mobile numbers are 9 digits after country code
    # The operator code is typically the first 2-3 digits after the leading 0
    return 'Unknown' if national_number.length < 9
    
    # Remove leading 0 if present and get the operator code (2-3 digits)
    clean_number = national_number.gsub(/^0/, '')
    
    # Try 3-digit codes first, then 2-digit codes
    three_digit_code = clean_number[0, 3]
    two_digit_code = clean_number[0, 2]
    
    OPERATORS.each do |operator, codes|
      return operator if codes.include?(three_digit_code) || codes.include?(two_digit_code)
    end
    
    'Unknown'
  end
  
  def self.batch_normalize(phone_numbers)
    phone_numbers.map { |phone| normalize(phone) }
  end
end
