# ukrainian_text_search.rb
require 'aai-ukrainian-stemmer'
require 'ukrainian'
require 'unicode_utils'
require 'pragmatic_tokenizer'

class UkrainianTextSearch
  def initialize
    @stemmer = Aai::UkrainianStemmer.new
    @tokenizer = PragmaticTokenizer::Tokenizer.new(
      language: :uk,
      remove_stop_words: false,
      punctuation: :none,
      numbers: :none,
      downcase: true
    )
  end

  # Normalize and clean Ukrainian text
  def normalize_text(text)
    # Convert to lowercase and normalize Unicode
    normalized = UnicodeUtils.downcase(text.to_s)
    # Remove extra whitespace and normalize
    normalized.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
  end

  # Tokenize text into words
  def tokenize(text)
    @tokenizer.tokenize(text)
  end

  # Stem a single word using the Ukrainian stemmer
  def stem_word(word)
    return word if word.length <= 2 # Don't stem very short words
    
    # Remove common punctuation that might be attached to words
    clean_word = word.gsub(/[.,!?;:()\[\]"']$/, '').gsub(/^[.,!?;:()\[\]"']/, '')
    
    return clean_word if clean_word.length <= 2
    
    begin
      @stemmer.stem(clean_word)
    rescue => e
      # Fallback to original word if stemming fails
      puts "Stemming failed for '#{clean_word}': #{e.message}"
      clean_word
    end
  end

  # Lemmatize a single word (using Ukrainian gem for more accurate lemmatization)
  def lemmatize_word(word)
    return word if word.length <= 2
    
    clean_word = word.gsub(/[.,!?;:()\[\]"']$/, '').gsub(/^[.,!?;:()\[\]"']/, '')
    
    return clean_word if clean_word.length <= 2
    
    begin
      # Try to get lemma using Ukrainian gem
      lemma = Ukrainian::Text.new(clean_word).lemma
      lemma.empty? ? clean_word : lemma
    rescue => e
      # Fallback to stemming if lemmatization fails
      puts "Lemmatization failed for '#{clean_word}', falling back to stemming: #{e.message}"
      stem_word(clean_word)
    end
  end

  # Process text for full-text search (stemming approach)
  def prepare_for_search_stemming(text)
    normalized = normalize_text(text)
    tokens = tokenize(normalized)
    
    stems = tokens.map { |token| stem_word(token) }
    stems.reject! { |stem| stem.empty? || stop_word?(stem) }
    
    stems.uniq.join(' ')
  end

  # Process text for full-text search (lemmatization approach - more accurate)
  def prepare_for_search_lemmatization(text)
    normalized = normalize_text(text)
    tokens = tokenize(normalized)
    
    lemmas = tokens.map { |token| lemmatize_word(token) }
    lemmas.reject! { |lemma| lemma.empty? || stop_word?(lemma) }
    
    lemmas.uniq.join(' ')
  end

  # Common Ukrainian stop words to filter out
  def stop_word?(word)
    stop_words = %w[
      і в на з за для про від до у по над під при через без під час
      але та чи бо як що коли де хто який скільки всі весь вся все
      цей ця це ті той та те свій своя своє свої
      не ні ані так ніби мов би бути був була були
      щоб аби хай нехай
    ]
    
    stop_words.include?(word.downcase)
  end

  # Advanced search preparation with options
  def prepare_text(text, method: :lemmatize, remove_stop_words: true, min_word_length: 2)
    normalized = normalize_text(text)
    tokens = tokenize(normalized)
    
    processed_tokens = tokens.map do |token|
      next if token.length < min_word_length
      
      processed = case method
                 when :lemmatize then lemmatize_word(token)
                 when :stem then stem_word(token)
                 else token
                 end
      
      processed
    end.compact
    
    if remove_stop_words
      processed_tokens.reject! { |token| stop_word?(token) }
    end
    
    processed_tokens.uniq.join(' ')
  end
end

```ruby
require 'tokenizers'

class UkrainianStemmer
  def initialize
    @tokenizer = Tokenizers.from_pretrained("tokenizers/uk-wordpiece")
    @stemmer = FastStemmer::Stemmer.new(language: "uk")
  end

  def process_text(text)
    # Токенізація тексту
    tokens = @tokenizer.encode(text).tokens
    
    # Видалення пунктуації та приведення до нижнього регістру
    cleaned_tokens = tokens.map { |token| token.gsub(/[[:punct:]]/, '').downcase }
                          .reject { |token| token.empty? }
    
    # Стемінг кожного токена
    stemmed_tokens = cleaned_tokens.map { |token| @stemmer.stem(token) }
    
    # Повертаємо об'єднаний текст для повнотекстового пошуку
    stemmed_tokens.join(' ')
  end

  # Альтернативний метод для отримання окремих стемованих токенів
  def process_to_tokens(text)
    tokens = @tokenizer.encode(text).tokens
    cleaned_tokens = tokens.map { |token| token.gsub(/[[:punct:]]/, '').downcase }
                          .reject { |token| token.empty? }
    
    cleaned_tokens.map { |token| @stemmer.stem(token) }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# config/initializers/pluralization.rb

# Додаємо українські правила множини до I18n
module I18n
  module Backend
    module Pluralization
      # Українські правила множини
      # Правила:
      # one: коли число закінчується на 1, але не на 11 (1, 21, 31, ...)
      # few: коли число закінчується на 2, 3, 4, але не на 12, 13, 14 (2-4, 22-24, 32-34, ...)
      # many: коли число закінчується на 0, 5-9, або 11-19 (0, 5-20, 25-30, ...)
      # other: для дробових чисел
      module Ukrainian
        def self.rule
          lambda { |n| 
            n ||= 0
            mod10 = n % 10
            mod100 = n % 100
            
            if mod10 == 1 && mod100 != 11
              :one
            elsif [2, 3, 4].include?(mod10) && ![12, 13, 14].include?(mod100)
              :few
            elsif mod10 == 0 || [5, 6, 7, 8, 9].include?(mod10) || [11, 12, 13, 14].include?(mod100)
              :many
            else
              :other
            end
          }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# Реєструємо українські правила множини
I18n.backend.class.send(:include, I18n::Backend::Pluralization)
I18n::Backend::Pluralization.send(:include, I18n::Backend::Pluralization::Ukrainian)

# Додаємо правило для української мови
I18n.config.available_locales = [:uk, :en] # Додаємо українську локаль
I18n.backend.store_translations :uk, i18n: { plural: { rule: I18n::Backend::Pluralization::Ukrainian.rule } }
```

      puts "- #{dict_path}.dic"

    end

    {
      original_text: text,
      clean_text: clean_text,
      errors: spelling_errors,
      error_count: spelling_errors.size,
      suggestions: generate_suggestions(spelling_errors),
      statistics: generate_statistics(clean_text, spelling_errors)
    }
  end
  
  # Check if a single word is spelled correctly
  def check_word(word)
    return { error: "Word cannot be empty" } if word.nil? || word.strip.empty?
    
    clean_word = UnicodeUtils.downcase(word.strip)
    result = @yaspeller.check(clean_word)
    
    {
      word: word,
      clean_word: clean_word,
      correct: result[:correct],
      suggestions: result[:s] || []
    }
  end

      character_count: text.length,
      average_word_length: calculate_average_word_length(text),
      language_confidence: detect_language_confidence(text),
      common_errors: identify_common_error_patterns(check_result[:errors])
    }
    
    check_result.merge(analysis: analysis)
  end
  
  private
  
  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Normalize Unicode and remove extra whitespace
    text = UnicodeUtils.nfkc(text)
    text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
  end
  
  def check_with_yaspeller(text)
    begin
      @yaspeller.check_text(text)
    rescue => e
      puts "Error using Yandex Speller: #{e.message}"
      []
    end
  end
  
  def generate_suggestions(errors)
    errors.map do |error|
      {
        original: error[:word],
        suggestions: error[:s] || [],
        position: error[:pos] || 0,
        length: error[:len] || error[:word].length
      }
    end
  end
  
  def generate_statistics(text, errors)
    words = text.split(/\s+/)
    total_words = words.size
    
    {
      total_words: total_words,
      misspelled_words: errors.size,
      accuracy_percentage: total_words > 0 ? ((total_words - errors.size).to_f / total_words * 100).round(2) : 100,
      unique_misspelled_words: errors.map { |e| e[:word] }.uniq.size
    }

  def count_words(text)
    # Simple word count for Ukrainian text

require 'unicode'

class UkrainianNameDecliner
  VOWELS = %w[а е є и і ї о у ю я]
  CONSONANTS = %w[б в г д ж з й к л м н п р с т ф х ц ч ш щ]
  
  # Common Ukrainian endings and their dative forms
  SURNAME_ENDINGS = {
    'енко' => 'енку',
    'ко' => 'ку',
    'юк' => 'юку',
    'ук' => 'уку',
    'ич' => 'ичу',
    'ів' => 'ову',
    'їв' => 'єву',
    'єв' => 'єву',
    'ов' => 'ову',
    'ев' => 'еву',
    'ин' => 'ину',
    'їн' => 'їну',
    'ян' => 'яну',
    'айло' => 'айлу',
    'ейко' => 'ейку',
    'ей' => 'ею',
    'ий' => 'ому',
    'ій' => 'ому',
    'ой' => 'ому',
    'ая' => 'ій',
    'я' => 'і',
    'ько' => 'ьку'
  }
  
  # First name endings for dative case
  FIRST_NAME_ENDINGS = {
    'о' => 'у',
    'й' => 'ю',
    'ь' => 'ю',
    'я' => 'і',
    'а' => 'і'
  }
  
  # Patronymic endings for dative case
  PATRONYMIC_ENDINGS = {
    'ович' => 'овичу',
    'івна' => 'івні',
    'івни' => 'івні',
    'івич' => 'івичу',
    'ічна' => 'ічні',
    'ів' => 'ову',
    'їв' => 'єву'
  }

  def decline_to_dative(full_name)
    parts = full_name.split(' ')
    
    case parts.size
    when 1
      # Only surname provided
      decline_surname(full_name)
    when 2
      # Surname and first name
      "#{decline_surname(parts[0])} #{decline_first_name(parts[1])}"
    when 3
      # Full name: surname, first name, patronymic
      "#{decline_surname(parts[0])} #{decline_first_name(parts[1])} #{decline_patronymic(parts[2])}"
    else
      # Handle edge cases
      full_name
    end
  end

  def decline_surname(surname)
    surname = Unicode.downcase(surname)
    
    # Check for specific endings
    SURNAME_ENDINGS.each do |ending, dative_ending|
      if surname.end_with?(ending)
        base = surname[0...-ending.length]
        return Unicode.capitalize(base + dative_ending)
      end
    end
    
    # Default rule for surnames ending with consonant
    if CONSONANTS.include?(surname[-1])
      return Unicode.capitalize(surname + 'у')
    end
    
    # If no specific rule applies, return original
    Unicode.capitalize(surname)
  end

  def decline_first_name(first_name)
    first_name = Unicode.downcase(first_name)
    
    FIRST_NAME_ENDINGS.each do |ending, dative_ending|
      if first_name.end_with?(ending)
        base = first_name[0...-ending.length]
        return Unicode.capitalize(base + dative_ending)
      end
    end

# profanity_filter.rb
require 'unicode'
require 'yaml'

class UkrainianProfanityFilter
  def initialize(config_file: nil)
    @profanity_list = load_profanity_list(config_file)
    @replacement_char = '*'
  end
  
  def filter(text, replacement: nil)
    return text unless text.is_a?(String)
    
    @replacement_char = replacement if replacement
    
    # Normalize the text for case-insensitive matching
    normalized_text = Unicode.downcase(text)
    
    # Replace profanity while preserving original case
    filtered_text = text.dup
    offset = 0
    
    @profanity_list.each do |profanity|
      normalized_profanity = Unicode.downcase(profanity)
      
      # Find all occurrences (case-insensitive)
      occurrences = find_occurrences(normalized_text, normalized_profanity)
      
      occurrences.reverse_each do |start_idx, end_idx|
        # Calculate positions in original text (considering previous replacements)
        original_start = start_idx + offset
        original_end = end_idx + offset
        
        # Create replacement string with same length as profanity
        replacement = @replacement_char * profanity.length
        
        # Replace in the filtered text
        filtered_text[original_start...original_end] = replacement
        
        # Adjust offset for future replacements
        offset += replacement.length - profanity.length
      end
    end
    
    filtered_text
  end
  
  def profane?(text)
    return false unless text.is_a?(String)
    
    normalized_text = Unicode.downcase(text)
    
    @profanity_list.any? do |profanity|
      normalized_profanity = Unicode.downcase(profanity)
      normalized_text.include?(normalized_profanity)
    end
  end
  
  def add_profanity(word)
    @profanity_list << word unless @profanity_list.include?(word)
    @profanity_list.uniq!
  end
  
  def remove_profanity(word)
    @profanity_list.delete(word)
  end
  
  def profanity_count(text)
    return 0 unless text.is_a?(String)
    
    normalized_text = Unicode.downcase(text)
    count = 0
    
    @profanity_list.each do |profanity|
      normalized_profanity = Unicode.downcase(profanity)
      count += normalized_text.scan(normalized_profanity).size
    end
    
    count
  end
  
  private
  
  def load_profanity_list(config_file)
    if config_file && File.exist?(config_file)
      YAML.load_file(config_file) || default_profanity_list
    else
      default_profanity_list
    end
  end
  
  def default_profanity_list
    # Common Ukrainian profanity words (this is a sample list)
    # In a real application, you would want a more comprehensive list
    [
      "блять", "пізда", "хуй", "єбать", "гондон", "мудак", "сука", "шльондра",
      "пизда", "єблан", "дахую", "дахує", "долбоєб", "заєбись", "заїбись",
      "заебись", "заібись", "їбати", "йобаний", "йобань", "підар", "підорас",
      "підор", "срака", "триндєж", "хер", "хую", "шльондра", "шльондрий"
    ]
  end
  
  def find_occurrences(text, substring)
    occurrences = []
    start_index = 0
    
    while (index = text.index(substring, start_index))
      occurrences << [index, index + substring.length]
      start_index = index + 1
    end
    
    occurrences
  end
end

    '050' => 'Vodafone Україна',

    '067' => 'Київстар',

    '092' => 'PEOPLEnet',

    '094' => 'Інтертелеком',
    '095' => 'Vodafone Україна',
    '096' => 'Київстар',
    '097' => 'Київстар',
    '098' => 'Київстар',
    '099' => 'Vodafone Україна'
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    I18n.config.available_locales = :uk
  end

  # Головний метод для нормалізації та визначення оператора
  def normalize_and_identify(phone_number)
    normalized_number = normalize_phone(phone_number)
    
    return {
      original: phone_number,
      normalized: normalized_number,
      valid: valid_phone?(normalized_number),
      operator: normalized_number ? identify_operator(normalized_number) : nil
    }
  end

  # Нормалізація номера до формату +380XXXXXXXXX
  def normalize_phone(phone_number)
    return nil unless phone_number
    
    # Видаляємо всі нецифрові символи крім плюса
    cleaned = phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
    
    # Видаляємо зайві плюси
    cleaned = cleaned.gsub(/\+{2,}/, '+')
    
    # Обробляємо різні формати
    case cleaned
    when /\A380\d{9}\z/ # 380XXXXXXXXX
      "+#{cleaned}"
    when /\A80\d{9}\z/ # 80XXXXXXXXX
      "+3#{cleaned}"
    when /\A0\d{9}\z/ # 0XXXXXXXXX
      "+38#{cleaned}"
    when /\A\d{9}\z/ # XXXXXXXXX
      "+380#{cleaned}"
    when /\A\+380\d{9}\z/ # +380XXXXXXXXX (вже правильний формат)
      cleaned
    when /\A\+38\d{10}\z/ # +38XXXXXXXXXX
      cleaned # Вже має правильний префікс
    else
      # Спроба виправити номери з додатковими цифрами
      if cleaned.length > 12
        # Шукаємо шаблон 380XXXXXXXXX у довгому рядку
        match = cleaned.match(/380(\d{9})/)
        "+380#{match[1]}" if match
      else
        nil # Неможливо нормалізувати
      end
    end
  end

  # Перевірка валідності номера
  def valid_phone?(normalized_number)
    return false unless normalized_number
    normalized_number.match?(/\A\+380(39|50|63|66|67|68|73|91|92|93|94|95|96|97|98|99)\d{7}\z/)
  end

  # Визначення оператора за кодом
  def identify_operator(normalized_number)
    return nil unless normalized_number && valid_phone?(normalized_number)
    
    # Виділяємо код оператора (3 цифри після +380)
    operator_code = normalized_number[4..6]
    OPERATOR_CODES[operator_code]
  end

  # Метод для обробки масиву номерів
  def process_numbers(phone_numbers)
    Array(phone_numbers).map { |number| normalize_and_identify(number) }

require 'json'
require 'postal'

class UkrainianAddressParser
  # Ukrainian oblasts (regions) for validation
  OBLASTS = [
    'Вінницька', 'Волинська', 'Дніпропетровська', 'Донецька', 'Житомирська',
    'Закарпатська', 'Запорізька', 'Івано-Франківська', 'Київська', 'Кіровоградська',
    'Луганська', 'Львівська', 'Миколаївська', 'Одеська', 'Полтавська',
    'Рівненська', 'Сумська', 'Тернопільська', 'Харківська', 'Херсонська',
    'Хмельницька', 'Черкаська', 'Чернівецька', 'Чернігівська', 'АР Крим'
  ].freeze

  def parse(address_text)
    return {} if address_text.nil? || address_text.strip.empty?

    # Normalize the address text
    normalized_text = normalize_text(address_text)
    
    # Parse using libpostal
    parsed_components = Postal::Expand.expand_address(normalized_text).first
    components = Postal::Parser.parse_address(parsed_components)
    
    # Convert to hash and extract Ukrainian components
    address_hash = components_to_hash(components)
    
    # Extract specific fields for Ukrainian addresses
    extract_ukrainian_fields(address_hash, normalized_text)
  end

  private

  def normalize_text(text)
    text.gsub(/[,.]/, ' ')
        .gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
        .strip
        .gsub(/(\d+)\s*-\s*(\d+)/, '\1-\2') # Fix apartment numbers like "10 - 20"
  end

  def components_to_hash(components)
    components.each_with_object({}) do |component, hash|
      hash[component.first] = component.last
    end
  end

  def extract_ukrainian_fields(address_hash, original_text)
    result = {
      oblast: extract_oblast(address_hash, original_text),
      city: extract_city(address_hash),
      street: extract_street(address_hash),
      building: extract_building(address_hash),
      apartment: extract_apartment(address_hash),
      original_text: original_text
    }
    
    # Clean up empty values
    result.reject { |_, v| v.nil? || v.empty? }
  end

  def extract_oblast(address_hash, original_text)
    # Try to find oblast in the parsed components
    oblast = address_hash['state'] || address_hash['state_district']
    
    # If not found, search for oblast names in the original text
    if oblast.nil? || oblast.empty?
      OBLASTS.each do |oblast_name|
        if original_text.downcase.include?(oblast_name.downcase)
          oblast = oblast_name
          break
        end
      end
    end
    
    normalize_ukrainian_name(oblast)
  end

  def extract_city(address_hash)
    city = address_hash['city'] || address_hash['town'] || address_hash['village']
    normalize_ukrainian_name(city)
  end

  def extract_street(address_hash)
    street = address_hash['road'] || address_hash['street']
    normalize_ukrainian_name(street)
  end

  def extract_building(address_hash)
    building = address_hash['house_number'] || address_hash['house']
    building.to_s.gsub(/\D+/, '') if building
  end

  def extract_apartment(address_hash)
    apartment = address_hash['unit'] || address_hash['apartment'] || address_hash['flat']
    
    # Try to extract apartment from the original components
    if apartment.nil?
      # Look for apartment patterns in the address hash values
      address_hash.each_value do |value|
        if value.to_s.match?(/кв\.?\s*(\d+)|квартира\s*(\d+)/i)
          apartment = $1 || $2
          break
        end
      end
    end
    
    apartment.to_s.gsub(/\D+/, '') if apartment
  end

  def normalize_ukrainian_name(name)
    return nil if name.nil? || name.empty?
    
    # Capitalize first letter of each word for Ukrainian names
    name.split(' ').map do |word|
      if word.match?(/^[А-ЯІЇЄҐ]/) # If already starts with uppercase Ukrainian letter
        word
      else
        word.capitalize
      end
    end.join(' ')
  end
end

```ruby
# profanity_filter.rb
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'
require 'unicode_utils'

class UkrainianProfanityFilter
  # Базова база нецензурних слів та їх варіантів
  PROFANITY_WORDS = [
    # Тут має бути список нецензурних слів українською мовою
    # У реальному застосунку цей список має бути більшим і зберігатися окремо
    'матюк', 'лайно', 'дурак', 'ідіот', 'мудак', 'сволоч', 'псяча', 'сука',
    'хєр', 'бля', 'пізд', 'єб', 'гівно', 'дрюк', 'хуй'
  ].freeze

  # Замінники для цензурування
  REPLACEMENTS = ['***', '%%%', '###', '@@@'].freeze

  def initialize(custom_words: [], replacement: nil)
    @profanity_words = PROFANITY_WORDS + custom_words
    @replacement = replacement || REPLACEMENTS.sample
    @pattern = build_pattern
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text)
    return '' unless text.is_a?(String)
    
    # Нормалізуємо текст
    normalized_text = UnicodeUtils.downcase(text.unicode_normalize(:nfc))
    
    # Замінюємо нецензурні слова
    filtered_text = normalized_text.gsub(@pattern) do |match|
      censor_word(match)
    end
    
    # Відновлюємо оригінальний регістр для незмінених частин тексту
    restore_case(text, filtered_text)
  end

  # Перевірка на наявність нецензурної лексики
  def profane?(text)
    return false unless text.is_a?(String)
    
    normalized_text = UnicodeUtils.downcase(text.unicode_normalize(:nfc))
    !!(normalized_text =~ @pattern)
  end

  # Отримати список знайдених нецензурних слів
  def find_profanities(text)
    return [] unless text.is_a?(String)
    
    normalized_text = UnicodeUtils.downcase(text.unicode_normalize(:nfc))
    normalized_text.scan(@pattern).uniq
  end

  private

  def build_pattern
    words_pattern = @profanity_words.map { |word| Regexp.escape(word) }.join('|')
    # Використовуємо \b для меж слів та дозволяємо деякі варіації
    Regexp.new("\\b(#{words_pattern})[а-яіїєґ]*\\b", Regexp::IGNORECASE | Regexp::MULTILINE)
  end

  def censor_word(word)
    # Робимо заміну з збереженням довжини слова
    if word.length > 2
      first_char = word[0]
      last_char = word[-1]
      "#{first_char}#{@replacement * (word.length - 2)}#{last_char}"
    else
      @replacement * word.length
    end
  end

  def restore_case(original, filtered)
    result = filtered.dup
    original.chars.each_with_index do |char, index|
      if char.match?(/[А-ЯІЇЄҐ]/)
        result[index] = result[index].upcase
      end
    end
    result
  end
end

    filter = UkrainianProfanityFilter.new(custom_words: custom_words, replacement: replacement)

    filter = UkrainianProfanityFilter.new(custom_words: custom_words)
    filter.profane?(self)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/currency_converter.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dalli'
require 'memoist'

class CurrencyConverter
  include Memoist

  # Cache store
  def self.cache_store
    @cache_store ||= Dalli::Client.new
  end

  # Fetch daily rates from European Central Bank
  def self.fetch_rates
    response = HTTParty.get('https://api.exchangerate.host/latest?base=EUR')
    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  # Convert price from one currency to another
  def self.convert_price(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
    rates = fetch_rates
    rate = rates[:rates][to_currency.to_sym] / rates[:rates][from_currency.to_sym]
    amount * rate
  end

  # Memoize the rates for a day
  memoize def self.rates
    fetch_rates[:rates]
  end
end
```

**Usage**
```ruby
# Example usage
converter = CurrencyConverter
puts converter.convert_price(100, 'EUR', 'USD')
```

**Notes**

* The `httparty` gem is used to make HTTP requests to the European Central Bank API.
* The `dalli` gem is used to cache the rates for a day.
* The `memoist` gem is used to memoize the rates for a day.
* The `fetch_rates` method fetches the daily rates from the European Central Bank API.
* The `convert_price` method converts a price from one currency to another using the fetched rates.
* The `rates` method is memoized to cache the rates for a day.

Please note that the European Central Bank API has a rate limit, so you should consider caching the rates for a longer period of time or using a paid API service if you need to make a large number of requests.

    'ю' => 'iu', 'я' => 'ia', 'ь' => '', "'" => '',

    'Х' => 'Kh', 'Ц' => 'Ts', 'Ч' => 'Ch', 'Ш' => 'Sh', 'Щ' => 'Shch',
    'Ю' => 'Yu', 'Я' => 'Ya'
  }.freeze

    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    # Нормалізуємо текст та перетворюємо на малі літери

    # Транслітеруємо кожен символ
    result = normalized_text.chars.map do |char|

    # Обробка спеціальних випадків на початку слова
    result = handle_special_cases(result)
    
    # Замінюємо послідовності пробілів на дефіси
    result = result.gsub(/\s+/, '-')
    
    # Видаляємо всі непотрібні символи
    result = result.gsub(/[^a-z0-9\-]/, '')
    
    # Видаляємо зайві дефіси
    result = result.gsub(/\-+/, '-')
    result = result.gsub(/^\-|\-$/, '')

### Step 1: Set up PayPal credentials

```ruby
# app/controllers/payments_controller.rb
class PaymentsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    # Create a new PayPal payment
    payment = PayPal::SDK::Payment.new(
      intent: 'capture',
      payer: {
        payment_method: 'paypal'
      },
      transactions: [
        {
          amount: {

            total: '10.00'
          },
          description: 'Test payment'
        }
      ],

      }

    # Redirect the buyer to PayPal for approval

  end

  def execute

    # Execute the payment

  end
```

```ruby
class CurrencyConverter
  def initialize
    @cache = Dalli::Client.new
    @api_url = 'https://api.exchangerate.host/latest'
  end

  def convert(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
    # Отримання курсів валют з кешу або API
    rates = get_rates

    # Перевірка, чи доступна валюта
    unless rates.key?(from_currency) && rates.key?(to_currency)
      raise ArgumentError, "Недоступна валюта: #{from_currency} або #{to_currency}"
    end

    # Конвертація ціни
    converted_amount = (amount * rates[to_currency]) / rates[from_currency]

    converted_amount
  end

  private

  def get_rates
    # Отримання курсів валют з кешу
    cached_rates = @cache.get('exchange_rates')

    # Якщо курси валют не кешовані, отримуємо їх з API
    unless cached_rates
      response = HTTParty.get(@api_url)
      rates = JSON.parse(response.body)['rates']

      # Кешування курсів валют на добу
      @cache.set('exchange_rates', rates, expires_in: 1.day)

      rates
    else
      cached_rates
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'i18n'
```

```ruby
class UkrainianSorter
  # Ukrainian alphabet in correct order
  UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET = %w(
    а б в г ґ д е є ж з и і ї й к л м н о п р с т у ф х ц ч ш щ ь ю я
  ).freeze

  def self.sort(words)
    # Convert to array if single string is passed
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    
    words.sort_by do |word|
      word.downcase.chars.map do |char|
        # Find position in Ukrainian alphabet, use original position + 1000 for unknown characters
        UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET.index(char.downcase) || (char.ord + 1000)
      end
    end
  end
end

        end
```

```ruby
    end
```

```ruby
    rescue IBANTools::InvalidIBANError
      false
    end
  end

  def self.validate_bic(bic)
    # BIC validation rules:
    # - 8 or 11 characters long
    # - First 4 characters are letters (bank code)
    # - Next 2 characters are letters or numbers (country code)
    # - Next 2 characters are letters or numbers (location code)
    # - Last 3 characters are letters or numbers (optional)
    bic_regex = /\A[A-Z]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?\z/
    bic =~ bic_regex
  end
end

class FormValidator

    @iban = iban
    @bic = bic
  end

  def validate

      errors << "Invalid IBAN"
    end

    unless IbanValidator.validate_bic(@bic)
      errors << "Invalid BIC"
    end

    if errors.empty?
      { valid: true }
    else
      { valid: false, errors: errors }
    end
  end
end
```

    final_result = combine_results(cld3_result, wl_result, letter_ratio_result)
    
    final_result
  end

  private

  def clean_text(text)
    # Видаляємо спеціальні символи, цифри, залишаємо лише букви та пробіли
    text.gsub(/[^а-яіїєґёъыэ\s]/i, ' ').gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
  end

  def detect_with_cld3(text)
    return :unknown if text.length < 10
    
    result = @cld3_detector.find_language(text)

    else :unknown
    end
  end

    case result
    when :ukrainian then :ukrainian
    when :russian then :russian
    else :unknown
    end

  def detect_with_letter_ratio(text)
    return :unknown if text.length < 5
    
    ukrainian_chars = text.chars.count { |c| UKRAINIAN_LETTERS.include?(c) }
    russian_chars = text.chars.count { |c| RUSSIAN_LETTERS.include?(c) }
    total_cyrillic = ukrainian_chars + russian_chars

      letter_ratio_result == :unknown ? :mixed : letter_ratio_result
    end
  end

```ruby
# app/models/order.rb
```

```ruby
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  def pay_with_paypal
    # Створіть клієнт PayPal
    client = PayPal::Client.new(
      client_id: PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID,
      client_secret: PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET,
      mode: PAYPAL_MODE
    )
    
    # Створіть платеж

      :intent =>  "sale",
      :payer =>  {
        :payment_method =>  "paypal" },
      :redirect_urls => {
        :return_url => "http://localhost:3000/orders/confirm_payment/#{id}",
        :cancel_url => "http://localhost:3000/" },
      :transactions =>  [{

            :sku => "item",
            :price => total_price,
            :currency => "USD",
            :quantity => 1 }] },
        :amount =>  {
          :currency => "USD",
          :total => total_price },
        :description =>  "Замовлення №#{id}" }] })
    
    # Виконайте платеж
    if payment.create(client)
      # Оновіть стан замовлення до 'paid'
      update(status: 'paid')
      payment.links.find{|v| v.rel == "approval_url" }.href
    else
      # Обробіть помилку
      payment.error
    end
  end
  
  def confirm_paypal_payment
    # Виконайте запит до PayPal для підтвердження платежу
    client = PayPal::Client.new(
      client_id: PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID,
      client_secret: PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET,
      mode: PAYPAL_MODE
    )
    
    payment = PayPal::Payment.find(params[:paymentId])
    if payment.execute(payer_id: params[:PayerID])

      update(status: 'confirmed')
    else

    end
  end
```

Тепер, створіть файл з назвою `iban_bic_validator.rb` і додайте наступний код:

```ruby
require 'iban-tools'

class IBANBICValidator
  def initialize(iban, bic)
    @iban = iban
    @bic = bic
  end

  def validate
    errors = []

    # Перевірка IBAN
    unless IBANTools::IBAN.valid?(@iban)
      errors << "Некоректний IBAN"
    end

    # Перевірка BIC
    if @bic.nil? || @bic.empty? || @bic.length != 11 || !@bic.match?(/^[A-Z]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9]{3}$/)
      errors << "Некоректний BIC"
    end

    if errors.any?
      { success: false, errors: errors }
    else
      { success: true, message: "IBAN і BIC коректні" }
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
iban = "UA1234567890123456789012345678901" # Замініть на ваш IBAN
bic = "COLOUAUKXXX" # Замініть на ваш BIC

validator = IBANBICValidator.new(iban, bic)
result = validator.validate

if result[:success]
  puts result[:message]
else
  puts "Помилки:"
  result[:errors].each { |error| puts error }
end
```

У цьому коді, ми використовуємо гем `iban-tools` для перевірки валідності IBAN. Для перевірки BIC, ми застосовуємо простий регулярний вираз, що відповідає стандарту BIC (4 літери банку, 2 літери країни, 2 літери місця розташування та 3 цифри, що ідентифікують банк). Якщо IBAN або BIC некоректні, повертається хеш з помилками; інакше, повертається повідомлення про успішну валідацию.

```ruby
        invoice_id: invoice.id,
        amount: transaction[:amount],
        date: transaction[:date]
      }
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# ukrainian_sorter.rb
require 'unicode'

class UkrainianSorter
  # Український алфавіт з правильним порядком
  UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET = %w[
    а б в г ґ д е є ж з и і ї й к л м н о п р с т у ф х ц ч ш щ ь ю я
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    setup_sort_order
  end

  # Основний метод для сортування масиву слів
  def sort_words(words)
    words.sort_by { |word| sort_key(word.downcase) }
  end

  # Сортування з урахуванням регістру (спочатку великі літери, потім малі)
  def sort_words_case_sensitive(words)
    words.sort_by do |word|
      [
        word.chars.map { |char| char == char.upcase ? 0 : 1 }, # спочатку великі літери
        sort_key(word.downcase)
      ]
    end
  end

  private

  def setup_sort_order
    @sort_order = {}
    UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET.each_with_index do |letter, index|
      @sort_order[letter] = index
    end
    
    # Додаємо відображення для великих літер
    UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET.each do |letter|
      uppercase = Unicode.upcase(letter)
      @sort_order[uppercase] = @sort_order[letter] if uppercase != letter
    end
  end

  # Створює ключ для сортування слова
  def sort_key(word)
    word.chars.map do |char|
      # Якщо літера є в алфавіті - повертаємо її позицію
      # Якщо ні - повертаємо дуже велике число, щоб невідомі символи йшли в кінці
      @sort_order[char] || 9999
    end
  end
end
```

class UkrainianHyphenator
  # Патерни переносів для української мови (спрощений варіант)
  PATTERNS = [
    # Голосні
    /а(?=а)/, /е(?=е)/, /и(?=и)/, /і(?=і)/, /о(?=о)/, /у(?=у)/,
    /а(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ]+[аеиіоуюя])/,
    /е(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ]+[аеиіоуюя])/,
    /и(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ]+[аеиіоуюя])/,
    /і(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ]+[аеиіоуюя])/,
    /о(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ]+[аеиіоуюя])/,
    /у(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ]+[аеиіоуюя])/,
    
    # Приголосні між голосними
    /(?<=[аеиіоуюя])(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ][аеиіоуюя])/,
    
    # Сполучення приголосних
    /(?<=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ])(?=[бвгґджзклмнпрстфхцчшщ][аеиіоуюя])/
  ].freeze

  # Слова, які не переносяться
  NON_BREAKABLE_WORDS = %w[
    і по та але або чи то не був є буде бувати
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @cache = {}
  end

  # Основна функція для додавання переносів до тексту
  def hyphenate_text(text, max_line_length = 80)
    words = text.split(/(\s+)/)
    hyphenated_words = words.map do |word|
      if word.strip.empty? || NON_BREAKABLE_WORDS.include?(word.downcase)
        word
      else
        hyphenate_word(word)
      end
    end
    hyphenated_words.join
  end

  # Розбиває слово на склади з можливими переносами
  def hyphenate_word(word)
    return word if word.length <= 3 # Занадто короткі слова не переносимо

    # Нормалізуємо слово для обробки
    normalized_word = UnicodeUtils.downcase(word)
    
    # Знаходимо місця для переносів
    break_points = find_break_points(normalized_word)
    
    return word if break_points.empty?
    
    # Будуємо слово з переносами
    build_hyphenated_word(word, break_points)
  end

  private

  def find_break_points(word)
    break_points = []
    
    PATTERNS.each do |pattern|
      word.scan(pattern) do
        match = Regexp.last_match
        position = match.end(0)
        # Додаємо позицію, якщо вона не на початку чи в кінці слова
        break_points << position if position > 1 && position < word.length - 1
      end
    end
    
    # Сортуємо та видаляємо дублікати
    break_points.uniq.sort
  end

  def build_hyphenated_word(original_word, break_points)
    result = ""
    last_pos = 0
    
    break_points.each do |pos|
      result += original_word[last_pos...pos] + "­" # м'який перенос
      last_pos = pos
    end
    
    result + original_word[last_pos..-1]
  end
end

```ruby
    'n' => 'т', 'm' => 'ь', ',' => 'б', '.' => 'ю', '/' => '.', '`' => "'", 'Q' => 'Й',
    'W' => 'Ц', 'E' => 'У', 'R' => 'К', 'T' => 'Е', 'Y' => 'Н', 'U' => 'Г', 'I' => 'Ш',
    'O' => 'Щ', 'P' => 'З', '{' => 'Х', '}' => 'Ї', 'A' => 'Ф', 'S' => 'І', 'D' => 'В',
    'F' => 'А', 'G' => 'П', 'H' => 'Р', 'J' => 'О', 'K' => 'Л', 'L' => 'Д', ':' => 'Ж',
    '"' => 'Є', 'Z' => 'Я', 'X' => 'Ч', 'C' => 'С', 'V' => 'М', 'B' => 'И', 'N' => 'Т',
    'M' => 'Ь', '<' => 'Б', '>' => 'Ю', '?' => ',', '~' => "'", '@' => '"', '#' => '№',
    '$' => ';', '^' => ':', '&' => '?', '|' => '/'
  }.freeze

  def self.convert(text)
    return "" if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    converted_text = text.chars.map do |char|
      LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN[char] || char
    end.join
    
    # Handle common punctuation and special cases
    converted_text.gsub!(/\.{3,}/, '…') # Convert multiple dots to ellipsis
    converted_text.gsub!(/,,/, '„')     # Convert double commas to opening quote
    converted_text.gsub!(/''/, '”')     # Convert single quotes to closing quote
    
    converted_text
  end

  # Additional method to detect if text might be in wrong layout
  def self.likely_wrong_layout?(text)
    return false if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    # Count Latin characters that have Ukrainian equivalents
    latin_chars = text.scan(/[a-zA-Z\[\];',\.\/`{}:"<>?@#$%^&|~]/).count
    ukrainian_chars = text.scan(/[а-яА-ЯїЇєЄіІ]/).count
    
    latin_chars > ukrainian_chars
  end

  # Method that auto-detects and converts if needed
  def self.auto_convert(text)
    if likely_wrong_layout?(text)
      convert(text)
    else
      text
    end
  end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_model'

class Transaction
  include ActiveModel::Model

  attr_accessor :id, :amount, :purpose, :date

  validates :id, :amount, :purpose, :date, presence: true
end

class Invoice
  include ActiveModel::Model

  attr_accessor :id, :amount, :purpose, :paid

  validates :id, :amount, :purpose, presence: true
end

class TransactionImporter
  def initialize(file_path, invoices)
    @file_path = file_path
    @invoices = invoices
  end

  def import
    # Парсим XML-файл
    xml = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(@file_path))

    # Знаходимо всі транзакції у файлі
    transactions = xml.css('Ntry')

    transactions.each do |transaction|
      # витягуюємо дані про транзакцію
      transaction_id = transaction.at_css('AcctSvcrRef').text
      amount = transaction.at_css('Amt').text.to_f
      purpose = transaction.at_css('RmtInf').text
      date = transaction.at_css('BookgDt').text

      # створюємо об'єкт транзакції
      transaction_object = Transaction.new(
        id: transaction_id,
        amount: amount,
        purpose: purpose,
        date: date
      )

      # Перевіряємо валідність транзакції
      if transaction_object.valid?
        # знаходимо відповідний рахунок
        invoice = @invoices.find { |invoice| invoice.purpose == purpose && !invoice.paid }

        if invoice
          # Означаємо рахунок як оплачений
          invoice.paid = true
          puts "Рахунок ##{invoice.id} оплачено"
        else
          puts "Не знайдено відповідного рахунку для транзакції ##{transaction_id}"
        end
      else
        puts "Невалідна транзакція: #{transaction_object.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

Тепер можна використовувати цей клас для імпорту транзакцій з файлу CAMT.053 і зіставлення їх з неоплаченими рахунками.

```ruby
# Створюємо масив рахунків
invoices = [
  Invoice.new(id: 1, amount: 100, purpose: 'Оплата за послуги', paid: false),
  Invoice.new(id: 2, amount: 200, purpose: 'Оплата за товари', paid: false)
]

# Створюємо імпортер транзакцій
importer = TransactionImporter.new('path/to/camt053.xml', invoices)

# Виконуємо імпорт
importer.import
```

Цей код імпортує транзакції з файлу `camt053.xml` і зіставляє їх з неоплаченими рахунками у масиві `invoices`. Якщо знайдено відповідний рахунок, він означується як оплачений.

require 'unicode'
require 'i18n'

class SurzhykChecker
  # Dictionary of common Surzhyk words/phrases and their literary Ukrainian equivalents
  SURZHYK_DICTIONARY = {
    # Russian loanwords and calques
    'щас' => 'зараз',
    'ага' => 'так',
    'нет' => 'ні',
    'давай' => 'давай (у контексті спонукання), пропоную',
    'нормально' => 'нормально (українською), гаразд',
    'кстати' => 'до речі',
    'понятно' => 'зрозуміло',
    'вообще' => 'взагалі',
    'точно' => 'точно, певно',
    'привет' => 'привіт',
    'пока' => 'до побачення',
    
    # Mixed grammar constructions
    'будеш?' => 'будеш? (українською) / будеш щось?',
    'ходив в магазин' => 'ходив до магазину',
    'на Украине' => 'в Україні',
    'с Украины' => 'з України',
    
    # Phonetic adaptations
    'шо' => 'що',
    'типа' => 'наче, ніби',
    'кароче' => 'коротше',
    'спс' => 'дякую',
    'пасиб' => 'дякую',
    'нору' => 'добре, файно',
    
    # Common mixed expressions
    'в принципе' => 'в принципі (українською), взагалі',
    'так себе' => 'так собі',
    'ничего так' => 'непогано',
    'в натуре' => 'справді, дійсно',
    'очень' => 'дуже',
    'можно' => 'можна'
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    setup_i18n
  end

  def check_text(text)
    text = Unicode.downcase(text)
    words = text.split(/\b/)
    
    found_surzhyk = []
    
    SURZHYK_DICTIONARY.each do |surzhyk_word, literary_replacement|
      # Use regex to find whole word matches
      pattern = /\b#{Regexp.escape(surzhyk_word)}\b/i
      if text =~ pattern
        matches = text.scan(pattern)
        found_surzhyk << {
          surzhyk_word: surzhyk_word,
          literary_replacement: literary_replacement,
          count: matches.size,
          examples: find_context_examples(text, surzhyk_word)
        }
      end
    end
    
    {
      text: text,
      surzhyk_words_found: found_surzhyk,
      total_surzhyk_occurrences: found_surzhyk.sum { |item| item[:count] },
      score: calculate_surzhyk_score(text, found_surzhyk)
    }
  end

  def suggest_corrections(text)
    result = check_text(text)
    corrected_text = text.dup
    
    result[:surzhyk_words_found].each do |item|
      # Replace all occurrences
      corrected_text.gsub!(/\b#{Regexp.escape(item[:surzhyk_word])}\b/i) do |match|
        # Preserve original case
        if match == match.upcase
          item[:literary_replacement].upcase
        elsif match[0] == match[0].upcase
          item[:literary_replacement].capitalize
        else
          item[:literary_replacement]
        end
      end
    end
    
    {
      original_text: text,
      corrected_text: corrected_text,
      changes_made: result[:surzhyk_words_found].size,
      details: result
    }
  end

  private

  def setup_i18n
    I18n.config.available_locales = :uk
  end

  def find_context_examples(text, word, context_words = 3)
    sentences = text.split(/[.!?]/)
    examples = []
    
    sentences.each do |sentence|
      words_in_sentence = sentence.split(/\s+/)
      word_index = words_in_sentence.index { |w| w.downcase.include?(word.downcase) }
      
      if word_index
        start_index = [0, word_index - context_words].max
        end_index = [words_in_sentence.size - 1, word_index + context_words].min
        
        context = words_in_sentence[start_index..end_index].join(' ')
        examples << "#{context.strip}."
        break if examples.size >= 2 # Limit examples
      end
    end
    
    examples
  end

```ruby
# tax_calculator.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class TaxCalculator
  def initialize(api_token)
    @api_token = api_token
    @api_url = 'https://api.taxjar.com/v2'
  end

  def calculate_tax(order)
    # Validate order data
    required_fields = %i[to_city to_state to_zip to_country from_city from_state from_zip from_country amount_to_collect shipping amount]
    unless required_fields.all? { |field| order.key?(field) }
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid order data'
    end

    # Set API endpoint and headers
    endpoint = "#{@api_url}/taxes"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    # Prepare request body
    body = {
      'to_city' => order[:to_city],
      'to_state' => order[:to_state],
      'to_zip' => order[:to_zip],
      'to_country' => order[:to_country],
      'from_city' => order[:from_city],
      'from_state' => order[:from_state],
      'from_zip' => order[:from_zip],
      'from_country' => order[:from_country],
      'amount' => order[:amount],
      'shipping' => order[:shipping],
      'amount_to_collect' => order[:amount_to_collect]
    }

    # Send request to TaxJar API
    response = HTTParty.post(endpoint, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)

    # Handle API response
    if response.success?
      tax_data = JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      {
        tax_amount: tax_data[:tax][:amount_to_collect],
        tax_rate: tax_data[:tax][:rate]
      }
    else
      raise "TaxJar API error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  api_token = 'YOUR_TAXJAR_API_TOKEN'
  calculator = TaxCalculator.new(api_token)

  order = {
    to_city: 'New York',
    to_state: 'NY',
    to_zip: '10001',
    to_country: 'US',
    from_city: 'San Francisco',
    from_state: 'CA',
    from_zip: '94105',
    from_country: 'US',
    amount: 100.00,
    shipping: 10.00,
    amount_to_collect: true
  }

  tax_data = calculator.calculate_tax(order)
  puts "Tax amount: #{tax_data[:tax_amount]}"
  puts "Tax rate: #{tax_data[:tax_rate]}"
end
```

**Note:** Replace `YOUR_TAXJAR_API_TOKEN` with your actual TaxJar API token.

This implementation uses the `httparty` gem to send a POST request to the TaxJar API with the required order data. The response is then parsed and the tax amount and rate are extracted. If the API request fails, an error is raised with the API error code.

require 'httparty'

class UkrainianTTS
  # Using Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API with Ukrainian voice
  GOOGLE_TTS_URL = "https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize"
  
  # Ukrainian voice options for Google TTS
  UKRAINIAN_VOICES = [
    "uk-UA-Wavenet-A",  # Female voice
    "uk-UA-Wavenet-B"   # Male voice
  ]

  def initialize(api_key:, voice: "uk-UA-Wavenet-A")
    @api_key = api_key
    @voice = voice
    validate_voice!
  end

  def text_to_speech(text, output_filename = "ukrainian_speech.mp3")
    validate_text!(text)
    
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Goog-Api-Key' => @api_key
    }

    payload = {
      input: { text: text },
      voice: {
        languageCode: 'uk-UA',
        name: @voice
      },
      audioConfig: {
        audioEncoding: 'MP3'
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(GOOGLE_TTS_URL, {
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    })

    if response.success?
      audio_content = response.parsed_response['audioContent']
      save_audio(audio_content, output_filename)
      puts "✅ Audio saved as: #{output_filename}"
      output_filename
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_voice!
    unless UKRAINIAN_VOICES.include?(@voice)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid voice. Available voices: #{UKRAINIAN_VOICES.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def validate_text!(text)
    if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Text cannot be empty"
    end
    
    if text.length > 5000
      raise ArgumentError, "Text is too long. Maximum 5000 characters allowed."
    end
  end

  def save_audio(audio_content, filename)
    # Ensure the audio content is base64 decoded
    decoded_audio = Base64.decode64(audio_content)
    
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(decoded_audio)
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = response.parsed_response['error']['message'] rescue "Unknown error"
    raise "TTS API Error: #{error_message} (Status: #{response.code})"
  end
end

  LOCATION_PATTERN = /\b(?:м\.|місто|село|смт|обл\.|область)\s+([A-ZА-ЯІЇЄҐ][a-zа-яіїєґ'-]+)/i

```ruby
require 'plaid_client'

class PlaidImporter
  def initialize(plaid_client, access_token)
    @plaid_client = plaid_client
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  def import_accounts
    accounts_response = @plaid_client.get_accounts(@access_token)
    accounts_response.accounts.each do |account|
      existing_account = Account.find_by(plaid_account_id: account.id)
      if existing_account
        existing_account.update(balance: account.balances.current)
      else
        Account.create(
          plaid_account_id: account.id,
          balance: account.balances.current,
          name: account.name
        )
      end
    end
  end

  def import_transactions(start_date, end_date)
    accounts = Account.all
    accounts.each do |account|
      transactions_response = @plaid_client.get_transactions(@access_token, account.plaid_account_id, start_date, end_date)
      transactions_response.transactions.each do |transaction|
        existing_transaction = Transaction.find_by(plaid_transaction_id: transaction.id)
        if existing_transaction
          existing_transaction.update(amount: transaction.amount, date: transaction.date)
        else
          Transaction.create(
            plaid_transaction_id: transaction.id,
            account_id: account.id,
            amount: transaction.amount,
            date: transaction.date,
            name: transaction.name
          )
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class ViesChecker

      wsdl: 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl',
      namespace: 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/services/checkVatService',

    )
```

```ruby
    @ticker = ticker
  end

  def fetch_historical_prices
    response = HTTParty.get(API_URL, query: {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: @ticker,
      outputsize: 'full',
      apikey: API_KEY
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)['Time Series (Daily)']
  end

  def compute_moving_average(prices, days = 20)
    dates = prices.keys
    moving_averages = {}

    dates.each_with_index do |date, index|
      if index >= days - 1
        window = dates[index - days + 1..index]
        average = window.map { |d| prices[d]['4. close'].to_f }.sum / window.size
        moving_averages[date] = average
      end
    end

    moving_averages
  end

  def fetch_and_compute_moving_average
    prices = fetch_historical_prices
    compute_moving_average(prices)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/credit_card_validator.rb
class CreditCardValidator
  def self.valid?(number)
    # Remove any non-digit characters
    number = number.gsub(/\D/, '')

    # Check if the number is valid according to the Luhn algorithm
    sum = 0
    number.reverse.each_char.with_index do |digit, index|
      digit = digit.to_i
      if index.even?
        sum += digit
      else
        digit *= 2
        sum += digit > 9 ? digit - 9 : digit
      end
    end
    sum % 10 == 0
  end

  def self.brand(number)
    # Remove any non-digit characters
    number = number.gsub(/\D/, '')

    # Detect the card brand
    case
    when number.start_with?('34', '37') then 'American Express'
    when number.start_with?('60', '64', '65') then 'Discover'
    when number.start_with?('5018', '5020', '5038', '6304') then 'Maestro'
    when number.start_with?('51', '52', '53', '54', '55') then 'Mastercard'
    when number.start_with?('4') then 'Visa'
    else 'Unknown'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# payment_card.rb

class PaymentCard
  def initialize(number)
    @number = number.to_s.gsub(/\D/, '')
  end

  def valid?
    # Алгоритм Луна
    digits = @number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    check_digit = digits.pop
    digits.reverse_each.with_index do |digit, index|
      digits[index] *= 2 if index.even?
      digits[index] -= 9 if digits[index] > 9
    end
    sum = digits.sum
    (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10 == check_digit
  end

  def payment_system
    # Визначення платіжної системи за номером картки
    case @number
    when /^4/ then 'Visa'
    when /^5[1-5]/ then 'Mastercard'
    when /^3[47]/ then 'American Express'
    when /^6011|64[4-9]|65/ then 'Discover'
    else 'Unknown'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    @client.api_key = AdyenConfig::API_KEY

        value: amount
      },
      reference: reference,
      paymentMethod: {

      },

  end

# Verify HMAC signature of notifications
class AdyenNotification
  def self.verify_signature(notification, hmac_key)
    # Get the HMAC signature from the notification
    signature = notification['additionalData']['hmacSignature']

    # Create a new HMAC signature using the notification data and the HMAC key
    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', hmac_key, notification.to_json)

    # Compare the two signatures
    expected_signature == signature
  end
end
```

```ruby
# loan_amortization.rb

require 'axlsx'

class LoanAmortization
  def initialize(loan_amount, annual_interest_rate, loan_term_in_years)
    @loan_amount = loan_amount
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 100.0
    @loan_term_in_years = loan_term_in_years
    @monthly_interest_rate = (@annual_interest_rate / 12.0)
    @number_of_payments = @loan_term_in_years * 12
    @monthly_payment = calculate_monthly_payment
  end

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    @monthly_payment = @loan_amount * (@monthly_interest_rate * (1 + @monthly_interest_rate) ** @number_of_payments) / ((1 + @monthly_interest_rate) ** @number_of_payments - 1)
  end

  def generate_amortization_schedule
    schedule = []
    balance = @loan_amount
    for i in 1..@number_of_payments
      interest_payment = balance * @monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = @monthly_payment - interest_payment
      balance -= principal_payment
      schedule << {
        month: i,
        payment: @monthly_payment.round(2),
        interest: interest_payment.round(2),
        principal: principal_payment.round(2),
        balance: balance.round(2)
      }
    end
    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(file_path)
    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet do |sheet|
        sheet.add_row ['Month', 'Payment', 'Interest', 'Principal', 'Balance']
        generate_amortization_schedule.each do |row|
          sheet.add_row [
            row[:month],
            row[:payment],
            row[:interest],
            row[:principal],
            row[:balance]
          ]
        end
      end
      p.serialize(file_path)
    end
  end
end

annual_interest_rate = 4.5
loan_term_in_years = 30

amortization.export_to_excel('amortization_schedule.xlsx')
```

```ruby
    payment = Mollie::Payment.get(payment_id)

    # Update the order based on the payment status
    case payment.status
    when 'paid'
      # Update the order as paid
      puts "Order paid: #{payment_id}"
    when 'failed'
      # Update the order as failed
      puts "Order failed: #{payment_id}"
    when 'open'
      # Update the order as open
      puts "Order open: #{payment_id}"
    end

    # Return a 200 OK response to Mollie
    'OK'
  end
end
```

### Xero Service Class

Create a service class `xero_service.rb` in the `app/services` directory:
```ruby
# app/services/xero_service.rb

require 'oauth2'
require 'xero-ruby'

class XeroService
  def initialize
    @client = XeroRuby::Client.new(
      client_id: XERO_CLIENT_ID,
      client_secret: XERO_CLIENT_SECRET,
      redirect_uri: XERO_REDIRECT_URI,
      scope: 'accounting.transactions offline_access'
    )
  end

  def authenticate
    @client.authorize_url
  end

  def get_access_token(code)
    @client.get_access_token(code)
  end

  def send_invoice(invoice)
    # Create a new invoice in Xero
    xero_invoice = {
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        name: invoice.customer_name
      },
      date: invoice.date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      line_items: invoice.line_items.map do |item|
        {
          item_code: item.item_code,
          description: item.description,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit_amount: item.unit_amount,
          account_code: item.account_code
        }
      end
    }

    @client.invoices.create(xero_invoice)
  end

  def sync_payment_status(invoice)
    # Get the payment status of the invoice from Xero
    xero_invoice = @client.invoices.find(invoice.xero_invoice_id)

    # Update the payment status in the Rails app
    invoice.update(payment_status: xero_invoice.status)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# quickbooks_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'oauth2'
require_relative 'config'

class QuickBooksAPI
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com'

  def initialize
    @access_token = QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN
    @access_token_secret = QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
    @realm_id = QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID
  end

  def export_invoice(invoice)
    # Set up authentication headers
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    # Prepare invoice data
    invoice_data = {
      'Invoice' => {
        'CustomerRef' => {
          'value' => invoice['customer_id']
        },
        'BillAddr' => {
          'Line1' => invoice['billing_address'],
          'City' => invoice['billing_city'],
          'State' => invoice['billing_state'],
          'PostalCode' => invoice['billing_zip']
        },
        'ShipAddr' => {
          'Line1' => invoice['shipping_address'],
          'City' => invoice['shipping_city'],
          'State' => invoice['shipping_state'],
          'PostalCode' => invoice['shipping_zip']
        },
        'InvoiceLine' => [
          {
            'Description' => invoice['description'],
            'Amount' => invoice['amount'],
            'SalesItemLineDetail' => {
              'ItemRef' => {
                'value' => invoice['item_id']
              }
            }
          }
        ],
        'TotalAmt' => invoice['total_amount']
      }
    }

    # Send request to create invoice
    response = self.class.post("/v3/company/#{@realm_id}/invoice", headers: headers, body: invoice_data.to_json)

    # Check response status
    if response.success?
      puts "Invoice exported successfully: #{response['Invoice']['Id']}"
    else
      puts "Error exporting invoice: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

class InvoiceExporter
  def initialize
    @quickbooks_api = QuickBooksAPI.new
  end

  def export_paid_invoices(invoices)
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      if invoice['paid']
        @quickbooks_api.export_invoice(invoice)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'axlsx'

class CreditCalculator
  def initialize(credit_amount, interest_rate, loan_term)
    @credit_amount = credit_amount
    @interest_rate = interest_rate / 100 / 12 # конвертуємо річну ставку у місячну
    @loan_term = loan_term
  end

  def calculate_payment
    # розрахунок щомісячного платежу за формулою аннуїтету
    monthly_payment = @credit_amount * (@interest_rate * (1 + @interest_rate) ** @loan_term) / ((1 + @interest_rate) ** @loan_term - 1)
    monthly_payment
  end

  def calculate_schedule
    schedule = []
    balance = @credit_amount
    monthly_payment = calculate_payment

    @loan_term.times do |month|
      interest = balance * @interest_rate
      principal = monthly_payment - interest
      balance -= principal

      schedule << {
        month: month + 1,
        payment: monthly_payment,
        interest: interest,
        principal: principal,
        balance: balance
      }
    end

    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(schedule, file_path)
    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet do |sheet|
        sheet.add_row ['Місяць', 'Платіж', 'Відсотки', 'Основна сума', 'Баланс']
        schedule.each do |row|
          sheet.add_row [row[:month], row[:payment], row[:interest], row[:principal], row[:balance]]
        end
      end
      p.serialize(file_path)
    end
  end
end
```
Цей клас приймає три параметри: суму кредиту, річну ставку та термін кредиту. Метод `calculate_payment` розрахує щомісячний платеж за формулою аннуїтету. Метод `calculate_schedule` розрахує графік погашення кредиту, а метод `export_to_excel` експортує цей графік у файл Excel.

Тепер ви можете використовувати цей клас для розрахунку графіка погашення кредиту та експорту його у файл Excel. Наприклад:
```ruby
calculator = CreditCalculator.new(100000, 12, 60) # 100 000 грн, 12% річних, 5 років
schedule = calculator.calculate_schedule
calculator.export_to_excel(schedule, 'credit_schedule.xlsx')
```

```ruby
  order = Order.find(order_id)

  when 'paid'

  when 'failed'
    order.update(status: 'failed')
  when 'expired'
    order.update(status: 'expired')
```

```ruby
    # Створіть замовлення або будь-який інший об'єкт для оплати
    order = Order.create(amount: 10.99, currency: 'UAH')

    # Створіть форму оплати LiqPay

      description: "Оплата замовлення ##{order.id}",
      order_id: order.id,

      order = Order.find(params[:order_id])
      order.update(status: 'paid')
      render json: { message: 'Оплата успішна' }
    else
```

### Implementation

Now, let's write the Ruby script to fetch transactions from the monobank API and save new ones. This script assumes you have an API token from monobank. For security, we'll use the `dotenv` gem to load the API token from a `.env` file.

1. **Create a `.env` file** in the root of your project and add your monobank API token:

```makefile
MONOBANK_API_TOKEN=your_api_token_here
```

2. **Ruby Script (`monobank_transactions.rb`):**

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class MonobankClient
  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
    @base_url = 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  end

  def get_transactions(account_id)
    response = HTTParty.get("#{@base_url}/personal/client-info", headers: {
      'X-Token' => @token
    })

    if response.success?
      client_info = JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      account = client_info[:accounts].find { |account| account[:id] == account_id }

      if account
        # Fetch transactions for the specified account
        transactions_response = HTTParty.get("#{@base_url}/personal/statement/#{account_id}/0/100", headers: {
          'X-Token' => @token
        })

        if transactions_response.success?
          transactions = JSON.parse(transactions_response.body, symbolize_names: true)
          # Here you can save new transactions to your database or file
          # For demonstration, we'll just print them
          transactions.each do |transaction|
            puts "Transaction ID: #{transaction[:id]}, Time: #{transaction[:time]}, Description: #{transaction[:description]}, Amount: #{transaction[:amount]}"
          end
        else
          puts "Failed to fetch transactions: #{transactions_response.code}"
        end
      else
        puts "Account not found"
      end
    else
      puts "Failed to fetch client info: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

# Usage
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  token = ENV['MONOBANK_API_TOKEN']
  client = MonobankClient.new(token)
  client.get_transactions('your_account_id_here') # Replace with your actual account ID
end
```

### Notes:
- Replace `'your_api_token_here'` in the `.env` file with your actual monobank API token.
- Replace `'your_account_id_here'` in the script with the ID of the account for which you want to fetch transactions.
- This script fetches the last 100 transactions for the specified account. You might need to adjust the parameters in the URL to fetch more or older transactions.

```ruby
require 'httparty'

  end

  def verify_signature(params)
    signature = params.delete('signature')
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    signature == expected_signature
  end

  def generate_signature(params)
    sorted_params = params.sort_by { |k, v| k }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    Base64.strict_encode64(Digest::SHA1.digest("#{@private_key}#{sorted_params}#{@private_key}"))
  end

  def payment_url(order_id, amount, currency, description, result_url)
    "https://www.liqpay.ua/api/3/checkout?public_key=#{@public_key}&version=3&amount=#{amount}&currency=#{currency}&description=#{description}&order_id=#{order_id}&result_url=#{result_url}"
  end
end
```

### wayforpay.rb
```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

# WayForPay API endpoint
WAYFORPAY_API = 'https://api.wayforpay.com/api'

# Your merchant account credentials
MERCHANT_ACCOUNT = 'YOUR_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT'
MERCHANT_SECRET_KEY = 'YOUR_MERCHANT_SECRET_KEY'

# Payment request
post '/payment' do
  # Get order details from request body
  order = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

  # Set payment request parameters
  payment_params = {
    'transactionType' => 'CREATE_INVOICE',
    'merchantAccount' => MERCHANT_ACCOUNT,
    'merchantDomainName' => 'example.com',
    'merchantTransactionSecureType' => 'AUTO',
    'orderReference' => order['orderReference'],
    'orderDate' => Time.now.utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
    'amount' => order['amount'],
    'currency' => order['currency'],
    'productName' => order['productName'],
    'productPrice' => order['productPrice'],
    'productCount' => order['productCount']
  }

  # Generate payment signature
  payment_signature = Digest::MD5.hexdigest("#{MERCHANT_ACCOUNT}#{payment_params['orderReference']}#{payment_params['amount']}#{payment_params['currency']}#{MERCHANT_SECRET_KEY}")

  # Send payment request to WayForPay API
  response = HTTParty.post("#{WAYFORPAY_API}/payment", headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }, body: { payment: payment_params, signature: payment_signature }.to_json)

  # Redirect user to payment page
  redirect response['url']
end

# Payment callback
post '/callback' do
  # Get payment status from request body
  payment_status = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

  # Check payment status
  if payment_status['transactionStatus'] == 'Approved'
    # Confirm the order
    order_reference = payment_status['orderReference']
    # Update order status in database
    # ...
    puts "Order #{order_reference} confirmed"
  else
    # Handle other payment statuses
    puts "Payment status: #{payment_status['transactionStatus']}"
  end

  # Return success response
  { success: true }.to_json
end
```

```ruby
  attr_accessor :merchant_id, :merchant_password, :order_id, :amount, :currency, :response

    }
  end

    @response = JSON.parse(response.body)
    @response
  end

    signature = response['signature']
    response_data = response.to_json
    expected_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(response_data + @merchant_password)
    signature == expected_signature
  end
end
```

```ruby
# nbu_qr_code_generator.rb

require 'rqrcode'
require 'chunky_png'

class NBUQRCodeGenerator
  def initialize(payment_info)
    @payment_info = payment_info
  end

  def generate_qr_code
    # NBU QR payment standard requires the following fields:
    # 1. Merchant ID (ID of the recipient)
    # 2. Merchant name (Name of the recipient)
    # 3. Payment amount
    # 4. Currency (always UAH for Ukrainian banks)
    # 5. Payment description (optional)
    # 6. Payment type (always "INVOICE" for invoice payments)

    qr_code_data = [
      "BP01", # Payment type (always "BP01" for NBU QR payments)
      @payment_info[:merchant_id],
      @payment_info[:merchant_name],
      @payment_info[:payment_amount].to_s,
      "980", # Currency (always 980 for UAH)
      @payment_info[:payment_description] || "",
      "INVOICE" # Payment type (always "INVOICE" for invoice payments)
    ].join(".")

    qr_code = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_code_data, size: 200)
    png = qr_code.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: "black",
      shape_rendering: ChunkyPNG::SHAPE_RENDERING_CRISP,
      text: nil,
      size: 200
    )

    png.save("payment_qr_code.png")
  end
end

# Example usage:
payment_info = {
  merchant_id: "1234567890",
  merchant_name: "Example Merchant",
  payment_amount: 100.0,
  payment_description: "Payment for services"
}

generator = NBUQRCodeGenerator.new(payment_info)
generator.generate_qr_code
```

3. Call the `generate_qr_code` method to generate the QR code.
4. The generated QR code will be saved as a PNG image file named "payment_qr_code.png".

Note: This implementation assumes that the payment information is valid and complete. You may want to add error handling and validation to ensure that the payment information is correct before generating the QR code.

```ruby
    edd = calculate_edd(income)
    esvid = calculate_esvid(income)
    edd + esvid
  end
```

```ruby
require 'csv'
require 'date'

# Клас для представлення транзакції
class Transaction
  attr_accessor :date, :description, :amount, :category

  def initialize(date, description, amount)
    @date = Date.strptime(date, "%d.%m.%Y")
    @description = description
    @amount = amount.to_f
    @category = nil
  end

  def categorize
    # Простіший підхід до категоризації - за ключовими словами
    if @description.include?("магазин") || @description.include?("супермаркет")
      @category = "Покупки"
    elsif @description.include?("кафе") || @description.include?("ресторан")
      @category = "Харчування"
    elsif @description.include?("бензин") || @description.include?("АЗС")
      @category = "Паливо"
    else
      @category = "Інше"
    end
  end
end

# Клас для імпорту та обробки транзакцій
class TransactionImporter
  def initialize(file_path)
    @transactions = []
    @file_path = file_path
  end

  def import
    CSV.foreach(@file_path, headers: false) do |row|
      transaction = Transaction.new(row[0], row[1], row[2])
      transaction.categorize
      @transactions << transaction
    end
  end

  def print_transactions
    @transactions.each do |transaction|
      puts "Дата: #{transaction.date}, Опис: #{transaction.description}, Сума: #{transaction.amount}, Категорія: #{transaction.category}"
    end
  end
end

# Використання

  importer = TransactionImporter.new("path_to_your_file.csv")
  importer.import
  importer.print_transactions
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class LiqPayP2PCredit
  def initialize(private_key, public_key)
    @private_key = private_key
    @public_key = public_key
  end

  def pay(card_number, amount, currency = 'UAH')
    url = 'https://www.liqpay.ua/api/request'
    data = {
      'version' => '3',
      'public_key' => @public_key,
      'action' => 'p2p_credit',
      'card' => card_number,
      'amount' => amount,
      'currency' => currency,
      'description' => 'Виплата коштів'
    }

    signature = generate_signature(data)
    data['signature'] = signature

    response = HTTParty.post(url, body: data)

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    data_str = data.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest("#{@private_key}#{data_str}#{@private_key}")
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class PrivatBankPayment
  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
  end

  def create_payment(order_id, amount, description)
    url = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/pay/api/public/v1/payment/create'
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@merchant_password}"

      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      description: description,
      payment_system: 'privat24'
    }.to_json

    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
```

```ruby
# Function to convert number to Ukrainian words
def number_to_words(number)
  integer_part = number.to_i
  fractional_part = (number * 100).to_i % 100

  integer_words = ''
  case integer_part
  when 0
    integer_words = I18n.t('number.words.zero')
  when 1..19
    integer_words = I18n.t("number.words.#{integer_part}")
  when 20..99
    tens = integer_part / 10
    ones = integer_part % 10
    integer_words = I18n.t("number.tens.#{tens * 10}") + (ones > 0 ? " #{I18n.t("number.words.#{ones}")}" : '')
  when 100..999
    hundreds = integer_part / 100
    rest = integer_part % 100
    integer_words = I18n.t("number.hundreds.#{hundreds}_hundreds") + (rest > 0 ? " #{number_to_words(rest)}" : '')
  end

  fractional_words = ''
  case fractional_part
  when 0
    # do nothing
  when 1
    fractional_words = I18n.t('currency.kop.one')
  when 2..4
    fractional_words = I18n.t('currency.kop.few')
  when 5..9, 11..14
    fractional_words = I18n.t('currency.kop.other')
  when 10, 15..19
    fractional_words = I18n.t('currency.kop.other')
  end

  if integer_part == 1
    currency_words = I18n.t('currency.uah.one')
  elsif integer_part >= 2 && integer_part <= 4
    currency_words = I18n.t('currency.uah.few')
  else
    currency_words = I18n.t('currency.uah.other')
  end

  "#{integer_words} #{currency_words} #{fractional_words}"
end
```

```ruby
    }
    params = {
      transaction_id: transaction_id
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers, query: params)

  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
class FondyPayment
  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_key = merchant_key
  end

  def make_payment(order_id, amount, currency, description)
    url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/redirect/'
    params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(url, body: params)
    response_body = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if response_body['response_status'] == 'success'
      # Отримати URL для редиректу
      redirect_url = response_body['redirect_url']
      # Перенаправити користувача на цей URL для оплати
      return redirect_url
    else
      # Обробити помилку
      return nil
    end
  end

  def verify_signature(response)
    # Отримати підпис з відповіді
    signature = response['signature']
    # Отримати дані з відповіді
    data = response['data']
    # Об'єднати дані в рядок
    data_string = data.to_json
    # Створити хеш з рядка даних
    hash = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha1', @merchant_key, data_string)
    # Перевірити підпис
    if OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha1', @merchant_key, data_string) == signature
      return true
    else
      return false
    end
```

- `TR` - тип операції (необов'язково)
- `RF` - додаткова інформація про платеж (необов'язково)

```ruby
  data[:an] ? "#{data[:an]}" : '',
  "#{data[:ac]}",
  "#{data[:am]}",
  "#{data[:cc]}",
  data[:tr] ? "#{data[:tr]}" : '',
```

1. **Set up the environment**: Create a Gemfile that lists the necessary gems.
2. **Implement the LiqPay API interaction**: Write Ruby code to interact with the LiqPay API for p2p credit operations.

First, let's create the Gemfile. We will need `httparty` for making HTTP requests and `json` for handling JSON data (though `json` is part of the Ruby Standard Library, so you don't need to add it explicitly to your Gemfile). If you're handling sensitive information like API keys, consider using environment variables or a secrets management system, which might require additional gems.


Run `bundle install` in your terminal to install the `httparty` gem.

Next, let's implement the Ruby code to interact with the LiqPay API. This example assumes you have an API key and a private key from LiqPay. The LiqPay API uses a specific format for requests and requires signature generation for authentication.

```ruby
# liqpay.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'

class LiqPay
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.liqpay.ua/api/'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key, private_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def payout(card, amount)
    # Prepare data
    data = {
      "action" => "p2p_credit",
      "version" => "3",
      "public_key" => @api_key,
      "amount" => amount,
      "currency" => "UAH",
      "description" => "Payout to card",
      "card" => card,
      "type" => "card"
    }

    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data)

    # Add signature to data
    data['signature'] = signature

    # Convert data to JSON and make request
    response = HTTParty.post(BASE_URL + 'request', body: data.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

    # Handle response
    if response.success?
      # Process successful response
      puts "Payout successful: #{response.body}"
    else
      # Handle error
      puts "Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    # Sort data by keys
    sorted_data = data.sort_by { |k, v| k }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join

    # Generate signature
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', @private_key, sorted_data)
    Base64.strict_encode64(signature)
  end
end

# Example usage

  api_key = 'YOUR_API_KEY'
  private_key = 'YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY'
  card = 'YOUR_CARD_NUMBER'
  amount = '100.00' # Example amount

  liqpay = LiqPay.new(api_key, private_key)
  liqpay.payout(card, amount)
end
```

Replace `'YOUR_API_KEY'`, `'YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY'`, and `'YOUR_CARD_NUMBER'` with your actual LiqPay API key, private key, and the recipient's card number, respectively.

Створіть файл `ipay_client.rb` і помістіть туди наступний код. Цей код надає базовий клієнт для взаємодії з API iPay.ua, включаючи прийом платежів та перевірку статусу транзакції.

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'uri'

class IPayClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.ipay.ua'

  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end

  # Прийом платежу
  def create_payment(order_id, amount, currency, description)
    response = self.class.post('/api/v2/payment/create', body: {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      secret_key: @secret_key,
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу транзакції
  def check_transaction_status(transaction_id)
    response = self.class.get("/api/v2/transaction/status/#{transaction_id}", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@secret_key}"
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end
end

  description = 'Тестовий платіж'

  # Перевірка статусу транзакції
  transaction_id = payment_response[:transaction_id]
```

```ruby
class DHLTracker
  def initialize(tracking_number)
    @tracking_number = tracking_number
    @url = "https://www.dhl.com/en/express/tracking.html?AWB=#{@tracking_number}&brand=DHL"
  end

        location: row.css('td')[2].text.strip,

      }
      events << event
    end

    events
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class EasyPostClient
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @base_url = 'https://api.easypost.com/v2'
  end

  def get_rates(shipment)
    response = HTTParty.get("#{@base_url}/shipments/#{shipment['id']}/rates", headers: { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}" })
    JSON.parse(response.body)['rates']
  end

  def buy_cheapest_label(shipment)
    rates = get_rates(shipment)
    cheapest_rate = rates.min_by { |rate| rate['rate'] }
    response = HTTParty.post("#{@base_url}/shipments/#{shipment['id']}/buy", headers: { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}" }, body: { rate: cheapest_rate['id'] }.to_json)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```
Цей код визначає клас `EasyPostClient`, який має два методи: `get_rates` і `buy_cheapest_label`. Метод `get_rates` використовує API EasyPost для отримання списку тарифів для певної відправлення, а метод `buy_cheapest_label` знаходить найдешевший тариф і купує відповідну етикетку.
