## Implementation

```ruby
require 'fedex'
require 'open-uri'
require 'fileutils'

class FedExShipper
  def initialize(credentials)
    @client = FedEx::Client.new(
      key: credentials[:key],
      password: credentials[:password],
      account: credentials[:account],
      meter: credentials[:meter]
    )
  end

  def create_shipment(shipment_details)
    # Create the shipment
    response = @client.create_shipment(
      from_address: {
        postal_code: shipment_details[:from_zip],
        country_code: shipment_details[:from_country]
      },
      to_address: {
        name: shipment_details[:to_name],
        address1: shipment_details[:to_address1],
        city: shipment_details[:to_city],
        state_or_province_code: shipment_details[:to_state],
        postal_code: shipment_details[:to_zip],
        country_code: shipment_details[:to_country]
      },
      package: {
        weight: shipment_details[:weight],
        dimensions: {
          length: shipment_details[:length],
          width: shipment_details[:width],
          height: shipment_details[:height]
        }
      },
      service: shipment_details[:service_type] || 'FEDEX_GROUND',
      packaging: shipment_details[:packaging_type] || 'YOUR_PACKAGING'
    )

    # Process the response
    if response.success?
      tracking_number = response.tracking_number
      label_url = response.label_url

      # Download the label as PDF
      download_label(label_url, tracking_number)

      { tracking_number: tracking_number, status: 'success' }
    else
      { error: response.errors, status: 'failed' }
    end
  end

  private

  def download_label(url, tracking_number)
    # Create directory if it doesn't exist
    Dir.mkdir('labels') unless Dir.exist?('labels')

    # Download the label
    filename = "labels/FedEx_#{tracking_number}.pdf"
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(URI.open(url).read)
    end

    filename
  end
end

# Ruby Implementation for iPay.ua Payments

Here's a complete solution for accepting payments through iPay.ua and checking transaction statuses in Ruby.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty' # For making HTTP requests
gem 'dotenv', groups: [:development, :test] # For environment variables
```

Run `bundle install` after creating this Gemfile.

## Implementation

```ruby
# lib/ipay_client.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class IpayClient
  include HTTParty

  # Initialize with your iPay.ua merchant credentials
  def initialize
    @base_uri = 'https://api.ipay.ua'
    @merchant_id = ENV['IPAY_MERCHANT_ID']
    @secret_key = ENV['IPAY_SECRET_KEY']
    @test_mode = ENV['IPAY_TEST_MODE'] == 'true'
  end

  # Create a new payment
  # @param amount [Numeric] amount in UAH
  # @param currency [String] currency code (default: 'UAH')
  # @param order_id [String] your unique order identifier
  # @param description [String] payment description
  # @param success_url [String] URL to redirect after successful payment
  # @param failure_url [String] URL to redirect after failed payment
  # @return [Hash] payment details including payment_id and redirect_url
  def create_payment(amount, order_id, description, success_url, failure_url, currency: 'UAH')
    raise ArgumentError, 'Amount must be positive' unless amount.to_f > 0

    params = {
      merchant: @merchant_id,
      amount: amount.to_s,
      currency: currency,
      order: order_id,
      description: description,
      pay_way: 'privat24,visa_mastercard,masterpass,googlepay,applepay',
      success_url: success_url,
      fail_url: failure_url,
      test_mode: @test_mode ? 1 : 0
    }

    signature = generate_signature(params.merge(secret_key: @secret_key))

    response = self.class.post(
      "/payment/init/",
      body: params.merge(signature: signature),
      query: { merchant: @merchant_id }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check payment status
  # @param payment_id [String] the payment ID from iPay.ua
  # @return [Hash] payment status information
  def payment_status(payment_id)
    params = {
      merchant: @merchant_id,
      payment_id: payment_id,
      test_mode: @test_mode ? 1 : 0
    }

    signature = generate_signature(params.merge(secret_key: @secret_key))

    response = self.class.post(
      "/payment/status/",
      body: params.merge(signature: signature),
      query: { merchant: @merchant_id }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  # Generate signature for API requests
  def generate_signature(params)
    params.sort.to_h.values.join('|')
  end

  # Handle API responses
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "iPay.ua API error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file in your project root:

```
IPAY_MERCHANT_ID=your_merchant_id_here
IPAY_SECRET_KEY=your_secret_key_here
IPAY_TEST_MODE=false
```

## Example Usage

```ruby

# Initialize the client

begin
  # Create a new payment
  payment = ipay.create_payment(
    amount: 100.00,
    order_id: 'ORDER12345',
    description: 'Test payment for widgets',
    success_url: 'https://yourapp.com/success',
    failure_url: 'https://yourapp.com/failure'
  )

  puts "Payment ID: #{payment['payment_id']}"

rescue => e

## Реалізація коду

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'awesome_print'

class DHLTracking
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://www.dhl.com'

  def initialize(tracking_number, country_code = 'us')
    @tracking_number = tracking_number
    @country_code = country_code
  end

  def get_tracking_info
    # Для DHL зручніше використовувати їх API, але ми будемо парсити веб-сторінку
    # Офіційне API DHL требує реєстрації і має обмеження

    # Формуємо URL для відстеження
    url = "/#{@country_code}/en/express/tracking.html?tracking-id=#{@tracking_number}"

    # Виконуємо запит
    response = self.class.get(url)

    if response.success?
      parse_tracking_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Failed to fetch tracking information: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_tracking_response(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)

    # Знаходимо основні дані посилки
    shipment_data = {}

    # Назва відправника та отримувача (може бути різним на різних сторінках DHL)
    # Зазвичай знаходиться в div з класом "shipper" або "consignee"
    shipment_data[:shipper] = doc.at_css('.shipper')&.text&.strip
    shipment_data[:consignee] = doc.at_css('.consignee')&.text&.strip

    # Статус посилки
    status = doc.at_css('.status') || doc.at_css('.tracking-status')
    shipment_data[:status] = status&.text&.strip if status

    # Події доставки (зазвичай в таблиці або списку)
    events = []
    event_rows = doc.css('.event') || doc.css('.tracking-event') || doc.css('tr.event-row')

    event_rows.each do |row|
      date = row.at_css('.date')&.text&.strip
      time = row.at_css('.time')&.text&.strip
      location = row.at_css('.location')&.text&.strip
      description = row.at_css('.description')&.text&.strip

      events << {
        date: date,
        time: time,
        location: location,
        description: description
      } if date || description
    end

    shipment_data[:events] = events

    shipment_data
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.empty?
    puts "Please provide a tracking number as an argument"
    puts "Example: ruby dhl_tracking.rb 1234567890"
    exit
  end

  tracking_number = ARGV[0]
  tracker = DHLTracking.new(tracking_number)

  tracking_info = tracker.get_tracking_info

  if tracking_info[:error]
    puts tracking_info[:error]
  else
    puts "\nTracking information for DHL shipment #{tracking_number}:\n"
    ap tracking_info
  end
end
```

## Примітки

1. Цей код використовує парсинг HTML-сторінки DHL, що може бути нестабільним, оскільки структура сторінки може змінюватися.

2. Для більш надійного рішення краще використовувати офіційний API DHL, який надає доступ до точних даних про відстеження.

3. Для роботи з офіційним API DHL вам знадобиться зареєструватися і отримати ключ доступу.

4. Код передбачає, що ви відстежуєте посилку на англомовній версії сайту DHL (з country code 'us'). Якщо потрібно інша локалізація, необхідно змінити country_code.

5. Для запуску коду:

## Implementation

require 'ups_ship'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class UPSRateCalculator
  # Initialize with your UPS API credentials
  def initialize(api_key, username, password, account_number)
    @ups = UPS::Ship.new(
      access_key: api_key,
      username: username,
      password: password,
      account: account_number
    )
  end

  # Get shipping rates for a parcel
  # Parameters:
  # - origin_zip: Origin ZIP code (string)
  # - destination_zip: Destination ZIP code (string)
  # - weight: Parcel weight in pounds (float)
  # - length: Parcel length in inches (float)
  # - width: Parcel width in inches (float)
  # - height: Parcel height in inches (float)
  # - service_codes: Array of UPS service codes to get rates for (optional)
  def get_rates(origin_zip, destination_zip, weight, length, width, height, service_codes: ['01', '03', '02', '11', '12', '13', '14', '54', '65'])
    # Create the request object
    request = @ups.rating(
      from_zip: origin_zip,
      to_zip: destination_zip,
      weight: weight,
      dimensions: {
        length: length,
        width: width,
        height: height
      },
      service: service_codes
    )

    # Make the API request
    response = request.get

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      raise "UPS API Error: #{response.error_message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response_body)
    # Parse the XML response (UPS returns XML by default)
    require 'nokogiri'
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)

    rates = []

    doc.xpath('//RatingServiceSelectionResponse/RatedShipment').each do |shipment|
      service_code = shipment.xpath('Service/Code').text
      service_name = shipment.xpath('Service/Description').text
      total_charge = shipment.xpath('TotalCharges/Money').text.to_f

      rates << {
        service_code: service_code,
        service_name: service_name,
        total_charge: total_charge
      }
    end

    rates
  end
end

# Example usage

  API_KEY = 'your_api_key'
  USERNAME = 'your_username'
  PASSWORD = 'your_password'
  ACCOUNT_NUMBER = 'your_account_number'

  begin
    # Example parcel
    origin_zip = '90210'
    destination_zip = '10001'
    weight = 5.0 # pounds
    length = 10.0 # inches

    height = 4.0 # inches

    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

1. **Authentication**: You need to sign up for UPS Developer Kit to get API credentials (API key, username, password, and account number).

class SPApiClient
  include Config

  attr_reader :logger

  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
    @logger.level = Logger::DEBUG
  end

  def get_orders(created_after = 1.day.ago.iso8601)
    endpoint = "https://sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com/orders/v0/orders"

    headers = {
      'x-amz-access-token' => refresh_access_token,
      'x-amz-date' => Time.now.utc.iso8601,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Amazon-Order-API-Version' => '2013-09-01'
    }

    params = {
      CreatedAfter: created_after,
      MarketplaceIds: config.marketplace_ids.join(','),
      OrderStatus: 'Unshipped',
      MaxResultsPerPage: config.max_results_per_page
    }

    begin
      response = RestClient.get(
        endpoint,
        { params: params, headers: headers }
      )

      Oj.load(response.body)
    rescue RestClient::ExceptionWithResponse => e
      logger.error "API request failed: #{e.response.body}"
      raise
    end
  end

  private

  def refresh_access_token
    return @access_token if @access_token && @token_expiry > Time.now.utc

    token_response = RestClient.post(
      'https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token',
      {
        grant_type: 'refresh_token',
        refresh_token: config.refresh_token,
        client_id: config.lwa_client_id,
        client_secret: config.lwa_client_secret
      }
    )

    token_data = Oj.load(token_response.body)
    @access_token = token_data['access_token']
    @token_expiry = Time.now.utc + token_data['expires_in'].to_i
    @access_token
  end

  def config
    Config[:amazon_seller]
  end
end

    puts "\nCheapest option: #{cheapest_rate.service} (#{cheapest_rate.carrier}) for $#{cheapest_rate.rate}"

    # Купимо найдешевшу етикетку
    if cheapest_rate
      bought_label = shipment.buy(rate: cheapest_rate)
      puts "\nPurchased label for #{bought_label.tracking_code}"
      return bought_label
    else
      puts "\nNo rates available"
      return nil
    end
  end
end

Dotenv.load

  has_many :ebay_listings, dependent: :destroy
end

  self.table_name = 'ebay_listings'
  belongs_to :product

  validates :item_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
end

# eBay Service
class EbayService
  def initialize
    @config = {
      token: ENV['EBAY_API_TOKEN'],
      dev_id: ENV['EBAY_DEV_ID'],
      app_id: ENV['EBAY_APP_ID'],
      cert_id: ENV['EBAY_CERT_ID'],
      sandbox: ENV['EBAY_SANDBOX'] == 'true'
    }
    @client = EbayApi::Client.new(@config)
  end

  # List all products that need to be listed on eBay
  def list_products
    products_without_listings = Product.joins("LEFT JOIN ebay_listings ON products.id = ebay_listings.product_id")
                                       .where("ebay_listings.product_id IS NULL OR ebay_listings.item_id IS NULL")
                                       .where("products.quantity > 0")

    products_without_listings.each do |product|
      list_product_on_ebay(product)
    end
  end

  # List a single product on eBay
  def list_product_on_ebay(product)
    LOGGER.info "Listing product #{product.id} on eBay: #{product.name}"

    response = @client.add_item(
      title: product.name,
      description: product.description,
      quantity: product.quantity,
      start_price: product.price,
      category: product.category,
      return_policy: {
        returns_accepted: 'ReturnsAccepted'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      listing = EbayListing.create!(
        product_id: product.id,
        item_id: response.item_id,
        status: 'active',
        created_at: Time.now,
        updated_at: Time.now
      )
      LOGGER.info "Successfully listed product #{product.id} with eBay ID: #{response.item_id}"
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to list product #{product.id}: #{response.error_message}"
    end
  rescue => e
    LOGGER.error "Error listing product #{product.id}: #{e.message}"
  end

  # Update quantities of all listed items
  def update_quantities
    EbayListing.where(status: 'active').each do |listing|
      product = listing.product
      update_quantity(listing, product.quantity)
    end
  end

  # Update quantity for a specific listing
  def update_quantity(listing, new_quantity)
    LOGGER.info "Updating quantity for eBay listing #{listing.item_id} to #{new_quantity}"

    response = @client.revise_item(
      item_id: listing.item_id,
      quantity: new_quantity
    )

    if response.success?
      listing.update!(quantity: new_quantity, updated_at: Time.now)
      LOGGER.info "Successfully updated quantity for listing #{listing.item_id}"
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to update quantity for listing #{listing.item_id}: #{response.error_message}"
    end
  rescue => e
    LOGGER.error "Error updating quantity for listing #{listing.item_id}: #{e.message}"
  end

  # Monitor stock changes and update eBay listings
  def monitor_stock_changes
    previous_quantities = {}

    # Initial state
    EbayListing.where(status: 'active').each do |listing|
      previous_quantities[listing.product_id] = listing.quantity
    end

    # This would be called periodically (e.g., via cron job)
    # In a real application, you'd want to implement a more robust monitoring system
    EbayListing.where(status: 'active').each do |listing|
      product = listing.product
      if previous_quantities[product.id] != product.quantity
        update_quantity(listing, product.quantity)
        previous_quantities[product.id] = product.quantity
      end
    end
  end
end

# app/ebay_marketplace.rb
require 'ebay-api'
require 'csv'
require 'yaml'

class EbayMarketplace
  def initialize(config_file = 'config/config.yml')
    @config = YAML.load_file(config_file)
    @ebay_client = create_ebay_client
    @products_file = @config['products_file']
  end

  def create_ebay_client
    EBay::Client.new(
      app_id: @config['ebay']['app_id'],
      dev_id: @config['ebay']['dev_id'],
      cert_id: @config['ebay']['cert_id'],
      token: @config['ebay']['token'],
      timeout: 30,
      environment: @config['ebay']['environment']
    )
  end

  def load_products
    products = []

    CSV.foreach(@products_file, headers: true) do |row|
      products << {
        id: row['id'],
        title: row['title'],
        description: row['description'],
        price: row['price'],
        quantity: row['quantity'].to_i,
        category: row['category'],
        condition: row['condition'],
        ebay_item_id: row['ebay_item_id']
      }
    end

    products
  end

  def update_quantity(product, new_quantity)
    if product[:ebay_item_id].present?
      item = @ebay_client.get_item(item_id: product[:ebay_item_id])

      if item && item.quantity != new_quantity
        @ebay_client.revise_item(
          item_id: product[:ebay_item_id],
          quantity: new_quantity
        )
        puts "Оновлено кількість для товару #{product[:id]} (eBay ID: #{product[:ebay_item_id]})"
      end
    end
  end

  def list_product(product)
    if product[:ebay_item_id].blank?
      response = @ebay_client.add_item(
        title: product[:title],
        description: product[:description],
        price: product[:price],
        quantity: product[:quantity],
        category_id: product[:category],
        condition: product[:condition]
      )

      if response.success?
        product[:ebay_item_id] = response.item_id
        puts "Товар #{product[:id]} успішно виставлений на eBay (ID: #{product[:ebay_item_id]})"
      else
        puts "Помилка при виставленні товару #{product[:id]}: #{response.errors.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    product
  end

  def sync_products
    products = load_products

    products.each do |product|
      # Виставляємо товар, якщо він ще не на eBay
      if product[:ebay_item_id].blank?
        listed_product = list_product(product)

        # Зберігаємо оновлений продукт (з eBay ID)
        if listed_product[:ebay_item_id].present?
          save_product(listed_product)
        end
      else
        # Перевіряємо кількість і оновлюємо, якщо потрібно
        update_quantity(product, product[:quantity])
      end
    end
  end

  def save_product(product)
    products = []
    CSV.read(@products_file).each do |row|
      if row[0] == product[:id]
        row[6] = product[:ebay_item_id] # Записуємо eBay ID
      end
      products << row
    end

    CSV.open(@products_file, 'w') do |csv|
      products.each { |row| csv << row }
    end
  end
end

require 'easypost'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ShippingRateComparer
  def initialize(api_key)
    EasyPost.api_key = api_key
  end

  # Compare rates from multiple carriers and buy the cheapest label
  def compare_and_buy_cheapest_label(params)
    # Create a shipment
    shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
      to_address: params[:to_address],
      from_address: params[:from_address],
      parcel: params[:parcel],
      carrier_accounts: params[:carrier_accounts]
    )

    # Get all available rates
    rates = shipment.rates

    # Find the cheapest rate
    cheapest_rate = find_cheapest_rate(rates)

    if cheapest_rate
      # Buy the label
      bought_label = buy_label(shipment, cheapest_rate)
      return bought_label
    else
      raise "No valid shipping rates available"
    end
  end

  private

  # Find the cheapest rate among all available options
  def find_cheapest_rate(rates)
    cheapest = nil

    rates.each do |rate|
      next if rate.service == "Extra Services" # Skip extra services

      if cheapest.nil? || rate.rate < cheapest.rate
        cheapest = rate
      end
    end

    cheapest
  end

  # Buy the label using the selected rate
  def buy_label(shipment, rate)
    shipment.buy(rate: rate)
  end
end

# Ruby Implementation for USPS Address Validation

Here's a complete solution for validating and normalizing a US shipping address using the USPS Address API.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'activesupport' # For string normalization
gem 'dotenv' # For managing API keys
```

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string/inflections'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class USPSAddressValidator
  include HTTParty

  # USPS Address Validation API endpoint
  API_URL = 'https://production.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'.freeze

  # Initialize with your USPS username (API key)
  def initialize(username)
    @username = username
    @api_key = ENV['USPS_API_KEY'] || username
  end

  # Validate and normalize an address
  def validate_address(address)
    request_body = build_request_address(address)
    response = self.class.post(API_URL, body: request_body, format: :xml)

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "USPS API request failed: #{response.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_request_address(address)
    # Normalize the input address
    normalized_address = normalize_address(address)

    # Build XML request body
    <<~XML
      <AddressValidateRequest USERID="#{@api_key}">
        <Address>
          <FirmName/>
          <Address1>#{normalized_address[:address1]}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{normalized_address[:address2] || ''}</Address2>
          <City>#{normalized_address[:city]}</City>
          <State>#{normalized_address[:state]}</State>
          <Zip5>#{normalized_address[:zip5]}</Zip5>
          <Zip4>#{normalized_address[:zip4] || ''}</Zip4>
        </Address>
      </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end

  def normalize_address(address)
    {
      address1: address[:street1] || '',
      address2: address[:street2] || '',
      city: address[:city] || '',
      state: address[:state]&.upcase || '',
      zip5: (address[:zip].to_s.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')[0..4] || ''),
      zip4: (address[:zip].to_s.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')[5..8] || '')
    }
  end

  def parse_response(xml_response)
    require 'nokogiri'
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)

    response = {
      valid: doc.xpath('//AddressValidateResponse/Address/Error').empty?,
      normalized_address: {}
    }

    if response[:valid]
      address = doc.xpath('//AddressValidateResponse/Address')[0]
      response[:normalized_address] = {
        street1: address.xpath('Address1').text,
        street2: address.xpath('Address2').text,
        city: address.xpath('City').text,
        state: address.xpath('State').text,
        zip5: address.xpath('Zip5').text,
        zip4: address.xpath('Zip4').text
      }
    else
      response[:error] = doc.xpath('//AddressValidateResponse/Address/Error').text
    end

    response
  end
end
```

```ruby

# USPS_API_KEY=YOUR_USERNAME

  street1: '1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW',

}

## Notes

1. You'll need to sign up for a USPS API username (which acts as your API key) at https://www.usps.com/business/web-tools-apis/

2. The API is XML-based, so we're using Nokogiri to parse the response.

3. The implementation includes basic address normalization before sending to the API.

4. Error handling is included for network and API errors.

# Ruby код для перевірки та нормалізації адрес через USPS API

```

## Реалізація

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class USPSAddressValidator
  include HTTParty

  # USPS API конфігурація
  API_ENDPOINT = 'https://secure.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'.freeze
  USERNAME = ENV['USPS_USERNAME'] # Отримайте це в USPS

  def initialize
    raise "USPS_USERNAME environment variable is not set" unless USERNAME
  end

  # Метод для перевірки адреси
  def validate_address(address, city, state, zip_code)
    request_body = build_request_body(address, city, state, zip_code)
    response = self.class.post(API_ENDPOINT, body: request_body, headers: headers)

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      raise "USPS API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise "Error validating address: #{e.message}"
  end

  private

  def build_request_body(address, city, state, zip_code)
    {
      '@XML' => "YES",
      '@XVERSION' => "1",
      AddressValidateRequest: {
        '@USERID' => USERNAME,
        Revision: 1,
        Address: {
          Address1: address,
          Address2: "",
          City: city,
          State: state,
          Zip5: zip_code,
          Zip4: ""
        }
      }
    }.to_xml(root: 'AddressValidateRequest', skip_types: true)
  end

  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'text/xml; charset=utf-8',
      'Accept' => 'text/xml'
    }
  end

  def parse_response(response_body)
    require 'nokogiri'
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)

    error = doc.at_xpath('//Error')
    if error
      error_code = error.at_xpath('Number').text
      error_description = error.at_xpath('Description').text
      raise "USPS API Error (#{error_code}): #{error_description}"
    end

    address = {
      address1: doc.at_xpath('//Address1').text,
      address2: doc.at_xpath('//Address2').text,
      city: doc.at_xpath('//City').text,
      state: doc.at_xpath('//State').text,
      zip5: doc.at_xpath('//Zip5').text,
      zip4: doc.at_xpath('//Zip4').text,
      delivery_point: doc.at_xpath('//DPVConfirmation/DPVFootnotes').text
    }

    address
  end
end
```

                :brand, :gtin, :mpn, :condition, :image_url, :url,

    end

class GoogleMerchantFeedGenerator
  def initialize(products)
    @products = products
  end

  def generate
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.rss('version' => '2.0', 'xmlns:g' => 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0') {
        xml.channel {
          xml.title('Product Feed')
          xml.link('https://www.yourstore.com') # Replace with your store URL
          xml.description('Product feed for Google Merchant Center')
          xml.lastBuildDate(Time.now.utc.iso8601)

          @products.each do |product|
            xml.item {
              xml.title(product.title)
              xml.link(product.url)
              xml.description(product.description) if product.description.present?
              xml.g.id(product.id.to_s)
              xml.g.price(product.price.to_s)
              xml.g.availability(product.availability) if product.availability.present?
              xml.g.product_type(product.product_type) if product.product_type.present?
              xml.g.brand(product.brand) if product.brand.present?
              xml.g.gtin(product.gtin) if product.gtin.present?
              xml.g.mpn(product.mpn) if product.mpn.present?
              xml.g.condition(product.condition) if product.condition.present?
              xml.g.image_link(product.image_url) if product.image_url.present?

              # Optional fields
              xml.g.shipping_weight(product.shipping_weight) if product.shipping_weight.present?
              if product.sale_price.present?
                xml.g.sale_price(product.sale_price.to_s)
                xml.g.sale_price_effective_date(product.sale_price_effective_date.to_date.iso8601) if product.sale_price_effective_date.present?
              end
              if product.shipping_price.present?
                xml.g.shipping(xml.g.shipping {
                  xml.g.service(product.shipping_price.to_s)
                })
              end
            }
          end
        }
      }
    end

    builder.to_xml
  end
end

```ruby
# app/models/product.rb
class Product < ApplicationRecord
  include Elasticsearch::Model
  include Elasticsearch::Model::Callbacks

  # Определяем индексы, которые будут сохранены в Elasticsearch
  index_name "products_#{Rails.env}"

  # Определяем, какие поля будут индексированы
  def as_indexed_json(_options = {})
    self.as_json(
      methods: [:price_range],
      only: [:id, :title, :description, :price, :category, :brand, :in_stock],
      include: { categories: { only: [:name] }, brands: { only: [:name] } }
    )
  end

  # Фильтр по диапазону цен
  def self.search_with_filters(query, filters)
    search = __elasticsearch__.search(
      query: {
        bool: {
          must: [
            { multi_match: { query: query, fields: ['title^3', 'description'] } }
          ],
          filter: filters
        }
      },
      aggs: {
        categories: { terms: { field: "category.keyword" } },
        brands: { terms: { field: "brand.keyword" } },
        price_ranges: { range: { field: "price", ranges: [
          { to: 50.0 },
          { from: 50.0, to: 100.0 },
          { from: 100.0, to: 200.0 },
          { from: 200.0 }
        ] } },
        in_stock: { terms: { field: "in_stock", size: 10 } }
      }
    )
    search.results
  end

  # Метод для обновления Elasticsearch при изменении записи
  def update_index
    __elasticsearch__.index_document
  end

  # Метод для удаления из индекса
  def remove_from_index
    __elasticsearch__.delete_document
  end
end

      filters << { term: { category: params[:category] } }
    end

      filters << { term: { brand: params[:brand] } }

    end

    end

      categories: @search_results.aggregations.categories.buckets,
      brands: @search_results.aggregations.brands.buckets,

  end

require 'barby'
require 'barby/barcode/ean_13'
require 'barby/outputter/png_outputter'
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/label'
require 'prawn/barcode'
require 'chunky_png'

class BarcodeGenerator
  # Standard label dimensions (Avery 5160 - 2.625 x 1)
  LABEL_WIDTH = 2.625.inches
  LABEL_HEIGHT = 1.inches

  def initialize
    @products = [] # Will store product data
  end

  # Add a product with required barcode data
  def add_product(name, gtin, price = nil)
    @products << {
      name: name,
      gtin: gtin.to_s.rjust(13, '0'), # Ensure 13 digits
      price: price
    }
  end

  # Generate a single EAN-13 barcode as a PNG
  def generate_barcode(gtin)
    barcode = Barby::EAN13.new(gtin)
    barcode.to_png
  end

  # Generate a PDF with all product labels
  def generate_pdf(filename = 'product_labels.pdf')
    Prawn::Document.generate(filename, page_layout: :landscape) do |pdf|
      pdf.label_format = "Avery|5160" # 2.625 x 1 inches

      @products.each do |product|
        # Start a new label
        pdf.start_new_label

        # Draw the barcode
        barcode = Barby::EAN13.new(product[:gtin])
        barcode_png = barcode.to_png

        pdf.image barcode_png, at: [0.5.inches, 0.3.inches], width: 1.625.inches

        # Draw the GTIN text below the barcode
        pdf.font "Helvetica", size: 10
        pdf.text product[:gtin], at: [0.5.inches, 0.1.inches]

        # Draw the product name
        pdf.font "Helvetica", size: 12, style: :bold
        pdf.text product[:name], at: [0.5.inches, 0.6.inches]

        # Draw the price if provided
        if product[:price]
          pdf.font "Helvetica", size: 10
          pdf.text "$#{product[:price].to_s}", at: [0.5.inches, 0.5.inches]
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

### 1. Create the background job

```ruby
# app/jobs/import_product_prices_job.rb
class ImportProductPricesJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(file_path)
    import_products(file_path)
  end

  private

  def import_products(file_path)
    spreadsheet = Roo::Excelx.new(file_path)
    sheet = spreadsheet.sheet(0)

    # Assuming first row is header
    header = sheet.row(1)

    (2..sheet.last_row).each do |row|
      product_data = Hash[header.zip(sheet.row(row))]

      # Basic validation
      next if product_data['product_id'].blank? || product_data['price'].blank?

      # Find or create product (adjust based on your model)
      product = Product.find_by(id: product_data['product_id']) ||
                Product.create!(product_data.slice('product_id', 'name', 'sku', 'description'))

      # Update price
      product.update!(
        price: product_data['price'].to_f,
        updated_at: Time.current
      )

      # Add any other fields from the Excel file as needed
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. Create a service to trigger the job

```ruby
# app/services/product_price_importer.rb
class ProductPriceImporter
  def initialize(file)
    @file = file
  end

  def import
    # Store the uploaded file temporarily
    temp_file = Tempfile.new([@file.original_filename, @file.content_type])

    begin
      temp_file.binmode
      temp_file.write(@file.read)
      temp_file.rewind

      # Enqueue the background job
      ImportProductPricesJob.perform_later(temp_file.path)
    ensure
      temp_file.close
      temp_file.unlink
    end
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
Dotenv.load

class EtsyAPI
  include HTTParty

  attr_reader :api_key, :api_version, :base_url

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ETSY_API_KEY']
    @api_version = 'v3'
    @base_url = "https://openapi.etsy.com/#{@api_version}/"
    raise 'Etsy API key not configured' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end

  # Get shop listings
  def get_listings(shop_id, limit = 10, offset = 0)
    response = self.class.get("#{base_url}listings/active", {
      query: {
        api_key: api_key,
        shop_id: shop_id,
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset,
        includes: 'ListingsImages'
      }
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get shop orders
  def get_orders(shop_id, limit = 10, offset = 0, status = 'all')
    response = self.class.get("#{base_url}shops/#{shop_id}/orders", {
      query: {
        api_key: api_key,
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset,
        status: status
      }
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Etsy API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end

class PriceImportWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(file_path)
    import_prices_from_excel(file_path)
  end

  private

  def import_prices_from_excel(file_path)
    spreadsheet = Roo::Excelx.new(file_path) # For .xlsx files

    # Assuming first sheet contains prices
    sheet = spreadsheet.sheet(0)

    (2..sheet.last_row).each do |row| # Skip header row
      product_data = {
        sku: sheet.cell(row, 1),
        name: sheet.cell(row, 2),
        price: sheet.cell(row, 3).to_f,
        cost: sheet.cell(row, 4).to_f,
        description: sheet.cell(row, 5),
        category: sheet.cell(row, 6),
        updated_at: Time.now
      }

      # Or use a repository pattern

      # For demonstration, we'll just log
      puts "Importing product: #{product_data[:name]} (SKU: #{product_data[:sku]})"
    end

    puts "Price import completed successfully"
  rescue => e
    puts "Error importing prices: #{e.message}"
  end
end

Here's a complete implementation for handling product image uploads to S3 with thumbnail generation and CDN serving:

```ruby
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'rmagick'
require 'open-uri'

# Configuration class for S3 and CDN settings
class S3Config
  def self.config
    {
      region: ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1',
      access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
      secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'],
      bucket_name: ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME'],
      cdn_domain: ENV['CDN_DOMAIN'] || 'd111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net'
    }
  end
end

# Main image uploader class
class ProductImageUploader
  def initialize
    @s3 = Aws::S3::Client.new(
      region: S3Config.config[:region],
      access_key_id: S3Config.config[:access_key_id],
      secret_access_key: S3Config.config[:secret_access_key]
    )
    @bucket = S3Config.config[:bucket_name]
  end

  # Upload a product image and generate thumbnails
  def upload_products(images, product_id)
    images.each do |image|
      upload_product_image(image, product_id)
    end
  end

  def upload_product_image(image, product_id, original_filename = nil)
    # Generate unique filename
    filename = original_filename || generate_filename(image)
    original_key = "products/#{product_id}/original/#{filename}"

    # Upload original image
    upload_to_s3(image, original_key)

    # Generate and upload thumbnails
    generate_thumbnails(original_key, product_id, filename)

    # Return URLs
    {
      original: generate_cdn_url(original_key),
      thumbnails: {
        small: generate_cdn_url("products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/small/#{filename}"),
        medium: generate_cdn_url("products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/medium/#{filename}"),
        large: generate_cdn_url("products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/large/#{filename}")
      }
    }
  end

  private

  def generate_filename(image)
    "#{SecureRandom.uuid}#{File.extname(image.original_filename)}"
  end

  def upload_to_s3(image, key)
    @s3.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket,
      key: key,
      body: image.read,
      content_type: image.content_type
    )
  end

  def generate_thumbnails(original_key, product_id, filename)
    # Download original image
    original_image = @s3.get_object(bucket: @bucket, key: original_key).body

    # Create thumbnails
    image = Magick::Image.read(original_image).first

    # Small thumbnail (100x100)
    small = image.resize_to_fill(100, 100)
    small_key = "products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/small/#{filename}"
    upload_to_s3_string(small.to_blob, small_key, image.mime_type)

    # Medium thumbnail (300x300)
    medium = image.resize_to_fill(300, 300)
    medium_key = "products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/medium/#{filename}"
    upload_to_s3_string(medium.to_blob, medium_key, image.mime_type)

    # Large thumbnail (600x600)
    large = image.resize_to_fill(600, 600)
    large_key = "products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/large/#{filename}"
    upload_to_s3_string(large.to_blob, large_key, image.mime_type)
  end

  def upload_to_s3_string(content, key, content_type = 'image/jpeg')
    @s3.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket,
      key: key,
      body: content,
      content_type: content_type
    )
  end

  def generate_cdn_url(key)
    "#{S3Config.config[:cdn_domain]}/#{key}"
  end
end
```

class AbandonedCartReminder
  def initialize

  end

  # Method to track cart abandonment
  def track_abandoned_cart(user_email, cart_items, user_properties = {})
    # In a real app, you'd track when the user started the cart
    # and then check if it's been abandoned
    cart = {
      items: cart_items,
      total_price: calculate_cart_total(cart_items),
      timestamp: Time.current
    }

    # Track the cart abandonment event
    KLAVIYO.track(
      event: 'Abandoned Cart',
      user_id: user_email, # or a user ID if you have one

        user_properties: user_properties
      }
    )

    # Create a flow trigger in Klaviyo for this event
    # This would be set up in your Klaviyo account
  end

  private

  def calculate_cart_total(items)
    items.sum { |item| item[:price] * (item[:quantity] || 1) }
  end
end

class AbandonedCartService
  def initialize
    @reminder = AbandonedCartReminder.new
    @tracked_carts = {} # In a real app, use a database
  end

  # Called when a user adds items to cart
  def add_to_cart(user_email, item)
    @tracked_carts[user_email] ||= { items: [], timestamp: Time.current }
    @tracked_carts[user_email][:items] << item
    @tracked_carts[user_email][:timestamp] = Time.current
  end

  # Called when user checks out (prevents reminder)
  def checkout(user_email)
    @tracked_carts.delete(user_email)
  end

  # Called periodically to check for abandoned carts
  def check_for_abandoned_carts
    @tracked_carts.each do |user_email, cart_data|
      if time_since_last_activity(user_email) > 30.minutes
        @reminder.track_abandoned_cart(
          user_email,
          cart_data[:items],
          { last_activity: cart_data[:timestamp].iso8601 }
        )
        @tracked_carts.delete(user_email)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def time_since_last_activity(user_email)
    current_time = Time.current
    (current_time - @tracked_carts[user_email][:timestamp])
  end
end

### 2. Image Uploader Service (services/image_uploader.rb)

```ruby
# services/image_uploader.rb
require 'mini_magick'
require_relative '../config/initializers/s3'

class ImageUploader
  def initialize(image_file)
    @image_file = image_file
    @s3 = Aws::S3::Client.new
    @bucket_name = S3_BUCKET
  end

  def upload_with_thumbnails(prefix: nil, thumbnail_sizes: [200, 400])
    # Generate unique filename
    filename = generate_filename
    original_key = [prefix, filename].compact.join('/')

    # Upload original image
    upload_to_s3(@image_file, original_key)

    # Generate and upload thumbnails
    thumbnail_sizes.each do |size|
      thumbnail_key = [prefix, "thumbnails/#{size}_#{filename}"].compact.join('/')
      generate_and_upload_thumbnail(size, thumbnail_key)
    end

    # Return URLs
    {
      original: generate_cdn_url(original_key),
      thumbnails: thumbnail_sizes.each_with_object({}) do |size, hash|
        thumbnail_key = [prefix, "thumbnails/#{size}_#{filename}"].compact.join('/')
        hash[size] = generate_cdn_url(thumbnail_key)
      end
    }
  end

  private

  def generate_filename
    "#{SecureRandom.uuid}.#{@image_file.original_filename.split('.').last.downcase}"
  end

  def upload_to_s3(file, key)
    @s3.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: key,
      body: file.tempfile,
      content_type: file.content_type,
      acl: 'public-read'
    )
  end

  def generate_and_upload_thumbnail(size, key)
    image = MiniMagick::Image.read(@image_file.tempfile.path)

    # Resize while maintaining aspect ratio
    image.resize "#{size}x#{size}>"

    # Save thumbnail to temp file
    temp_thumbnail = Tempfile.new(['thumbnail', File.extname(@image_file.original_filename)])
    image.write(temp_thumbnail.path)

    # Upload thumbnail
    @s3.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: key,
      body: temp_thumbnail,
      content_type: @image_file.content_type,
      acl: 'public-read'
    )

    temp_thumbnail.close
    temp_thumbnail.unlink
  end

  def generate_cdn_url(key)
    "#{S3_CDN_DOMAIN}/#{key}"
  end

# lib/abandoned_cart_reminder.rb
require 'klaviyo'
require 'dotenv'
require 'active_support/core_ext/numeric/time'
require 'active_support/core_ext/object'

class AbandonedCartReminder
  def initialize
    Dotenv.load
    @client = Klaviyo::Client.new(
      public_key: ENV['KLAVIYO_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      private_key: ENV['KLAVIYO_PRIVATE_KEY']
    )
  end

  # Main method to process abandoned carts
  def send_reminders
    abandoned_carts = find_abandoned_carts
    abandoned_carts.each do |cart|
      send_reminder(cart)
    end
  end

  private

  # Find carts that were abandoned (not completed within a time threshold)
  def find_abandoned_carts
    # In a real application, this would query your database
    # Here's a mocked example - replace with your actual cart retrieval logic

    # Example: Find carts created within the last 24 hours that weren't completed
    Time.now - 24.hours..Time.now
  end

  # Send a reminder email for a specific abandoned cart
  def send_reminder(cart)
    # Extract necessary information from the cart
    customer_email = cart[:email]
    cart_items = cart[:items]
    cart_total = calculate_cart_total(cart_items)
    cart_url = generate_cart_url(cart[:id])

    # Prepare the data to send to Klaviyo
    payload = {
      profile: {
        email: customer_email
      },
      event: 'Abandoned Cart',
      properties: {
        cart_id: cart[:id],
        cart_url: cart_url,
        cart_value: cart_total,
        item_count: cart_items.size,
        items: format_items_for_klaviyo(cart_items),
        abandoned_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
      }
    }

    # Send the event to Klaviyo
    begin
      @client.track(payload).success?
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to send abandoned cart reminder to #{customer_email}: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end

  # Helper methods
  def calculate_cart_total(items)
    items.sum { |item| item[:price] * item[:quantity] }
  end

  def generate_cart_url(cart_id)
    # Replace with your actual cart URL generation logic
    "#{ENV['APP_URL']}/cart/#{cart_id}"
  end

  def format_items_for_klaviyo(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        name: item[:name],
        product_id: item[:product_id],
        url: item[:url],
        image_url: item[:image_url],
        price: item[:price],
        quantity: item[:quantity],
        variant: item[:variant] || {}
      }
    end
  end
end

# Ruby Implementation for Product Recommendation using Collaborative Filtering

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'gemoji' # For emoji support in output
gem 'nmatrix' # For matrix operations in collaborative filtering
gem 'csv' # For reading/writing data files

# If you need a database, you might also want:
# gem 'sqlite3' # Or your preferred database adapter
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# product_recommender.rb
require 'csv'
require 'nmatrix'
require 'gemoji'

class ProductRecommender
  attr_reader :user_product_matrix, :product_similarity_matrix

  def initialize
    @user_product_matrix = nil
    @product_similarity_matrix = nil
  end

  # Load order data from CSV
  # Format: user_id, product_id, quantity, [timestamp]
  def load_data(file_path)
    data = []
    CSV.foreach(file_path, headers: false) do |row|
      data << row
    end

    # Create a matrix where rows are users and columns are products
    # Values are quantities purchased
    users = data.map { |row| row[0] }.uniq
    products = data.map { |row| row[1] }.uniq

    @user_product_matrix = NMatrix.zeros([users.size, products.size])

    data.each do |user_id, product_id, quantity, *rest|
      user_index = users.index(user_id)
      product_index = products.index(product_id)
      @user_product_matrix[user_index, product_index] = quantity.to_f
    end

    calculate_similarity
  end

  # Calculate product similarity using cosine similarity
  def calculate_similarity
    # Transpose the matrix to get product-user matrix
    product_user_matrix = @user_product_matrix.transpose

    # Calculate cosine similarity between all product vectors
    @product_similarity_matrix = NMatrix.zeros([product_user_matrix.row_count, product_user_matrix.row_count])

    product_user_matrix.each_row_with_index do |product_row, product_index|
      product_user_matrix.each_row_with_index do |other_row, other_index|
        dot_product = product_row.dot(other_row)
        product_norm = product_row.norm
        other_norm = other_row.norm

        next if product_norm == 0 || other_norm == 0

        similarity = dot_product / (product_norm * other_norm)
        @product_similarity_matrix[product_index, other_index] = similarity
      end
    end
  end

  # Recommend products for a user
  def recommend_for_user(user_id, n_recommendations = 5, products_to_recommend = nil)
    users = @user_product_matrix.row_indices
    user_index = users.index(user_id)

    return [] unless user_index

    user_row = @user_product_matrix[user_index, :]
    products = @user_product_matrix.column_indices

    # Get products the user has already purchased
    purchased_products = (0...user_row.size).select { |i| user_row[i] > 0 }

    # Get products to recommend (either provided or all products)
    recommendation_candidates = products_to_recommend || products

    # Calculate recommendation scores for each candidate product
    scores = {}
    recommendation_candidates.each do |product_index|
      next if purchased_products.include?(product_index)

      # For each product the user has purchased, get similarity to candidate
      score = 0.0
      count = 0

      purchased_products.each do |purchased_index|
        similarity = @product_similarity_matrix[purchased_index, product_index]
        if similarity > 0
          score += similarity * user_row[purchased_index]
          count += 1
        end
      end

      scores[product_index] = score / count unless count == 0
    end

    # Sort by score and return top n recommendations
    sorted_scores = scores.sort_by { |_, score| -score }
    top_recommendations = sorted_scores.first(n_recommendations)

    top_recommendations.map { |product_index, _| product_index }
  end

  # Get product names (if you have a product name mapping)
  def get_product_name(product_id, product_name_mapping)
    product_name_mapping[product_id] || "Product #{product_id}"
  end

  # Print formatted recommendations
  def print_recommendations(user_id, recommendations, product_name_mapping, n_recommendations = 5)
    top_recommendations = recommendations.first(n_recommendations)

    puts "💎 Top recommendations for user #{user_id}:"
    top_recommendations.each_with_index do |product_id, index|
      name = get_product_name(product_id, product_name_mapping)
      puts "#{index + 1}. #{name}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/uber_direct_delivery.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'oj'
require 'logger'

class UberDirectDelivery
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.uber.com'

  # Initialize with API credentials
  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, sandbox_mode: false)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @sandbox_mode = sandbox_mode

    configure_logger
    authenticate
  end

  # Book a delivery
  def book_delivery(booking_params)
    validate_params(booking_params)

    response = self.class.post(
      "/v2/requests/deliveries",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: booking_params.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def configure_logger
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
      "#{datetime.iso8601} #{severity}: #{msg}\n"
    end
  end

  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v2/token",
      query: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        scope: 'deliveries_delivery'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = Oj.load(response.body)['access_token']
      @logger.info("Successfully authenticated with Uber Direct")
    else
      @logger.error("Authentication failed: #{response.body}")
      raise "Uber Direct authentication failed"
    end
  end

  def validate_params(params)
    required_fields = %w[product_id pickup pickup_latitude pickup_longitude
                        dropoff dropoff_latitude dropoff_longitude]

    if required_fields.any? { |field| params[field].blank? }
      @logger.error("Missing required fields in booking parameters")
      raise "Missing required fields in booking parameters"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Delivery booked successfully: #{response.body}")
      Oj.load(response.body)
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to book delivery: #{response.body}")
      raise "Failed to book delivery: #{response.error}"
    end
  end
end
```

Here's a complete Ruby solution for tracking Nova Poshta parcels using the Nova Poshta API. The implementation includes a Gemfile with required dependencies and a script to track parcels by their express invoice numbers.

## Implementation

First, create a `.env` file in your project root to store your Nova Poshta API key:

```

```

Now, here's the Ruby implementation:

```ruby
# nova_poshta_tracker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class NovaPoshtaTracker
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    raise "NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY environment variable not set" unless @api_key
  end

  def track_parcel(parcel_number)
    response = self.class.get(
      '/JSON',
      query: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'TrackingDocument',
        calledMethod: 'getStatusDocuments',
        methodProperties: {
          Documents: [{ Ref: parcel_number }],
          Language: 'UA'
        }
      }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    body = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if body['success']
      documents = body['data'].first['Documents'].first
      {
        status: documents['Status'],
        status_description: documents['StatusName'],
        status_date: documents['StatusDate'],
        warehouse: documents['WarehouseName'],
        reciever: documents['RecipientName'],
        contact_phone: documents['RecipientPhone']
      }
    else
      raise "API Error: #{body['warnings'].first['message']}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    raise "Failed to parse API response"
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class UberDirectClient
  include HTTParty

  # Uber Direct API base URL
  base_uri 'https://api.uber.com/v2'

  # Initialize with API client ID and access token
  def initialize(client_id: nil, access_token: nil)
    @client_id = client_id || Config.uber_direct.client_id
    @access_token = access_token || Config.uber_direct.access_token
  end

  # Create a new delivery request
  def create_delivery(params)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Access-Token' => @access_token,
      'X-Client-ID' => @client_id
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      '/requests/all',
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get delivery status
  def get_delivery_status(request_id)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'X-Access-Token' => @access_token,
      'X-Client-ID' => @client_id
    }

    response = self.class.get(
      "/requests/#{request_id}",
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Cancel a delivery
  def cancel_delivery(request_id)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'X-Access-Token' => @access_token,
      'X-Client-ID' => @client_id
    }

    response = self.class.delete(
      "/requests/#{request_id}",
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    $logger.info "API Response: #{response.body}"

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error = JSON.parse(response.body)
      $logger.error "API Error: #{error['message'] || error['errors'].to_s}"
      raise StandardError, "Uber Direct API Error: #{error['message'] || 'Unknown error'}"
    end
  end
end

## Implementation

### 1. Model classes (assuming we're using ActiveRecord for database)

```ruby
# models/order.rb
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :order_items
  belongs_to :customer

  def self.recommended_products(customer, top_n = 5)
    collaborative_filtering(customer, top_n)
  end

  private

  def self.collaborative_filtering(customer, top_n)
    # Step 1: Find similar customers based on purchase history
    similar_customers = find_similar_customers(customer)

    # Step 2: Find products purchased by similar customers but not by our customer
    # and rank them by frequency
    similar_customers_products = similar_customers
      .map { |c| c.order_items.pluck(:product_id) }
      .flatten
      .tally
      .reject { |product_id, _| customer.order_items.pluck(:product_id).include?(product_id) }

    # Step 3: Sort by frequency and return top N recommendations
    similar_customers_products
      .sort_by { |_, count| -count }
      .take(top_n)
      .map { |product_id, _| Product.find(product_id) }
  end

  def self.find_similar_customers(customer, threshold = 0.5)
    all_customers = Customer.all
    customer_orders = customer.order_items.pluck(:product_id)

    all_customers
      .reject { |c| c == customer } # Exclude the customer themselves
      .map do |other_customer|
        other_customer_orders = other_customer.order_items.pluck(:product_id)
        similarity = calculate_similarity(customer_orders, other_customer_orders)
        [other_customer, similarity] if similarity >= threshold
      end
      .compact
      .sort_by { |_, similarity| -similarity }
      .map { |customer, _| customer }
  end

  def self.calculate_similarity(products_a, products_b)
    intersection = products_a & products_b
    union = products_a | products_b
    union.size.zero? ? 0.0 : intersection.size.to_f / union.size
  end
end
```

### 2. Alternative implementation without ActiveRecord (pure Ruby)

```ruby
# collaborative_filtering.rb
class CollaborativeFiltering
  def initialize(orders_data)
    @orders_data = orders_data # Expected format: { customer_id => [product_id1, product_id2, ...] }
  end

  def recommend_similar_products(customer_id, top_n = 5)
    similar_customers = find_similar_customers(customer_id)
    products_purchased = @orders_data[customer_id] || []

    # Find products not purchased by customer but by similar customers
    recommendations = similar_customers
      .flat_map { |c| @orders_data[c] }
      .reject { |p| products_purchased.include?(p) }
      .tally
      .sort_by { |_, count| -count }

    recommendations.take(top_n).map(&:first)
  end

  private

  def find_similar_customers(customer_id, similarity_threshold = 0.5)
    all_customers = @orders_data.keys
    customer_products = @orders_data[customer_id] || []

    all_customers
      .reject { |c| c == customer_id }
      .map do |other_customer|
        other_products = @orders_data[other_customer] || []
        similarity = calculate_jaccard_similarity(customer_products, other_products)
        [other_customer, similarity] if similarity >= similarity_threshold
      end
      .compact
      .sort_by { |_, similarity| -similarity }
      .map { |customer, _| customer }
  end

  def calculate_jaccard_similarity(array1, array2)
    intersection = array1 & array2
    union = array1 | array2
    union.empty? ? 0.0 : intersection.size.to_f / union.size
  end
end

    )

First, let's create the main implementation file:

```ruby
# ukrposhta_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaAPI
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua/v1'.freeze

  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Create a new shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments",
      body: shipment_data.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get shipment details
  def get_shipment(shipment_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Print a label for a shipment
  def print_label(shipment_id, label_options = {})
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label",
      body: label_options.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Download a label
  def download_label(shipment_id, format: 'pdf')
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label/#{format}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response, :raw)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response, return_type = :parsed)
    if response.success?
      return_type == :raw ? response.body : JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
    else
      error_message = JSON.parse(response.body)['message'] || 'Unknown error'
      raise UkrposhtaAPIError, "Request failed: #{error_message}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    raise UkrposhtaAPIError, "Failed to parse response: #{response.body}"
  end
end

class UkrposhtaAPIError < StandardError; end

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for calculating Nova Poshta courier delivery costs based on weight and declared value.

## Implementation

```ruby
# nova_poshta_calculator.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

class NovaPoshtaCalculator
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0'

  def initialize
    Dotenv.load if ENV['RACK_ENV'] == 'development'
    @api_key = ENV['NOVA_POSTA_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key_here'
  end

  def calculate_delivery_cost(weight_kg, declared_value_ua_hryvnia, from_warehouse = 1, to_warehouse = 2, service_type = 'DoorToDoor')
    raise ArgumentError, "Weight must be positive" unless weight_kg.positive?
    raise ArgumentError, "Declared value must be positive" unless declared_value_ua_hryvnia.positive?

    params = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'InternetDocument',
      calledMethod: 'getDocumentPrice',
      methodProperties: {
        PayerType: 'Sender',
        PaymentMethod: 'Cash',
        DateTime: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        ServiceType: service_type,
        CargoType: 'Parcel',
        Weight: weight_kg,
        VolumeGeneral: 0.03, # Assuming a standard small parcel volume
        Cost: declared_value_ua_hryvnia,
        SeatsAmount: 1,
        Description: 'Parcel delivery',
        CargoDescription: 'General cargo',
        From: { WarehouseId: from_warehouse.to_s },
        To: { WarehouseId: to_warehouse.to_s }
      }
    }

    response = self.class.post('/JSON', body: { modelName: 'Address' }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    response = self.class.post('/JSON', body: params.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Nova Poshta API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  calculator = NovaPoshtaCalculator.new

  begin
    weight = 3.5 # kilograms
    declared_value = 10000 # UAH

    result = calculator.calculate_delivery_cost(weight, declared_value)
    puts "Delivery cost for #{weight}kg parcel (declared #{declared_value} UAH):"
    puts "Cost: #{result['data'][0]['CostOnSite']} UAH"
    puts "Estimated delivery time: #{result['data'][0]['DeliveryDate']}"
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  rescue => e
    puts "Error calculating delivery cost: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

   ```

### 2. Order Importer from Prom.ua API

```ruby
# prom_ua_importer.rb

require 'httparty'

class PromUaImporter
  include HTTParty

  def initialize(api_key, store_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @store_id = store_id
    @base_url = 'https://api.prom.ua'
  end

  # Fetch new orders from Prom.ua
  def fetch_orders(last_order_id = nil)
    query = {
      'store_id' => @store_id,
      'api_key' => @api_key
    }

    if last_order_id
      query['from_order_id'] = last_order_id
    end

    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/orders", query: query)

    if response.success?
      handle_response(response)
    else
      raise "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    json = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if json['success']
      json['orders']
    else
      raise "API error: #{json['error']}"
    end
  end
end
```

  include HTTParty

  API_KEY  = ENV['MEEST_API_KEY'] # Не забудьте додати API ключ до змінних середовища

    @options = {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{API_KEY}"
      }
    }
  end

  def calculate_delivery_cost(params)
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{BASE_URL}/rates",
        body: params.to_json,
        options: @options
      )

      if response.success?
        # Обробка успішної відповіді

        raise "Meest API Error: #{error_response['message']}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise "Failed to calculate delivery cost: #{e.message}"

class NovaPoshtaFinder
  NOVA_POSHTA_URL = 'https://novaposhta.ua/ru/shipment/points'.freeze

  def initialize(address)
    @address = address
  end

  def find_nearby_branch
    # Геокодування адреси
    location = Geocoder.search(@address).first

    if location.nil?
      puts "Не вдалося знайти координати для адреси: #{@address}"
      return
    end

    # Параметри для request до сайту Нової Пошти
    params = {
      Latitude: location.latitude,
      Longitude: location.longitude,
      Radius: 30, # радіус пошуку в км
      Limit: 20,  # максимальна кількість відділень
      SortByDistance: true
    }

    # Запит до сайту Нової Пошти (може потребувати обробки, якщо API змінено)
    uri = URI.parse(NOVA_POSHTA_URL)
    uri.query = URI.encode_www_form(params)

    response = Net::HTTP.get(uri)

    # Парсинг HTML відповіді
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response)

    branches = []
    doc.css('.branch-item').each do |branch|
      name = branch.css('.branch-name').text.strip
      address = branch.css('.branch-address').text.strip
      work_hours = branch.css('.branch-work-hours').text.strip
      distance = branch.css('.branch-distance').text.strip

      branches << {
        name: name,
        address: address,
        work_hours: work_hours,
        distance: distance
      }
    end

    branches
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Помилка під час пошуку відділень: #{e.message}"
    []
  end
end

  finder = NovaPoshtaFinder.new(address)

```ruby
# olx_partner_api.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_support/core_ext/object/deep_duplicate'

module OLXPartnerAPI
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    base_uri 'https://api.olx.partner'

    # Initialize with API credentials from environment variables
    def initialize
      @api_key = ENV['OLX_API_KEY']
      @api_secret = ENV['OLX_API_SECRET']
      @account_id = ENV['OLX_ACCOUNT_ID']
      @country_code = ENV['OLX_COUNTRY_CODE'] || 'UA'
      @language_code = ENV['OLX_LANGUAGE_CODE'] || 'uk'
    end

    # Helper method to make authenticated requests
    def make_request(method, path, body = nil, headers = {})
      headers.merge!(
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'X-API-Key' => @api_key
      )

      options = {
        body: body.to_json,
        headers: headers
      }

      response = self.class.send(method, path, options)

      if response.success?
        response.parsed_response
      else
        raise "OLX API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    end

    # Get list of categories
    def get_categories
      make_request(:get, "/categories/v2?country_code=#{@country_code}&language_code=#{@language_code}")
    end

    # Get list of regions
    def get_regions
      make_request(:get, "/regions/v2?country_code=#{@country_code}&language_code=#{@language_code}")
    end

    # Create a new advert
    def create_advert(advert_params)
      path = "/adverts/#{@country_code}"
      response = make_request(:post, path, advert_params)
      {
        advert_id: response['advert_id'],
        status: response['status']
      }
    end

    # Get advert details
    def get_advert(advert_id)
      make_request(:get, "/adverts/#{@country_code}/#{advert_id}")
    end

    # Update an existing advert
    def update_advert(advert_id, advert_params)
      path = "/adverts/#{@country_code}/#{advert_id}"
      response = make_request(:put, path, advert_params)
      {
        advert_id: advert_id,
        status: response['status']
      }
    end

    # Delete an advert
    def delete_advert(advert_id)
      path = "/adverts/#{@country_code}/#{advert_id}"
      response = make_request(:delete, path)
      {
        advert_id: advert_id,
        status: response['status']
      }
    end

    # Get list of adverts
    def get_adverts(limit = 100, offset = 0, status = 'active')
      query = {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset,
        status: status
      }
      make_request(:get, "/adverts/#{@country_code}?#{query.to_query}")
    end
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Syncing Products and Stock with Epicentr Marketplace

Here's a complete implementation for syncing products and stock with the Epicentr marketplace through its seller API.

## Gemfile

## Implementation

```ruby
# epicentr_sync.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'rescuable'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class EpicentrAPI
  include HTTParty
  include Rescuable

  BASE_URI = 'https://seller-api.epicentr.kz/v1'.freeze

  # Initialize with API credentials
  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['EPICENTR_API_TOKEN']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO

    self.class.base_uri BASE_URI
    self.class.default_headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
                              'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}"
  end

  # Get all products from Epicentr
  def get_products
    response = self.class.get('/products')
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Update product information
  def update_product(product_data)
    response = self.class.put("/products/#{product_data[:id]}", body: product_data.to_json)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Create a new product
  def create_product(product_data)
    response = self.class.post('/products', body: product_data.to_json)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get stock information for a product
  def get_stock(product_id)
    response = self.class.get("/products/#{product_id}/stock")
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Update stock information
  def update_stock(product_id, stock_data)
    response = self.class.put("/products/#{product_id}/stock", body: stock_data.to_json)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Sync all products from local system to Epicentr
  def sync_all_products(local_products)
    local_products.each do |product|
      existing_product = find_product_by_sku(product[:sku])
      if existing_product
        update_product(product.merge(id: existing_product['id']))
      else
        create_product(product)
      end
    end
  end

  # Sync stock information for all products
  def sync_all_stock(local_stock_data)
    local_stock_data.each do |stock_item|
      product = find_product_by_sku(stock_item[:sku])
      next unless product

      update_stock(product['id'], { quantity: stock_item[:quantity] })
    end
  end

  private

  # Find a product by SKU
  def find_product_by_sku(sku)
    all_products.find { |p| p['sku'] == sku }
  end

  # Get all products (caching for performance)
  def all_products
    @all_products ||= get_products
  end

  # Handle API responses
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      @logger.error "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      @logger.error "Response: #{response.body}"
      raise "Epicentr API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

require 'oj'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Configure logger
LOGGER = Logger.new($stdout)
LOGGER.level = Logger::INFO

class RozetkaOrders
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.rozetka.com.ua/v2'

  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['ROZETKA_API_TOKEN']
    @partner_id = ENV['ROZETKA_PARTNER_ID']
    @max_orders = ENV['MAX_ORDERS'] || 100
    raise "Missing Rozetka API credentials" unless @auth_token && @partner_id
  end

  def fetch_new_orders
    LOGGER.info "Fetching new orders from Rozetka API..."

    options = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        partner_id: @partner_id,
        limit: @max_orders,
        status: 'NEW'  # Filter for new orders only
      },
      timeout: 30
    }

    response = self.class.get('/orders', options)

    if response.success?
      orders = Oj.load(response.body)
      LOGGER.info "Fetched #{orders.size} new orders"
      orders
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to fetch orders: #{response.body}"
      []
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    LOGGER.error "Error fetching orders: #{e.message}"
    []
  end

  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status, tracking_number = nil)
    LOGGER.info "Updating order #{order_id} status to #{new_status}"

    payload = {
      order_id: order_id,
      status: new_status
    }

    payload[:tracking_number] = tracking_number if tracking_number

    options = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: Oj.dump(payload),
      timeout: 30
    }

    response = self.class.post('/orders/status', options)

    if response.success?
      LOGGER.info "Successfully updated order #{order_id} status"
      true
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to update order #{order_id} status: #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    LOGGER.error "Error updating order status: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  def process_orders
    orders = fetch_new_orders

    orders.each do |order|
      # Here you would implement your business logic for processing orders
      # For example:
      # 1. Check if order needs fulfillment
      # 2. Update inventory
      # 3. Prepare shipping
      # 4. Update status in Rozetka

      # Example: Update all orders to "PROCESSING" status
      update_order_status(order['id'], 'PROCESSING')

      # If you have tracking numbers, you can update with that:
      # update_order_status(order['id'], 'SHIPPED', 'TRACK123456')
    end
  end

require 'httparty'

  include HTTParty

    @consumer_secret = ENV['OLX_CONSUMER_SECRET']
    @access_token = ENV['OLX_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @token_secret = ENV['OLX_TOKEN_SECRET']
    @partner_id = ENV['OLX_PARTNER_ID']
  end

  def create_ad(ad_data)
    # Prepare the request data
    request_data = {
      ad: {
        title: ad_data[:title],
        description: ad_data[:description],
        category: ad_data[:category],
        price: ad_data[:price],
        currency: ad_data[:currency] || 'UAH',
        location: ad_data[:location],
        images: ad_data[:images] || [],
        attributes: ad_data[:attributes] || {}
      },
      partner_id: @partner_id
    }

    # Generate JWT token
    payload = {
      iss: @consumer_key,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600, # 1 hour expiration
      partner_id: @partner_id
    }

    token = JWT.encode(payload, @consumer_secret, 'HS256')

    # Make the request
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      '/ads',
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def update_ad(ad_id, update_data)
    # Prepare the request data
    request_data = {
      partner_id: @partner_id
    }

    # Add only the fields that need to be updated
    request_data[:ad] = {}
    request_data[:ad][:title] = update_data[:title] if update_data[:title]
    request_data[:ad][:description] = update_data[:description] if update_data[:description]
    request_data[:ad][:price] = update_data[:price] if update_data[:price]
    request_data[:ad][:location] = update_data[:location] if update_data[:location]

    # Generate JWT token
    payload = {
      iss: @consumer_key,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600, # 1 hour expiration
      partner_id: @partner_id
    }

    token = JWT.encode(payload, @consumer_secret, 'HS256')

    # Make the request
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.put(
      "/ads/#{ad_id}",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_ad(ad_id)
    # Generate JWT token
    payload = {
      iss: @consumer_key,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600, # 1 hour expiration
      partner_id: @partner_id
    }

    token = JWT.encode(payload, @consumer_secret, 'HS256')

    # Make the request
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.get(
      "/ads/#{ad_id}",
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      parsed_response = Oj.load(response.body, symbolize_keys: true)
      {
        success: true,
        data: parsed_response[:data] || parsed_response,
        message: 'Request successful'
      }
    else
      error_details = Oj.load(response.body, symbolize_keys: true) rescue {}
      {
        success: false,
        error: error_details[:error] || error_details[:errors] || 'Unknown error',
        message: response.message
      }
    end
  end
end

def generate_hotline_feed_nokogiri(products)
  builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
    xml.shop {
      xml.currency('UAH')

      products.each do |product|
        xml.offer {
          xml.id(product[:id])
          xml.available(product[:availability] == "in_stock" || product[:availability] == "available")

          xml.url(product[:url])

          xml.price(product[:price])

          xml.currencyId(product[:currency])

          xml.picture(product[:image_url])

          xml.store(true)

          xml.pickup(false)

          xml.delivery(true)

          if product[:attributes]&.any?
            xml.param.each do |key, value|
              xml.param {
                xml.name(key)
                xml.value(value)
              }
            end
          end

          xml.catalog_group {
            xml.name(product[:category])
          }

          xml.name(product[:name])
          xml.vendor(product[:brand])
          xml.description(product[:description])
        }
      end
    }
  end

  builder.to_xml
end

      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

    response = self.class.post(

      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise 'Unauthorized: Invalid API key'
    when 404
      raise 'Not found: Shipment not found'
    when 422
      raise "Validation error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "API request failed with status #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
