    @fuzzy_matcher = FuzzyMatch.new(@companies)
  end
  
  # Find matches using Levenshtein distance
  def find_levenshtein_matches(query, threshold: 0.8, max_results: 5)
    query = query.downcase
    results = []
    
    companies.each do |company|
      @levenshtein_matcher.pattern = query
      distance = @levenshtein_matcher.match(company)
      max_length = [query.length, company.length].max
      similarity = 1.0 - (distance.to_f / max_length)
      
      if similarity >= threshold
        results << {

          similarity: similarity.round(4),
          distance: distance,
          method: :levenshtein
        }

    end
    
    results.sort_by { |r| -r[:similarity] }.first(max_results)
  end

        results << {

          similarity: score.round(4),
          method: :fuzzy_match
        }
      end
    end
    
    results.sort_by { |r| -r[:similarity] }.first(max_results)
  end

require 'whatlanguage'
require 'cld'
require 'fasttext'
require 'linguist'
require 'stopwords-filter'

class LanguageDetector
  def initialize
    @wl = WhatLanguage.new(:all)
    @filter = Stopwords::Filter.new
    setup_fasttext
  end

  def detect(comment)
    return :unknown if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?

    # Clean the comment
    clean_comment = preprocess_text(comment)
    
    # Get results from multiple detectors
    results = {
      whatlanguage: detect_with_whatlanguage(clean_comment),
      cld: detect_with_cld(clean_comment),
      fasttext: detect_with_fasttext(clean_comment),
      linguist: detect_with_linguist(clean_comment)
    }

    # Return the most confident result
    determine_final_language(results, clean_comment)
  end

  def detect_batch(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| detect(comment) }
  end

  def detect_with_confidence(comment)
    return { language: :unknown, confidence: 0.0 } if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?

    clean_comment = preprocess_text(comment)
    
    results = {
      whatlanguage: detect_with_whatlanguage(clean_comment),
      cld: detect_with_cld(clean_comment),
      fasttext: detect_with_fasttext(clean_comment),
      linguist: detect_with_linguist(clean_comment)
    }

    final_language, confidence = determine_language_with_confidence(results, clean_comment)
    { language: final_language, confidence: confidence }
  end

  private

  def setup_fasttext
    # FastText model would need to be downloaded separately
    # You can download a model from: https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html
    @fasttext_model_path = 'lid.176.bin' # Path to your FastText model
    
    begin
      @ft = FastText::Model.new(@fasttext_model_path)
    rescue => e
      puts "FastText model not found: #{e.message}"
      @ft = nil
    end
  end

  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Remove excessive whitespace, special characters, and normalize
    text.gsub(/[^\p{L}\s]/, ' ')  # Remove non-letters except spaces
        .gsub(/\s+/, ' ')         # Collapse multiple spaces
        .strip                    # Remove leading/trailing spaces
        .downcase                # Convert to lowercase
  end

  def detect_with_whatlanguage(text)
    return :unknown if text.length < 3
    
    result = @wl.language(text)
    result == :unknown ? nil : result
  end

  def detect_with_cld(text)
    return :unknown if text.length < 3
    
    result = CLD.detect_language(text)
    result[:reliable] ? result[:code].to_sym : nil
  rescue => e
    puts "CLD error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def detect_with_fasttext(text)
    return :unknown if text.length < 3 || @ft.nil?
    
    result = @ft.predict(text)
    return :unknown if result.empty?
    
    # Extract language code (e.g., "__label__en" -> :en)
    result.first.first.gsub('__label__', '').to_sym
  rescue => e
    puts "FastText error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def detect_with_linguist(text)
    return :unknown if text.length < 3
    
    result = Linguist.detect(text)
    result ? result[0].to_sym : nil
  rescue => e
    puts "Linguist error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def determine_final_language(results, text)
    # Count votes from different detectors
    votes = Hash.new(0)
    results.each_value do |language|
      votes[language] += 1 if language && language != :unknown
    end

    return :unknown if votes.empty?

    # Return the language with the most votes
    votes.max_by { |lang, count| count }[0]
  end

  def determine_language_with_confidence(results, text)
    votes = Hash.new(0)
    valid_results = results.values.select { |lang| lang && lang != :unknown }
    
    return [:unknown, 0.0] if valid_results.empty?

    valid_results.each { |lang| votes[lang] += 1 }
    
    best_language, vote_count = votes.max_by { |lang, count| count }
    confidence = vote_count.to_f / results.size
    
    [best_language, confidence.round(2)]
  end
end

```ruby
    @levenshtein = Text::Levenshtein.new

    max_length = [normalized_query.length, @company_names.map { |name| normalize_name(name).length }.max].max
    
    @company_names.select do |name|
      normalized_name = normalize_name(name)
      distance = @levenshtein.distance(normalized_query, normalized_name)
      similarity = 1 - (distance.to_f / max_length)
      similarity >= threshold
    end
  end

  # Find matches using Jaro-Winkler distance
  def find_jaro_winkler_matches(query, threshold: 0.8)
    normalized_query = normalize_name(query)
    @jaro_winkler.pattern = normalized_query
    
    @company_names.select do |name|
      normalized_name = normalize_name(name)
      similarity = @jaro_winkler.match(normalized_name)
      similarity >= threshold
    end
  end

  # Find matches using both methods with weighted scoring
  def find_fuzzy_matches(query, levenshtein_weight: 0.5, jaro_winkler_weight: 0.5, threshold: 0.7)
    normalized_query = normalize_name(query)
    max_length = [normalized_query.length, @company_names.map { |name| normalize_name(name).length }.max].max
    @jaro_winkler.pattern = normalized_query

    results = @company_names.map do |name|
      normalized_name = normalize_name(name)
      
      # Calculate Levenshtein similarity
      lev_distance = @levenshtein.distance(normalized_query, normalized_name)
      lev_similarity = 1 - (lev_distance.to_f / max_length)
      
      # Calculate Jaro-Winkler similarity
      jw_similarity = @jaro_winkler.match(normalized_name)
      
      # Combined score
      combined_score = (lev_similarity * levenshtein_weight) + (jw_similarity * jaro_winkler_weight)
      
      {
        name: name,
        normalized_name: normalized_name,
        levenshtein_similarity: lev_similarity,
        jaro_winkler_similarity: jw_similarity,
        combined_score: combined_score
      }
    end

    results.select { |result| result[:combined_score] >= threshold }
           .sort_by { |result| -result[:combined_score] }
  end

  # Use the fuzzy_match gem for advanced matching
  def find_with_fuzzy_match_gem(query, threshold: 0.7)
    fuzzy_matcher = FuzzyMatch.new(@company_names, read: ->(name) { normalize_name(name) })
    fuzzy_matcher.find_all_with_score(query, threshold: threshold)
  end

  private

  def normalize_name(name)
    name.to_s.downcase
        .gsub(/[^\w\s]/, '')     # Remove punctuation
        .gsub(/\b(inc|llc|corp|corporation|company|co|ltd|limited)\b/, '') # Remove common suffixes
        .strip
```

```ruby
# language_detector.rb
require 'cld3'
require 'whatlanguage'
require 'fasttext'
require 'json'

class LanguageDetector
  def initialize
    # Initialize CLD3 detector
    @cld3_detector = CLD3::NNetLanguageIdentifier.new(1, 2048)
    
    # Initialize WhatLanguage detector
    @wl_detector = WhatLanguage.new(:all)
    
    # Initialize FastText model (you'll need to download the model file)
    # Download from: https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html
    @fasttext_model = FastText::Model.new("path/to/lid.176.bin")
  end

  def detect_single_comment(comment_text)
    return nil if comment_text.nil? || comment_text.strip.empty?
    
    results = {
      text: comment_text,
      cld3: detect_with_cld3(comment_text),
      whatlanguage: detect_with_whatlanguage(comment_text),
      fasttext: detect_with_fasttext(comment_text),
      confidence: calculate_confidence(comment_text)
    }
    
    results[:final_language] = determine_final_language(results)
    results
  end

  def detect_multiple_comments(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| detect_single_comment(comment) }
  end

  private

  def detect_with_cld3(text)
    result = @cld3_detector.find_language(text)
    {
      language: result.language,
      probability: result.probability,
      reliable: result.reliable?
    }
  rescue => e
    { error: "CLD3 error: #{e.message}" }
  end

  def detect_with_whatlanguage(text)
    begin
      language = @wl_detector.language(text)
      {
        language: language.to_s,
        confidence: @wl_detector.language_confidence(text)
      }
    rescue => e
      { error: "WhatLanguage error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  def detect_with_fasttext(text)
    begin
      # FastText expects one prediction per line
      prediction = @fasttext_model.predict(text, k: 1).first
      {
        language: prediction[0].gsub('__label__', ''),
        probability: prediction[1]
      }
    rescue => e
      { error: "FastText error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  def calculate_confidence(text)
    # Simple confidence calculation based on text characteristics
    confidence = 0.0
    
    # Longer text tends to be more reliable
    confidence += [text.length / 100.0, 1.0].min * 0.3
    
    # Check for common language patterns
    confidence += 0.2 if contains_common_words?(text)
    
    # Check for special characters that might indicate specific languages
    confidence += 0.1 if contains_language_specific_chars?(text)
    
    confidence
  end

  def contains_common_words?(text)
    # Simple check for common words in major languages
    common_words = %w[the and of to a in is it you that he was for on are]
    words = text.downcase.split(/\W+/)
    (words & common_words).size > 2
  end

  def contains_language_specific_chars?(text)
    # Check for non-ASCII characters that might indicate specific languages
    text.match?(/[^\x00-\x7F]/)
  end

  def determine_final_language(results)
    # Use a voting system to determine the final language
    votes = {}
    
    # CLD3 vote (weighted by probability)
    if results[:cld3][:language] && results[:cld3][:probability]
      lang = results[:cld3][:language]
      weight = results[:cld3][:probability] * 0.4
      votes[lang] = votes.fetch(lang, 0) + weight
    end
    
    # WhatLanguage vote
    if results[:whatlanguage][:language] && results[:whatlanguage][:confidence]
      lang = results[:whatlanguage][:language]
      weight = results[:whatlanguage][:confidence] * 0.35
      votes[lang] = votes.fetch(lang, 0) + weight
    end
    
    # FastText vote
    if results[:fasttext][:language] && results[:fasttext][:probability]
      lang = results[:fasttext][:language]
      weight = results[:fasttext][:probability] * 0.25
      votes[lang] = votes.fetch(lang, 0) + weight
    end
    
    # Return the language with highest weighted vote
    votes.max_by { |_, score| score }&.first || "unknown"
  end
end
```

```ruby
      Obscenity.replacement = :vowels
    when :garbled
      Obscenity.replacement = :garbled
```

```ruby
class ProfanityFilter
  # Default profanity list (Obscenity gem comes with its own list)
  # You can customize this list based on your needs
  CUSTOM_PROFANITY_LIST = %w[
    damn hell bastard bitch asshole motherfucker shit fuck piss crap
    dick cock pussy whore slut bastard douchebag fag faggot nigger
    retard retarded retards
  ].freeze

  REPLACEMENT_CHAR = '*'

  def initialize
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Filter profanity in a single comment
  def filter(comment, replacement: REPLACEMENT_CHAR)
    return '' if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    # Use Obscenity gem to sanitize the text
    Obscenity.sanitize(comment, replacement: replacement)
  end

  # Check if a comment contains profanity
  def profane?(comment)
    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    Obscenity.profane?(comment)
  end

  # Get a list of profane words found in the comment
  def profane_words(comment)
    return [] if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    Obscenity.offensive(comment)
  end

  # Filter multiple comments at once
  def filter_comments(comments, replacement: REPLACEMENT_CHAR)
    return [] if comments.nil? || comments.empty?
    
    comments.map { |comment| filter(comment, replacement: replacement) }
  end

  # Advanced filtering with custom rules
  def advanced_filter(comment, options = {})
    return '' if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    options = {
      replacement: REPLACEMENT_CHAR,
      ignore_case: true,
      partial_match: false
    }.merge(options)

    # Create a custom configuration
    custom_config = Obscenity::Config.new do |config|
      config.replacement = options[:replacement]
      config.blacklist = CUSTOM_PROFANITY_LIST + Obscenity::Config.blacklist
    end

    Obscenity.configure { |config| config = custom_config }
    
    filtered_text = Obscenity.sanitize(comment)
    
    # Restore default configuration
    configure_obscenity
    
    filtered_text
  end

  # Add custom profanity words to the filter
  def add_custom_words(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    
    Obscenity::Config.blacklist += words.map(&:downcase)
  end

  # Remove words from the profanity filter
  def remove_words(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    
    Obscenity::Config.blacklist -= words.map(&:downcase)
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = CUSTOM_PROFANITY_LIST + Obscenity::Base.blacklist
      config.replacement = REPLACEMENT_CHAR
      config.whitelist = []  # Words that should never be filtered
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    options = {

    if options[:strict_mode]
      comment_text = filter_custom_blacklist(comment_text, options[:replacement])
    end

    filter(comment_text, replacement: options[:replacement])
  end

  private

    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = Obscenity::Base.blacklist + CUSTOM_BLACKLIST
      config.whitelist = Obscenity::Base.whitelist + CUSTOM_WHITELIST

    CUSTOM_BLACKLIST.each do |word|
      text = text.gsub(/\b#{Regexp.escape(word)}\b/i, replacement)
    end
```

```ruby
# app/services/profanity_filter.rb
require 'obscenity'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Список додаткових нецензурних слів (можна розширювати)
  CUSTOM_BLACKLIST = [
    'badword1', 'badword2', 'offensive_term'
  ].freeze

  # Список безпечних слів, які можуть бути фальшивими спрацьовуваннями
  WHITELIST = [
    'assistant', 'classic', 'grass' # слова, що можуть містити частини нецензурних слів
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text, replacement: '[censored]')
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    # Перевірка та фільтрація тексту
    if profane?(text)
      Obscenity.sanitize(text, replacement: replacement)
    else
      text
    end
  end

  # Перевірка на наявність нецензурної лексики
  def profane?(text)
    Obscenity.profane?(text)
  end

  # Отримання списку виявлених нецензурних слів у тексті
  def offensive_words(text)
    Obscenity.offensive(text)
  end

  # Більш агресивна фільтрація (використовує додаткові правила)
  def strict_filter(text, replacement: '[censored]')
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    filtered_text = filter(text, replacement: replacement)
    
    # Додаткова фільтрація за допомогою регулярних виразів
    additional_filtering(filtered_text, replacement)
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = Obscenity::Base.blacklist + CUSTOM_BLACKLIST
      config.whitelist = WHITELIST
      config.replacement = :garbled # or :stars, :vowels, or custom string
    end
  end

  def additional_filtering(text, replacement)
    # Додаткові шаблони для більш агресивної фільтрації
    patterns = [
      /(?:f|ph|phr)[\*\.\-\_]*(?:u|v|y)[\*\.\-\_]*(?:c|k|ck|q)[\*\.\-\_]*(?:k|q|ck)/i,
      /s[\*\.\-\_]*h[\*\.\-\_]*i[\*\.\-\_]*t/i,
      /b[\*\.\-\_]*i[\*\.\-\_]*t[\*\.\-\_]*c[\*\.\-\_]*h/i
    ]

    patterns.each do |pattern|
      text = text.gsub(pattern, replacement)
    end

    text
  end
end
```

```ruby
# support_summarizer.rb
require 'anthropic'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class SupportSummarizer
  def initialize
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(access_token: ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])
  end

  def summarize_support_request(support_text, options = {})
    default_options = {
      model: 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229',
      max_tokens: 1000,
      temperature: 0.1
    }
    options = default_options.merge(options)

    prompt = build_prompt(support_text)

    response = @client.messages(
      parameters: {
        model: options[:model],
        max_tokens: options[:max_tokens],
        temperature: options[:temperature],
        messages: [
          { role: 'user', content: prompt }
        ]
      }
    )

    extract_summary(response)
  end

  def summarize_multiple_requests(support_texts, options = {})
    summaries = []
    
    support_texts.each_with_index do |text, index|
      puts "Обробляємо звернення #{index + 1}/#{support_texts.length}..."
      
      summary = summarize_support_request(text, options)
      summaries << {
        original_text: text[0..200] + (text.length > 200 ? '...' : ''), # Перші 200 символів
        summary: summary,
        length_reduction: calculate_reduction(text, summary)
      }
      
      # Невелика затримка між запитами
      sleep(1) if index < support_texts.length - 1
    end
    
    summaries
  end

  private

  def build_prompt(support_text)
    <<~PROMPT
      Ти - асистент підтримки, який аналізує довгі звернення клієнтів. 
      Будь ласка, підсумуй наведений нижче текст звернення до підтримки.

      **Інструкції:**
      1. Виділи основну проблему або запит клієнта
      2. Вкажи ключові деталі та факти
      3. Визнач емоційний стан клієнта (якщо це видно з тексту)
      4. Запропонуй короткий план дій для вирішення проблеми
      5. Обмеж підсумок до 3-5 ключових пунктів

      **Текст звернення:**
      #{support_text}

      **Підсумок:**
    PROMPT
  end

  def extract_summary(response)
    if response['content'] && response['content'].is_a?(Array)
      response['content'].first['text']
    else
      response.dig('content', 0, 'text') || 'Не вдалося отримати підсумок'
    end
  end

  def calculate_reduction(original_text, summary)
    original_length = original_text.length
    summary_length = summary.length
    reduction = ((original_length - summary_length).to_f / original_length * 100).round(2)
    "#{reduction}% зменшення"
  end
end
```

class SupportFileProcessor
  def self.load_from_txt(file_path)

    texts = []

    case File.extname(output_file)

    when '.csv'

    when '.txt'

    end
  end

require 'anthropic'

class SupportTicketSummarizer
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(access_token: @api_key)
  end

  def summarize_ticket(ticket_content, max_length: 500, include_key_points: true)
    # Truncate if the ticket is extremely long to avoid token limits
    truncated_content = truncate_content(ticket_content, 8000)
    
    prompt = build_prompt(truncated_content, max_length, include_key_points)
    
    response = @client.messages(
      parameters: {
        model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
        max_tokens: 1000,
        messages: [
          {
            role: "user",
            content: prompt
          }
        ]
      }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end

  def summarize_multiple_tickets(tickets, max_length: 300)
    summaries = tickets.map do |ticket|
      {
        id: ticket[:id],
        original_length: ticket[:content].length,
        summary: summarize_ticket(ticket[:content], max_length: max_length)
      }
    end
    
    summaries
  end

  private

  def build_prompt(content, max_length, include_key_points)
    <<~PROMPT
      Please summarize the following support ticket content into a concise summary of approximately #{max_length} characters or less.

      #{"Include 3-5 key bullet points highlighting the main issues or requests." if include_key_points}

      Ticket Content:
      """
      #{content}
      """

      Please provide:
      1. A brief overall summary
      #{include_key_points ? "2. Key bullet points of main issues/requests\n3. Any critical next steps or urgency indicators" : "2. Main takeaways"}

      Keep the summary clear, professional, and focused on the customer's core needs.
    PROMPT
  end

  def truncate_content(content, max_chars)
    return content if content.length <= max_chars
    
    # Try to truncate at a sentence boundary
    truncated = content[0...max_chars]
    last_period = truncated.rindex(/[.!?]/)
    
    if last_period && last_period > max_chars - 100
      truncated[0..last_period] + " [Content truncated...]"
    else
      truncated + " [Content truncated...]"
    end
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    # Extract the content from the response
    if response['content'] && response['content'].is_a?(Array)
      response['content'].first['text']
    else
      response.to_s
    end
  rescue => e
    "Error parsing response: #{e.message}"
  end
end

```ruby
# natural_date_parser.rb
require 'chronic'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/time'

class NaturalDateParser
  # Configure Chronic with additional context
  Chronic.time_class = Time
  
  # Common timezone abbreviations (you can extend this)
  TIMEZONES = {
    'EST' => 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)',
    'PST' => 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)',
    'CST' => 'Central Time (US & Canada)',
    'MST' => 'Mountain Time (US & Canada)',
    'UTC' => 'UTC',
    'GMT' => 'GMT'
  }

  def self.parse(date_string, options = {})
    new.parse(date_string, options)
  end

  def parse(date_string, options = {})
    return nil if date_string.nil? || date_string.strip.empty?
    
    # Normalize the input
    normalized_string = normalize_date_string(date_string)
    
    # Parse with Chronic
    parsed_time = Chronic.parse(normalized_string, chronic_options(options))
    
    # Apply timezone if specified
    if parsed_time && options[:context]
      parsed_time = apply_context(parsed_time, options[:context])
    end
    
    parsed_time
  end

  private

  def normalize_date_string(date_string)
    # Convert to lowercase for consistent parsing
    string = date_string.downcase
    
    # Handle common natural language patterns
    string = string.gsub(/\bnext\s+(\w+)\b/) { "next #{$1}" }
    string = string.gsub(/\blast\s+(\w+)\b/) { "last #{$1}" }
    string = string.gsub(/\bthis\s+(\w+)\b/) { "this #{$1}" }
    
    # Handle timezone abbreviations
    TIMEZONES.each do |abbr, _|
      string = string.gsub(/\b#{abbr.downcase}\b/, abbr)
    end
    
    string
  end

  def chronic_options(options)
    chronic_opts = {}
    
    # Set context time (default to now)
    chronic_opts[:context] = options[:context] || :future
    
    # Allow guessing ambiguous times
    chronic_opts[:guess] = options.fetch(:guess, true)
    
    # Ambiguous time range (for times like 12:00 which could be AM or PM)
    chronic_opts[:ambiguous_time_range] = options.fetch(:ambiguous_time_range, 6)
    
    chronic_opts
  end

  def apply_context(time, context)
    case context
    when :past
      # If the parsed time is in the future but context is past, 
      # assume it's the most recent occurrence
      if time > Time.now
        time - 1.week
      else
        time
      end
    when :future
      # If the parsed time is in the past but context is future,
      # assume it's the next occurrence
      if time < Time.now
        time + 1.week
      else
        time
      end
    when Time, DateTime
      # Use the provided time as context
      Chronic.parse(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
    else
      time
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# main.rb
require 'phonelib'

class UkrainianPhoneNumber
  # Ukrainian mobile operators and their codes
  OPERATORS = {
    'Kyivstar' => ['67', '68', '96', '97', '98'],
    'Vodafone' => ['50', '66', '95', '99'],
    'Lifecell' => ['63', '73', '93'],
    '3mob' => ['91'],
    'Intertelecom' => ['89', '94'],
    'People.net' => ['92'],
    'TriMob' => ['39']
  }.freeze

  def self.normalize(phone_number)
    # Parse the phone number using Phonelib
    parsed = Phonelib.parse(phone_number, 'UA')
    
    # Return nil if the number is not valid for Ukraine
    return nil unless parsed.valid_for_country?('UA')
    
    # Get the number in E164 format (+380...)
    normalized = parsed.e164
    
    # Verify it's a mobile number (starts with +380 and has correct length)
    return nil unless normalized&.start_with?('+380') && normalized.length == 13
    
    normalized
  end

  def self.detect_operator(phone_number)
    normalized = normalize(phone_number)
    return nil unless normalized
    
    # Extract the operator code (digits 4-5 after +380)
    operator_code = normalized[4, 2]
    
    # Find the operator
    OPERATORS.each do |operator, codes|
      return operator if codes.include?(operator_code)
    end
    
    'Unknown'
  end

  def self.normalize_and_detect(phone_number)
    normalized = normalize(phone_number)
    return { normalized: nil, operator: nil } unless normalized
    
    operator = detect_operator(normalized)
    
    { normalized: normalized, operator: operator }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# ukrainian_phone_normalizer.rb
require 'phony'
require 'countries'

class UkrainianPhoneNormalizer
  # Ukrainian mobile operators and their prefixes
  OPERATORS = {
    'Kyivstar' => ['67', '68', '96', '97', '98'],
    'Vodafone' => ['50', '66', '95', '99'],
    'lifecell' => ['63', '73', '93'],
    '3mob' => ['91'],
    'People.net' => ['92'],
    'intertelecom' => ['89', '94']
  }.freeze

  def self.normalize(phone_number)
    # Remove all non-digit characters except '+' at the beginning
    cleaned_number = phone_number.gsub(/(?!^\+)\D/, '')
    
    # Remove any existing country code
    cleaned_number.gsub!(/^\+?380/, '')
    cleaned_number.gsub!(/^0/, '') # Remove leading 0 if present
    
    # Add Ukrainian country code if needed
    if cleaned_number.length == 9
      normalized = "+380#{cleaned_number}"
    elsif cleaned_number.length == 10 && cleaned_number.start_with?('0')
      normalized = "+380#{cleaned_number[1..-1]}"
    else
      normalized = "+#{cleaned_number}"
    end
    
    # Validate and format with Phony
    if Phony.plausible?(normalized)
      Phony.normalize(normalized)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number: #{phone_number}"
    end
  end

  def self.detect_operator(phone_number)
    normalized = normalize(phone_number)
    
    # Extract the prefix (2-3 digits after country code)
    prefix = normalized[/^\+380(\d{2,3})/, 1]
    
    return nil unless prefix
    
    # Find operator by prefix
    OPERATORS.each do |operator, prefixes|
      prefixes.each do |op_prefix|
        if prefix.start_with?(op_prefix)
          return operator
        end
      end
    end
    
    nil
  end

  def self.normalize_and_detect(phone_number)
    begin
      normalized = normalize(phone_number)
      operator = detect_operator(normalized)
      
      {
        original: phone_number,
        normalized: normalized,
        operator: operator,
        valid: true
      }
    rescue ArgumentError => e
      {
        original: phone_number,
        normalized: nil,
        operator: nil,
        valid: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  # Utility method to validate without normalizing
  def self.valid?(phone_number)
    begin
      normalize(phone_number)
      true
    rescue ArgumentError
      false
    end
  end
end

    '0501234567',
    '+380501234567',
    '380501234567',
    '80501234567',
    '050-123-45-67',
```

require 'i18n'
require 'dry-validation'

class UkrainianPhoneNormalizer

  OPERATORS = {

    '067' => 'kyivstar',

    '093' => 'lifecell',
    '091' => 'utel',
    '092' => 'peoplenet',
    '094' => 'intertelecom',
    '089' => 'тримоб'
  }.freeze

  # Схема валідації за допомогою dry-validation
  PhoneSchema = Dry::Validation.Schema do
    configure do
      config.messages_file = File.join(__dir__, 'errors.yml')
      
      def valid_operator?(value)
        UkrainianPhoneNormalizer::OPERATORS.key?(value)
      end
    end

    required(:number).filled(:str?)
    
    validate(valid_operator: :number) do |number|
      operator_code = number.match(/^\+380(\d{2})/).to_a[1]
      valid_operator?(operator_code) if operator_code
    end
  end

  def initialize
    I18n.load_path += Dir[File.expand_path('locales/*.yml', __dir__)]
    I18n.default_locale = :uk
  end

  # Основний метод для нормалізації та визначення оператора
  def normalize(phone_number)
    return nil if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.empty?

    # Очищаємо номер від усіх нецифрових символів, крім плюса
    cleaned_number = phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
    
    # Видаляємо зайві нулі на початку
    cleaned_number.gsub!(/^0+/, '') if cleaned_number.start_with?('0')
    
    # Обробляємо різні формати
    normalized_number = case cleaned_number
                       when /^380\d{9}$/  # Формат 380XXXXXXXXX
                         "+#{cleaned_number}"
                       when /^80\d{9}$/   # Формат 80XXXXXXXXX
                         "+3#{cleaned_number}"
                       when /^0\d{9}$/    # Формат 0XXXXXXXXX
                         "+38#{cleaned_number}"
                       when /^\d{9}$/     # Формат XXXXXXXX (без коду країни)
                         "+380#{cleaned_number}"
                       when /^\+\d+$/     # Вже має +, але перевіряємо довжину
                         cleaned_number.length == 13 ? cleaned_number : nil
                       else
                         nil
                       end

    return { success: false, error: 'Некоректний формат номера' } unless normalized_number

    # Перевіряємо довжину номера
    unless normalized_number.length == 13
      return { success: false, error: 'Некоректна довжина номера' }
    end

    # Визначаємо оператора
    operator_code = normalized_number[4..6] # Код після +380
    operator = OPERATORS[operator_code]

    unless operator
      return { success: false, error: 'Невідомий оператор або некоректний код' }
    end

    # Валідація за допомогою dry-validation
    validation_result = PhoneSchema.call(number: normalized_number)
    
    if validation_result.success?
      {
        success: true,
        original: phone_number,
        normalized: normalized_number,
        operator: operator,
        operator_name: operator_name(operator)
      }
    else

```ruby
    '093' => { name: 'lifecell', brand: 'lifecell' },
    '094' => { name: 'Інтертелеком', brand: 'Intertelecom' },
    '095' => { name: 'Vodafone Україна', brand: 'Vodafone' },
    '096' => { name: 'Київстар', brand: 'Kyivstar' },
    '097' => { name: 'Київстар', brand: 'Kyivstar' },
    '098' => { name: 'Київстар', brand: 'Kyivstar' },
    '099' => { name: 'Vodafone Україна', brand: 'Vodafone' }
  }.freeze

  def self.normalize(phone_number)
    return nil if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.empty?

    # Очищаємо номер від зайвих символів
    cleaned_number = phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
    
    # Видаляємо міжнародний префікс 8 (для російського формату)
    cleaned_number = cleaned_number.gsub(/^8/, '')

    # Якщо номер починається з 380 і має правильну довжину
    if cleaned_number =~ /^380\d{9}$/
      return "+#{cleaned_number}"
    end

    # Якщо номер починається з 0 і має правильну довжину (10 цифр)
    if cleaned_number =~ /^0\d{9}$/
      return "+38#{cleaned_number}"
    end

    # Якщо номер має 9 цифр (без префіксу)
    if cleaned_number =~ /^\d{9}$/
      return "+380#{cleaned_number}"
    end

    # Спроба використати phonelib для парсингу
    parsed = Phonelib.parse(phone_number, 'UA')
    if parsed.valid?
      return parsed.international
    end

    nil # Якщо номер не вдалося нормалізувати
  end

  def self.operator_info(phone_number)
    normalized = normalize(phone_number)
    return nil unless normalized

    # Витягуємо код оператора (цифри після +380)
    operator_code = normalized[4..6] # Позиції для коду оператора

    OPERATORS[operator_code]
  end

  def self.valid?(phone_number)
    normalized = normalize(phone_number)
    return false unless normalized

    # Перевіряємо, чи відповідає номер формату +380XXXXXXXXX
    normalized =~ /^\+380\d{9}$/
  end

  # Утилітні методи
  def self.normalize_with_info(phone_number)
    normalized = normalize(phone_number)
    return nil unless normalized

    operator = operator_info(phone_number)
    
    {
      original: phone_number,
      normalized: normalized,
      operator: operator,
      valid: valid?(phone_number)
    }
  end

  def self.batch_normalize(phone_numbers)
    phone_numbers.map { |phone| normalize_with_info(phone) }.compact
  end
end
```

```ruby
        word

  end

    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?

    words.any? { |word| profanity_word?(word) }
  end
  
  # Get list of profanity words found in comment

    return [] if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    words = comment.downcase.split(/\W+/)
    words.select { |word| profanity_word?(word) }.uniq
  end

    return false if word.empty?

    # Create regex pattern that matches whole words only
```

```ruby
      when UKRAINIAN_CODE
        :ukrainian
      when RUSSIAN_CODE
        :russian
      else
        :other
      end
    else
      # If not reliable, check for Surzhyk (mix of Ukrainian and Russian)
      detect_surzhyk(text)
    end
  end

  private

  def detect_surzhyk(text)
    # Split the text into words (simple split by spaces, you might want to improve this)
    words = text.downcase.split(/\s+/)
    
    # Count words that are typically Ukrainian or Russian
    # This is a simplified approach; you might need a more sophisticated method
    ukrainian_words = words.count { |word| ukrainian_word?(word) }
    russian_words = words.count { |word| russian_word?(word) }

    total_words = words.size.to_f
    return :unknown if total_words.zero?

    ukrainian_ratio = ukrainian_words / total_words
    russian_ratio = russian_words / total_words

    # If both Ukrainian and Russian words are present in significant amounts, it's Surzhyk
    if ukrainian_ratio > 0.2 && russian_ratio > 0.2
      :surzhyk
    else
      :unknown
    end
  end

  # Simple lists of characteristic words (you should expand these lists)
  UKRAINIAN_CHARACTERISTIC_WORDS = %w[та і в у на з для про від до без через]
  RUSSIAN_CHARACTERISTIC_WORDS = %w[и в на с для про от до без через]

  def ukrainian_word?(word)
    UKRAINIAN_CHARACTERISTIC_WORDS.include?(word)
  end

  def russian_word?(word)
    RUSSIAN_CHARACTERISTIC_WORDS.include?(word)
  end
```

```ruby
require 'unicode'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  UKRAINIAN_PROFANITY_WORDS = [
    # Основні нецензурні слова (замінено на приклади)
    'бляха', 'муха', 'трясця', 'чорт', 'дідько',
    # Скорочення та варіації
    'блть', 'тряс', 'чортів'
  ].freeze

  UKRAINIAN_PROFANITY_PATTERNS = [
    /х[уі]й/i,
    /п[іи]зд/i,
    /єб/i
  ].freeze

  REPLACEMENT_WORDS = [
    'нецензурне слово', '***', 'цензура', '[видалено]'
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @profanity_words = UKRAINIAN_PROFANITY_WORDS.dup
    @profanity_patterns = UKRAINIAN_PROFANITY_PATTERNS.dup
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text, replacement: '***')
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    filtered_text = text.dup
    
    # Фільтрація окремих слів
    @profanity_words.each do |profanity|
      regex = build_regex(profanity)
      filtered_text.gsub!(regex) { |match| replace_profanity(match, replacement) }
    end
    
    # Фільтрація за патернами
    @profanity_patterns.each do |pattern|
      filtered_text.gsub!(pattern) { |match| replace_profanity(match, replacement) }
    end
    
    filtered_text
  end

  # Перевірка наявності нецензурної лексики
  def contains_profanity?(text)
    return false if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    text_downcased = Unicode.downcase(text)
    
    @profanity_words.any? { |word| text_downcased.include?(Unicode.downcase(word)) } ||
    @profanity_patterns.any? { |pattern| text_downcased.match?(pattern) }
  end

  # Додавання кастомних слів до фільтра
  def add_custom_words(words)
    @profanity_words.concat(Array(words))
    @profanity_words.uniq!
  end

  # Додавання кастомних патернів
  def add_custom_patterns(patterns)
    @profanity_patterns.concat(Array(patterns))
  end

  # Отримання статистики для тексту
  def analyze_text(text)
    return { profanity_count: 0, words_found: [] } if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    found_words = []
    text_downcased = Unicode.downcase(text)
    
    @profanity_words.each do |word|
      if text_downcased.include?(Unicode.downcase(word))
        found_words << word
      end
    end
    
    @profanity_patterns.each do |pattern|
      matches = text_downcased.scan(pattern)
      found_words.concat(matches) if matches.any?
    end
    
    {
      profanity_count: found_words.size,
      words_found: found_words.uniq
    }
  end

  private

  # Побудова regex з урахуванням українських літер
  def build_regex(word)
    # Заміна українських літер на regex з альтернативами
    regex_pattern = word.chars.map do |char|
      case char.downcase
      when 'і' then '[іи]'
      when 'и' then '[иі]'
      when 'є' then '[єе]'
      when 'ї' then 'ї'
      else char
      end
    end.join
    
    /#{regex_pattern}/i
  end

  def replace_profanity(match, replacement)
    # Якщо слово починається з великої літери, зберігаємо регістр
    if match.match?(/\A[A-ZА-ЯЄІЇ]/)
      replacement.capitalize
    else
      replacement
    end
  end
end
```

  UKRAINIAN_SWEAR_WORDS = [

    'поганеслово', 'іншепоганеслово', 'щеодне',
    # Транслітерація та варіанти
    'pidor', 'blya', 'huy', 'ebat', 'pizda', 'her', 'dolboyob'
  ].freeze

  # Замінники для цензури
  REPLACEMENTS = ['***', 'цінзура', 'заблоковано'].freeze

  def initialize(custom_words: [], replacement: '***')
    @swear_words = Set.new(UKRAINIAN_SWEAR_WORDS + custom_words.map(&:downcase))
    @replacement = replacement
    @ukrainian = Ukrainian::Transliterator.new
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text)
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    words = text.split(/\b/)
    filtered_words = words.map do |word|
      if swear_word?(word.downcase)
        @replacement
      else
        word
      end
    end
    
    filtered_words.join
  end

  # Перевірка, чи є слово нецензурним
  def swear_word?(word)
    # Базова перевірка
    return true if @swear_words.include?(word.downcase)
    
    # Перевірка з урахуванням українських особливостей
    check_variations(word)
  end

  # Додати користувацькі нецензурні слова
  def add_custom_words(words)
    Array(words).each { |word| @swear_words.add(word.downcase) }
  end

  # Отримати список всіх нецензурних слів
  def swear_words
    @swear_words.to_a
  end

  private

  # Перевірка варіацій слова (транслітерація, заміни символів тощо)
  def check_variations(word)
    # Перевірка замін символів (напр., o -> 0, i -> 1, a -> @)
    variations = generate_variations(word)
    
    variations.any? { |variation| @swear_words.include?(variation) }
  end

  # Генерація можливих варіацій слова
  def generate_variations(word)
    variations = [word]
    
    # Заміни символів, що використовуються для обходу фільтрів
    char_replacements = {
      'a' => ['@', '4', 'а'],
      'o' => ['0', 'о'],
      'i' => ['1', 'і', 'ї'],
      'e' => ['3', 'е'],
      's' => ['5', '$', 'с'],
      'b' => ['6', '8', 'в']
    }
    
    # Генеруємо варіації з заміненими символами
    char_replacements.each do |original, replacements|
      replacements.each do |replacement|
        variations << word.gsub(original, replacement)
        variations << word.gsub(replacement, original)
      end
    end
    
    # Транслітерація кирилиці-латиниці
    begin
      latin_variant = @ukrainian.transliterate(word)
      variations << latin_variant.downcase
    rescue
      # Ігноруємо помилки транслітерації
    end
    
    variations.uniq
  end
end

```ruby
    convert_text(text, UKRAINIAN_TO_LATIN)
  end

  def self.detect_and_convert(text)
    # Simple detection based on the presence of Ukrainian characters
    has_ukrainian = text.match?(/[а-яїієґ]/i)
    has_latin_only = text.match?(/[a-z]/i) && !text.match?(/[а-яїієґ]/i)
    
    if has_latin_only && looks_like_mistaken_layout(text)
      latin_to_ukrainian(text)
    elsif has_ukrainian
      text # Already in Ukrainian, return as is
    else
      text # Return original if we can't determine
    end
  end

  private

  def self.convert_text(text, mapping)
    text.chars.map { |char| mapping[char] || char }.join
  end

  def self.looks_like_mistaken_layout(text)
    # Check if the text contains common Ukrainian words when converted
    test_conversion = latin_to_ukrainian(text.downcase)
    
    # Common Ukrainian words that might appear after conversion
    ukrainian_indicators = ['це', 'не', 'так', 'що', 'де', 'як', 'він', 'вона', 'вони', 'мати', 'бути']
    
    ukrainian_indicators.any? { |word| test_conversion.include?(word) }
  end
```

```ruby
  }

  end

    StanfordCoreNLP.use :ukrainian
    StanfordCoreNLP.model_files = {}
    StanfordCoreNLP.default_jars = [
      'stanford-corenlp-4.5.0.jar',
      'stanford-corenlp-4.5.0-models.jar',
      UKRAINIAN_MODELS_PATH
    ]
    
    pipeline = %w[tokenize ssplit pos lemma ner]
    @pipeline = StanfordCoreNLP.load_pipeline(*pipeline)
  end

  def extract_entities_from_text(text)
    return {} if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?

    text = preprocess_text(text)
    annotation = StanfordCoreNLP::Annotation.new(text)
    @pipeline.annotate(annotation)

    entities = {
      'People' => [],
      'Organizations' => [],
      'Places' => [],
      'Geo-political entities' => []
    }

    annotation.get(:sentences).each do |sentence|
      sentence.get(:tokens).each do |token|
        entity_type = token.get(:ner).to_s
        entity_text = token.get(:original_text).to_s
        
        if ENTITY_TYPES.key?(entity_type)
          category = ENTITY_TYPES[entity_type]
          entities[category] << entity_text unless entities[category].include?(entity_text)
        end
      end
    end

    # Clean up and filter results
    entities.transform_values { |list| list.reject { |e| e.length < 2 } }
  end

  def extract_entities_from_url(url)
    begin
      page = @agent.get(url)
      text = extract_article_text(page)
      extract_entities_from_text(text)
    rescue Mechanize::Error => e
      puts "Error fetching URL: #{e.message}"
      {}
    end
  end

  def extract_entities_from_html(html_content)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html_content)
    text = extract_article_text(doc)
    extract_entities_from_text(text)
  end

    text.gsub(/[^\p{Cyrillic}\s\p{P}\d]/, ' ')

        .strip
  end

  def extract_article_text(page_or_doc)
    # Try to extract main article content
    # Common selectors for news article content
    selectors = [
      'article .article-content',
      'article .content',
      '.article-body',
      '.post-content',
      '.news-content',
      'article p',

    ]

        content = elements.map(&:text).join(' ')

      end
    end

    # Fallback to body text if no specific content found
    content = page_or_doc.css('body').text if content.empty? || content.length < 100
    
    content
  end
```

Dotenv.load

class SMSVerificationService
  def initialize
    account_sid = ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID']
    auth_token = ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
    @verification_codes = {} # In production, use a proper database
  end

  # Generate a random 6-digit verification code
  def generate_verification_code
    rand(100000..999999).to_s
  end

  # Send SMS with verification code
  def send_verification_code(phone_number)
    code = generate_verification_code
    expiration_time = Time.now + 600 # 10 minutes expiry
    
    @verification_codes[phone_number] = {
      code: code,
      expires_at: expiration_time,
      attempts: 0
    }

    message = @client.messages.create(
      body: "Your verification code is: #{code}. It will expire in 10 minutes.",
      from: ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER'],
      to: phone_number
    )

    {
      success: true,
      message_sid: message.sid,
      phone_number: phone_number
    }
  rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: e.message
    }
  end

  # Verify the code entered by user
  def verify_code(phone_number, entered_code)
    stored_data = @verification_codes[phone_number]
    
    return { success: false, error: 'No verification code found for this number' } unless stored_data
    return { success: false, error: 'Verification code has expired' } if Time.now > stored_data[:expires_at]
    
    # Limit verification attempts
    if stored_data[:attempts] >= 3
      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number)
      return { success: false, error: 'Too many failed attempts. Please request a new code.' }
    end

    stored_data[:attempts] += 1

    if stored_data[:code] == entered_code
      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number) # Clear after successful verification
      { success: true, message: 'Verification successful' }
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'Invalid verification code',
        attempts_remaining: 3 - stored_data[:attempts]
      }
    end
  end

  # Check if a phone number has a pending verification
  def pending_verification?(phone_number)
    stored_data = @verification_codes[phone_number]
    return false unless stored_data
    Time.now <= stored_data[:expires_at]
  end
end

  def initialize
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(

    )
    @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')

  def send_verification_code(phone_number)

    # Зберігаємо код в Redis з терміном дії 10 хвилин
    @redis.setex("verification_code:#{phone_number}", 600, code)

  end

require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class WhatsAppTemplateSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0'

  def initialize(phone_number_id, access_token)
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  # Send a template message to a recipient
  # @param to [String] The recipient's phone number in international format (e.g., "15551234567")
  # @param template_name [String] The name of the template
  # @param language_code [String] The language code (e.g., "en_US")
  # @param components [Array] Optional components for the template (headers, body, buttons)
  # @return [HTTParty::Response] The API response
  def send_template_message(to:, template_name:, language_code: 'en_US', components: nil)
    # Remove any non-digit characters from phone number
    formatted_to = to.gsub(/\D/, '')

    payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: formatted_to,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Add components if provided
    payload[:template][:components] = components if components && !components.empty?

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"

    HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    })
  end

  # Helper method to create text parameters for template components
  def self.create_text_parameter(text)
    { type: 'text', text: text }
  end

  # Helper method to create currency parameters
  def self.create_currency_parameter(amount, currency_code = 'USD')
    {
      type: 'currency',
      currency: {
        fallback_value: "#{amount} #{currency_code}",
        code: currency_code,
        amount_1000: (amount.to_f * 1000).to_i

require 'httparty'

```ruby
class WhatsAppCloudAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0'

  def initialize(access_token, phone_number_id)
    @access_token = access_token
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
  end

  # Send a template message
  def send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code = 'en', components = [])
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: to_phone_number,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Add components if provided (for dynamic template parameters)
    payload[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Helper method to create text component for template parameters
  def create_text_component(parameters)
    {
      type: 'body',
      parameters: parameters.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create button component
  def create_button_component(index, parameters)
    {
      type: 'button',
      sub_type: 'quick_reply',
      index: index,
      parameters: parameters.map { |param| { type: 'payload', payload: param } }
    }
  end

  # Get template list (optional - for checking available templates)
  def get_templates(business_account_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{business_account_id}/message_templates"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "Error #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
      raise WhatsAppAPIError, error_message
    end
  end
end
```

# fcm_notification_sender.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'json'

class FCMNotificationSender
  def initialize(server_key)
    @fcm = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      to: device_token,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      registration_ids: device_tokens,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Send notification to a topic
  def send_to_topic(topic_name, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      to: "/topics/#{topic_name}",
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Send notification with custom options
  def send_custom_notification(device_token, options = {})
    message = {
      to: device_token
    }.merge(options)

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Subscribe device to a topic
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_tokens, topic_name)
    @fcm.topic_subscription(device_tokens, topic_name)
  end

  # Unsubscribe device from a topic
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_tokens, topic_name)
    @fcm.topic_unsubscription(device_tokens, topic_name)
  end

  private

  def send_message(message)
    begin
      response = @fcm.send(message)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      result = {
        success: true,
        status_code: response[:status_code],
        message_id: body['message_id'],
        multicast_id: body['multicast_id'],
        success_count: body['success'],
        failure_count: body['failure'],
        canonical_ids: body['canonical_ids'],
        results: body['results']
      }
      
      # Handle individual results for multiple devices
      if body['results']
        result[:individual_results] = body['results'].map.with_index do |res, index|
          {
            device_index: index,
            message_id: res['message_id'],
            error: res['error'],
            registration_id: res['registration_id'] # canonical registration ID
          }
        end
      end
      
      result
    else
      {
        success: false,
        status_code: response[:status_code],
        error: response[:body]
      }
    end
  end
end

```ruby
require 'fcm'

class FirebaseNotificationService
  def initialize(server_key = nil)
    # Ключ сервера Firebase можна передати або встановити через змінну середовища
    @server_key = server_key || ENV['FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY']
    
    unless @server_key
      raise ArgumentError, "Firebase Server Key is required. Set FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY environment variable or pass as argument."
    end
    
    @fcm = FCM.new(@server_key)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на один пристрій
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = build_message(device_token, title, body, data)
    
    begin
      response = @fcm.send([device_token], message)
      handle_response(response, device_token)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на кілька пристроїв
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    message = build_message(nil, title, body, data)
    
    begin
      response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, message)
      handle_response(response, device_tokens)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на тему
  def send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data = {})
    message = build_message(nil, title, body, data.merge(topic: topic))
    
    begin
      response = @fcm.send_to_topic(topic, message)
      handle_response(response, "topic: #{topic}")
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення з кастомними налаштуваннями
  def send_custom_notification(device_tokens, notification_payload)
    begin
      response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, notification_payload)
      handle_response(response, device_tokens)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_message(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default',
        badge: '1'
      },
      data: data,
      android: {
        notification: {
          sound: 'default',
          priority: 'high',
          notification_priority: 'PRIORITY_HIGH'
        }
      },
      apns: {
        payload: {
          aps: {
            sound: 'default',
            badge: 1
          }
        }
      }
    }

    # Додаємо токен пристрою, якщо він переданий
    message[:to] = device_token if device_token
    
    message
  end

  def handle_response(response, target)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      result = {
        success: true,
        target: target,
        message_id: body['message_id'],
        multicast_id: body['multicast_id'],
        success_count: body['success'],
        failure_count: body['failure'],
        canonical_ids: body['canonical_ids']
      }
      
      # Додаємо інформацію про помилки, якщо вони є
      if body['results']
        result[:errors] = body['results'].map.with_index do |res, index|
          if res['error']
            { index: index, error: res['error'] }
          end
        end.compact
      end
      
      result
    else
      {
        success: false,
        target: target,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}",
        body: response[:body]
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'vonage'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class SMSSender
  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET']
    )
  end

  def send_sms(to, message)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.send(
        from: ENV['VONAGE_BRAND_NAME'],
        to: to,
        text: message,
        callback: "#{ENV['WEBHOOK_URL']}/delivery-receipt"
      )

      if response.messages.first.status == '0'
        {
          success: true,
          message_id: response.messages.first.message_id,
          remaining_balance: response.messages.first.remaining_balance,
          status: 'Message sent successfully'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: response.messages.first.error_text,
          status: response.messages.first.status
        }
      end
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  # Method to check message status (alternative to webhooks)
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.search(message_id)
      {
        message_id: response.message_id,
        status: response.status,
        final_status: response.final_status,
        price: response.price,
        date_received: response.date_received
      }
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      { error: e.message }
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Webhook Server for Delivery Receipts

```ruby
# webhook_server.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

# In-memory storage for delivery receipts (use a database in production)
$delivery_receipts = {}

class WebhookServer < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :port, 4567
    set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
  end

  # Endpoint to receive delivery receipts from Vonage
  post '/webhooks/delivery-receipt' do
    content_type :json

    receipt_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    message_id = receipt_data['messageId']
    status = receipt_data['status']
    error_code = receipt_data['error-code']
    timestamp = receipt_data['message-timestamp']

    # Store the delivery receipt
    $delivery_receipts[message_id] = {
      status: status,
      error_code: error_code,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      received_at: Time.now
    }

    puts "Delivery receipt received:"
    puts "Message ID: #{message_id}"
    puts "Status: #{status}"
    puts "Error Code: #{error_code}"
    puts "Timestamp: #{timestamp}"
    puts "---"

    status 200
    { success: true }.to_json
  end

  # Endpoint to check delivery status
  get '/webhooks/status/:message_id' do
    content_type :json
    
    message_id = params[:message_id]
    receipt = $delivery_receipts[message_id]

    if receipt
      receipt.merge(message_id: message_id).to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: "No delivery receipt found for message ID: #{message_id}" }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Health check endpoint
  get '/' do
    content_type :json
    { status: 'Webhook server is running' }.to_json
  end
end
```

    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/messages/single",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

    response = HTTParty.post(

      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 60
    )

  end

      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 15
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

    )

  end

      end
    }

    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

```ruby
    response = send_request('send.php', xml_body)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_sms_response(response.body)
    else

    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу SMS

    xml_body = <<~XML

      <request>
        <operation>GETSTATUS</operation>
        <message id="#{message_id}" />
      </request>
    XML
    
    response = send_request('status.php', xml_body)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_status_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Помилка отримання статусу: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def send_request(endpoint, body = nil)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Basic #{@auth_string}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml'
    }
    
    if body
      self.class.post("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", body: body, headers: headers)
    else
      self.class.get("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", headers: headers)
    end
  end
  
  def build_sms_xml(phone, message, options)
    start_time = options[:start_time] || Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 24
    description = options[:description] || 'SMS from Ruby client'
    source = options[:source] || 'Info'
    
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="#{description}">
          <body>#{message}</body>
          <recipient>#{phone}</recipient>
          <source>#{source}</source>
        </message>
      </request>

  end
  
  def parse_sms_response(xml_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_body)
    
    state = doc.at_xpath('//state')
    return { error: 'Invalid response format' } unless state
    
    result = {
      code: state['code'],
      message: state.text
    }
    
    # Додаємо ID повідомлення, якщо є
    message_node = doc.at_xpath('//message')
    result[:message_id] = message_node['id'] if message_node
    
    result
  end
  
  def parse_status_response(xml_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_body)
    
    state = doc.at_xpath('//state')
    return { error: 'Invalid response format' } unless state
    
    {
      code: state['code'],
      status: state.text,
      status_time: state['time']
    }
  end
```

require 'telegram/bot'

class UkraineAirRaidBot
  ALERT_MAP_URL = 'https://airraidalertmap.com.ua/'
  ALERTS_API_URL = 'https://api.ukrainealarm.com/api/v3/alerts'
  
  def initialize
    @token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
    unless @token
      puts "Error: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable is not set"
      exit(1)
    end
  end

  def run
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.listen do |message|
        case message.text
        when '/start'
          send_welcome_message(bot, message.chat.id)
        when '/map', '/status'
          send_alert_map(bot, message.chat.id)
        when '/help'
          send_help_message(bot, message.chat.id)
        else
          handle_unknown_command(bot, message.chat.id)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def send_welcome_message(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~WELCOME
      🚨 Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot 🚨
      
      This bot provides real-time information about air-raid alerts in Ukraine.
      
      Available commands:
      /start - Show this welcome message
      /map or /status - Show current air-raid alert map
      /help - Show help information
      
      Stay safe! 🇺🇦
    WELCOME

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end

  def send_alert_map(bot, chat_id)
    begin
      # Get the latest alert map image
      map_url = fetch_alert_map_url
      
      if map_url
        bot.api.send_photo(
          chat_id: chat_id,
          photo: map_url,
          caption: "🚨 Current Air-Raid Alert Map of Ukraine\nUpdated: #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}"
        )
        
        # Also send current alert status summary
        status_summary = get_alert_status_summary
        bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: status_summary)
      else
        bot.api.send_message(
          chat_id: chat_id, 
          text: "⚠️ Unable to fetch the current alert map. Please try again later."
        )
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error sending alert map: #{e.message}"
      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id, 
        text: "❌ Error fetching alert information. Please try again later."
      )
    end
  end

  def fetch_alert_map_url
    # Try to get the map from airraidalertmap.com.ua
    response = HTTParty.get(ALERT_MAP_URL)
    
    if response.success?
      doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
      
      # Look for map image - this selector might need adjustment based on the website structure
      map_image = doc.css('img').find { |img| img['src']&.include?('map') }
      
      if map_image
        src = map_image['src']
        # Convert relative URL to absolute if needed
        src.start_with?('http') ? src : URI.join(ALERT_MAP_URL, src).to_s
      else
        # Fallback to a known map URL pattern
        "https://airraidalertmap.com.ua/img/map.png?#{Time.now.to_i}"
      end
    else
      # Fallback to alternative source
      "https://alerts.in.ua/map.png?#{Time.now.to_i}"
    end
  end

  def get_alert_status_summary
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(ALERTS_API_URL, headers: {
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      })
      
      if response.success?
        alerts = JSON.parse(response.body)
        summary = parse_alerts_summary(alerts)
        return format_alert_summary(summary)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error fetching API data: #{e.message}"
    end
    
    "📊 Alert data temporarily unavailable. Please check the map for current status."
  end

  def parse_alerts_summary(alerts)
    summary = {
      active_alerts: 0,
      regions_on_alert: [],
      last_update: Time.now
    }
    
    alerts.each do |alert|
      region_name = alert['regionName'] || alert['title']
      if alert['active'] && region_name
        summary[:active_alerts] += 1
        summary[:regions_on_alert] << region_name
      end
    end
    
    summary
  end

```ruby
class DiiaApiClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['DIIA_BASE_URL'] || 'https://partner-api.diia.gov.ua'

  def initialize
    @partner_id = ENV['DIIA_PARTNER_ID']
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(ENV['DIIA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH']))
    @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'])
  end

  # Отримання токена доступу
  def get_access_token
    cached_token = @redis.get('diia_access_token')
    return cached_token if cached_token

    timestamp = Time.now.to_i
    payload = {
      partnerId: @partner_id,
      timestamp: timestamp
    }

    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    signature = JWT.encode(payload, @private_key, 'RS256')

    body = {
      partnerId: @partner_id,
      signature: signature
    }

    response = self.class.post('/api/v1/auth', {
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    })

    if response.success?
      token_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      access_token = token_data['token']
      expires_in = token_data['expiresIn'] || 3600
      
      # Зберігаємо токен в Redis з часом життя на 5 хвилин менше
      @redis.setex('diia_access_token', expires_in - 300, access_token)
      
      access_token
    else
      raise DiiaApiError, "Помилка отримання токена: #{response.body}"
    end
```

  # @param message [String] The text message to be converted to speech

    # Default options

      language: options[:language] || 'en-US',    # Language for TTS

    }

    payload = {
      customerNumber: format_phone_number(customer_number),
      message: message,
      generalCall: {
        callerid: default_options[:callerid],
        language: default_options[:language],
        voice: default_options[:voice],
        repeat: default_options[:repeat]
      }
    }

    # Make the API request
    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Basic #{@auth_string}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    # Parse and return the response
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Make a call using a pre-recorded audio file
  # @param customer_number [String] The phone number to call
  # @param audio_url [String] URL to the audio file to play
  # @param options [Hash] Additional options
  # @return [Hash] API response
  def make_call_with_audio(customer_number, audio_url, options = {})
    payload = {
      customerNumber: format_phone_number(customer_number),
      audioCall: {
        callerid: options[:callerid] || 'unknown',
        audioUrl: audio_url,
        repeat: options[:repeat] || 1
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Basic #{@auth_string}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }

      }

```ruby
    params[:callerID] = options[:caller_id] if options[:caller_id]
    params[:uniqueid] = options[:unique_id] if options[:unique_id]
    params[:generalDTMF] = options[:dtmf] if options[:dtmf]
    params[:waitTime] = options[:wait_time] || 30 # seconds to wait for answer
    params[:answerTime] = options[:answer_time] || 60 # max call duration
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: params)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check call status
  def call_status(call_id)
    endpoint = '/calls/callstatus'
    
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      callID: call_id
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: params)
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = response.parsed_response
      
      if result['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          data: result['data'],
          message: result['message']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: result['message'] || 'Unknown error occurred'
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      }
    end
  rescue => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Request failed: #{e.message}"
    }
  end
```

```ruby
  def make_call(to_number, from_number, voice_message, options = {})
    endpoint = '/calls/make-call-to-phone'

    params = {
      fromNumber: from_number,
      toNumber: to_number,
      voiceMessage: voice_message,
      # Додаткові параметри
      language: options[:language] || 'uk', # мова голосового повідомлення
      gender: options[:gender] || 'female', # стать голосу
      repeat: options[:repeat] || 1, # кількість повторень
      callbackUrl: options[:callback_url] # URL для зворотного виклику
    }

    response = post_request(endpoint, params)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Дзвінок успішно ініційовано!"
      puts "ID дзвінка: #{response['callID']}"
      puts "Статус: #{response['status']}"
    else
      puts "Помилка при здійсненні дзвінка: #{response['code']} - #{response['message']}"
    end

    response
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу дзвінка
  def call_status(call_id)
    endpoint = '/calls/status'
    params = { callID: call_id }

    response = post_request(endpoint, params)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Статус дзвінка #{call_id}: #{response['status']}"
      puts "Тривалість: #{response['billsec']} сек" if response['billsec']
    end

    response
  end

  # Метод для отримання історії дзвінків
  def call_history(options = {})
    endpoint = '/stats/calls-history'
    
    params = {
      startDate: options[:start_date] || (Time.now - 86400).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), # минулий день
      endDate: options[:end_date] || Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
      limit: options[:limit] || 10
    }

    response = post_request(endpoint, params)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Знайдено #{response['totalCount']} дзвінків"
      response['calls'].each do |call|
        puts "Дзвінок #{call['callID']}: #{call['fromNumber']} -> #{call['toNumber']} (#{call['status']})"
      end
    end

    response
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_secret.nil?
      raise "BINOTEL_API_KEY та BINOTEL_API_SECRET мають бути встановлені"
    end
  end

  def post_request(endpoint, params)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}.json"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, 
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Basic #{Base64.strict_encode64("#{@api_key}:#{@api_secret}")}"
      }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

      lang: 'uk',           # мова тексту для перетворення в мову

      timeout: 30           # час очікування відповіді (секунди)
    }
    
    options = default_options.merge(options)
    
    # Параметри запиту до API
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      from: from_number,
      to: to_number,
      text: voice_message_text,
      lang: options[:lang],
      voice: options[:voice],
      speed: options[:speed].to_s,
      attempts: options[:attempts],
      timeout: options[:timeout]
    }

    # Додаткові параметри (якщо задані)

    params[:callback_method] = options[:callback_method] if options[:callback_method]
    params[:unique_id] = options[:unique_id] if options[:unique_id]

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        "#{@base_url}/call/tts.json",
        body: params,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
      )

      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Error: #{e.message}" }

      secret: @api_secret,
      callID: call_id

      response = HTTParty.get(
        "#{@base_url}/call/status.json",
        query: params
      )

      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['status'] == 'success'
        { 
          success: true, 
          call_id: result['callID'],
          message: result['message'],
          data: result
        }
      else
        { 
          success: false, 
          error: result['message'] || 'Unknown error',
          data: result
        }
      end
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}" 
      }
    end
  end

        pdf.text @invoice_data[:company_address]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:company_email]
      end
      
      pdf.bounding_box([300, pdf.cursor + 50], width: 250) do
        pdf.text "Bill To:", style: :bold
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:client_name]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:client_address]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:client_email]
      end
      
      pdf.move_down 80
      
      # Line items table
      pdf.text "Line Items", style: :bold, size: 14
      pdf.move_down 10
      
      table_data = [["Description", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Amount"]]
      @invoice_data[:line_items].each do |item|
        amount = item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price]
        table_data << [
          item[:description],
          item[:quantity].to_s,
          format_currency(item[:unit_price]),
          format_currency(amount)
        ]
      end
      
      pdf.table(table_data, header: true, width: pdf.bounds.width) do |t|
        t.row(0).font_style = :bold
        t.row(0).background_color = "E8E8E8"
        t.columns(2..3).align = :right
        t.cells.style(padding: 5, border_width: 1)
      end
      
      pdf.move_down 20
      
      # Totals
      subtotal = calculate_subtotal
      vat_amount = calculate_vat(subtotal)
      total = subtotal + vat_amount
      
      totals_data = [
        ["Subtotal:", format_currency(subtotal)],
        ["VAT (#{@invoice_data[:vat_rate]}%):", format_currency(vat_amount)],
        ["Total:", format_currency(total)]
      ]
      
      pdf.table(totals_data, width: 200, position: :right) do |t|
        t.columns(0).font_style = :bold
        t.columns(1).align = :right
        t.row(2).font_style = :bold
        t.row(2).size = 14
      end
      
      # Footer
      pdf.move_down 40

  end
  
  def format_currency(amount)
    "$#{'%.2f' % amount}"
  end
end

```ruby
class CoinbasePaymentService
  def initialize
    @client = Coinbase::Commerce::Client.new(api_key: ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_API_KEY'])
  end

  # Створення нового платежу
  def create_charge(order_id, amount, currency = 'USD', description = 'Order payment')
    charge_data = {
      name: "Order ##{order_id}",
      description: description,
      pricing_type: 'fixed_price',
      local_price: {
        amount: amount.to_s,
        currency: currency
      },
      metadata: {
        order_id: order_id
      },
      redirect_url: "#{ENV['BASE_URL']}/orders/#{order_id}/success",
      cancel_url: "#{ENV['BASE_URL']}/orders/#{order_id}/cancel"
    }

    @client.charge.create(charge_data)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  def check_charge_status(charge_id)
    @client.charge.retrieve(charge_id)
  end

  # Обробка вебхука
  def process_webhook(payload, signature)
    # Перевірка підпису вебхука
    unless valid_webhook_signature?(payload, signature)
      raise 'Invalid webhook signature'
    end

    event = JSON.parse(payload)
    process_webhook_event(event)
  end

  private

  def valid_webhook_signature?(payload, signature)
    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(
      OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha256'),
      ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET'],
      payload
    )
    Rack::Utils.secure_compare(expected_signature, signature)
  end

  def process_webhook_event(event)
    case event['type']
    when 'charge:confirmed', 'charge:resolved'
      charge = event['data']
      order_id = charge.dig('metadata', 'order_id')
      
      if order_id
        mark_order_as_paid(order_id, charge['id'])
        return { success: true, order_id: order_id }
      end
    when 'charge:failed', 'charge:delayed'
      # Обробка невдалих платежів
      handle_failed_payment(event['data'])
    end

    { success: false }
  end

  def mark_order_as_paid(order_id, charge_id)
    # Знайдіть та оновіть замовлення в вашій базі даних
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    if order
      order.update!(
        payment_status: 'paid',
        paid_at: Time.current,
        transaction_id: charge_id
      )
      
      # Додаткові дії після успішної оплати
      OrderMailer.payment_confirmation(order).deliver_later
    end
  end

  def handle_failed_payment(charge_data)
    order_id = charge_data.dig('metadata', 'order_id')
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    
    if order
      order.update!(
        payment_status: 'failed',
        payment_error: charge_data['timeline']&.last&.dig('status')
      )
    end
  end
```
