  # Визначення платіжних систем за префіксами
  PAYMENT_SYSTEMS = {
    visa: { prefix: '4', lengths: [13, 16, 19] },
    mastercard: { prefix: ['51', '52', '53', '54', '55', '2221', '2720'], lengths: [16] },
    amex: { prefix: ['34', '37'], lengths: [15] },
    discover: { prefix: ['6011', '65', '644', '645', '646', '647', '648', '649', '622126', '622925'], lengths: [16, 19] },
    jcb: { prefix: ['3528', '3529', '353', '354', '355', '356', '357', '358'], lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19] },
    diners_club: { prefix: ['300', '301', '302', '303', '304', '305', '36', '38'], lengths: [14, 16, 19] },
    mir: { prefix: '2200', lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19] },
    unionpay: { prefix: ['62', '88'], lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19] }
  }.freeze

  def initialize(card_number)
    @card_number = card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Видаляємо пробіли
  end

  # Перевірка алгоритмом Луна
  def valid?
    return false unless @card_number.match?(/^\d+$/) # Тільки цифри
    return false if @card_number.length < 12 || @card_number.length > 19

    digits = @card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    check_digit = digits.pop

    sum = digits.reverse.each_with_index.sum do |digit, index|
      if index.even?
        doubled = digit * 2
        doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        digit
      end
    end

    (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10 == check_digit
  end

  # Визначення платіжної системи
  def payment_system
    PAYMENT_SYSTEMS.each do |system, rules|
      prefixes = Array(rules[:prefix])
      lengths = Array(rules[:lengths])
      
      prefix_match = prefixes.any? { |prefix| @card_number.start_with?(prefix.to_s) }
      length_match = lengths.include?(@card_number.length)
      
      return system.to_s.capitalize if prefix_match && length_match
    end
    
    'Unknown'
  end

  # Комплексна перевірка
  def validate
    {
      valid: valid?,
      payment_system: payment_system,
      card_number: @card_number,
      formatted_number: format_card_number
    }
  end

  private

  def format_card_number
    @card_number.gsub(/(.{4})/, '\1 ').strip
  end

# stock_analyzer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'date'

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    raise "API key not found. Please set ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY environment variable" unless @api_key
  end
  
  def fetch_historical_prices(ticker, days: 100)
    # We need more than 20 days to calculate a proper 20-day moving average
    response = HTTParty.get(ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL, query: {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: ticker,
      apikey: @api_key,
      outputsize: days <= 100 ? 'compact' : 'full'
    })
    
    unless response.success?
      raise "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
    
    data = response.parsed_response
    
    if data['Error Message']
      raise "Invalid API call: #{data['Error Message']}"
    end
    
    if data['Note']
      puts "Note: #{data['Note']}"
    end
    
    time_series = data['Time Series (Daily)']
    unless time_series
      raise "No historical data found for ticker: #{ticker}"
    end
    
    # Convert to array of [date, closing_price] sorted by date
    historical_data = time_series.map do |date, values|
      [Date.parse(date), values['4. close'].to_f]
    end.sort_by { |date, _| date }
    
    historical_data.last(days) # Return most recent N days
  end
  
  def calculate_moving_average(prices, period: 20)
    return [] if prices.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    prices.each_cons(period) do |window|
      average = window.sum / period.to_f
      moving_averages << average
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end
  
  def analyze(ticker, period: 20)
    puts "Fetching historical data for #{ticker}..."
    historical_data = fetch_historical_prices(ticker, days: period + 50) # Get extra data
    
    dates = historical_data.map(&:first)
    prices = historical_data.map(&:last)
    
    puts "Calculating #{period}-day moving average..."
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, period: period)
    
    # Align dates with moving averages (moving averages start after the period)
    ma_dates = dates[(period - 1)..-1]
    
    # Display results
    puts "\n#{ticker} - #{period}-Day Moving Average Analysis"
    puts "=" * 50
    
    ma_dates.zip(moving_averages).last(10).each do |date, ma|
      current_price = prices[dates.index(date)]
      puts "#{date}: Price: $#{current_price.round(2)}, MA#{period}: $#{ma.round(2)}"
    end
    
    # Return structured data
    {
      ticker: ticker,
      historical_data: historical_data,
      moving_averages: moving_averages,
      ma_dates: ma_dates,
      current_price: prices.last,
      current_ma: moving_averages.last
    }
  end
end

require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'oauth2'
require 'dotenv'

require 'active_support/core_ext'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class QuickBooksInvoiceExporter
  attr_reader :client, :access_token, :realm_id

  def initialize
    @realm_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    setup_oauth_client
    authenticate
  end

  def setup_oauth_client
    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID'],
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      site: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2',
      authorize_url: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2',
      token_url: 'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer'
    )
  end

  def authenticate
    # For production, you'd typically store and refresh tokens
    @access_token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      @client,
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      refresh_token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    )
  end

  def quickbooks_service
    @quickbooks_service ||= Quickbooks::Service::Invoice.new
    @quickbooks_service.company_id = @realm_id
    @quickbooks_service.access_token = @access_token
    @quickbooks_service
  end

  def export_invoice(paid_invoice_data)
    begin
      # Convert our invoice data to QuickBooks invoice format
      qb_invoice = map_to_quickbooks_invoice(paid_invoice_data)
      
      # Create the invoice in QuickBooks
      created_invoice = quickbooks_service.create(qb_invoice)
      
      puts "✅ Invoice exported successfully to QuickBooks!"
      puts "QuickBooks Invoice ID: #{created_invoice.id}"
      puts "Invoice Number: #{created_invoice.doc_number}"
      
      { success: true, quickbooks_id: created_invoice.id, invoice_number: created_invoice.doc_number }
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "❌ Error exporting invoice to QuickBooks: #{e.message}"
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def map_to_quickbooks_invoice(invoice_data)
    Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new.tap do |invoice|
      # Basic invoice information
      invoice.customer_id = invoice_data[:customer_qb_id]
      invoice.doc_number = invoice_data[:invoice_number]
      invoice.txn_date = Date.parse(invoice_data[:paid_date] || Date.today.to_s)
      invoice.due_date = Date.parse(invoice_data[:due_date] || Date.today.to_s)
      
      # Mark as paid
      invoice.allow_online_credit_card_payment = true
      invoice.allow_online_payment = true
      
      # Add line items
      invoice.line_items = invoice_data[:line_items].map do |item|
        Quickbooks::Model::InvoiceLineItem.new.tap do |line_item|
          line_item.amount = item[:amount]
          line_item.description = item[:description]
          line_item.sales_item! do |sales_item|
            sales_item.item_id = item[:item_id] || '1' # Default service item
            sales_item.quantity = item[:quantity] || 1
            sales_item.unit_price = item[:unit_price] || item[:amount]
          end
        end
      end
      
      # Add payment if invoice is marked as paid
      if invoice_data[:paid_amount] && invoice_data[:paid_amount] > 0
        add_payment_to_invoice(invoice, invoice_data)
      end
    end
  end

  def add_payment_to_invoice(invoice, invoice_data)
    # Create a payment for the invoice
    payment_service = Quickbooks::Service::Payment.new
    payment_service.company_id = @realm_id
    payment_service.access_token = @access_token

    payment = Quickbooks::Model::Payment.new
    payment.customer_id = invoice_data[:customer_qb_id]
    payment.total_amount = invoice_data[:paid_amount]
    payment.txn_date = Date.parse(invoice_data[:paid_date] || Date.today.to_s)
    
    # Link payment to the invoice
    payment_line = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
    payment_line.amount = invoice_data[:paid_amount]
    payment_line.linked_transactions << Quickbooks::Model::LinkedTransaction.new.tap do |lt|
      lt.txn_id = invoice_data[:invoice_number] # This will be updated with the actual invoice ID after creation
      lt.txn_type = 'Invoice'
    end
    
    payment.line_items << payment_line
    
    # In a real implementation, you'd create the payment after the invoice is created
    # and link them properly using the invoice ID
    invoice.auto_doc_number = true
  end

# app/services/quickbooks_service.rb
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'oauth'

class QuickBooksService
  def initialize
    @client = Quickbooks::Client.new(
      client_id: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID'],
      client_secret: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      access_token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      refresh_token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN'],
      realm_id: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID'],
      sandbox: false # Set to true for testing
    )
  end

  def export_invoice(invoice_data)
    begin
      # Create QuickBooks invoice object
      qb_invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
      
      # Set basic invoice information
      qb_invoice.customer_id = invoice_data[:customer_qb_id]
      qb_invoice.txn_date = invoice_data[:invoice_date]
      qb_invoice.due_date = invoice_data[:due_date]
      qb_invoice.doc_number = invoice_data[:invoice_number]
      
      # Set invoice line items
      invoice_data[:line_items].each do |item|
        line_item = Quickbooks::Model::InvoiceLineItem.new
        line_item.amount = item[:amount]
        line_item.description = item[:description]
        line_item.sales_item! do |detail|
          detail.item_id = item[:item_id]
          detail.quantity = item[:quantity]
          detail.unit_price = item[:unit_price]
        end
        qb_invoice.line_items << line_item
      end
      
      # Set payment information if paid
      if invoice_data[:paid]
        qb_invoice.auto_doc_number = false
        
        # Create payment
        payment = Quickbooks::Model::Payment.new
        payment.customer_id = invoice_data[:customer_qb_id]
        payment.total = invoice_data[:total_amount]
        payment.txn_date = invoice_data[:payment_date]
        payment.payment_ref_number = invoice_data[:payment_reference]
        
        # Link payment to invoice
        payment_line = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
        payment_line.amount = invoice_data[:total_amount]
        payment_line.linked_transactions << Quickbooks::Model::LinkedTransaction.new.tap do |lt|
          lt.txn_id = qb_invoice.id
          lt.txn_type = 'Invoice'
        end
        
        payment.line_items << payment_line
        
        # Create payment in QuickBooks
        created_payment = @client.create(payment)
      end
      
      # Create invoice in QuickBooks
      created_invoice = @client.create(qb_invoice)
      
      {
        success: true,
        invoice_id: created_invoice.id,
        payment_id: created_payment&.id,
        invoice_number: created_invoice.doc_number
      }
      
    rescue Quickbooks::AuthorizationFailure => e
      { success: false, error: "Authorization failed: #{e.message}" }
    rescue Quickbooks::ServiceUnavailable => e
      { success: false, error: "QuickBooks service unavailable: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  def refresh_token_if_needed
    # QuickBooks access tokens expire after 1 hour
    # This method should be called periodically or before API calls
    @client.refresh!
    
    # Update environment variables or token storage
    ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'] = @client.access_token
    ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN'] = @client.refresh_token
    
    true
  rescue StandardError => e
    false
  end
end

# stock_analyzer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'time'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'

  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    raise "Alpha Vantage API key not found" unless @api_key
  end

  def fetch_historical_prices(ticker, output_size: 'compact')
    params = {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: ticker.upcase,
      outputsize: output_size,
      apikey: @api_key
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL, query: params)
    
    unless response.success?
      raise "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end

    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['Error Message']
      raise "API Error: #{data['Error Message']}"
    end
    
    if data['Note']
      raise "API Limit Note: #{data['Note']}"
    end

    time_series = data['Time Series (Daily)']
    raise "No time series data found for #{ticker}" unless time_series

    process_time_series(time_series)
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(prices, period = 20)
    return {} if prices.length < period

    moving_averages = {}
    
    prices.each_cons(period) do |window|
      date = window.last[:date]
      average_price = window.sum { |day| day[:close].to_f } / period
      moving_averages[date] = average_price.round(4)
    end

    moving_averages
  end

  def get_20_day_moving_average(ticker, output_size: 'compact')
    puts "Fetching historical prices for #{ticker}..."
    prices = fetch_historical_prices(ticker, output_size: output_size)
    
    puts "Calculating 20-day moving average..."
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, 20)
    
    {
      ticker: ticker,
      prices: prices,
      moving_averages: moving_averages,
      latest_price: prices.first[:close],
      latest_moving_average: moving_averages.values.first
    }
  end

  private

  def process_time_series(time_series)
    # Convert to array of hashes sorted by date (newest first)
    time_series.map do |date, data|
      {
        date: date,
        open: data['1. open'],
        high: data['2. high'],
        low: data['3. low'],
        close: data['4. close'],
        volume: data['5. volume']
      }
    end.sort_by { |day| day[:date] }.reverse
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    analyzer = StockAnalyzer.new
    
    # Get ticker from command line or use default
    ticker = ARGV[0] || 'AAPL'
    
    result = analyzer.get_20_day_moving_average(ticker, output_size: 'full')
    
    puts "\n=== Stock Analysis for #{result[:ticker]} ==="
    puts "Latest Price: $#{result[:latest_price]}"
    puts "Latest 20-day Moving Average: $#{result[:latest_moving_average]}"
    
    # Display recent moving averages
    puts "\nRecent 20-day Moving Averages:"
    result[:moving_averages].first(10).each do |date, avg|
      puts "#{date}: $#{avg}"
    end
    
    # Display price vs moving average comparison
    latest_date = result[:prices].first[:date]
    latest_close = result[:prices].first[:close].to_f
    latest_ma = result[:moving_averages].values.first
    
    puts "\nPrice vs Moving Average:"
    if latest_close > latest_ma
      puts "Price is ABOVE the 20-day MA by #{((latest_close - latest_ma) / latest_ma * 100).round(2)}%"
    else
      puts "Price is BELOW the 20-day MA by #{((latest_ma - latest_close) / latest_ma * 100).round(2)}%"
    end
    
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    puts "\nUsage: ruby stock_analyzer.rb [TICKER]"
    puts "Make sure you have set ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY in your .env file"
  end
end

class StockAnalyzer
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    raise "API ключ не знайдено. Встановіть ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY у змінні середовища або передайте як параметр" unless @api_key
  end

  def get_historical_prices(symbol, output_size: 'compact')
    params = {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: symbol,
      outputsize: output_size,
      apikey: @api_key
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, query: params)
    
    if response.success?
      data = response.parsed_response
      
      if data['Error Message']
        raise "Помилка API: #{data['Error Message']}"
      elsif data['Note']
        raise "Обмеження API: #{data['Note']}"
      end
      
      time_series = data['Time Series (Daily)']
      raise "Дані не знайдено для символу #{symbol}" unless time_series
      
      process_time_series(time_series)
    else
      raise "Помилка HTTP: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(prices, period = 20)
    raise "Недостатньо даних для обчислення #{period}-денного ковзного середнього" if prices.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    prices.each_with_index do |price_data, index|
      next if index < period - 1
      
      # Беремо закриті ціни за останні 'period' днів
      window = prices[(index - period + 1)..index].map { |p| p[:close].to_f }
      average = window.sum / period
      
      moving_averages << {
        date: price_data[:date],
        close_price: price_data[:close].to_f,
        moving_average: average.round(4),
        period: period
      }
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

  private

  def process_time_series(time_series)
    # Конвертуємо хеш у масив і сортуємо за датою (від найстарішої до найновішої)
    time_series.map do |date, values|
      {
        date: date,
        open: values['1. open'],
        high: values['2. high'],
        low: values['3. low'],
        close: values['4. close'],
        volume: values['5. volume']
      }
    end.sort_by { |entry| Date.parse(entry[:date]) }
  end
end

# stock_analyzer.rb
require 'alphavantage'

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    
    unless @api_key
      raise "API ключ не знайдено. Встановіть ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY в змінні середовища або передайте як аргумент"
    end
    
    Alphavantage.configure do |config|
      config.api_key = @api_key
    end
  end

  def get_stock_data(ticker, output_size: "compact")
    begin
      client = Alphavantage::Stock.new(symbol: ticker)
      timeseries = client.timeseries(type: "daily", outputsize: output_size)
      
      # Перетворюємо дані у зручний формат
      historical_data = timeseries.history.map do |entry|
        {
          date: Date.parse(entry[0]),
          open: entry[1]["1. open"].to_f,
          high: entry[1]["2. high"].to_f,
          low: entry[1]["3. low"].to_f,
          close: entry[1]["4. close"].to_f,
          volume: entry[1]["5. volume"].to_i
        }
      end.sort_by { |entry| entry[:date] }
      
      historical_data
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка отримання даних: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(data, period: 20, price_type: :close)
    return [] if data.nil? || data.empty?
    return [] if data.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    data.each_with_index do |entry, index|
      if index >= period - 1
        # Беремо останні `period` значень
        window = data[(index - period + 1)..index]
        average = window.sum { |e| e[price_type] } / period.to_f
        moving_averages << {
          date: entry[:date],
          price: entry[price_type],
          moving_average: average.round(4)
        }
      end
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

  def analyze_stock(ticker, period: 20, output_size: "compact")
    puts "Отримання даних для акції #{ticker}..."
    
    stock_data = get_stock_data(ticker, output_size: output_size)
    
    if stock_data.nil?
      puts "Не вдалося отримати дані"
      return
    end
    
    puts "Знайдено #{stock_data.length} торгових днів"
    
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(stock_data, period: period)
    
    puts "\n20-денне ковзне середнє для #{ticker}:"
    puts "=" * 60
    printf "%-12s %-10s %-15s\n", "Дата", "Ціна", "Ковзне середнє"
    puts "-" * 60
    
    # Показуємо останні 10 значень
    moving_averages.last(10).each do |ma|
      printf "%-12s %-10.2f %-15.2f\n", 
             ma[:date].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), 
             ma[:price], 
             ma[:moving_average]
    end
    
    # Додаткова аналітика
    latest_ma = moving_averages.last
    if latest_ma
      price_vs_ma = ((latest_ma[:price] - latest_ma[:moving_average]) / latest_ma[:moving_average] * 100).round(2)
      trend = price_vs_ma > 0 ? "вище" : "нижче"
      puts "\nОстання ціна #{latest_ma[:price]} #{trend} ковзного середнього на #{price_vs_ma.abs}%"
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

module Xero
  class AuthService
    def initialize
      @client = xero_client
    end
    
    # Отримання URL для авторизації
    def authorization_url
      @client.authorization_url
    end
    
    # Обмін коду авторизації на токен
    def exchange_code_for_token(code)
      tokens = @client.get_token_set(code)
      
      # Збереження токенів у базі даних
      XeroToken.create!(
        access_token: tokens[:access_token],
        refresh_token: tokens[:refresh_token],
        expires_at: Time.at(tokens[:expires_at])
      )
      
      tokens
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Xero auth error: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
    
    # Оновлення токену
    def refresh_token
      current_token = XeroToken.last
      return nil unless current_token
      
      tokens = @client.refresh_token_set(current_token.refresh_token)
      
      current_token.update!(
        access_token: tokens[:access_token],
        refresh_token: tokens[:refresh_token] || current_token.refresh_token,
        expires_at: Time.at(tokens[:expires_at])
      )
      
      tokens
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Xero token refresh error: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
    
    # Перевірка чи токен дійсний
    def token_valid?
      token = XeroToken.last
      token && token.expires_at > 1.hour.from_now
    end
  end
end

class XeroToken < ApplicationRecord
  validates :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_at, presence: true

  def self.current_token
    token = order(created_at: :desc).first
    return nil unless token

    # Refresh token if expired
    if token.expired?
      token.refresh!
      token = order(created_at: :desc).first
    end

    {
      access_token: token.access_token,
      refresh_token: token.refresh_token,
      expires_at: token.expires_at.to_i
    }
  end

  def expired?
    expires_at <= Time.current
  end

  def refresh!
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
      ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      site: 'https://identity.xero.com',
      token_url: 'connect/token'
    )

    new_token = OAuth2::AccessToken.from_hash(client, {
      refresh_token: refresh_token,
      expires_at: expires_at.to_i
    }).refresh!

    update!(
      access_token: new_token.token,
      refresh_token: new_token.refresh_token,
      expires_at: Time.at(new_token.expires_at)
    )
  rescue OAuth2::Error => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to refresh Xero token: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end

  def self.set_token(token_set)
    create!(
      access_token: token_set[:access_token],
      refresh_token: token_set[:refresh_token],
      expires_at: Time.at(token_set[:expires_at])
    )
  end
end

  rescue => e

class CheckboxReceiptIssuer
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.checkbox.in.ua/api/v1'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['CHECKBOX_API_KEY']
    @cashier_id = ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ID']
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-License-Key' => ENV['CHECKBOX_LICENSE_KEY']
    }
  end

  def create_receipt(payment_data)
    receipt_data = build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/sell",
      headers: @headers,
      body: receipt_data.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    {
      goods: build_goods(payment_data[:items]),
      payments: build_payments(payment_data[:payment_info]),
      # Optional fields
      header: payment_data[:header] || "Online Payment Receipt",
      footer: payment_data[:footer] || "Thank you for your purchase!",
      barcode: payment_data[:order_id],
      # Cashier information
      cashier_name: payment_data[:cashier_name] || "Online System",
      departament: payment_data[:department] || "Online",
      # Transaction details
      related_receipt_id: payment_data[:related_receipt_id],
      # Fiscalization parameters
      fiscal_code: payment_data[:fiscal_code],
      fiscal_date: payment_data[:transaction_date] || Time.now.iso8601
    }.compact
  end

  def build_goods(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        good: {
          code: item[:sku] || item[:id],
          name: item[:name],
          price: item[:price],
          barcode: item[:barcode],
          tax: item[:tax_code] || []
        },
        quantity: item[:quantity],
        is_return: item[:is_return] || false
      }
    end
  end

  def build_payments(payment_info)
    [
      {
        type: map_payment_type(payment_info[:type]),
        value: payment_info[:amount],
        label: payment_info[:label] || "Online Payment",
        # Card payment details (if applicable)
        card_mask: payment_info[:card_mask],
        bank_name: payment_info[:bank_name],
        auth_code: payment_info[:auth_code],
        rrn: payment_info[:rrn],
        terminal_id: payment_info[:terminal_id]
      }.compact
    ]
  end

  def map_payment_type(type)
    # Map common payment types to Checkbox PRRO codes
    case type.to_s.downcase
    when 'card', 'credit_card', 'debit_card'
      'CARD'
    when 'cash'
      'CASH'
    when 'online', 'bank_transfer'
      'CASHLESS'
    else
      'CASHLESS' # Default for online payments
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      raise StandardError, error_message
    end
  end
end

  def create_payment(order_params)
    required_params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
      amount: order_params[:amount], # в копійках
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      server_callback_url: order_params[:callback_url]
    }
    
    # Додаємо додаткові параметри
    params = required_params.merge(order_params)
    
    # Генеруємо підпис
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    # Відправляємо запит до Fondy
    response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, {
      body: { request: params.to_json },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    })
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
  
  # Генерація підпису для запиту
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Сортуємо параметри за ключами в алфавітному порядку
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    
    # Формуємо рядок для підпису
    signature_string = @secret_key + '|' + 
                      sorted_params.map { |k, v| v.to_s }.join('|')
    
    # Обчислюємо SHA-1 хеш
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end
  
  # Перевірка підпису відповіді від Fondy
  def verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
    # Копіюємо параметри без підпису
    params_to_verify = callback_params.dup
    received_signature = params_to_verify.delete('signature')
    
    # Сортуємо параметри за ключами в алфавітному порядку
    sorted_params = params_to_verify.sort.to_h
    
    # Формуємо рядок для перевірки
    signature_string = @secret_key + '|' + 
                      sorted_params.map { |k, v| v.to_s }.join('|')
    
    # Обчислюємо очікуваний підпис
    expected_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
    
    # Порівнюємо підписи
    expected_signature == received_signature
  end
  
  # Альтернативний метод перевірки підпису (більш надійний)
  def verify_response_signature(response_data)
    # Отримуємо підпис з відповіді
    signature = response_data['signature']
    
    # Видаляємо підпис з даних для перевірки
    data_to_verify = response_data.dup
    data_to_verify.delete('signature')
    
    # Сортуємо за ключами
    sorted_data = data_to_verify.sort.to_h
    
    # Формуємо рядок для перевірки
    verification_string = sorted_data.map { |k, v| v.to_s }.join('|')
    verification_string = @secret_key + '|' + verification_string
    
    # Обчислюємо підпис
    calculated_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(verification_string)
    
    # Безпечне порівняння для уникнення timing attacks
    secure_compare(calculated_signature, signature)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Безпечне порівняння рядків (запобігає timing attacks)
  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.blank? || b.blank? || a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    
    l = a.unpack "C#{a.bytesize}"
    
    res = 0
    b.each_byte { |byte| res |= byte ^ l.shift }
    res == 0
  end

    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, SECRET_KEY, signature_string)
    
    signature
  end

  def self.verify_signature(response_params)
    # Extract signature from response
    received_signature = response_params['signature']
    
    # Remove signature from parameters for verification
    verification_params = response_params.reject { |k, _| k == 'signature' }
    
    # Sort parameters alphabetically and concatenate values with pipe separator

    # Generate expected signature
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, SECRET_KEY, signature_string)
    
    # Compare signatures
    received_signature == expected_signature

      amount: order_params[:amount], # Amount in cents

      response_url: order_params[:response_url],
      lang: order_params[:lang] || 'en'
    }

    params = required_params.merge(optional_params).compact

    # Generate signature
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)

    # Make API request to Fondy
    response = @client.post do |req|
      req.body = { request: params }.to_json
    end

    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if result['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        return result['response']['checkout_url']
      else
        raise "Fondy API Error: #{result['response']['error_message']}"
      end

require 'rqrcode'
require 'base64'

class UkrainianQRPayment
  # NBU QR payment standard structure
  PAYMENT_FIELDS = {
    version: 'VER',           # Version (always '1')
    coding: 'COD',            # Character encoding (always '1' for UTF-8)
    identification: 'ID',     # Identification (always '1' for SHA-256)
    bic: 'BIC',               # Bank BIC code (8 digits)
    bank_name: 'NAM',         # Bank name
    account: 'ACC',          # IBAN account number
    currency: 'CCY',          # Currency code (3 letters)
    amount: 'AMT',            # Amount (optional)
    purpose: 'PUR',           # Payment purpose code (4 digits)
    details: 'DET',           # Payment details
    info: 'INF',              # Additional information
    payee_name: 'NAM',        # Payee name
    payee_code: 'CDT',        # Payee identification code (EDRPOU or RNOKPP)
    payee_bank: 'BANK',       # Payee bank name
    payee_account: 'ACC',     # Payee IBAN account number
    payee_bic: 'BIC'          # Payee bank BIC
  }.freeze

  def initialize(options = {})
    @options = {
      version: '1',
      coding: '1',
      identification: '1',
      currency: 'UAH',
      purpose: '1083' # Common purpose code for goods/services
    }.merge(options)
  end

  def generate_qr_string
    fields = []

    # Required fields
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:version], @options[:version])
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:coding], @options[:coding])
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:identification], @options[:identification])
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:bic], @options[:bic])
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:bank_name], @options[:bank_name])
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:account], @options[:account])
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:currency], @options[:currency])
    
    # Optional fields (only include if provided)
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:amount], @options[:amount]) if @options[:amount]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:purpose], @options[:purpose]) if @options[:purpose]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:details], @options[:details]) if @options[:details]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:info], @options[:info]) if @options[:info]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:payee_name], @options[:payee_name]) if @options[:payee_name]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:payee_code], @options[:payee_code]) if @options[:payee_code]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:payee_bank], @options[:payee_bank]) if @options[:payee_bank]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:payee_account], @options[:payee_account]) if @options[:payee_account]
    fields << format_field(PAYMENT_FIELDS[:payee_bic], @options[:payee_bic]) if @options[:payee_bic]

    fields.join('|')
  end

  def generate_qr_code(size: 300, file_path: nil)
    qr_string = generate_qr_string
    
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string, level: :m)
    
    if file_path
      # Save as PNG file
      png = qr.as_png(
        resize_gte_to: false,
        resize_exactly_to: false,
        fill: 'white',
        color: 'black',
        size: size,
        border_modules: 4,
        module_px_size: 6,
        file: file_path
      )
      puts "QR code saved to: #{file_path}"
    end
    
    qr
  end

  def generate_qr_base64(size: 300)
    qr_string = generate_qr_string
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string, level: :m)
    
    png = qr.as_png(
      resize_gte_to: false,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      fill: 'white',
      color: 'black',
      size: size,
      border_modules: 4,
      module_px_size: 6
    )
    
    Base64.strict_encode64(png.to_s)
  end

  private

  def format_field(key, value)
    "#{key}:#{value}"
  end
end

  def initialize(public_key = nil, private_key = nil)
    @public_key = public_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']
    @private_key = private_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    
    validate_credentials
    
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: @public_key,
      private_key: @private_key
    )
  end

    validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    
    # Prepare the payout parameters
    params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: options[:description] || 'P2P Credit Payout',
      order_id: options[:order_id] || generate_order_id,
      receiver_card: format_card_number(card_number),
      receiver_first_name: extract_first_name(recipient_name),
      receiver_last_name: extract_last_name(recipient_name)
    }
    
    # Optional parameters
    params[:ip] = options[:ip] if options[:ip]
    params[:phone] = options[:phone] if options[:phone]
    params[:card] = options[:sender_card] if options[:sender_card] # Sender's card (if needed)
    
    begin
      puts "Sending P2P payout request..."
      puts "Recipient: #{recipient_name}"
      puts "Card: #{mask_card_number(card_number)}"
      puts "Amount: #{amount} #{currency}"
      
      # Send the request to LiqPay API
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error occurred: #{e.message}"
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def check_payout_status(order_id)
    params = {
      action: 'status',
      version: '3',
      order_id: order_id
    }
    
    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      response
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    unless @public_key && @private_key
      raise ArgumentError, "LiqPay credentials not found. Please set LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY and LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY environment variables."
    end
  end

  def validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be positive" unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise ArgumentError, "Currency is required" if currency.to_s.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Card number is required" if card_number.to_s.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipient name is required" if recipient_name.to_s.empty?
    
    # Validate Ukrainian card format (16 digits, starts with 4)
    unless card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '') =~ /^4\d{15}$/
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid Ukrainian card number format"
    end

    card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
  end

  end

      { success: false, error: response['err_description'], status: response['status'] }
    when 'try_again'
      puts "⚠️  Please try again: #{response['err_description']}"
      { success: false, error: response['err_description'], status: response['status'] }
    else
      puts "⏳ Payout processing: #{response['status']}"
      { success: nil, status: response['status'], order_id: response['order_id'] }
    end
  end

require 'rqrcode'

class NBUQRGenerator
  # Стандартні коди для полів за стандартом НБУ
  FIELD_CODES = {
    version: '001',
    encoding: '1',
    beneficiary_name: '01',
    beneficiary_account: '02',
    beneficiary_bank_code: '03',
    payment_purpose: '04',
    amount: '05',
    currency: '06',
    payment_details: '07',
    reserved: '08',
    edrpou: '09',
    payment_id: '10'
  }.freeze

  CURRENCY_CODES = {
    uah: '980',
    usd: '840',
    eur: '978'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(options = {})
    @options = {
      version: '001',
      encoding: '1',
      currency: :uah
    }.merge(options)
  end

  def generate_qr_string(payment_data)
    fields = []

    # Обов'язкові поля
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:version], @options[:version])
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:encoding], @options[:encoding])
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:beneficiary_name], payment_data[:beneficiary_name])
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:beneficiary_account], payment_data[:beneficiary_account])
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:beneficiary_bank_code], payment_data[:beneficiary_bank_code])
    
    # Опціональні поля
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:payment_purpose], payment_data[:payment_purpose]) if payment_data[:payment_purpose]
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:amount], format_amount(payment_data[:amount])) if payment_data[:amount]
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:currency], CURRENCY_CODES[@options[:currency]]) if @options[:currency]
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:payment_details], payment_data[:payment_details]) if payment_data[:payment_details]
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:edrpou], payment_data[:edrpou]) if payment_data[:edrpou]
    fields << format_field(FIELD_CODES[:payment_id], payment_data[:payment_id]) if payment_data[:payment_id]

    fields.join
  end

  def generate_qr_code(payment_data, options = {})
    qr_string = generate_qr_string(payment_data)
    
    qr_options = {
      size: 12,
      level: :h, # high error correction
      mode: :byte_8bit
    }.merge(options)

    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string, qr_options)
    
    qrcode
  end

  def save_qr_as_png(payment_data, filename, options = {})
    qrcode = generate_qr_code(payment_data, options)
    
    png_options = {
      fill: 'white',
      color: 'black',
      size: 300,
      border_modules: 4,
      module_px_size: 6
    }.merge(options[:png] || {})

    png = qrcode.as_png(png_options)
    png.save(filename)
    
    puts "QR-код збережено як: #{filename}"
  end

  def display_qr_in_terminal(payment_data, options = {})
    qrcode = generate_qr_code(payment_data, options)
    
    # Вивід QR-коду в термінал (для тестування)
    puts qrcode.as_ansi(
      light: "\033[47m", 
      dark: "\033[40m",
      fill_character: "  ",
      quiet_zone_size: 1
    )
  end

  private

  def format_field(code, value)
    # Формат: [довжина][код поля][значення]
    value_str = value.to_s
    length = value_str.length.to_s.rjust(2, '0')
    "#{length}#{code}#{value_str}"
  end

  def format_amount(amount)
    # Форматування суми (копійки відокремлюються крапкою)
    if amount.is_a?(Float)
      sprintf('%.2f', amount)
    else
      sprintf('%.2f', amount.to_f)
    end
  end
end

  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(private_key: private_key, public_key: public_key)
  end

  # Make a P2P payout to a Ukrainian card
  # @param amount [Float] - amount to pay (in UAH)
  # @param card_number [String] - recipient's card number (without spaces)
  # @param recipient_name [String] - full name of the recipient
  # @param description [String] - payment description
  # @return [Hash] - API response
  def payout(amount:, card_number:, recipient_name:, description: "P2P Payout")
    # LiqPay expects amount as string with 2 decimal places
    amount_str = "%.2f" % amount
    
    # Generate unique order ID
    order_id = generate_order_id
    
    # Prepare payment parameters
    params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key,
      amount: amount_str,
      currency: 'UAH',
      description: description,
      order_id: order_id,
      receiver_card: format_card_number(card_number),
      receiver_last_name: extract_last_name(recipient_name),
      receiver_first_name: extract_first_name(recipient_name)
    }
    
    # Make the API request
    response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
    
    # Parse and return the response
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Check payment status
  # @param order_id [String] - order ID to check
  # @return [Hash] - status response
  def check_status(order_id)
    params = {
      action: 'status',
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key,
      order_id: order_id
    }
    
    response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def generate_order_id
    "p2p_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
  end

  def format_card_number(card_number)
    # Remove any spaces or dashes and ensure it's a string
    card_number.to_s.gsub(/[\s-]/, '')
  end

  def extract_first_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').first
  end

  def extract_last_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').last
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    # LiqPay returns a string that needs to be parsed as JSON
    if response.is_a?(String)
      JSON.parse(response)
    else
      response
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { 'error' => 'Failed to parse response', 'raw_response' => response }
  end
end

class LiqPayPayout
  def initialize(public_key = nil, private_key = nil)
    @public_key = public_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']

    )

  def payout_to_card(amount, currency, card_number, receiver_name, options = {})
    validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, receiver_name)
    
    request_params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: options[:description] || 'P2P Credit Payment',
      order_id: options[:order_id] || generate_order_id,
      receiver_card: sanitize_card_number(card_number),
      receiver_first_name: extract_first_name(receiver_name),
      receiver_last_name: extract_last_name(receiver_name)
    }

    # Додаткові параметри
    request_params[:ip] = options[:ip] if options[:ip]
    request_params[:phone] = options[:phone] if options[:phone]
    request_params[:email] = options[:email] if options[:email]

    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', request_params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: "API Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу транзакції
  def check_status(order_id)
    return { success: false, error: 'Order ID is required' } unless order_id

    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', {
        action: 'status',
        version: '3',
        order_id: order_id
      })
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: "API Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    unless @public_key && @private_key
      raise ArgumentError, 'LiqPay credentials are missing. Set LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY and LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY environment variables'
    end
  end

  def validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, receiver_name)
    raise ArgumentError, 'Amount must be positive' unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise ArgumentError, 'Currency is required' unless currency
    raise ArgumentError, 'Card number is required' unless card_number
    raise ArgumentError, 'Receiver name is required' unless receiver_name
    
    # Базова валідація номера картки (16 цифр)
    clean_card = sanitize_card_number(card_number)
    raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid card number' unless clean_card.length.between?(16, 19)
  end

  def sanitize_card_number(card_number)
    card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
  end

  end

    "p2p_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

        order_id: response['order_id'],
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        response: response
      }
    end

require 'sinatra'

class PrivatBankInstallmentPayment
  # PrivatBank API endpoints
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
  end
  
  # Generate payment signature
  def generate_signature(data_string)
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', @merchant_password, data_string)
  end
  
  # Create installment payment order
  def create_payment_order(order_params)
    # Required parameters for installment payment
    required_params = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: order_params[:order_id],
      amount: order_params[:amount],
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      details: order_params[:description],
      payWay: 'privatParts', # Specify installment payment method
      merchantType: 'internet',
      period: order_params[:period] || 3, # Default 3 months
      product: order_params[:product_info] || 'Online purchase'
    }
    
    # Generate data string for signature
    data_string = required_params.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    required_params[:signature] = generate_signature(data_string)
    
    # Make API request to create payment
    begin
      response = RestClient.post(
        "#{API_BASE_URL}/pay_pb",
        required_params.to_json,
        content_type: :json,
        accept: :json
      )
      
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    rescue RestClient::Exception => e
      { error: "API Error: #{e.response}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Verify payment status
  def check_payment_status(order_id)
    data_string = "merchantId=#{@merchant_id}&orderId=#{order_id}"
    signature = generate_signature(data_string)
    
    params = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: order_id,
      signature: signature
    }
    
    begin
      response = RestClient.post(
        "#{API_BASE_URL}/check_pay_pb",
        params.to_json,
        content_type: :json,
        accept: :json
      )
      
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    rescue RestClient::Exception => e
      { error: "API Error: #{e.response}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Handle callback from PrivatBank
  def handle_callback(callback_data)
    # Verify callback signature
    expected_signature = callback_data['signature']
    callback_data_without_signature = callback_data.reject { |k, _| k == 'signature' }
    
    data_string = callback_data_without_signature.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.sort.join('&')
    actual_signature = generate_signature(data_string)
    
    if actual_signature == expected_signature
      # Signature is valid, process the callback
      process_payment_callback(callback_data)
    else
      { error: 'Invalid signature' }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_payment_callback(callback_data)
    # Process payment callback based on status
    case callback_data['state']
    when 'approved'
      # Payment approved, update order status
      update_order_status(callback_data['orderId'], 'approved')
    when 'declined'
      # Payment declined
      update_order_status(callback_data['orderId'], 'declined')
    when 'expired'
      # Payment expired
      update_order_status(callback_data['orderId'], 'expired')
    else
      # Unknown status
      { error: "Unknown payment status: #{callback_data['state']}" }
    end
  end

    # This should update your database or order management system
    puts "Order #{order_id} status updated to: #{status}"
    { success: true, order_id: order_id, status: status }
  end

First, create a new file `config/initializers/carrierwave.rb` to configure CarrierWave:
```ruby
# config/initializers/carrierwave.rb
CarrierWave.configure do |config|
  config.fog_provider = 'AWS'
  config.fog_credentials = {
    provider: 'AWS',
    aws_access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
    aws_secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'],
    region: ENV['AWS_REGION']
  }

end

### Uploader Class

Next, create an uploader class `product_image_uploader.rb`:
```ruby
# app/uploaders/product_image_uploader.rb
class ProductImageUploader < CarrierWave::Uploader::Base
  include CarrierWave::MiniMagick

  storage :fog

  def store_dir
    "product_images/#{model.id}"
  end

  def extension_whitelist
    %w(jpg jpeg gif png)
  end

  def default_url(*args)
    # For Rails 5.2+
    ActionController::Base.helpers.asset_path("fallback/" + [version_name, "default.png"].compact.join("_"))
  end

  # Generate thumbnails
  version :thumb do
    process resize_to_fit: [200, 200]
  end

  version :small do
    process resize_to_fit: [400, 400]
  end
end
```

require 'httparty'

  base_uri 'https://api.etsy.com/v3'

    @api_secret = api_secret
    @access_token = access_token
  end

    self.class.get('/public/listings/active', headers: {
      'x-api-key' => @api_key,
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    })
  end

  def get_orders
    self.class.get('/shops/123456/orders', headers: {
      'x-api-key' => @api_key,
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    })
  end
end

# lib/product_image_uploader.rb
require 'rmagick'
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'cloudinary'

class ProductImageUploader
  def initialize(image, product_id)
    @image = image
    @product_id = product_id
  end

  def upload
    # Upload image to S3
    s3_object = S3_CLIENT.put_object(
      bucket: S3_BUCKET,
      key: "products/#{@product_id}/#{@image.original_filename}",
      body: @image
    )

    # Generate thumbnail
    thumbnail = generate_thumbnail(@image)

    # Upload thumbnail to S3
    s3_object = S3_CLIENT.put_object(
      bucket: S3_BUCKET,
      key: "products/#{@product_id}/#{@image.original_filename}_thumb",
      body: thumbnail
    )

    # Upload image to Cloudinary
    cloudinary_image = Cloudinary::Uploader.upload(
      @image.path,
      public_id: "products/#{@product_id}/#{@image.original_filename}",
      eager: [
        { width: 200, height: 200, crop: 'fill' }
      ]
    )

    # Return the URL of the uploaded image
    cloudinary_image['secure_url']
  end

  private

  def generate_thumbnail(image)
    # Use RMagick to generate a thumbnail
    img = Magick::Image.read(image.path).first
    img.resize_to_fit(200, 200)
    img.to_blob
  end
end

  has_one_attached :image

  after_save :upload_image

  private

  def upload_image
    return unless image.attached?

    uploader = ProductImageUploader.new(image, id)
    image_url = uploader.upload

    # Update the product with the image URL
    update(image_url: image_url)
  end
end

require 'aws-sdk-s3'

class ImageUploader
  def initialize(bucket_name, cdn_url)
    @bucket_name = bucket_name
    @cdn_url = cdn_url
    @s3 = Aws::S3::Client.new(
      region: 'your-region', # замінити на свій регіон
      credentials: Aws::Credentials.new('your-access-key', 'your-secret-key') # замінити на свої дані
    )
    @fog = Fog::Storage.new(
      provider: 'AWS',
      aws_access_key_id: 'your-access-key',
      aws_secret_access_key: 'your-secret-key'
    )
  end

  def upload_image(image_path, image_name)
    # Завантаження зображення до S3
    obj = @s3.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: image_name,
      body: File.open(image_path, 'rb')
    )

    # Генерація мініатюри
    image = Magick::Image.read(image_path).first
    thumbnail = image.resize_to_fit(100, 100)
    thumbnail.write("thumbnail_#{image_name}")

    # Завантаження мініатюри до S3
    @s3.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: "thumbnail_#{image_name}",
      body: File.open("thumbnail_#{image_name}", 'rb')
    )

    # Віддавання зображення через CDN
    @fog.put_object(
      @bucket_name,
      image_name,
      File.open(image_path, 'rb'),
      public: true
    )

    # Віддавання мініатюри через CDN
    @fog.put_object(
      @bucket_name,
      "thumbnail_#{image_name}",
      File.open("thumbnail_#{image_name}", 'rb'),
      public: true
    )

    # Повернення URL зображення і мініатюри
    {
      image_url: "#{@cdn_url}/#{image_name}",
      thumbnail_url: "#{@cdn_url}/thumbnail_#{image_name}"
    }
  end
end
```

class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :cart_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :items, through: :cart_items

  def add_item(item)
    cart_items.create(item: item)
  end

  def remove_item(item)
    cart_items.find_by(item: item)&.destroy
  end

  def total_price
    cart_items.sum { |cart_item| cart_item.item.price }
  end

  def apply_coupon(coupon)
    coupon.apply(self)
  end

# app/models/coupon.rb
class Coupon < ApplicationRecord
  def apply(cart)
    if self.percentage_discount?
      cart.total_price * (1 - self.discount_amount / 100)
    else
      cart.total_price - self.discount_amount
    end
  end

  def percentage_discount?
    self.discount_type == 'percentage'
  end
end

We will use a simple collaborative filtering algorithm, which recommends products to a customer based on the products purchased by other customers with similar purchase history. We will use a matrix to represent the customer-product interactions.

```ruby
# Import necessary libraries
require 'mysql2'
require 'active_record'
require 'matrix'

# Connect to the database
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'mysql2',
  host: 'localhost',
  database: 'orders',
  username: 'root',
  password: 'password'
)

# Define the Customer and Product models
class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
end

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
end

class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :customer
  belongs_to :product
end

# Define a class for collaborative filtering
class CollaborativeFiltering
  def initialize(customers, products)
    @customers = customers
    @products = products
    @matrix = build_matrix
  end

  # Build a matrix representing customer-product interactions
  def build_matrix
    matrix = Matrix.build(@customers.size, @products.size) { 0 }
    @customers.each_with_index do |customer, i|
      customer.orders.each do |order|
        product_index = @products.find_index { |p| p.id == order.product_id }
        matrix[i, product_index] = 1
      end
    end
    matrix
  end

  # Calculate the similarity between two customers
  def similarity(customer1, customer2)
    vector1 = @matrix.row(@customers.find_index { |c| c.id == customer1.id })
    vector2 = @matrix.row(@customers.find_index { |c| c.id == customer2.id })
    dot_product = vector1.dot(vector2)
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vector1.map { |x| x ** 2 }.sum)
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vector2.map { |x| x ** 2 }.sum)
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  # Recommend products to a customer based on similar customers
  def recommend(customer, num_recommendations)
    similar_customers = @customers.sort_by { |c| similarity(customer, c) }.reverse
    recommended_products = []
    similar_customers.each do |similar_customer|
      similar_customer.orders.each do |order|
        unless customer.orders.any? { |o| o.product_id == order.product_id }
          recommended_products << order.product
        end
      end
      break if recommended_products.size >= num_recommendations
    end
    recommended_products.take(num_recommendations)
  end
end

# Example usage
customers = Customer.all
products = Product.all
cf = CollaborativeFiltering.new(customers, products)
customer = Customer.find(1)
recommended_products = cf.recommend(customer, 5)
puts "Recommended products for customer #{customer.id}:"
recommended_products.each do |product|
  puts product.name
end
```

This implementation assumes that you have a database with `customers`, `products`, and `orders` tables, and that you have already set up the necessary associations between these tables. The `CollaborativeFiltering` class builds a matrix representing customer-product interactions, calculates the similarity between customers, and recommends products to a customer based on similar customers. The example usage at the end shows how to use this class to recommend products to a customer.

        length: package[:length],
        width: package[:width],
        height: package[:height]
      }
    }

    # Send request to create shipment
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, headers: headers, body: shipment_data.to_json)

    # Check if shipment was created successfully

require 'matrix'
require 'csv'
require 'pp'
require 'ruby-progressbar'

# Завантаження даних про замовлення клієнтів
def load_orders(file_name)
  orders = {}
  CSV.foreach(file_name, headers: true) do |row|
    client_id = row['client_id'].to_i
    product_id = row['product_id'].to_i
    orders[client_id] ||= []
    orders[client_id] << product_id
  end
  orders
end

# Обчислення подібності між клієнтами за допомогою косинуса кута
def cosine_similarity(vector1, vector2)
  dot_product = vector1.dot(vector2)
  magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vector1.dot(vector1))
  magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vector2.dot(vector2))
  dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
end

# Отримання рекомендацій для клієнта
def get_recommendations(orders, client_id, num_recommendations)
  # Створення матриці замовлень
  matrix = []
  clients = orders.keys
  products = orders.values.flatten.uniq
  clients.each do |client|
    row = []
    products.each do |product|
      row << (orders[client].include?(product) ? 1 : 0)
    end
    matrix << row
  end

  # Обчислення подібності між клієнтом і іншими клієнтами
  similarities = []
  clients.each_with_index do |other_client, index|
    next if other_client == client_id
    vector1 = Matrix[orders[client_id]]
    vector2 = Matrix[orders[other_client]]
    similarity = cosine_similarity(vector1, vector2)
    similarities << [other_client, similarity]
  end

  # Сортування клієнтів за подібністю
  similarities.sort_by! { |_, similarity| -similarity }

  # Отримання рекомендацій
  recommendations = []
  similarities.each do |other_client, _|
    orders[other_client].each do |product|
      next if orders[client_id].include?(product)
      recommendations << product
    end
  end

  # Видалення дублікатів і сортування рекомендацій
  recommendations.uniq!
  recommendations.sort!

  # Повернення перших N рекомендацій
  recommendations.first(num_recommendations)
end

# Завантаження даних про замовлення клієнтів
orders = load_orders('orders.csv')

# Отримання рекомендацій для клієнта з ID 1
client_id = 1
num_recommendations = 3
recommendations = get_recommendations(orders, client_id, num_recommendations)

# Виведення рекомендацій
pp "Рекомендації для клієнта з ID #{client_id}: #{recommendations}"
```

Below is a basic implementation of a collaborative filtering system using Ruby. This system will recommend products to a customer based on the products they have ordered in the past.

### Model Definitions

First, we need to define our models. We will have a `Customer`, `Product`, and `Order` model.

```ruby
# models/customer.rb
class Customer
  attr_accessor :id, :name, :orders

  def initialize(id, name)
    @id = id
    @name = name
    @orders = []
  end

  def add_order(order)
    @orders << order
  end
end

# models/product.rb
class Product
  attr_accessor :id, :name

  def initialize(id, name)
  @id = id
  @name = name
  end
end

# models/order.rb
class Order
  attr_accessor :id, :customer, :product

  def initialize(id, customer, product)
    @id = id
    @customer = customer
    @product = product
  end
end
```

### Collaborative Filtering

Next, we will implement the collaborative filtering system. This system will calculate the similarity between customers based on their past orders.

```ruby
# collaborative_filtering.rb
require 'matrix'

class CollaborativeFiltering
  def initialize(customers)
    @customers = customers
  end

  # Calculate the similarity between two customers
  def calculate_similarity(customer1, customer2)
    # Get the products ordered by both customers
    common_products = customer1.orders.map(&:product).intersection(customer2.orders.map(&:product))

    # Calculate the similarity using Jaccard similarity
    similarity = common_products.size.to_f / (customer1.orders.size + customer2.orders.size - common_products.size)
    similarity
  end

  # Get the recommended products for a customer
  def get_recommendations(customer)
    # Get all other customers
    other_customers = @customers.reject { |c| c.id == customer.id }

    # Calculate the similarity between the customer and all other customers
    similarities = other_customers.map do |other_customer|
      [other_customer, calculate_similarity(customer, other_customer)]
    end

    # Sort the similarities in descending order
    similarities.sort_by! { |_, similarity| -similarity }

    # Get the top N similar customers
    top_similar_customers = similarities.take(5).map(&:first)

    # Get the products ordered by the top similar customers
    recommended_products = top_similar_customers.flat_map(&:orders).map(&:product).uniq

    # Remove products already ordered by the customer
    recommended_products.reject! { |product| customer.orders.any? { |order| order.product.id == product.id } }

    recommended_products
  end
end
```

### Example Usage

```ruby
# main.rb
require_relative 'customer'
require_relative 'product'
require_relative 'order'
require_relative 'collaborative_filtering'

# Create some products
product1 = Product.new(1, 'Product 1')
product2 = Product.new(2, 'Product 2')
product3 = Product.new(3, 'Product 3')
product4 = Product.new(4, 'Product 4')
product5 = Product.new(5, 'Product 5')

# Create some customers
customer1 = Customer.new(1, 'Customer 1')
customer2 = Customer.new(2, 'Customer 2')
customer3 = Customer.new(3, 'Customer 3')

# Create some orders
order1 = Order.new(1, customer1, product1)
order2 = Order.new(2, customer1, product2)
order3 = Order.new(3, customer2, product2)
order4 = Order.new(4, customer2, product3)
order5 = Order.new(5, customer3, product3)
order6 = Order.new(6, customer3, product4)

# Add orders to customers

customer1.add_order(order2)
customer2.add_order(order3)
customer2.add_order(order4)
customer3.add_order(order5)
customer3.add_order(order6)

# Create a collaborative filtering system
customers = [customer1, customer2, customer3]
collaborative_filtering = CollaborativeFiltering.new(customers)

# Get recommended products for a customer

The `CollaborativeFiltering` class calculates the similarity between customers using the Jaccard similarity metric and recommends products based on the top N similar customers.

```ruby
# app/services/recommendation_service.rb
class RecommendationService
  def initialize(client)
    @client = client
  end

  def recommend
    # Розрахунок коефіцієнта схожості для кожного клієнта
    clients_similarity = {}
    Client.all.each do |other_client|
      next if other_client == @client
      similarity = pearson_coefficient(other_client)
      clients_similarity[other_client] = similarity if similarity
    end

    # Виключення товарів, які клієнт вже замовляв
    recommended_products = []
    clients_similarity.each do |client, similarity|
      next unless similarity.positive?
      client.products.each do |product|
        recommended_products << product unless @client.products.include?(product)
      end
    end

    recommended_products.uniq
  end

  private

  def pearson_coefficient(other_client)
    # Розрахунок коефіцієнта Пірсона
    orders = @client.orders.map(&:product_id) & other_client.orders.map(&:product_id)
    return unless orders.any?

    ratings1 = orders.map { |product_id| @client.orders.find_by(product_id: product_id).rating }
    ratings2 = orders.map { |product_id| other_client.orders.find_by(product_id: product_id).rating }

    mean1 = ratings1.sum / ratings1.size.to_f
    mean2 = ratings2.sum / ratings2.size.to_f

    numerator = 0
    denominator1 = 0
    denominator2 = 0

    orders.each_with_index do |product_id, index|
      rating1 = @client.orders.find_by(product_id: product_id).rating
      rating2 = other_client.orders.find_by(product_id: product_id).rating

      numerator += (rating1 - mean1) * (rating2 - mean2)
      denominator1 += (rating1 - mean1) ** 2
      denominator2 += (rating2 - mean2) ** 2
    end

    denominator = Math.sqrt(denominator1 * denominator2)

    numerator / denominator if denominator != 0
  end
end
```

# BAS Exporter for Ukrainian businesses
require "active_support/all"
require "builder"
require "nokogiri"

# Define a class to handle BAS export
class BASExporter
  # Define the XML namespace
  NAMESPACE = "http://www.bas.ua/namespace"

  # Initialize the exporter with orders
  def initialize(orders)
    @orders = orders
  end

  # Export orders to BAS XML format
  def export
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: "1.0", encoding: "UTF-8"
    xml.tag!("Orders", xmlns: NAMESPACE) do
      @orders.each do |order|
        xml.Order do
          xml.OrderID order[:id]
          xml.CustomerName order[:customer_name]
          xml.OrderDate order[:order_date]
          xml.Total order[:total]
          xml.Items do
            order[:items].each do |item|
              xml.Item do
                xml.ItemID item[:id]
                xml.Name item[:name]
                xml.Quantity item[:quantity]
                xml.UnitPrice item[:unit_price]
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

class GlovoClient

  base_uri 'https://api.glovoapp.com'

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)

    @api_secret = api_secret
  end

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    body = {

class OrderExporter

    @bas_token = bas_token
  end

      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml'

**Implementation**

First, let's create a Rails application. Run the following command in your terminal:

Next, create a new file `config/initializers/commerce_ml.rb` with the following content:
```ruby
# config/initializers/commerce_ml.rb

require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'

class CommerceML
  def self.products_url
    'https://your-1c-enterprise-url.com/commerceml/products.xml'
  end

  def self.prices_url
    'https://your-1c-enterprise-url.com/commerceml/prices.xml'
  end

  def self.orders_url
    'https://your-1c-enterprise-url.com/commerceml/orders.xml'
  end

  def self.import_products
    response = HTTParty.get(products_url)
    xml = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    xml.css('Каталог_Товары_Товар').each do |product|
      # Create or update product in Rails shop
      product_attributes = {
        name: product.css('Наименование').text,
        description: product.css('Описание').text,
        price: product.css('Цена').text
      }
      # Save product to database
      Product.create_or_update(product_attributes)
    end
  end

  def self.import_prices
    response = HTTParty.get(prices_url)
    xml = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    xml.css('ПакетПредложений_Предложение').each do |price|
      # Update price in Rails shop
      product = Product.find_by(name: price.css('Наименование').text)
      product.update(price: price.css('Цена').text) if product
    end
  end

  def self.import_orders
    response = HTTParty.get(orders_url)
    xml = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    xml.css('Документ_Заказ').each do |order|
      # Create order in Rails shop
      order_attributes = {
        customer_name: order.css('Контрагент_Наименование').text,
        order_date: order.css('Дата').text,
        total: order.css('Сумма').text
      }
      # Save order to database
      Order.create(order_attributes)
    end
  end

  def self.export_products
    # Get products from Rails shop database
    products = Product.all
    xml = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.Каталог_Товары {
        products.each do |product|
          xml.Товар {
            xml.Наименование product.name
            xml.Описание product.description
            xml.Цена product.price
          }
        end
      }
    end
    # Send XML to 1C:Enterprise
    HTTParty.post('https://your-1c-enterprise-url.com/commerceml/import', body: xml.to_xml)
  end

  def self.export_prices
    # Get prices from Rails shop database
    prices = Product.all.map { |product| { name: product.name, price: product.price } }
    xml = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.ПакетПредложений {
        prices.each do |price|
          xml.Предложение {
            xml.Наименование price[:name]
            xml.Цена price[:price]
          }
        end
      }
    end
    # Send XML to 1C:Enterprise
    HTTParty.post('https://your-1c-enterprise-url.com/commerceml/import', body: xml.to_xml)
  end

  def self.export_orders
    # Get orders from Rails shop database
    orders = Order.all
    xml = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.Документ_Заказ {
        orders.each do |order|
          xml.Контрагент_Наименование order.customer_name
          xml.Дата order.order_date
          xml.Сумма order.total
        end
      }
    end
    # Send XML to 1C:Enterprise
    HTTParty.post('https://your-1c-enterprise-url.com/commerceml/import', body: xml.to_xml)
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class KeycrmApiClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri KEYCRM_API_URL

  def initialize
    @auth = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{KEYCRM_API_TOKEN}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    }
  end

  def get_orders
    self.class.get('/orders', @auth)
  end

  def create_order(order_data)
    self.class.post('/orders', @auth, body: order_data.to_json)
  end

  def update_order(order_id, order_data)
    self.class.put("/orders/#{order_id}", @auth, body: order_data.to_json)
  end

  def delete_order(order_id)
    self.class.delete("/orders/#{order_id}", @auth)
  end
end
```

# Import required libraries
require "json"
require "httparty"
require "docusign_esign"

# Set up DocuSign API credentials
class DocuSignConfig
  attr_accessor :account_id, :access_token, :base_path, :api_client

  def initialize
    # Replace with your own credentials
    @account_id = "YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID"
    @access_token = "YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
    @base_path = "https://www.docusign.net/restapi"
    @api_client = DocuSign::ApiClient.new
    @api_client.configure do |config|
      config.host = base_path
      config.debugging = true
      config.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    end
  end
end

# Set up the DocuSign API client
class DocuSignClient
  attr_accessor :config, :envelopes_api

  def initialize(config)
    @config = config
    @envelopes_api = DocuSign::EnvelopesApi.new(config.api_client)
  end

  # Create a new envelope with a PDF contract
  def create_envelope(contract_pdf, recipient_name, recipient_email)
    # Create a new envelope definition
    envelope_definition = DocuSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
      email_subject: "Electronic Signature Request",
      documents: [
        DocuSign::Document.new(
          document_base64: Base64.strict_encode64(contract_pdf),
          document_id: "1",
          file_extension: "pdf",
          name: "contract.pdf"
        )
      ],
      recipients: {
        signers: [
          DocuSign::Signer.new(
            email: recipient_email,
            name: recipient_name,
            recipient_id: "1",
            routing_order: "1"
          )
        ]
      },
      status: "sent"
    )

    # Create the envelope
    response = @envelopes_api.create_envelope(config.account_id, envelope_definition)

    # Get the envelope ID
    envelope_id = response.envelope_id

    # Create a signer view for the recipient
    recipient_view_request = DocuSign::RecipientViewRequest.new(
      authentication_method: "none",
      client_user_id: "1",
      email: recipient_email,
      return_url: "https://example.com",
      user_name: recipient_name
    )
    signer_view = @envelopes_api.create_recipient_view(config.account_id, envelope_id, recipient_view_request)

    # Return the envelope ID and the signer view URL
    [envelope_id, signer_view.url]
  end

  # Get the status of an envelope
  def get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    @envelopes_api.get_envelope(config.account_id, envelope_id)
  end

  # Download a completed envelope
  def download_envelope(envelope_id)
    @envelopes_api.get_document(config.account_id, envelope_id, "combined")
  end
end

# Example usage
config = DocuSignConfig.new
client = DocuSignClient.new(config)

# Load the PDF contract
contract_pdf = File.binread("path/to/contract.pdf")

# Create a new envelope with the PDF contract
envelope_id, signer_view_url = client.create_envelope(contract_pdf, "John Doe", "john.doe@example.com")

# Print the signer view URL
puts "Signer view URL: #{signer_view_url}"

# Wait for the envelope to be completed
loop do
  envelope_status = client.get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
  break if envelope_status.status == "completed"
  sleep 10
end

# Download the completed envelope
completed_envelope = client.download_envelope(envelope_id)

# Save the completed envelope to a file
File.binwrite("completed_contract.pdf", completed_envelope)
```

*   This code assumes that you have the `docusign_esign`, `json`, and `httparty` gems installed. If not, run `bundle install` to install them.
*   This code uses the DocuSign eSignature API to create a new envelope with a PDF contract, send it to a recipient for signature, and download the completed envelope when it is signed.

*   The `download_envelope` method downloads a completed envelope.

```ruby
# docusign_esign.rb
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

class DocusignEsign
  def initialize
    # Replace with your own credentials
    @integration_key = 'YOUR_INTEGRATION_KEY'
    @secret_key = 'YOUR_SECRET_KEY'
    @base_path = 'https://www.docusign.net/restapi'
    @api_version = 'v2.1'
    @access_token = get_access_token
  end

  def get_access_token
    # Get access token using OAuth2
    auth_url = 'https://account.docusign.com/oauth/token'
    auth_headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    }
    auth_params = {
      grant_type: 'client_credentials',
      client_id: @integration_key,
      client_secret: @secret_key
    }
    response = HTTParty.post(auth_url, headers: auth_headers, body: auth_params)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
  end

  def create_envelope(template_id, signer_name, signer_email, signer_role_name)
    # Create a new envelope
    url = "#{@base_path}/#{@api_version}/accounts/#{@integration_key}/envelopes"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    body = {
      'emailSubject' => 'Please sign this document',
      'templateId' => template_id,
      'templateRoles' => [
        {
          'email' => signer_email,
          'name' => signer_name,
          'roleName' => signer_role_name,
          'routingOrder' => '1',
          'tabs' => {
            'signHereTabs' => [
              {
                'anchorString' => '/sn1/',
                'anchorXOffset' => '20',
                'anchorYOffset' => '10'
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      'status' => 'sent'
    }
    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['envelopeId']
  end

  def get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    # Get the status of the envelope
    url = "#{@base_path}/#{@api_version}/accounts/#{@integration_key}/envelopes/#{envelope_id}"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['status']
  end

  def download_envelope(envelope_id)
    # Download the signed envelope
    url = "#{@base_path}/#{@api_version}/accounts/#{@integration_key}/envelopes/#{envelope_id}/documents/1"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    File.open('signed_contract.pdf', 'wb') { |f| f.write(response.body) }
  end
end

# Example usage
docusign = DocusignEsign.new
template_id = 'YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID'
signer_name = 'John Doe'
signer_email = 'john.doe@example.com'
signer_role_name = 'Signer1'

envelope_id = docusign.create_envelope(template_id, signer_name, signer_email, signer_role_name)

# Wait for the envelope to be signed
while docusign.get_envelope_status(envelope_id) != 'completed'
  sleep 60 # wait 1 minute
end

docusign.download_envelope(envelope_id)
```

Ось реалізація на Ruby для завдання конвертації валют на основі щоденних курсів Європейського центрального банку (ECB) з кешуванням на добу.

### 1. Gemfile

```ruby
