      raise
    end
  end

  # Validate invoice data before sending
  def validate_invoice_data(invoice_data)
    errors = []

    # Required fields validation
    required_fields = %w[documentId seller buyer invoiceDate invoiceNumber currencyCode amount]
    required_fields.each do |field|
      errors << "Missing required field: #{field}" if invoice_data[field].nil? || invoice_data[field].to_s.empty?
    end

    # Date validation
    if invoice_data[:invoiceDate]
      begin
        Date.parse(invoice_data[:invoiceDate])
      rescue ArgumentError
        errors << "Invalid invoiceDate format"
      end
    end

    # Amount validation
    if invoice_data[:amount]
      begin
        amount = BigDecimal(invoice_data[:amount].to_s)
        errors << "Amount must be positive" if amount <= 0
      rescue ArgumentError
        errors << "Invalid amount format"
      end
    end

    # Currency validation
    if invoice_data[:currencyCode]
      valid_currencies = %w[UAH USD EUR]
      errors << "Invalid currency code" unless valid_currencies.include?(invoice_data[:currencyCode])
    end

    errors
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      @logger.info("API request successful: #{response.code}")
      response.parsed_response
    when 400
      @logger.error("Bad request: #{response.body}")
      raise "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      @logger.error("Unauthorized: Invalid API key")
      raise "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 404
      @logger.error("Not Found: Resource not found")
      raise "Not Found: Resource not found"
    when 500..599

      raise "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      @logger.warn("Unexpected response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      raise "Unexpected response: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# tax_calculator.rb
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'active_support/core_ext/numeric/conversions'

class SoleProprietorTaxCalculator
  # Tax rates for 3rd group sole proprietors
  TAX_RATE = 0.05 # 5% tax rate
  ESV_RATE = 0.025 # 2.5% ESV rate
  
  # Minimum taxable income for 3rd group
  MINIMUM_INCOME = 10000 # UAH
  
  def initialize(income, quarter_months = 3)
    @income = BigDecimal(income.to_s)
    @quarter_months = quarter_months
  end
  
  def calculate_quarterly_tax
    # Calculate quarterly income
    quarterly_income = @income
    
    # Apply minimum income rule (if income is less than minimum, use minimum)
    taxable_income = [quarterly_income, MINIMUM_INCOME].max
    
    # Calculate tax
    tax_amount = (taxable_income * TAX_RATE).round(2)
    
    # Calculate ESV
    esv_amount = (taxable_income * ESV_RATE).round(2)
    
    {
      quarterly_income: quarterly_income,
      taxable_income: taxable_income,
      tax: tax_amount,
      esv: esv_amount,
      total_deductions: (tax_amount + esv_amount).round(2)
    }
  end
  
  def calculate_monthly_breakdown
    monthly_income = (@income / @quarter_months).round(2)
    monthly_tax = (monthly_income * TAX_RATE).round(2)
    monthly_esv = (monthly_income * ESV_RATE).round(2)
    
    {
      monthly_income: monthly_income,
      monthly_tax: monthly_tax,
      monthly_esv: monthly_esv
    }
  end
  
  def get_summary
    quarterly_data = calculate_quarterly_tax
    monthly_data = calculate_monthly_breakdown
    
    {
      quarterly: quarterly_data,
      monthly: monthly_data
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'rqrcode'
require 'mini_magick'

# Функція для генерації QR-коду за стандартом НБУ
def generate_nbu_payment_qr(amount, recipient_name, recipient_iban, purpose = "")
  # Валідація даних
  raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be a number" unless amount.is_a?(Numeric)
  raise ArgumentError, "IBAN must be a string" unless recipient_iban.is_a?(String)
  raise ArgumentError, "Recipient name must be a string" unless recipient_name.is_a?(String)

  # Створюємо текстовий рядок за форматом НБУ
  qr_data = "ua:pay:sb:1.01#{amount};#{recipient_name};#{recipient_iban};#{purpose}"

  # Генеруємо QR-код
  qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_data, size: 10, level: :h)

  # Виводимо QR-код у вигляді тексту (для демонстрації)
  puts qr.to_ascii

  # Якщо потрібно зберегти як зображення:
  png = qr.to_img.resize('300x300').to_blob
  File.open("payment_qr.png", 'wb') { |f| f.write(png) }
  puts "QR-код збережено як payment_qr.png"
end

# Приклад використання

  amount: 100.50,
  recipient_name: "Іван Петренко",
  recipient_iban: "UA213000000000000000000000001",
  purpose: "Оплата послуг"
)
```

```ruby
require 'csv'
require 'date'

class BankStatementImporter
  # Категорії транзакцій
  CATEGORIES = {
    'Продукти' => %w[продукти супермаркет],
    'Транспорт' => %w[таксі маршрутка],
    'Розваги' => %w[кінотеатр],
    'Оплата послуг' => %w[зв'язок комунальні],
    'Зарплата' => %w[зарплата],
    'Інші' => []
  }.freeze

  def initialize(csv_file_path)
    @csv_file_path = csv_file_path
    @transactions = []
  end

  def import
    CSV.foreach(@csv_file_path, headers: true, encoding: 'UTF-8') do |row|
      transaction = parse_transaction(row)
      @transactions << transaction
    end
  end

  def categorize_transactions
    @transactions.map do |tx|
      tx[:category] = categorize(tx[:description])
      tx
    end
  end

  def print_summary
    @transactions.each do |tx|
      puts "#{tx[:date]} | #{tx[:description]} | #{tx[:amount]} | #{tx[:category]}"
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_transaction(row)
    {
      date: Date.parse(row['Дата']),
      description: row['Опис'],
      amount: row['Сума'].to_f,
      currency: row['Валюта']
    }
  end

  def categorize(description)
    description = description.downcase
    CATEGORIES.each do |category, keywords|
      return category if keywords.any? { |word| description.include?(word) }
    end
    'Інші'
  end
end

  importer = BankStatementImporter.new('privatbank_statement.csv')
  importer.import
  categorized = importer.categorize_transactions
  importer.print_summary
end
```

```ruby
# app/services/shopify_sync_service.rb
class ShopifySyncService
  attr_reader :shopify_site, :access_token

  def initialize(shopify_site = nil, access_token = nil)
    @shopify_site = shopify_site || ShopifyAPI::Session.new(
      Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:shop],
      Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:access_token]
    )
    @access_token = access_token || Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:access_token]
  end

  def sync_products
    products = fetch_all_products
    products.each do |product_data|
      sync_product(product_data)
    end
    Rails.logger.info "Synced #{products.length} products from Shopify"
  end

  def sync_inventory_levels
    inventory_items = fetch_all_inventory_items
    inventory_items.each do |inventory_item|
      sync_inventory_level(inventory_item)
    end
    Rails.logger.info "Synced #{inventory_items.length} inventory levels from Shopify"
  end

  def sync_all
    sync_products
    sync_inventory_levels
    Rails.logger.info "Full sync completed"
  end

  private

  def fetch_all_products
    ShopifyAPI::Product.all
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error fetching products: #{e.message}"
    []
  end

  def fetch_all_inventory_items
    ShopifyAPI::InventoryItem.all
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error fetching inventory items: #{e.message}"
    []
  end

  def sync_product(product_data)
    product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(shopify_id: product_data.id)
    product.update!(

        )
      end
    end
  end
```

```ruby
class IPayClient

  end

    response = self.class.post('/transactions', {
      body: {
        merchant_id: ENV['IPAY_MERCHANT_ID'],
        api_key: ENV['IPAY_API_KEY'],

  end

        api_key: ENV['IPAY_API_KEY']
      }

  end
```

# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

# Configure logger
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Portmone API configuration

PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID = ENV['PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID'] || 'YOUR_MERCHANT_ID'
PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY = ENV['PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY'] || 'YOUR_SECRET_KEY'

# Payment status constants
PAYMENT_STATUS_SUCCESS = 'success'
PAYMENT_STATUS_FAILED = 'failed'
PAYMENT_STATUS_PENDING = 'pending'

# Payment data structure
class Payment
  attr_accessor :id, :amount, :description, :currency, :redirect_url, :status, :created_at

  def initialize(id, amount, description, currency, redirect_url)
    @id = id
    @amount = amount
    @description = description
    @currency = currency
    @redirect_url = redirect_url
    @status = PAYMENT_STATUS_PENDING
    @created_at = Time.now
  end

  def to_hash
    {
      id: @id,
      amount: @amount,
      description: @description,
      currency: @currency,
      redirect_url: @redirect_url,
      status: @status,
      created_at: @created_at
    }
  end
end

# Store payments in memory (in production, use a database)
$payments = {}

# Helper method to generate unique payment ID
def generate_payment_id
  "pay_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
end

# Helper method to sign request data
def sign_request(data, secret_key)
  require 'openssl'
  OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', secret_key, data)
end

# Create payment link
def create_payment_link(amount, description, currency = 'UAH', return_url = nil)
  payment_id = generate_payment_id
  
  # Create payment object
  payment = Payment.new(
    payment_id,
    amount,
    description,
    currency,
    return_url
  )
  
  $payments[payment_id] = payment
  
  # Prepare data for Portmone API
  data = {
    merchant_id: PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID,
    amount: amount,
    currency: currency,
    description: description,
    order_id: payment_id,
    return_url: return_url || 'https://yourdomain.com/payment/success',
    cancel_url: 'https://yourdomain.com/payment/cancel',
    notification_url: 'https://yourdomain.com/payment/callback'
  }
  
  # Sign the request
  data_to_sign = data.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
  signature = sign_request(data_to_sign, PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY)
  
  # Make API request to Portmone
  headers = {
    'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    'Accept' => 'application/json'
  }
  
  payload = {
    merchant_id: PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID,
    amount: amount,
    currency: currency,
    description: description,
    order_id: payment_id,
    return_url: data[:return_url],
    cancel_url: data[:cancel_url],
    notification_url: data[:notification_url],
    signature: signature
  }
  
  begin
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{PORTMONE_API_URL}/payment/create",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    logger.info("Payment link creation response: #{response.body}")
    
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      payment.redirect_url = result['payment_url'] if result['payment_url']
      return payment
    else
      logger.error("Payment creation failed: #{response.body}")
      return nil
    end
  rescue => e
    logger.error("Exception during payment creation: #{e.message}")
    return nil
  end
end

# Process callback from Portmone
def process_callback(params)
  logger.info("Processing callback: #{params}")
  
  # Extract payment details
  payment_id = params['order_id']
  status = params['status']
  signature = params['signature']
  
  # Verify signature
  expected_signature = sign_request(
    "merchant_id=#{PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID}&order_id=#{payment_id}&status=#{status}",
    PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY
  )
  
  if signature != expected_signature
    logger.error("Invalid signature in callback")
    return false
  end
  
  # Update payment status
  payment = $payments[payment_id]
  if payment
    payment.status = case status
                     when 'success'
                       PAYMENT_STATUS_SUCCESS
                     when 'failed'
                       PAYMENT_STATUS_FAILED
                     else
                       PAYMENT_STATUS_PENDING
                     end
    
    logger.info("Payment #{payment_id} status updated to #{payment.status}")
    return true
  else
    logger.error("Payment #{payment_id} not found")
    return false
  end
end

## Implementation

### lib/ukrainian_payment_qr.rb

```ruby
# lib/ukrainian_payment_qr.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

class UkrainianPaymentQR
  # Payment QR code format according to NBU standard
  PAYMENT_QR_CODE_FORMAT = "QR%02d".freeze
  
  # Required fields according to NBU standard
  REQUIRED_FIELDS = %i[
    recipient_name
    recipient_iban
    amount
    purpose
    recipient_bank_code
    recipient_branch_code
  ].freeze
  
  # Field codes according to NBU standard
  FIELD_CODES = {
    recipient_name: '01',
    recipient_iban: '02',
    amount: '03',
    purpose: '04',
    recipient_bank_code: '05',
    recipient_branch_code: '06',
    recipient_city: '07',
    recipient_address: '08',
    receiver_id: '09',
    payment_type: '10',
    currency: '11',
    payment_date: '12',
    recipient_phone: '13'
  }.freeze

  attr_reader :fields

  def initialize(fields = {})
    @fields = fields.dup
    validate_fields!
  end

  def generate_qr_code(size: 300)
    qr_text = build_qr_text
    QRCode::QRCode.new(qr_text, size: size)
  end

  def to_svg(size: 300)
    qr = generate_qr_code(size: size)
    qr.to_svg
  end

  def to_png(size: 300, margin: 1)
    qr = generate_qr_code(size: size)
    qr.to_png(size: size, margin: margin)
  end

  def to_string
    build_qr_text
  end

  private

  def validate_fields!
    missing_fields = REQUIRED_FIELDS - @fields.keys
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end

    # Validate IBAN format (basic validation)
    iban = @fields[:recipient_iban]
    if iban && !iban.match?(/\A[A-Z]{2}\d{20}\z/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid IBAN format: #{iban}"
    end

    # Validate amount
    amount = @fields[:amount]
    if amount && (amount < 0 || amount > 9999999999.99)
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be between 0 and 9999999999.99"
    end
  end

  def build_qr_text
    # Build the QR code text according to NBU format
    parts = []
    
    # Add required fields
    REQUIRED_FIELDS.each do |field|
      if @fields[field]
        field_code = FIELD_CODES[field]
        value = @fields[field].to_s
        # Escape semicolon and backslash in field values
        escaped_value = value.gsub('\\', '\\\\').gsub(';', '\\;')
        parts << "#{field_code}#{escaped_value.length}:#{escaped_value}"
      end
    end
    
    # Add optional fields
    (FIELD_CODES.keys - REQUIRED_FIELDS).each do |field|
      if @fields[field]
        field_code = FIELD_CODES[field]
        value = @fields[field].to_s
        # Escape semicolon and backslash in field values
        escaped_value = value.gsub('\\', '\\\\').gsub(';', '\\;')
        parts << "#{field_code}#{escaped_value.length}:#{escaped_value}"
      end
    end
    
    # Add payment QR code format
    format = PAYMENT_QR_CODE_FORMAT % 1
    
    # Combine all parts
    "#{format};#{parts.join(';')}"
  end
end
```

**lib/ipay_client.rb:**
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'digest'

class IPayClient
  include HTTParty

  # Base URL for iPay.ua API
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.ipay.ua'.freeze

  # Initialize the client with merchant credentials
  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key, test_mode: false)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @test_mode = test_mode
    @base_url = test_mode ? 'https://test.api.ipay.ua' : BASE_URL
    self.class.base_uri(@base_url)
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end

  # Create a new payment
  def create_payment(amount, currency, description, return_url, 
                     cancel_url: nil, notify_url: nil, 
                     customer_email: nil, customer_phone: nil,
                     custom_params: {})
    
    # Generate unique order ID
    order_id = generate_order_id

    # Prepare payment data
    payment_data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description,
      order_id: order_id,
      return_url: return_url,
      cancel_url: cancel_url,
      notify_url: notify_url,
      customer_email: customer_email,
      customer_phone: customer_phone,
      custom_params: custom_params
    }.compact

    # Remove nil values
    payment_data.delete_if { |_, value| value.nil? }

    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(payment_data)

    # Send request
    response = self.class.post('/payment', 
      body: payment_data.merge(signature: signature),
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check transaction status by transaction ID
  def check_transaction_status(transaction_id)
    # Generate signature for status check
    params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      transaction_id: transaction_id
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(params)

    response = self.class.get("/payment/status?merchant_id=#{@merchant_id}&transaction_id=#{transaction_id}&signature=#{signature}")

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get transaction details by transaction ID
  def get_transaction_details(transaction_id)
    response = self.class.get("/payment/details?merchant_id=#{@merchant_id}&transaction_id=#{transaction_id}")

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Verify IPN callback
  def verify_ipn_signature(params, signature)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    expected_signature == signature
  end

  private

  # Generate unique order ID
  def generate_order_id
    "order_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

  # Generate signature for API requests
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Sort parameters alphabetically by key
    sorted_params = params.sort_by(&:first).to_h
    
    # Create signature string
    signature_string = sorted_params.map do |key, value|
      if value.is_a?(Hash)
        "#{key}=#{value.to_json}"
      else
        "#{key}=#{value}"
      end
    end.join('&')

    # Add secret key and hash
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest("#{signature_string}#{@secret_key}")
  end

  # Handle API response
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      begin
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        { error: 'Invalid JSON response', raw_response: response.body }
      end
    when 400
      { error: 'Bad Request', details: response.parsed_response }
    when 401
      { error: 'Unauthorized', details: response.parsed_response }
    when 404
      { error: 'Not Found', details: response.parsed_response }
    when 500
      { error: 'Internal Server Error', details: response.parsed_response }
    else
      { error: "HTTP #{response.code}", details: response.parsed_response }
    end
  end
end
```

## 2. Модель `Product` (для зберігання даних з Shopify)

```ruby
# app/models/product.rb

class Product < ApplicationRecord
  validates :shopify_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :title, presence: true

  scope :synced, -> { where(synced: true) }

  def self.sync_from_shopify
    shopify_session = ShopifyAPI::Session.new(
      domain: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:domain],
      access_token: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:access_token]
    )

    ShopifyAPI::Base.activate_session(shopify_session)

    ShopifyAPI::Product.all.each do |shopify_product|
      product = Product.find_or_create_by(shopify_id: shopify_product.id) do |p|
        p.title = shopify_product.title
        p.description = shopify_product.body_html
        p.synced = true
      end

      # Синхронізація залишків
      shopify_product.variants.each do |variant|
        product_variant = product.product_variants.find_or_create_by(shopify_variant_id: variant.id) do |pv|
          pv.title = variant.title
          pv.price = variant.price
          pv.inventory_quantity = variant.inventory_quantity
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. **Код для відстеження посилки**

Створіть файл `dhl_tracker.rb`:

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class DHLTracker
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://www.dhl.com'

  def initialize(tracking_number)
    @tracking_number = tracking_number
  end

  def track
    # DHL API використовує REST API або може бути через формат HTML
    # В цьому прикладі використовуємо прямий запит до сторінки відстеження
    url = "https://www.dhl.com/en/express/tracking.html?AWB=#{@tracking_number}&brand=DHL"

    response = self.class.get(url, headers: {
      'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)',
      'Accept' => 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8'
    })

    if response.success?
      parse_tracking_data(response.body)
    else
      puts "Не вдалося отримати дані для відстеження: #{response.code}"
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_tracking_data(html)
    # Використовуємо Nokogiri для парсингу HTML
    require 'nokogiri'
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)

    events = []

    # Приклад: пошук елементів з подіями (може відрізнятися в залежності від структури DHL)
    # Це лише загальний шаблон
    doc.css('.tracking-event').each do |event|
      events << {
        date: event.css('.date').text.strip,
        location: event.css('.location').text.strip,
        status: event.css('.status').text.strip
      }
    end

    events
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  tracking_number = ARGV[0] || 'YOUR_TRACKING_NUMBER_HERE'
  tracker = DHLTracker.new(tracking_number)
  events = tracker.track

  if events
    puts "Події для посилки #{tracking_number}:"
    events.each do |event|
      puts "- #{event[:date]} | #{event[:location]} | #{event[:status]}"
    end
  else
    puts "Немає даних для відстеження."
  end
end
```

```ruby
class AmazonSPAPI
  include HTTParty

    @config = amazon_config

    self.class.base_uri @base_url
  end

  def get_orders(max_results = 100, order_status = 'Unshipped')
    # Get access token first

    # Set headers
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-amz-access-token' => access_token
    }
    
    # Build parameters
    params = {
      'createdAfter' => 1.hour.ago.iso8601,
      'maxResultsPerPage' => max_results,
      'orderStatuses' => order_status
    }
    
    # Make API call
    response = self.class.get('/orders/v0/orders', 
                              headers: headers, 
                              query: params)
    
    if response.code == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def get_access_token
    # This would typically be implemented with your refresh token flow
    # For now, we'll just return a placeholder or use environment variables
    ENV['SP_API_ACCESS_TOKEN'] || raise("SP_API_ACCESS_TOKEN not set")

  end
```

```ruby
      else
        puts "Failed to save order: #{order_id} - #{order_record.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

# config/environment.rb
require 'bundler/setup'
Bundler.require

require 'active_record'

# Set up logger
logger = Logger.new('ebay_sync.log')
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Database configuration
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'products.db'
)

# Product model
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :name, :price, :quantity, presence: true
  validates :price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :quantity, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }

  def self.active_products
    where(active: true)
  end

  def self.with_ebay_listing
    where.not(ebay_item_id: nil)
  end
end

# eBay synchronization service
class EbaySyncService
  def initialize
    @ebay_client = EbayAPI::Client.new(
      app_id: ENV['EBAY_APP_ID'],
      dev_id: ENV['EBAY_DEV_ID'],
      cert_id: ENV['EBAY_CERT_ID'],
      site_id: '0' # US site
    )
    @logger = Logger.new('ebay_sync.log')
  end

  def list_products
    products = Product.active_products
    listed_count = 0

    products.find_each do |product|
      begin
        if product.ebay_item_id.nil?
          # List new product
          item_id = list_product(product)
          product.update(ebay_item_id: item_id) if item_id
          listed_count += 1
        else
          # Update existing listing
          update_product_quantity(product)
        end
      rescue StandardError => e
        @logger.error("Failed to sync product #{product.id}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end

    @logger.info("Listed #{listed_count} products on eBay")
    listed_count
  end

  def update_product_quantity(product)
    return unless product.ebay_item_id

    response = @ebay_client.revise_fixed_price_item(
      item_id: product.ebay_item_id,
      quantity: product.quantity
    )

    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Updated quantity for product #{product.id} (#{product.name}) to #{product.quantity}")
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to update quantity for product #{product.id}: #{response.error}")
    end
  end

  private

  def list_product(product)
    item = {
      title: product.name,
      description: product.description || "Product: #{product.name}",
      primary_category: { category_id: product.category_id || '172730' },
      start_price: product.price,
      quantity: product.quantity,
      listing_duration: 'Days_30',
      condition_id: 'New',
      country: 'US',
      currency: 'USD',
      payment_methods: ['PayPal'],
      paypal_email_address: ENV['EBAY_PAYPAL_EMAIL']
    }

    response = @ebay_client.add_fixed_price_item(item)
    
    if response.success?
      item_id = response.item_id
      @logger.info("Successfully listed product #{product.id} (#{product.name}) as eBay item #{item_id}")
      item_id
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to list product #{product.id} (#{product.name}): #{response.error}")
      nil
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# export_feed.rb
require 'bundler/setup'
require 'nokogiri'

# Налаштування бази даних (приклад для SQLite)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'products.db'
)

# Модель товару
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'products'
end

# Генерація XML-фіда
def generate_xml_feed(products)
  builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
    xml.feed("xmlns" => "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom") {
      xml.title "Google Merchant Center Feed"
      xml.link href: "https://example.com/feed.xml"
      xml.updated Time.current.iso8601
      xml.author { xml.name "Your Store Name" }

      products.each do |product|
        xml.entry {
          xml.id product.id
          xml.title product.title
          xml.description product.description
          xml.link href: product.url
          xml.price product.price
          xml.availability product.in_stock? ? "in stock" : "out of stock"
          xml.image_link product.image_url if product.image_url
          xml.brand product.brand
          xml.category product.category
        }
      end
    }
  end

  builder.to_xml
end

# Отримання всіх продуктів
products = Product.all

# Генерація XML
xml_feed = generate_xml_feed(products)

# Запис у файл
File.open("google_merchant_feed.xml", "w") do |file|
  file.write(xml_feed)
end

puts "XML feed generated successfully as google_merchant_feed.xml"
```

```ruby
# app/models/woocommerce_product.rb
class WooCommerceProduct < ApplicationRecord
  self.table_name = 'woocommerce_products'
  
  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :sku, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :description, presence: true
  
  before_save :sync_with_woocommerce
  
  def sync_with_woocommerce
    # Sync with WooCommerce API
    begin
      if self.id.nil?
        # Creating new product
        response = WooCommerceAPI.client.post('products', {
          name: self.name,
          sku: self.sku,
          regular_price: self.price.to_s,
          description: self.description,
          short_description: self.short_description,
          images: self.images.map { |img| { src: img } }
        })
        self.woocommerce_id = response['id']
        self.woocommerce_slug = response['slug']
      else
        # Updating existing product
        WooCommerceAPI.client.put("products/#{self.woocommerce_id}", {
          name: self.name,
          sku: self.sku,
          regular_price: self.price.to_s,
          description: self.description,
          short_description: self.short_description,
          images: self.images.map { |img| { src: img } }
        })
      end
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("WooCommerce sync error: #{e.message}")
      errors.add(:base, "Failed to sync with WooCommerce: #{e.message}")
      return false
    end
  end
  
  def self.from_woocommerce(product_data)
    # Create a product from WooCommerce data
    product = WooCommerceProduct.new(
      name: product_data['name'],
      sku: product_data['sku'],
      price: product_data['regular_price'],
      description: product_data['description'],
      short_description: product_data['short_description'],
      woocommerce_id: product_data['id'],
      woocommerce_slug: product_data['slug'],
      images: product_data['images'].map { |img| img['src'] }
    )
    product
  end
  
  def self.sync_all_from_woocommerce
    # Fetch all products from WooCommerce and sync with local database
    begin
      response = WooCommerceAPI.client.get('products?per_page=100')
      response['products'].each do |product_data|
        product = WooCommerceProduct.find_or_create_by(woocommerce_id: product_data['id']) do |p|
          p.name = product_data['name']
          p.sku = product_data['sku']
          p.price = product_data['regular_price']
          p.description = product_data['description']
          p.short_description = product_data['short_description']
          p.woocommerce_slug = product_data['slug']
          p.images = product_data['images'].map { |img| img['src'] }
        end
      end
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Failed to sync products from WooCommerce: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user
  has_many :cart_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :line_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :products, through: :cart_items

  validates :user, presence: true

  def add_product(product, quantity = 1)
    cart_item = cart_items.find_or_initialize_by(product: product)
    cart_item.quantity += quantity
    cart_item.save!
    cart_item
  end

  def remove_product(product)
    cart_item = cart_items.find_by(product: product)
    cart_item&.destroy
  end

  def update_quantity(product, quantity)
    cart_item = cart_items.find_by(product: product)
    if cart_item
      if quantity <= 0
        cart_item.destroy
      else
        cart_item.update(quantity: quantity)
      end
    end
  end

  def total_items
    cart_items.sum(:quantity)
  end

  def subtotal
    cart_items.sum { |item| item.product.price_in_dollars * item.quantity }
  end

  def total
    subtotal
  end

  def clear!
    cart_items.destroy_all
  end

  def apply_coupon(coupon)
    return false unless coupon.active?
    return false unless coupon.valid_for_cart_amount?(subtotal)

    self.coupon = coupon
    save!
  end

  def discount_amount
    return 0 if coupon.nil?
    coupon.discount_amount(subtotal)
  end

  def final_total
    [subtotal - discount_amount, 0].max
  end

  def items
    cart_items.includes(:product)
  end

  def empty?
    cart_items.empty?
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Cart
  attr_reader :items, :coupon

  def initialize
    @items = []
  end

  def add_item(product, quantity = 1)
    item = @items.find { |i| i[:product] == product }
    if item
      item[:quantity] += quantity
    else
      @items << { product: product, quantity: quantity }
    end
  end

  def total
    @items.sum { |item| item[:product].price * item[:quantity] }
  end

  def total_with_discount
    discounted_total = total
    if @coupon
      discounted_total = @coupon.apply_discount(discounted_total)
    end
    discounted_total
  end

  def apply_coupon(coupon)
    @coupon = coupon
  end

  def clear
    @items.clear
    @coupon = nil
  end
end
```

```ruby
  products = Product.all

  products.each do |product|
    if product.ebay_item_id && product.quantity != product.previous_changes['quantity']
      update_ebay_quantity(product.ebay_item_id, product.quantity)

  end
```

```ruby
      # Get all available rates
      rates = shipment.rates
      
      if rates.empty?
        @logger.error("No shipping rates available")
        return nil
      end
      
      # Find the cheapest rate
      cheapest_rate = rates.min_by { |rate| rate.rate }
      
      @logger.info("Cheapest rate found: #{cheapest_rate.carrier} - #{cheapest_rate.service} - $#{cheapest_rate.rate}")
      
      # Buy the cheapest label
      purchased_shipment = shipment.buy(rate: cheapest_rate)
      
      @logger.info("Successfully purchased label")

      }
      
    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      @logger.error("EasyPost API error: #{e.message}")
      raise
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Unexpected error: #{e.message}")

        parcel: parcel_obj,

      # Get all available rates
      rates = shipment.rates
      
      if rates.empty?
        @logger.error("No shipping rates available")
        return []
      end
      
      # Sort rates by price
```

```ruby
    @filters = filters

    search

        }
      }
    }

    # Додавання фільтрів

      params[:filter] ||= []
      params[:filter] << { term: { category: @filters[:category] } }
    end

    if @filters[:brand].present?
      params[:filter] ||= []
      params[:filter] << { term: { brand: @filters[:brand] } }
    end

    if @filters[:min_price].present? || @filters[:max_price].present?
      range_filter = {}
      range_filter[:gte] = @filters[:min_price].to_f if @filters[:min_price].present?
      range_filter[:lte] = @filters[:max_price].to_f if @filters[:max_price].present?
      
      params[:filter] ||= []
      params[:filter] << { range: { price: range_filter } }
    end

    # Додавання сортування
    if params[:sort].present?
      params[:sort] = [{
        "created_at" => { "order" => "desc" }
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'

class USPSAddressValidator
  include HTTParty

  # Встановлюємо базову URL для API USPS (для тестування)
  base_uri 'https://secure.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'

  # Метод для перевірки та нормалізації адреси
  def self.validate_address(street, city, state, zip)
    # Формуємо параметри запиту
    params = {
      API: 'Verify',
      XML: build_xml(street, city, state, zip)
    }

    # Відправляємо запит до API USPS
    response = get(base_uri, query: params)

    # Парсимо відповідь
    parse_response(response.body)
  end

  private

  # Будуємо XML для запиту до USPS
  def self.build_xml(street, city, state, zip)
    <<-XML
    <?xml version="1.0"?>
    <AddressValidateRequest USERID="YOUR_USER_ID">
      <Address ID="0">
        <Address1>#{street}</Address1>
        <Address2></Address2>
        <City>#{city}</City>
        <State>#{state}</State>
        <Zip5>#{zip}</Zip5>
        <Zip4></Zip4>
      </Address>
    </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end

  # Парсимо відповідь з API
  def self.parse_response(xml_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_body)

    # Отримуємо дані з відповіді
    address = doc.at_xpath('//Address')
    return nil unless address

    {
      street: address.at_xpath('./Address1').text,
      city: address.at_xpath('./City').text,
      state: address.at_xpath('./State').text,
      zip5: address.at_xpath('./Zip5').text,
      zip4: address.at_xpath('./Zip4').text,
      error: doc.at_xpath('//Error')&.text
    }
  end
end

    puts "Штат: #{result[:state]}"
```

```ruby
class ImportPriceListJob
  include Sidekiq::Job

  def perform(file_path, user_id)
    # Читаємо Excel файл
    workbook = Roo::Excelx.new(file_path)
    sheet = workbook.sheet(0)

    # Припускаємо, що перший рядок — це заголовки
    headers = sheet.row(1)
    (2..sheet.last_row).each do |row_num|
      row = sheet.row(row_num)
      product_data = Hash[headers.zip(row)]

      # Тут можна зробити валідацію та зберегти товар
      Product.create!(
        name: product_data['name'],
        price: product_data['price'],
        # інші поля
      )
    end

    # Після завершення імпорту можна відправити повідомлення користувачу
    User.find(user_id).update(import_status: 'completed')
  end
end
```

  rescue => e

      error: e.message,
      original_address: address_data
    }
  end
  
  private

    xml = <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0"?>
      <AddressValidateRequest USERID="#{@api_user_id}">
        <Address>
          <FirmName>#{escape_xml(address_data['FirmName'])}</FirmName>
          <Address1>#{escape_xml(address_data['Address1'])}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{escape_xml(address_data['Address2'])}</Address2>
          <City>#{escape_xml(address_data['City'])}</City>
          <State>#{escape_xml(address_data['State'])}</State>
          <Zip5>#{escape_xml(address_data['Zip5'])}</Zip5>
          <Zip4>#{escape_xml(address_data['Zip4'])}</Zip4>
        </Address>
      </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end
  
  # Parse the XML response from USPS
  def parse_response(xml_body)
    # Simple XML parsing for demonstration
    # In production, you'd want to use Nokogiri or similar
    success = xml_body.include?('<AddressValidateRequest>')
    
    if success
      {
        success: true,
        normalized_address: extract_normalized_address(xml_body),
        matched: xml_body.include?('Match'),
        error: nil
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        normalized_address: nil,
        matched: false,
        error: "Invalid address or API error"
      }
    end
  end
  
  # Extract normalized address from XML (simplified version)
  def extract_normalized_address(xml_body)
    # This is a simplified extraction - in practice, use proper XML parsing
    normalized = {}
    
    # Extract basic fields (this is a very basic implementation)
    normalized[:street] = extract_field(xml_body, '<Address1>')
    normalized[:city] = extract_field(xml_body, '<City>')
    normalized[:state] = extract_field(xml_body, '<State>')
    normalized[:zip5] = extract_field(xml_body, '<Zip5>')
    normalized[:zip4] = extract_field(xml_body, '<Zip4>')
    
    normalized
  end
  
  # Helper to extract field values from XML
  def extract_field(xml, tag)
    if xml.include?(tag)
      start = xml.index(tag) + tag.length
      end_pos = xml.index('</', start)
      xml[start...end_pos].strip if end_pos
    end
  end
  
  # Simple XML escaping
  def escape_xml(text)
    text.to_s.gsub('&', '&').gsub('<', '<').gsub('>', '>').gsub('"', '"').gsub("'", ''')
  end

    @page_width = 210
    @page_height = 297
    @label_width = 50
    @label_height = 30
    @margin = 10
  end

  # Generate EAN-13 barcode for a product
  def generate_barcode(product_id)
    # Ensure the product ID is 12 digits long (EAN-13 uses 13 digits total)
    # First 12 digits are provided, last digit is calculated
    if product_id.length < 12
      product_id = product_id.rjust(12, '0')
    elsif product_id.length > 12
      product_id = product_id[0..11]
    end
    
    # Calculate check digit
    check_digit = calculate_check_digit(product_id)
    barcode_string = product_id + check_digit.to_s
    
    # Create barcode object
    barcode = Barby::EAN13.new(barcode_string)
    barcode
  end

  # Calculate EAN-13 check digit
  def calculate_check_digit(product_id)
    # EAN-13 check digit calculation
    # Sum of odd positions multiplied by 1, even positions multiplied by 3
    sum = 0
    product_id.chars.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      digit_value = digit.to_i
      if index.even?
        sum += digit_value * 1
      else
        sum += digit_value * 3
      end
    end
    
    # Check digit is the number that makes the sum divisible by 10
    (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
  end

  # Create a PDF with barcodes for labels
  def create_label_pdf(products, filename = "product_labels.pdf")
    Prawn::Document.generate(filename, page_size: "A4", margin: 20) do |pdf|
      pdf.font "Helvetica"
      
      # Calculate how many labels fit per page
      labels_per_row = (@page_width - 2 * @margin) / @label_width
      labels_per_col = (@page_height - 2 * @margin) / @label_height
      labels_per_page = labels_per_row * labels_per_col
      
      # Process products in batches
      products.each_slice(labels_per_page) do |batch|
        batch.each_with_index do |product, index|
          # Calculate label position
          row = index / labels_per_row
          col = index % labels_per_row
          
          x = @margin + col * @label_width
          y = @page_height - @margin - (row + 1) * @label_height
          
          # Draw label border
          pdf.stroke_rectangle([x, y], @label_width, @label_height)
          
          # Add product information
          pdf.text product[:name], size: 8, at: [x + 5, y + 20]
          pdf.text "ID: #{product[:id]}", size: 7, at: [x + 5, y + 12]
          
          # Generate barcode
          barcode = generate_barcode(product[:id])
          
          # Draw barcode using Prawn outputter
          outputter = Barby::PrawnOutputter.new(pdf)
          outputter.draw(barcode, x: x + 5, y: y + 5)
          
          # Add product ID below barcode
          pdf.text barcode.to_s, size: 7, at: [x + 5, y + 3]
        end
        
        # Add new page if needed
        if batch.length == labels_per_page
          pdf.start_new_page
        end
      end
    end
    
    puts "PDF created: #{filename}"
  end

```ruby
# image_processor.rb
require 'mini_magick'
require 'fileutils'
require_relative 'config'

class ImageProcessor
  # Generate thumbnail from an image file
  def self.generate_thumbnail(image_path, thumbnail_size: '200x200')
    begin
      # Create temporary file for thumbnail
      thumbnail_path = "#{image_path}_thumb.jpg"
      
      # Use MiniMagick to create thumbnail
      image = MiniMagick::Image.open(image_path)
      image.resize(thumbnail_size)
      image.strip # Remove metadata
      image.format('jpg')
      image.write(thumbnail_path)
      
      thumbnail_path
    rescue => e
      ImageUploadConfig.logger.error("Error generating thumbnail: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end

  # Generate multiple thumbnail sizes
  def self.generate_multiple_thumbnails(image_path)
    sizes = ['100x100', '200x200', '300x300', '400x400']
    thumbnails = {}
    
    sizes.each do |size|
      thumbnail_path = generate_thumbnail(image_path, thumbnail_size: size)
      thumbnails[size] = thumbnail_path if thumbnail_path
    end
    
    thumbnails
  end

  # Validate image file
  def self.validate_image(file_path)
    return false unless File.file?(file_path)
    
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(file_path)
    image.mime_type.match?(/image\/(jpeg|png|gif|webp)/i)
  rescue
    false
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/import_product_prices_job.rb
class ImportProductPricesJob
  include Sidekiq::Job

  def perform(file_path, user_id = nil)
    begin
      # Log job start
      Rails.logger.info "Starting product price import from #{file_path}"
      
      # Process the Excel file
      products = parse_excel_file(file_path)
      
      # Import products in batches to handle large datasets
      import_products_in_batches(products)
      
      # Send completion notification if user_id is provided
      notify_user(user_id, :success) if user_id
      
      Rails.logger.info "Product price import completed successfully"
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Product price import failed: #{e.message}"
      notify_user(user_id, :failure, e.message) if user_id
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_excel_file(file_path)
    # Validate file exists
    unless File.exist?(file_path)
      raise "File not found: #{file_path}"
    end

    # Open Excel file using Roo
    workbook = Roo::Excelx.new(file_path)
    sheet = workbook.sheet(0) # First sheet
    
    # Skip header row and process data
    products = []
    (2..sheet.last_row).each do |row|
      # Assuming columns: A=SKU, B=Name, C=Price
      sku = sheet.cell(row, 1).to_s.strip
      name = sheet.cell(row, 2).to_s.strip
      price = sheet.cell(row, 3)
      
      # Skip empty rows
      next if sku.empty?
      
      # Validate and convert price
      price_value = parse_price(price)
      next if price_value.nil?
      
      products << {
        sku: sku,
        name: name,
        price: price_value
      }
    end
    
    Rails.logger.info "Parsed #{products.length} products from Excel file"
    products
  end

  def parse_price(price_cell)
    return nil if price_cell.nil?
    
    # Try to parse as numeric value
    case price_cell
    when Numeric
      price_cell.to_f
    when String
      # Remove currency symbols and parse
      cleaned_price = price_cell.gsub(/[^\d.-]/, '')
      cleaned_price.to_f if cleaned_price.match?(/\d/)
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  def import_products_in_batches(products)
    batch_size = 1000
    total_products = products.length
    
    products.each_slice(batch_size) do |batch|
      # Use transaction for batch import
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        batch.each do |product_data|
```

```ruby
require 'klaviyo'
require 'redis'
require 'json'

class AbandonedCartReminder
  def initialize(klaviyo_api_key, redis_url = 'redis://localhost:6379')
    @klaviyo = Klaviyo::API.new(klaviyo_api_key)
    @redis = Redis.new(url: redis_url)
  end

  def check_and_send_reminders
    # Get all cart abandonment records from Redis
    abandonment_records = @redis.keys('abandoned_cart:*')
    
    abandonment_records.each do |key|
      process_abandoned_cart(key)
    end
  end

  def track_abandoned_cart(user_id, cart_items, timestamp = Time.current)
    # Store abandonment data in Redis with expiration (e.g., 24 hours)
    abandonment_key = "abandoned_cart:#{user_id}"
    abandonment_data = {
      user_id: user_id,
      cart_items: cart_items,
      timestamp: timestamp.iso8601,
      created_at: Time.current.iso8601
    }
    
    @redis.setex(abandonment_key, 86400, abandonment_data.to_json)
    puts "Stored abandoned cart for user #{user_id}"
  end

  def process_abandoned_cart(key)
    json_data = @redis.get(key)
    return unless json_data
    
    data = JSON.parse(json_data)
    user_id = data['user_id']
    timestamp = Time.parse(data['timestamp'])
    
    # Check if it's time to send reminder (e.g., 1 hour after abandonment)
    if should_send_reminder?(timestamp)
      send_reminder_email(user_id, data['cart_items'])
      @redis.del(key) # Remove the record after sending
    end
  end

  def should_send_reminder?(timestamp)
    # Send reminder after 1 hour of abandonment
    Time.current > timestamp + 1.hour
  end

  def send_reminder_email(user_id, cart_items)
    begin
      # Get user info from your database or session
      user_info = fetch_user_info(user_id)
      
      # Prepare email properties
      properties = {
        '$email' => user_info[:email],
        '$first_name' => user_info[:first_name],
        '$last_name' => user_info[:last_name],
        'cart_items' => cart_items,
        'cart_count' => cart_items.length,
        'abandoned_at' => Time.current.iso8601
      }
      
      # Send to Klaviyo
      response = @klaviyo.track(
        event: 'Abandoned Cart Reminder',
        customer_properties: properties,
        additional_properties: {
          'cart_items' => cart_items
        }
      )
      
      puts "Sent abandoned cart reminder to #{user_info[:email]}"
      return true
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Failed to send reminder email: #{e.message}"
      return false
    end
  end

  private

  def fetch_user_info(user_id)
    # Replace this with your actual user data retrieval logic
    # This is a mock implementation
    {
      email: "user#{user_id}@example.com",
      first_name: "User#{user_id}",
      last_name: "Last#{user_id}"
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key, logger = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  # Get shop listings
  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, limit: 25, offset: 0)
    @logger.info("Fetching shop listings for shop ID: #{shop_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings/active",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key
      },
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get shop orders
  def get_shop_orders(shop_id, limit: 25, offset: 0)
    @logger.info("Fetching shop orders for shop ID: #{shop_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/orders",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key
      },
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get a specific listing
  def get_listing(shop_id, listing_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching listing #{listing_id} from shop #{shop_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings/#{listing_id}",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get a specific order
  def get_order(shop_id, order_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching order #{order_id} from shop #{shop_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Handle API responses
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      @logger.error("Authentication failed: #{response.body}")
      raise 'Authentication failed'
    when 403
      @logger.error("Access forbidden: #{response.body}")
      raise 'Access forbidden'
    when 404
      @logger.error("Resource not found: #{response.body}")
      raise 'Resource not found'
    else
      @logger.error("API Error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}")
      raise "API Error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
      "methodProperties" => {
```

```ruby
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

    return { error: "Request failed" } unless response.success?

    data = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if data["success"] == true && data["data"].is_a?(Array) && !data["data"].empty?
      document = data["data"][0]

        city: document["City"],
        address: document["Address"],
        last_event: document["LastEvent"],
        last_event_date: document["LastEventDate"],
        sender: document["Sender"],
        recipient: document["Recipient"]
      }
    else

    end
```

```ruby
require 'faraday'

class UberDirectClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.uber.com/v1/direct'.freeze

  def initialize
    @token = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_TOKEN']
    @server_token = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_SERVER_TOKEN']
    @conn = Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
      f.request :json
      f.response :json
      f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
  end

  def create_delivery(order_id, pickup_address, dropoff_address)
    response = @conn.post('/orders') do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Token #{@token}"
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = {
        order_id: order_id,
        pickup: {
          address: pickup_address
        },
        dropoff: {
          address: dropoff_address
        }
      }.to_json
    end

    if response.success?
      puts "Кур'єр успішно замовлено!"
      puts "Order ID: #{order_id}"
      puts "Response: #{response.body}"
    else
      puts "Помилка замовлення: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

    # Якщо API вимагає аутентифікації через заголовок
    self.class.headers('Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}")
    
    # Приклад структури даних для відправлення
    data = {
      "sender" => {
        "name" => shipment_data[:sender_name],
        "address" => shipment_data[:sender_address],
        "phone" => shipment_data[:sender_phone]
      },
      "recipient" => {
        "name" => shipment_data[:recipient_name],
        "address" => shipment_data[:recipient_address],
        "phone" => shipment_data[:recipient_phone]

      "package" => {

        "dimensions" => {
          "length" => shipment_data[:length],
          "width" => shipment_data[:width],
          "height" => shipment_data[:height]
        },
        "description" => shipment_data[:description]
      },
      "service" => shipment_data[:service] || "standard"
    }
    
    # Надсилання запиту на створення відправлення
    response = self.class.post('/shipments', 
                               body: data.to_json,
                               headers: self.class.headers)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Відправлення успішно створено!"
      return response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "Помилка створення відправлення: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      return nil
    end
  end
  
  # Отримання етикетки для відправлення
  def get_label(shipment_id)
    self.class.headers('Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}")
    
    # Надсилання запиту на отримання етикетки

# lib/ukrposhta_shipment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class UkrposhtaShipment
  include HTTParty
  
  # Set default headers and base URL
  base_uri 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Create a new shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    endpoint = '/v1/shipments'
    
    # Prepare the shipment data
    payload = {
      shipment: {
        recipient: {
          name: shipment_data[:recipient_name],
          phone: shipment_data[:recipient_phone],
          email: shipment_data[:recipient_email],
          address: {
            city: shipment_data[:recipient_city],
            street: shipment_data[:recipient_street],
            building: shipment_data[:recipient_building],
            apartment: shipment_data[:recipient_apartment],
            postal_code: shipment_data[:recipient_postal_code]
          }
        },
        sender: {
          name: shipment_data[:sender_name],
          phone: shipment_data[:sender_phone],
          email: shipment_data[:sender_email],
          address: {
            city: shipment_data[:sender_city],
            street: shipment_data[:sender_street],
            building: shipment_data[:sender_building],
            apartment: shipment_data[:sender_apartment],
            postal_code: shipment_data[:sender_postal_code]
          }
        },
        package: {
          weight: shipment_data[:weight],
          dimensions: {
            length: shipment_data[:length],
            width: shipment_data[:width],
            height: shipment_data[:height]
          }
        },
        service_type: shipment_data[:service_type] || 'standard',
        payment_method: shipment_data[:payment_method] || 'cash_on_delivery'
      }
    }
    
    # Make the API request
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, 
                              headers: @headers, 
                              body: payload.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Shipment created successfully!"
      puts "Shipment ID: #{response['shipment_id']}"
      return response
    else
      puts "Error creating shipment: #{response.body}"
      return nil
    end
  end
  
  # Generate and print a shipping label
  def generate_label(shipment_id)
    endpoint = "/v1/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label"
    
    # Make the API request to generate label
    response = self.class.get(endpoint, headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Label generated successfully!"
      puts "Label URL: #{response['label_url']}"
      
      # Save the label to a file
      save_label_to_file(response['label_data'], shipment_id)
      return response
    else
      puts "Error generating label: #{response.body}"
      return nil
    end
  end
  
  # Save label to file
  def save_label_to_file(label_data, shipment_id)
    filename = "label_#{shipment_id}.pdf"
    
    # Decode base64 data if needed
    label_content = if label_data.start_with?('data:')
                      # Extract base64 part after the comma
                      label_data.split(',')[1]
                    else
                      label_data
                    end
    
    # Write to file
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(Base64.decode64(label_content))
    end
    
    puts "Label saved to #{filename}"
  end
  
  # Get shipment status
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_id)
    endpoint = "/v1/shipments/#{shipment_id}"
    
    response = self.class.get(endpoint, headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Shipment status: #{response['status']}"
      return response
    else
      puts "Error retrieving shipment status: #{response.body}"
      return nil
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/models/product.rb

class Product < ApplicationRecord
  validates :name, :price, presence: true

  def create_in_bigcommerce!
    client = Bigcommerce::API.new(
      store_hash: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH'],
      access_token: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    )

    response = client.post('/products', {
      name: name,
      price: price,
      sku: sku,
      inventory_tracking: 'product'
    })

    if response.success?
      self.bigcommerce_id = response.body['id']
      save!
```

```ruby
  has_many :products, through: :order_items

  end

    # Знаходимо користувачів з схожими замовленнями
    User.joins(:orders)
        .joins(:order_items)
        .where("orders.user_id != ? AND order_items.product_id IN (?)", id, ordered_products.pluck(:id))
        .group("users.id")
        .having("COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.product_id) > ?", ordered_products.count / 2)
        .select("users.*, COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.product_id) as similarity_count")
        .order("similarity_count DESC")
  end
  
  def recommended_products(limit = 5)
    # Збираємо продукти, які купували схожі користувачі
    similar_users = self.similar_users
    
    return [] if similar_users.empty?
    
    # Отримуємо продукти, які купували схожі користувачі, але не ми
    recommended = Product.joins(:order_items)
                        .joins(order: :user)
                        .where("users.id IN (?) AND order_items.product_id NOT IN (?)", 
                               similar_users.pluck(:id), ordered_products.pluck(:id))
                        .group("products.id")
                        .order("COUNT(*) DESC")
                        .limit(limit)
```

```ruby
    my_users = OrderItem.joins(:order).where(product_id: id).pluck(:user_id)
    other_users = OrderItem.joins(:order).where(product_id: other_product.id).pluck(:user_id)
    
    common_users = my_users & other_users
    all_users = my_users | other_users
    
    return 0 if all_users.empty?
    
    common_users.length.to_f / all_users.length
  end

    # Знаходить схожі продукти за кількістю спільних покупців
    products = Product.all
    similarities = []
    
    products.each do |product|
      next if product.id == id
      similarity = cosine_similarity(product)
      similarities << { product: product, similarity: similarity }
    end
    
    similarities.sort_by { |item| -item[:similarity] }
```

class RecommendationEngine
  def initialize
    @customers = Customer.all
    @products = Product.all
    @orders = Order.all
  end

  # Calculate user similarity using cosine similarity
  def user_similarity(user1_id, user2_id)
    # Get products ordered by both users
    user1_orders = Order.where(customer_id: user1_id).pluck(:product_id)
    user2_orders = Order.where(customer_id: user2_id).pluck(:product_id)
    
    # Find intersection of products
    common_products = user1_orders & user2_orders
    
    return 0.0 if common_products.empty?
    
    # Create binary vectors for both users
    user1_vector = @products.pluck(:id).map { |pid| common_products.include?(pid) ? 1 : 0 }
    user2_vector = @products.pluck(:id).map { |pid| common_products.include?(pid) ? 1 : 0 }
    
    # Calculate cosine similarity
    dot_product = user1_vector.zip(user2_vector).map { |a, b| a * b }.sum
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(user1_vector.sum { |x| x * x })
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(user2_vector.sum { |x| x * x })
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1 == 0 || magnitude2 == 0
    
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  # Get similar users
  def similar_users(customer_id, threshold = 0.1)
    @customers.where.not(id: customer_id).map do |other_customer|
      similarity = user_similarity(customer_id, other_customer.id)
      [other_customer, similarity]
    end.select { |_, similarity| similarity >= threshold }
      .sort_by { |_, similarity| -similarity }
      .map(&:first)
  end

  # Get products ordered by similar users but not by the target user
  def recommended_products(customer_id, limit = 5)
    # Get user's already ordered products
    user_products = Order.where(customer_id: customer_id).pluck(:product_id)
    
    # Get similar users
    similar_customers = similar_users(customer_id)
    
    # Find products ordered by similar users but not by this user
    recommended = {}
    
    similar_customers.each do |similar_customer|
      similar_orders = Order.where(customer_id: similar_customer.id)
        .where.not(product_id: user_products)
        .includes(:product)
        
      similar_orders.each do |order|
        product = order.product
        recommended[product.id] ||= {
          product: product,
          count: 0,
          similarity: 0.0
        }
        recommended[product.id][:count] += 1
        recommended[product.id][:similarity] += user_similarity(customer_id, similar_customer.id)
      end
    end
    
    # Sort by recommendation score (frequency * average similarity)
    recommended.values
      .sort_by { |item| -(item[:count] * item[:similarity]) }
      .first(limit)
      .map { |item| item[:product] }
  end

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class MeestDeliveryCalculator
  include HTTParty
  
  # Base URL for Meest Express API
  base_uri 'https://api.meest.com'
  
  # Initialize with API credentials
  def initialize(api_key: nil, username: nil, password: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MEEST_API_KEY']
    @username = username || ENV['MEEST_USERNAME']
    @password = password || ENV['MEEST_PASSWORD']
    
    # Set default headers
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  # Calculate delivery cost
  def calculate_delivery_cost(parcel_data)
    # Validate required parameters
    validate_parcel_data(parcel_data)
    
    # Prepare request payload
    payload = build_request_payload(parcel_data)
    
    # Make API request to calculate cost
    response = self.class.post(
      '/calculate_cost',
      {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
        },
        body: payload.to_json
      }
    )
    
    # Handle response
    case response.code
    when 200
      parse_success_response(response.body)
    when 400
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise StandardError, "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    when 422
      raise ArgumentError, "Validation error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise StandardError, "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Validate required parcel data
  def validate_parcel_data(parcel_data)
    required_fields = [:from_city, :to_city, :weight, :length, :width, :height]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields.select do |field|
      !parcel_data.key?(field) || parcel_data[field].nil? || parcel_data[field].to_s.strip.empty?
    end
    
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Validate weight and dimensions
    weight = parcel_data[:weight].to_f
    length = parcel_data[:length].to_f
    width = parcel_data[:width].to_f
    height = parcel_data[:height].to_f
    
    if weight <= 0
      raise ArgumentError, "Weight must be greater than 0"
    end
    
    if [length, width, height].any? { |dim| dim <= 0 }
      raise ArgumentError, "Dimensions must be greater than 0"
    end
  end
  
  # Build request payload
  def build_request_payload(parcel_data)
    {
      from: {
        city: parcel_data[:from_city],
        zip_code: parcel_data[:from_zip_code]
      },
      to: {
        city: parcel_data[:to_city],
        zip_code: parcel_data[:to_zip_code]
      },
      package: {
        weight: parcel_data[:weight],
        length: parcel_data[:length],
        width: parcel_data[:width],
        height: parcel_data[:height],
        description: parcel_data[:description],
        value: parcel_data[:value]
      },
      services: parcel_data[:services] || [],
      additional_options: parcel_data[:additional_options] || {}
    }
  end
  
  # Parse successful API response
  def parse_success_response(response_body)
    data = JSON.parse(response_body)
    
    {
      total_cost: data['total_cost'],
      base_cost: data['base_cost'],
      additional_costs: data['additional_costs'],
      estimated_delivery_time: data['estimated_delivery_time'],
      currency: data['currency'],
      breakdown: data['breakdown']
    }
  end
end
```

    payload[:destination].delete_if { |_, v| v.nil? }

    response = self.class.post('/delivery', body: payload.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      handle_success(response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  def get_delivery_status(delivery_id)
    response = self.class.get("/delivery/#{delivery_id}")
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_success(response)
    result = JSON.parse(response.body)
    {
      success: true,
      delivery_id: result['delivery_id'],
      status: result['status'],
      estimated_arrival: result['estimated_arrival'],
      driver_info: result['driver']
    }
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    {
      success: false,
      error_code: response.code,
      error_message: error_data['message'] || 'Unknown error occurred'
    }
  end
end

    @logger.info("Attempting to book delivery for order #{order_id}")

    # Validate required fields
    required_fields = [:pickup_address, :delivery_address, :order_id]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| order_details[field].nil? || order_details[field].empty? }

    if missing_fields.any?
      @logger.error("Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}")
      return {
        success: false,
        error: "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      }
    end

    # Prepare delivery data
    delivery_data = {

      pickup_address: order_details[:pickup_address],
      pickup_name: order_details[:pickup_name],

```ruby
class NovaPoshtaTracker
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  def track_parcel(tracking_number)
    # Create the request data
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "TrackingDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getStatusDocuments",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "Documents" => [
          {
            "DocumentNumber" => tracking_number,
            "Phone" => ""
          }
        ]
      }
    }

    # Make the API request
    response = self.class.post(
      '/tracking',
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.parsed_response)
    else
      puts "Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}".colorize(:red)
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    data = response['data']
    
    if data.empty?
      puts "No tracking information found for invoice number: #{tracking_number}".colorize(:yellow)
      return nil
    end

    document = data.first
    display_tracking_info(document)
  end

  def display_tracking_info(document)
    puts "=" * 60
    puts "NOVA POSHTA TRACKING INFORMATION".center(60).colorize(:blue)
    puts "=" * 60
    
    puts "Invoice Number:".ljust(25) + document['DocumentNumber']
    puts "Status:".ljust(25) + format_status(document['Status'])
    puts "City:".ljust(25) + document['City']
    puts "Recipient:".ljust(25) + document['Recipient']
    puts "Weight:".ljust(25) + document['Weight'].to_s + " kg"
    puts "Cost:".ljust(25) + document['Cost'].to_s + " UAH"
    puts "Date Created:".ljust(25) + document['DateCreated']
    
    puts "\n" + "-" * 60
    puts "STATUS HISTORY".center(60).colorize(:green)
    puts "-" * 60

    if document['StatusHistory'] && !document['StatusHistory'].empty?
      document['StatusHistory'].each_with_index do |history, index|
        puts "#{index + 1}. #{history['Date']}: #{format_status(history['Status'])}"
        puts "   Location: #{history['Location']}"
        puts "   Description: #{history['Description']}"
        puts ""
      end
    else
      puts "No status history available."
    end

    puts "=" * 60
  end

  def format_status(status)
    case status.downcase
    when /відправлення/
      status.colorize(:green)
    when /в дорозі/
      status.colorize(:yellow)
    when /доставлено/
      status.colorize(:blue)
    when /відмова/
      status.colorize(:red)
    when /помилка/
      status.colorize(:red)
    else
      status
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class PromYmlExporter

  end

    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|

        xml.shop do
          xml.name 'MyStore'
          xml.company 'My Company Ltd.'
          xml.url 'https://www.mystore.com'

            xml.category(id: 1, name: 'Electronics')
            xml.category(id: 2, name: 'Clothing')
            xml.category(id: 3, name: 'Home')
          end
          
          xml.offers do
            @products.each do |product|
              xml.offer(id: product[:id], available: product[:available]) do
                xml.url product[:url]
                xml.price product[:price]
                xml.currencyId 'UAH'
                xml.categoryId product[:category_id]
                xml.picture product[:image_url]
                xml.name product[:name]
                xml.vendor product[:brand] || 'Unknown'

                xml.weight product[:weight] || 0

                xml.param(name: 'Size', value: product[:size] || '') if product[:size]

        end
```

### 2. Prom.ua Order Importer

```ruby
# prom_order_importer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class PromOrderImporter
  include HTTParty
  
  def initialize(api_key, shop_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_id = shop_id
    @base_url = 'https://api.prom.ua'
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  def import_orders(orders)
    success_count = 0
    failed_orders = []
    
    orders.each do |order|
      begin
        result = post_order(order)
        if result['success']
          success_count += 1
        else
          failed_orders << { order_id: order[:id], error: result['error'] }
        end
      rescue => e
        failed_orders << { order_id: order[:id], error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    { success: success_count, failed: failed_orders }
  end
  
  def get_orders(status = 'new')
    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/orders", 
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        shop_id: @shop_id,
        status: status
      }
    )
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
  
  def update_order_status(order_id, status)
    response = self.class.put("#{@base_url}/orders/#{order_id}/status", 
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        status: status,
        shop_id: @shop_id
      }.to_json
    )
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
  
  private
  
  def post_order(order)
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/orders", 
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        shop_id: @shop_id,
        order: order
      }.to_json
    )
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

        xml.version "1.0"
      end
      
      xml.products do
        @products.each do |product|
          xml.product do
            xml.id product[:id]
            xml.name product[:name]
            xml.description product[:description] || ""
            xml.category product[:category] || ""
            xml.price product[:price].to_s
            xml.old_price product[:old_price].to_s if product[:old_price]
            xml.currency "UAH"
            xml.available product[:available] ? "true" : "false"
            xml.brand product[:brand] || ""
            xml.model product[:model] || ""

            xml.image product[:image_url] if product[:image_url]
            xml.url product[:url] if product[:url]
            xml.warranty product[:warranty] || "" if product[:warranty]
            xml.features(product[:features].join("; ")) if product[:features]
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
  
  def save_to_file(filename = "hotline_feed.xml")
    File.write(filename, generate_xml)
    puts "XML feed saved to #{filename}"
  end

```ruby
  # - declared_value: declared value of the parcel (numeric)
  # - city_to: destination city name (string)
  # - city_from: origin city name (string) - optional, defaults to Kiev
  # - service_type: delivery service type (string) - optional, defaults to "Cargo"
  def calculate_delivery_cost(weight, declared_value, city_to, city_from: "Киев", service_type: "Cargo")
    # Validate inputs
    raise ArgumentError, "Weight must be a positive number" unless weight.is_a?(Numeric) && weight > 0
    raise ArgumentError, "Declared value must be a positive number" unless declared_value.is_a?(Numeric) && declared_value >= 0
    
    # Get city reference
    city_to_ref = get_city_reference(city_to)
    city_from_ref = get_city_reference(city_from)
    
    # If we can't find the city, try with just the city name
    return nil unless city_to_ref && city_from_ref
    
    # Calculate shipping cost using Nova Poshta API
    payload = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getDocumentPrice",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "CitySender" => city_from_ref,
        "CityRecipient" => city_to_ref,
        "ServiceType" => service_type,
        "Weight" => weight.to_s,
        "Cost" => declared_value.to_s,
        "CargoType" => "Cargo",
        "SeatsAmount" => "1"
      }
    }
    
    response = send_request(payload)
    
    if response && response["success"]
      response["data"][0]["Cost"]
    else
      nil
    end
  end

      }
    }
    
    response = send_request(payload)
    
    if response && response["success"] && response["data"] && !response["data"].empty?
      response["data"][0]["Ref"]
    else
      nil
    end
  end

    begin

        body: payload.to_json,
```

```ruby
# order.rb
class Order
  attr_accessor :id, :customer_name, :items, :total_amount, :date

  def initialize(id, customer_name, items, total_amount, date)
    @id = id
    @customer_name = customer_name
    @items = items
    @total_amount = total_amount
    @date = date
  end

  def to_xml
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    builder.instruct!
    builder.order do |o|
      o.id @id
      o.customer_name @customer_name
      o.date @date
      o.total_amount @total_amount
      o.items do
        @items.each do |item|
          o.item do
            o.name item[:name]
            o.quantity item[:quantity]
            o.price item[:price]
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class EpicenterSync
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['EPICENTER_API_URL']

  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new('sync.log')
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['EPICENTER_API_KEY']}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Отримує список товарів з вашої системи (використовуйте свою логіку)

    # Це приклад. Замініть на ваш код отримання товарів

    products.each do |product|

    end
  end

    else
      @logger.error "Помилка оновлення залишків для товару #{product_id}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    xml_data = request.body.read
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)

    doc.xpath('//Товар').each do |product_node|
      code = product_node.at_xpath('Код').text

        price: price,
        quantity: quantity
      )
    end
```
