# app/services/xero_service.rb
class XeroService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0'

  def initialize
    @consumer_key = Rails.application.secrets.xero_consumer_key
    @consumer_secret = Rails.application.secrets.xero_consumer_secret
    @access_token = Rails.application.secrets.xero_access_token
    @access_token_secret = Rails.application.secrets.xero_access_token_secret
  end

  def send_invoice(invoice)
    # Authenticate with Xero
    auth = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'xero-tenant-id' => 'YOUR_TENANT_ID'
    }

    # Create a new Xero invoice
    response = self.class.post('/Invoices', headers: auth, body: {
      'Invoice' => {
        'Type' => 'ACCREC',
        'Contact' => {
          'Name' => invoice.customer_name
        },
        'Date' => invoice.date,
        'DueDate' => invoice.due_date,
        'LineItems' => [
          {
            'Description' => invoice.description,
            'Quantity' => 1,
            'UnitAmount' => invoice.amount,
            'AccountCode' => 'YOUR_ACCOUNT_CODE'
          }
        ]
      }
    }.to_json)

    # Check if the invoice was created successfully
    if response.success?
      # Update the invoice status in the Rails app
      invoice.xero_invoice_id = response['Invoices'][0]['InvoiceID']
      invoice.save!
    else
      # Handle errors
      Rails.logger.error("Error sending invoice to Xero: #{response.code}")
    end
  end

  def sync_payment_status(invoice)
    # Authenticate with Xero
    auth = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'xero-tenant-id' => 'YOUR_TENANT_ID'
    }

    # Get the Xero invoice
    response = self.class.get("/Invoices/#{invoice.xero_invoice_id}", headers: auth)

    # Check if the invoice was retrieved successfully
    if response.success?
      # Update the payment status in the Rails app
      invoice.payment_status = response['Invoices'][0]['Status']
      invoice.save!
    else
      # Handle errors
      Rails.logger.error("Error syncing payment status with Xero: #{response.code}")
    end
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'digest/sha1'
require 'base64'

class FondyPayment
  attr_accessor :merchant_id, :merchant_password, :order_id, :amount, :currency

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
  end

  def pay(order_id, amount, currency)
    @order_id = order_id
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency

    url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/url/'
    response = HTTParty.post(url, body: {
      'merchant_id' => @merchant_id,
      'order_id' => @order_id,
      'amount' => @amount,
      'currency' => @currency,
      'signature' => generate_signature
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def verify_signature(params)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    actual_signature = params['signature']
    expected_signature == actual_signature
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(params = nil)
    if params.nil?
      params = {
        'merchant_id' => @merchant_id,
        'order_id' => @order_id,
        'amount' => @amount,
        'currency' => @currency
      }
    end

    sorted_params = params.sort_by { |k, v| k }
    signature_string = sorted_params.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string + @merchant_password)
  end
end

require "httparty"

class LiqPayP2PApi
  BASE_URL = "https://www.liqpay.ua/api".freeze
  VERSION = "3".freeze

  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def payout(card_number, amount, currency = "UAH")
    params = {
      version: VERSION,
      public_key: @public_key,
      action: "p2p_credit",
      card: card_number,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      type: "card"
    }

    signature = generate_signature(params)

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/3/request",
      body: {
        public_key: @public_key,
        action: params[:action],
        card: params[:card],
        amount: params[:amount],
        currency: params[:currency],
        type: params[:type],
        signature: signature
      },
      headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(params)
    sorted_params = params.sort_by { |key, value| key.to_s }
    string_to_sign = sorted_params.map { |key, value| "#{key}=#{value}" }.join
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest("#{@private_key}#{string_to_sign}#{@private_key}")
  end

### xero_api.rb (initializer)

```ruby
# config/initializers/xero_api.rb

require 'xero-api'
require 'oauth2'

XERO_CONSUMER_KEY = ENV['XERO_CONSUMER_KEY']
XERO_CONSUMER_SECRET = ENV['XERO_CONSUMER_SECRET']
XERO_REDIRECT_URI = ENV['XERO_REDIRECT_URI']

class XeroApi
  def initialize
    @client = Xero::Client.new(
      consumer_key: XERO_CONSUMER_KEY,
      consumer_secret: XERO_CONSUMER_SECRET,
      redirect_uri: XERO_REDIRECT_URI
    )
  end

  def connect
    @client.connect
  end

  def disconnect
    @client.disconnect
  end

  def create_invoice(invoice)
    # Create a new invoice in Xero
    xero_invoice = {
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        name: invoice.customer_name
      },
      date: invoice.date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      line_items: invoice.line_items.map do |item|
        {
          description: item.description,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit_amount: item.unit_amount,
          account_code: item.account_code
        }
      end
    }

    @client.invoices.create(xero_invoice)
  end

  def update_payment_status(invoice)
    # Fetch the payment status of an invoice from Xero
    xero_invoice = @client.invoices.find(invoice.xero_invoice_id)

    if xero_invoice
      # Update the payment status in the Rails app
      invoice.update(payment_status: xero_invoice.status)
    end
  end
end
```

require 'rqrcode'

class QrCodeGenerator
  def initialize(payment_info)
    @payment_info = payment_info
  end

  def generate_qr_code
    # Стандарт НБУ для платіжних QR-кодів вимагає наступної структури:
    # "SPD*1*UA*400010*100*UAH*IVAN PETRENKO*IBAN UA12345678901234567890123456789012*City*Street 1"
    # Розбір складу:
    # - SPD: ідентифікатор стандарту
    # - 1: версія стандарту
    # - UA: код країни (для України - UA)
    # - 400010: код банку отримувача (МФО)
    # - 100: сума платежу
    # - UAH: валюта платежу
    # - IVAN PETRENKO: прізвище та ім'я одержувача
    # - IBAN UA12345678901234567890123456789012: номер рахунку одержувача у форматі IBAN
    # - City: місто
    # - Street 1: адреса

    qr_code_data = "SPD*1*#{@payment_info[:country_code]}*#{@payment_info[:bank_code]}*#{@payment_info[:amount]}*#{@payment_info[:currency]}*#{@payment_info[:receiver_name]}*IBAN #{@payment_info[:iban]}*#{@payment_info[:city]}*#{@payment_info[:address]}"

    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_code_data, size: 200)

    # Збереження QR-коду у файл
    png = qrcode.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      shape_rendering: ChunkyPNG::SHAPE_RENDERING_CRISP,
      text: nil,
      size: 200
    )

    png.save('payment_qr_code.png')
  end
end

  country_code: 'UA',
  bank_code: '400010',
  amount: '100',
  currency: 'UAH',
  receiver_name: 'IVAN PETRENKO',
  iban: 'UA12345678901234567890123456789012',
  city: 'City',
  address: 'Street 1'
}

generator.generate_qr_code

Note that you'll need to replace `'YOUR_LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'` and `'YOUR_LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'` with your actual LiqPay public and private keys, respectively. Also, ensure you handle errors and exceptions according to your application's needs.

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'uri'
require 'openssl'

class LiqPayP2PCredit
  attr_accessor :public_key, :private_key

  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def payout(card_number, amount)
    # Prepare data for the request
    data = {
      "version" => "3",
      "action" => "p2p_credit",
      "amount" => amount.to_s,
      "card" => card_number,
      "currency" => "UAH", # Assuming Ukrainian Hryvnia
      "description" => "Payout to card"
    }

    # Sign the data
    signature = generate_signature(data)

    # Make the request
    response = HTTParty.post(
      'https://www.liqpay.ua/api/request',
      body: {
        "data" => Base64.strict_encode64(data.to_json),
        "signature" => signature
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )

    # Handle the response
    if response.success?
      # Parse the response
      response_data = JSON.parse(Base64.strict_decode64(URI.unescape(response['data'])), symbolize_names: true)
      # Check if the transaction was successful
      if response_data[:status] == 'success'
        puts "Payout successful. Transaction ID: #{response_data[:transaction_id]}"
      else
        puts "Payout failed. Error: #{response_data[:err_description]}"
      end
    else
      puts "Failed to make payout. Response code: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    string_to_sign = data.sort.to_h.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', private_key, string_to_sign)
  end
end

# Example usage
liqpay = LiqPayP2PCredit.new('YOUR_LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY', 'YOUR_LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY')
liqpay.payout('4242424242424242', 10.0)
```

Додатково нам потрібно буде використовувати гем `openssl` для шифрування даних.

Тепер перейдемо до реалізації коду:
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'uri'
require 'openssl'

class LiqPayP2PCredit
  def initialize(private_key, public_key)
    @private_key = private_key
    @public_key = public_key
    @api_url = 'https://www.liqpay.ua/api/request'
  end

  def send_payment(card_number, amount, currency)
    # Підготовка даних для запиту
    data = {
      'version' => '3',
      'public_key' => @public_key,
      'action' => 'p2p_credit',
      'card' => card_number,
      'amount' => amount,
      'currency' => currency,
      'description' => 'Оплата через LiqPay'
    }

    # Підпис даних приватним ключем
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha1', @private_key, data.to_json)

    # Додавання підпису до даних
    data['signature'] = signature

    # Відправка запиту до API
    response = HTTParty.post(@api_url, body: data.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

    # Перевірка статусу відповіді
    if response.success?
      # Розбор відповіді
      response_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if response_data['result'] == 'success'
        # Операція успішна
        puts "Операція успішна. Посилання на платіж: #{response_data['transaction_id']}"
      else
        # Помилка під час операції
        puts "Помилка під час операції: #{response_data['error']}"
      end
    else
      # Помилка під час запиту
      puts "Помилка під час запиту: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

# Використання класу
liqpay = LiqPayP2PCredit.new('Ваш приватний ключ', 'Ваш публічний ключ')
liqpay.send_payment('Номер картки', 100, 'UAH')
```

У цьому прикладі ми створюємо клас `LiqPayP2PCredit`, який приймає приватний та публічний ключі у конструкторі. Метод `send_payment` приймає номер картки, суму та валюту, та здійснює запит до API LiqPay для здійснення платежу.

Після виконання запиту ми перевіряємо статус відповіді та розбираємо дані відповіді. Якщо операція успішна, ми виводимо посилання на платіж. Якщо під час операції виникла помилка, ми виводимо текст помилки.

Пам'ятайте, що для використання цього коду вам потрібно буде замінити `'Ваш приватний ключ'` та `'Ваш публічний ключ'` на свої реальні ключі, а також замінити `'Номер картки'` на реальний номер картки.

          'Quantity' => 1,

        }
      ]
    }

    # Відправити запит до Xero
    response = HTTParty.post(

      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "OAuth #{access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: invoice_data.to_json
    )

      # Синхронізувати статус оплати

require 'sinatra'
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Налаштування AWS
Aws.config.update({
  region: ENV['AWS_REGION'],
  credentials: Aws::Credentials.new(ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'], ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'])
})

s3 = Aws::S3::Resource.new
bucket_name = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME']
cdn_url = ENV['CDN_URL'] # Наприклад: "https://your-cdn-domain.com"

# Маршрут для завантаження зображення
post '/upload' do
  # Перевірка наявності файлу
  unless params[:image] && params[:image][:tempfile]
    halt 400, "No image provided"
  end

  file = params[:image][:tempfile]
  original_filename = params[:image][:filename]

  # Назва файлу для S3
  key = "originals/#{original_filename}"
  thumbnail_key = "thumbnails/#{File.basename(original_filename, '.*')}_thumb.jpg"

  # Завантаження оригіналу до S3
  s3.bucket(bucket_name).object(key).upload_file(file.path)

  # Генерація мініатюри
  image = MiniMagick::Image.open(file.path)
  image.resize "200x200>"
  thumbnail_path = "/tmp/thumb_#{original_filename}"
  image.write thumbnail_path

  # Завантаження мініатюри до S3
  s3.bucket(bucket_name).object(thumbnail_key).upload_file(thumbnail_path)

  # Видалення тимчасового файлу
  File.delete(thumbnail_path) if File.exist?(thumbnail_path)

  # Повернення посилань на оригінал і мініатюру
  content_type :json
  {
    original_url: "#{cdn_url}/#{key}",
    thumbnail_url: "#{cdn_url}/#{thumbnail_key}"
  }.to_json
end

require_relative 'config/environment'

class ProductImageUploader
  def initialize(s3_client, s3_resource)
    @s3_client = s3_client
    @s3_resource = s3_resource
    @bucket_name = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME']
  end

  def upload_image(file_path, product_id)
    # Генерація ім'я файлу для оригінального зображення
    original_filename = File.basename(file_path)
    original_key = "products/#{product_id}/#{original_filename}"
    
    # Завантаження оригінального зображення
    @s3_client.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: original_key,
      body: File.open(file_path),
      content_type: 'image/jpeg'
    )
    
    # Генерація мініатюри
    thumbnail_key = "products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/#{original_filename}"
    generate_thumbnail(file_path, thumbnail_key)
    
    # Повертаємо URL для оригінального зображення та мініатюри
    {
      original_url: "https://#{@bucket_name}.s3.amazonaws.com/#{original_key}",
      thumbnail_url: "https://#{@bucket_name}.s3.amazonaws.com/#{thumbnail_key}"
    }
  end

  private

  def generate_thumbnail(input_path, output_key)
    # Використання MiniMagick для генерації мініатюри
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(input_path)
    image.resize(THUMBNAIL_SIZE)
    image.strip
    
    # Зберігаємо мініатюру в тимчасовий файл
    temp_file = Tempfile.new(['thumbnail', '.jpg'])
    image.write(temp_file.path)
    
    # Завантаження мініатюри в S3
    @s3_client.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: output_key,
      body: File.open(temp_file.path),
      content_type: 'image/jpeg'
    )
    
    # Очищення тимчасового файлу
    temp_file.unlink
  end

    end

    if @coupon && @coupon.valid?

    discount_amount = calculate_discount(subtotal)
    subtotal - discount_amount

# lib/image_processor.rb
require_relative 'environment'

class ImageProcessor
  def initialize
    @s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new
    @bucket_name = S3_BUCKET_NAME
  end

  def upload_and_process_image(file_path, product_id, original_filename)
    begin
      # Generate unique key for the original image
      original_key = "products/#{product_id}/original/#{original_filename}"
      
      # Upload original image to S3
      upload_original_image(file_path, original_key)
      
      # Generate thumbnails
      thumbnails = generate_thumbnails(file_path, product_id, original_filename)
      
      # Upload thumbnails to S3
      thumbnail_keys = upload_thumbnails(thumbnails, product_id)
      
      # Return image metadata
      {
        original_url: "#{CDN_BASE_URL}/#{original_key}",
        thumbnail_urls: thumbnail_keys.map { |key| "#{CDN_BASE_URL}/#{key}" },
        original_key: original_key,
        thumbnail_keys: thumbnail_keys
      }
    rescue => e
      LOGGER.error("Error processing image: #{e.message}")
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def upload_original_image(file_path, key)
    @s3_client.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: key,
      body: File.open(file_path, 'rb'),
      content_type: get_content_type(file_path)
    )
    LOGGER.info("Uploaded original image to S3: #{key}")
  end

  def generate_thumbnails(file_path, product_id, filename)
    sizes = [
      { width: 300, height: 300, suffix: 'small' },
      { width: 600, height: 600, suffix: 'medium' },
      { width: 1200, height: 1200, suffix: 'large' }
    ]

    thumbnails = []
    temp_dir = "/tmp/thumbnails_#{product_id}"
    Dir.mkdir(temp_dir) unless Dir.exist?(temp_dir)

    sizes.each do |size|
      output_path = File.join(temp_dir, "#{filename.split('.')[0]}_#{size[:suffix]}.jpg")
      
      MiniMagick::Tool::Convert.new do |convert|
        convert << file_path
        convert.resize "#{size[:width]}x#{size[:height]}^"
        convert.gravity "center"
        convert.background "white"
        convert.extent "#{size[:width]}x#{size[:height]}"
        convert.quality 90
        convert << output_path
      end
      
      thumbnails << {
        path: output_path,
        size: size,
        key: "products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/#{size[:suffix]}_#{filename}"
      }
    end

    thumbnails
  end

  def upload_thumbnails(thumbnails, product_id)
    thumbnail_keys = []
    
    thumbnails.each do |thumb|
      @s3_client.put_object(
        bucket: @bucket_name,
        key: thumb[:key],
        body: File.open(thumb[:path], 'rb'),
        content_type: 'image/jpeg',
        cache_control: 'public, max-age=31536000'
      )
      thumbnail_keys << thumb[:key]
      LOGGER.info("Uploaded thumbnail to S3: #{thumb[:key]}")
    end
    
    thumbnail_keys
  end

  def get_content_type(file_path)
    case File.extname(file_path).downcase
    when '.jpg', '.jpeg'
      'image/jpeg'
    when '.png'
      'image/png'
    when '.gif'
      'image/gif'
    else
      'image/jpeg'
    end
  end
end

require 'fedex-api'

  config.debug = true # Для логування запитів
end

# Створення відправлення
begin
  shipment = FedEx::Shipment.new do |s|
    s.service_type = 'FEDEX_GROUND'
    s.package_type = 'BOX'
    s.package_weight = 1.0
    s.dimensions = { length: 10, width: 10, height: 10 }

    s.shipper = {
      name: 'John Doe',
      company: 'Company Inc',
      phone: '123-456-7890',
      address: {
        street: '123 Main St',
        city: 'Anytown',
        state: 'CA',
        postal_code: '12345',
        country: 'US'
      }
    }

    s.recipient = {
      name: 'Jane Smith',
      company: 'Recipient Inc',
      phone: '098-765-4321',
      address: {
        street: '456 Oak Ave',
        city: 'Somewhere',
        state: 'NY',
        postal_code: '67890',
        country: 'US'
      }
    }
  end

  # Відправка відправлення
  response = shipment.create

  # Зберігаємо номер відстеження
  tracking_number = response['CompletedShipmentDetail']['CompletedPackageDetails'][0]['TrackingIds'][0]['TrackingNumber']
  puts "Номер відстеження: #{tracking_number}"

  # Завантаження етикетки у форматі PDF
  label_response = shipment.get_label(format: 'PDF')
  File.open('label.pdf', 'wb') do |file|
    file.write(label_response.body)
  end

  puts "Етикетка збережена як label.pdf"

rescue => e

```ruby
# fedex_shipment.rb
require 'fedex'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'fileutils'

class FedExShipment
  def initialize(config_file = 'fedex_config.json')
    @logger = Logger.new('fedex_shipment.log')
    @config = load_config(config_file)
    setup_fedex_client
  end

  def create_shipment(origin, destination, package_details, label_format = 'PDF')
    begin
      # Create shipment request
      shipment_request = {
        requested_shipment_details: {
          shipment_type: 'FEDEX_GROUND',
          shipper: format_address(origin),
          recipient: format_address(destination),
          packaging_type: 'YOUR_PACKAGING',
          package_count: 1,
          preferred_currency: 'USD',
          shipment_package_details: [package_details]
        },
        label_specification: {
          label_format: label_format,
          label_stock_type: 'PAPER_4X6'
        }
      }

      # Send to FedEx API
      response = @fedex_client.call(:create_shipment, shipment_request)
      
      # Extract tracking number and label
      tracking_number = extract_tracking_number(response)
      label_data = extract_label_data(response)
      
      # Save label to file
      label_filename = save_label(label_data, tracking_number)
      
      # Store tracking number
      store_tracking_number(tracking_number)
      
      @logger.info("Shipment created successfully")
      @logger.info("Tracking number: #{tracking_number}")
      @logger.info("Label saved to: #{label_filename}")
      
      {
        tracking_number: tracking_number,
        label_file: label_filename,
        response: response
      }
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error creating shipment: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  private

  def load_config(config_file)
    if File.exist?(config_file)
      JSON.parse(File.read(config_file))
    else
      # Default configuration - you should create fedex_config.json
      {
        "key": "YOUR_KEY",
        "password": "YOUR_PASSWORD",
        "account_number": "YOUR_ACCOUNT_NUMBER",
        "meter_number": "YOUR_METER_NUMBER",
        "production": false
      }
    end
  end

  def setup_fedex_client
    @fedex_client = FedEx::Client.new(
      key: @config['key'],
      password: @config['password'],
      account_number: @config['account_number'],
      meter_number: @config['meter_number'],
      production: @config['production'] || false
    )
  end

  def format_address(address_data)
    {
      address: {
        street_lines: [address_data[:street]],
        city: address_data[:city],
        state_or_province_code: address_data[:state],
        postal_code: address_data[:zip],
        country_code: address_data[:country] || 'US'
      }
    }
  end

  def extract_tracking_number(response)
    response.dig('CompletedShipmentDetail', 'CompletedPackageDetails', 0, 'TrackingIds', 0, 'TrackingNumber')
  end

  def extract_label_data(response)
    response.dig('CompletedShipmentDetail', 'CompletedPackageDetails', 0, 'Label', 'Parts', 0, 'Image')
  end

  def save_label(label_data, tracking_number)
    # Decode base64 data if needed
    pdf_data = decode_label_data(label_data)
    
    filename = "fedex_label_#{tracking_number}.pdf"
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(pdf_data)
    end
    
    filename
  end

  def decode_label_data(label_data)
    # If label data is base64 encoded
    if label_data.is_a?(String) && label_data.start_with?('JVBER')
      require 'base64'
      Base64.decode64(label_data)
    else
      label_data
    end
  end

  def store_tracking_number(tracking_number)
    File.open('tracking_numbers.txt', 'a') do |file|
      file.puts "#{Time.now}: #{tracking_number}"
    end
  end
end

      description: description,
      weight: weight,
      width: width,

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'
  
  def initialize(api_key, shop_id = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_id = shop_id
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    self.class.base_uri(BASE_URL)
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end
  
  # Fetch shop listings
  def get_shop_listings(limit: 25, offset: 0, status: 'active')
    path = "/application/shops/#{@shop_id}/listings"
    
    options = {
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset,
        status: status
      },
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.get(path, options)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch listings: #{response.code} - #{response.message}")

## `etsy_client.rb`

```ruby
require 'etsy-api'
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

class EtsyClient
  include HTTParty

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ETSY_API_KEY']
    @shop_name = ENV['ETSY_SHOP_NAME']
    
    raise "ETSY_API_KEY not set in environment" unless @api_key
    raise "ETSY_SHOP_NAME not set in environment" unless @shop_name

    # Налаштування HTTParty
    self.class.default_timeout 30
    self.class.headers({
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => @api_key
    })
  end

  # Отримання оголошень (listings) магазину
  def get_shop_listings(options = {})
    page = options[:page] || 1
    limit = options[:limit] || 25
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "https://openapi.etsy.com/v3/application/shops/#{@shop_name}/listings/active",
      query: {
        page: page,
        limit: limit
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання замовлень магазину
  def get_shop_orders(options = {})
    page = options[:page] || 1
    limit = options[:limit] || 25
    status = options[:status] || 'active' # active, completed, cancelled
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "https://openapi.etsy.com/v3/application/shops/#{@shop_name}/orders",
      query: {
        page: page,
        limit: limit,
        status: status
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання деталей конкретного оголошення
  def get_listing_details(listing_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "https://openapi.etsy.com/v3/application/shops/#{@shop_name}/listings/#{listing_id}"
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання деталей конкретного замовлення
  def get_order_details(order_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "https://openapi.etsy.com/v3/application/shops/#{@shop_name}/orders/#{order_id}"
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання статистики магазину
  def get_shop_stats
    response = self.class.get(
      "https://openapi.etsy.com/v3/application/shops/#{@shop_name}"
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      puts response.body if response.body
      nil
    end
  end
end

## BigCommerce Service Class

```ruby
# app/services/bigcommerce_service.rb
class BigCommerceService
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/{store_hash}/v3'.freeze
  HEADERS = {
    'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    'Accept' => 'application/json',
    'X-Auth-Token' => ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN']
  }.freeze

  attr_accessor :store_hash

  def initialize(store_hash = ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH'])
    @store_hash = store_hash
    self.class.base_uri(BASE_URL.gsub('{store_hash}', store_hash))
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end

  def create_product(product_data)
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        '/catalog/products',
        headers: HEADERS,
        body: product_data.to_json
      )

      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise BigCommerceError, "Failed to create product: #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce API Error: #{e.message}")
      raise BigCommerceError, e.message
    end
  end

  def create_order(order_data)
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        '/orders',
        headers: HEADERS,
        body: order_data.to_json
      )

      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise BigCommerceError, "Failed to create order: #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce API Error: #{e.message}")
      raise BigCommerceError, e.message
    end
  end

  def get_product(product_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "/catalog/products/#{product_id}",
        headers: HEADERS
      )

      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise BigCommerceError, "Failed to fetch product: #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce API Error: #{e.message}")
      raise BigCommerceError, e.message
    end
  end

  def get_order(order_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "/orders/#{order_id}",
        headers: HEADERS
      )

      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise BigCommerceError, "Failed to fetch order: #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce API Error: #{e.message}")
      raise BigCommerceError, e.message
    end
  end

  def update_product(product_id, product_data)
    begin
      response = self.class.put(
        "/catalog/products/#{product_id}",
        headers: HEADERS,
        body: product_data.to_json
      )

      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise BigCommerceError, "Failed to update product: #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce API Error: #{e.message}")
      raise BigCommerceError, e.message
    end
  end

  def delete_product(product_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.delete(
        "/catalog/products/#{product_id}",
        headers: HEADERS
      )

      if response.success?
        true
      else
        raise BigCommerceError, "Failed to delete product: #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce API Error: #{e.message}")
      raise BigCommerceError, e.message
    end
  end
end

class BigCommerceError < StandardError; end

### `recommendations.rb`

```ruby
require 'matrix'

class CollaborativeFilter
  def initialize
    @user_item_matrix = {}
    @items = Set.new
    @users = Set.new
  end

  def add_order(user_id, item_id)
    @user_item_matrix[user_id] ||= {}
    @user_item_matrix[user_id][item_id] = 1
    @items.add(item_id)
    @users.add(user_id)
  end

  def cosine_similarity(user_a, user_b)
    intersection = (@user_item_matrix[user_a].keys & @user_item_matrix[user_b].keys)
    return 0 if intersection.empty?

    dot_product = intersection.sum { |item| @user_item_matrix[user_a][item] * @user_item_matrix[user_b][item] }
    norm_a = Math.sqrt(@user_item_matrix[user_a].values.sum { |v| v * v })
    norm_b = Math.sqrt(@user_item_matrix[user_b].values.sum { |v| v * v })

    return 0 if norm_a == 0 || norm_b == 0

    dot_product / (norm_a * norm_b)
  end

  def find_similar_users(target_user)
    similarities = @users.reject { |u| u == target_user }.map do |user|
      [user, cosine_similarity(target_user, user)]
    end.sort_by { |_, sim| -sim }

    similarities.first(5) # Повертаємо 5 найбільш схожих користувачів
  end

  def recommend_items(target_user, num_recommendations = 5)
    similar_users = find_similar_users(target_user)

    item_scores = Hash.new(0)

    similar_users.each do |user, similarity|
      next if similarity <= 0

      @user_item_matrix[user].each do |item, _|
        next if @user_item_matrix[target_user][item] # Пропускаємо вже куплені товари

        item_scores[item] += similarity
      end
    end

    item_scores.sort_by { |_, score| -score }.first(num_recommendations).map(&:first)
  end
end

# Перевірте статус відповіді
if response.success?
  # Отримайте ідентифікатор фіскального чека
  receipt_id = JSON.parse(response.body)['id']

  # Відправте запит до API Checkbox для друку фіскального чека
  print_response = HTTParty.post(
    "https://api.checkbox.ua/v1/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts/#{receipt_id}/print",
    headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  )

  # Перевірте статус відповіді
  if print_response.success?
    puts 'Фіскальний чек успішно виданий!'
  else
    puts 'Помилка при друці фіскального чека'
  end
else
  puts 'Помилка при створенні фіскального чека'
end
```
Цей код створює фіскальний чек через API Checkbox після онлайн-оплати та друкує його. Для цього потрібно вказати свій API-токен, ідентифікатор магазину та дані про оплату.

Після виконання коду фіскальний чек буде виданий та надрукований. Якщо виникнуть помилки, код виведе повідомлення про помилку.

class XeroClient
  def initialize

  def send_invoice(invoice)

    invoice_data = {

        name: invoice.customer_name
      },
      date: invoice.date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      line_items: invoice.line_items.map do |item|
        {
          description: item.description,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit_amount: item.unit_amount
        }
      end
    }

    # Надсилання рахунку до Xero
    response = @client.invoices.create(invoice_data)

    # Отримання ідентифікатора створеного рахунку
    invoice_id = response['Invoices'].first['InvoiceID']

    # Повернення ідентифікатора рахунку
    invoice_id
  end

  def sync_payment_status(invoice)
    # Отримання статусу оплати рахунку з Xero
    response = @client.invoices.get(invoice.xero_invoice_id)
    payment_status = response['Invoices'].first['Status']

    # Оновлення статусу оплати у застосунку
    invoice.update(payment_status: payment_status)
  end
end

```ruby
# ukrposhta_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'byebug'

class UkrposhtaClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  # Створення відправлення
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.post('/shipments', 
      headers: headers,
      body: shipment_data.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надрукування етикетки
  def print_label(shipment_id)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.post("/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label", 
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання статусу відправлення
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_id)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }

    response = self.class.get("/shipments/#{shipment_id}", 
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise StandardError, "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise StandardError, "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 404
      raise StandardError, "Not Found: Shipment not found"
    when 500..599
      raise StandardError, "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise StandardError, "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/models/commerce_ml_handler.rb
class CommerceMlHandler
  include ActiveModel::Model
  
  attr_accessor :connection_url, :username, :password
  
  def initialize(connection_url: nil, username: nil, password: nil)
    @connection_url = connection_url
    @username = username
    @password = password
  end
  
  # Process product data from 1C
  def import_products(xml_data)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)
    products = []
    
    doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/Каталог/Товары/Товар').each do |product_node|
      product = parse_product_node(product_node)
      products << product
    end
    
    # Save products to database
    products.each do |product_data|
      Product.find_or_create_by(external_id: product_data[:external_id]) do |product|
        product.update!(product_data)
      end
    end
    
    products
  end
  
  # Export products to 1C
  def export_products
    products = Product.includes(:category).all
    
    xml_builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.КоммерческаяИнформация(ВерсияСхемы: '2.07', ДатаФормирования: Time.current.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) do
        xml.Каталог do
          xml.Товары do
            products.each do |product|
              xml.Товар do
                xml.Ид(product.external_id)
                xml.Наименование(product.name)
                xml.Описание(product.description) if product.description.present?
                
                xml.Категории do
                  xml.Ид(product.category.external_id) if product.category
                end
                
                xml.Цены do
                  xml.Цена do
                    xml.ЦенаЗаЕдиницу(product.price)
                    xml.Валюта('RUB')
                    xml.ТипЦены('Розничная')
                  end
                end
                
                xml.Количество(product.stock_quantity)
                xml.ЕдиницаИзмерения('шт')
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml_builder.to_xml
  end
  
  # Import orders from 1C
  def import_orders(xml_data)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)
    orders = []
    
    doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/Заказы/Заказ').each do |order_node|
      order = parse_order_node(order_node)
      orders << order
    end
    
    # Create orders in database
    orders.each do |order_data|
      order = Order.find_or_create_by(external_id: order_data[:external_id]) do |order|
        order.update!(order_data)
      end
      
      # Create order items
      order_data[:items].each do |item_data|
        OrderItem.find_or_create_by(
          order_id: order.id,
          product_id: Product.find_by(external_id: item_data[:product_external_id]).try(:id),
          quantity: item_data[:quantity],
          price: item_data[:price]
        )
      end
    end
    
    orders
  end
  
  # Export orders to 1C
  def export_orders

    @api_secret = api_secret

      api_secret: @api_secret,

    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipment/create",

      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def print_label(shipment_id)

      body: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        api_secret: @api_secret,
        shipment_id: shipment_id
      }.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipment/status/#{shipment_id}",
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else

  end

require 'httparty'

module OlxUaApi
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    # Configure the base URL and default headers
    base_uri 'https://developers.olx.ua/api/v1'

    # Initialize the client with API credentials
    def initialize(api_key, logger = nil)

    end
    
    # Publish a new advertisement
    def create_advertisement(ad_data)
      @logger.info("Creating new advertisement...")
      
      response = self.class.post(

          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
        },
        body: ad_data.to_json
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Update an existing advertisement
    def update_advertisement(ad_id, ad_data)
      @logger.info("Updating advertisement with ID: #{ad_id}")
      
      response = self.class.put(
        "/advertisements/#{ad_id}",
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
        },
        body: ad_data.to_json
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Get details of an advertisement
    def get_advertisement(ad_id)
      @logger.info("Fetching advertisement with ID: #{ad_id}")
      
      response = self.class.get(
        "/advertisements/#{ad_id}",
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
        }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Delete an advertisement
    def delete_advertisement(ad_id)
      @logger.info("Deleting advertisement with ID: #{ad_id}")
      
      response = self.class.delete(
        "/advertisements/#{ad_id}",
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
        }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # List advertisements
    def list_advertisements(params = {})
      @logger.info("Listing advertisements...")
      
      response = self.class.get(
        '/advertisements',
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
        },
        query: params
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    private
    
    # Handle API responses
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200..201
        @logger.info("API request successful")
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      when 400
        @logger.error("Bad Request: #{response.body}")
        raise Errors::BadRequest, response.body
      when 401
        @logger.error("Unauthorized: #{response.body}")
        raise Errors::Unauthorized, response.body
      when 404
        @logger.error("Not Found: #{response.body}")
        raise Errors::NotFound, response.body
      when 422
        @logger.error("Unprocessable Entity: #{response.body}")
        raise Errors::UnprocessableEntity, response.body
      when 500..599
        @logger.error("Server Error: #{response.body}")
        raise Errors::ServerError, response.body
      else
        @logger.error("Unexpected response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
        raise Errors::UnknownError, "Unexpected response code: #{response.code}"
      end
    end
    
    # Error classes
    module Errors
      class BaseError < StandardError; end
      class BadRequest < BaseError; end
      class Unauthorized < BaseError; end
      class NotFound < BaseError; end
      class UnprocessableEntity < BaseError; end
      class ServerError < BaseError; end
      class UnknownError < BaseError; end
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/controllers/commerce_ml_controller.rb
class CommerceMlController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_content_type

  def import_products
    xml_data = request.body.read
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)

    doc.xpath('//Товар').each do |product_node|
      name = product_node.at_xpath('Наименование')&.text
      price = product_node.at_xpath('Цена')&.text&.to_f

      Product.find_or_create_by(name: name) do |p|
        p.price = price
      end
    end

    render xml: { status: 'success' }.to_xml(root: 'response')
  end

  def export_products
    products = Product.all

    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct!
    xml.CommerceML(version: '2.0.1') do
      xml.Каталог do
        products.each do |product|
          xml.Товар do
            xml.Наименование product.name
            xml.Цена product.price
          end
        end
      end
    end

    render xml: xml.target!
  end

  def import_orders
    xml_data = request.body.read
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)

    doc.xpath('//Заказ').each do |order_node|
      customer = order_node.at_xpath('Покупатель')&.text
      order = Order.find_or_create_by(customer_name: customer)

      order_node.xpath('Товары/Товар').each do |item_node|
        product_name = item_node.at_xpath('Наименование')&.text
        quantity = item_node.at_xpath('Количество')&.text&.to_i
        price = item_node.at_xpath('Цена')&.text&.to_f

        product = Product.find_by(name: product_name)
        next unless product

        OrderItem.create!(
          order: order,
          product: product,
          quantity: quantity,
          price: price
        )
      end
    end

    render xml: { status: 'success' }.to_xml(root: 'response')
  end

  def export_orders
    orders = Order.includes(:order_items).all

    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct!
    xml.CommerceML(version: '2.0.1') do
      xml.Заказы do
        orders.each do |order|
          xml.Заказ do
            xml.Покупатель order.customer_name
            xml.Товары do
              order.order_items.each do |item|
                xml.Товар do
                  xml.Наименование item.product.name
                  xml.Количество item.quantity
                  xml.Цена item.price
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    render xml: xml.target!
  end

  private

  def set_content_type
    request.format = :xml
  end
end
```

**lib/olx_client.rb**
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'digest'

class OLXClient
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri OLXConfig.base_url
  
  def initialize
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
    self.class.headers({
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    })
  end
  
  def publish_advertisement(advertisement_data)
    endpoint = '/ads'
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, {
      body: advertisement_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers('POST', endpoint)
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def update_advertisement(ad_id, advertisement_data)
    endpoint = "/ads/#{ad_id}"
    response = self.class.put(endpoint, {
      body: advertisement_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers('PUT', endpoint)
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_advertisement(ad_id)
    endpoint = "/ads/#{ad_id}"
    response = self.class.get(endpoint, {
      headers: auth_headers('GET', endpoint)
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def delete_advertisement(ad_id)
    endpoint = "/ads/#{ad_id}"
    response = self.class.delete(endpoint, {
      headers: auth_headers('DELETE', endpoint)
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def auth_headers(method, path)
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i.to_s
    nonce = SecureRandom.hex(16)
    
    # Створення сигнатури
    signature_string = "#{method}#{path}#{timestamp}#{nonce}"
    signature = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(signature_string + OLXConfig.api_secret)
    
    {
      'X-OLX-API-Key' => OLXConfig.api_key,
      'X-OLX-Timestamp' => timestamp,
      'X-OLX-Nonce' => nonce,
      'X-OLX-Signature' => signature
    }
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..201
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise OLXBadRequestError, "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise OLXUnauthorizedError, "Unauthorized: #{response.body}"
    when 404
      raise OLXNotFoundError, "Not Found: #{response.body}"
    when 500..599
      raise OLXServerError, "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise OLXError, "Unexpected error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Виключення
class OLXError < StandardError; end
class OLXBadRequestError < OLXError; end
class OLXUnauthorizedError < OLXError; end
class OLXNotFoundError < OLXError; end
class OLXServerError < OLXError; end

require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'logger'

class OrderExporter
  include HTTParty

  end

    else
      @logger.error("Помилка експорту замовлення #{order[:id]}: #{response.body}")
    end

    response
  end

  private

  def build_xml(order)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.Order {
        xml.Id order[:id]
        xml.CustomerName order[:customer_name]
        xml.Date order[:date]
        xml.Items {
          order[:items].each do |item|
            xml.Item {
              xml.ProductCode item[:product_code]
              xml.Quantity item[:quantity]
              xml.Price item[:price]
            }
          end
        }
        xml.TotalAmount order[:total_amount]
      }
    end

  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'builder'
require 'json'

class BASExporter
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.bas.example.com/exports'  # Приклад URL, замініть на справжній
  HEADERS = {
    'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
    'Accept' => 'application/xml'
  }

  def initialize(api_key:)
    self.class.default_timeout 30
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  def export_order(order)
    xml = generate_xml(order)
    puts xml  # Для демонстрації
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, body: xml, headers: HEADERS)
    response.body
  end

  private

  def generate_xml(order)
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    builder.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'

    builder.orders do
      builder.order do
        builder.id(order[:id])
        builder.date(order[:date])
        builder.customer do
          builder.name(order[:customer][:name])
          builder.inn(order[:customer][:inn])
        end
        builder.items do
          order[:items].each do |item|
            builder.item do
              builder.name(item[:name])
              builder.quantity(item[:quantity])
              builder.price(item[:price])
            end
          end
        end
        builder.total(order[:total])
      end
    end
  end
end

# lib/glovo_order.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class GlovoOrder
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure the base URL for Glovo API
  base_uri 'https://api.glovoapp.com'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil, client_id = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    @client_id = client_id || ENV['GLOVO_CLIENT_ID']
    @logger = Logger.new('glovo_order.log')
    
    # Set default headers
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  def order_courier(order_params)
    # Validate required parameters
    validate_order_params(order_params)
    
    # Prepare the order request
    order_data = {
      order: {
        restaurant_id: order_params[:restaurant_id],
        customer: {
          address: order_params[:customer_address],
          phone: order_params[:customer_phone],
          name: order_params[:customer_name]
        },
        items: order_params[:items],
        delivery_type: 'fast',
        delivery_address: order_params[:delivery_address],
        metadata: {
          city: 'Kyiv',
          country: 'UA'
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Make the API request
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        '/orders',
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
          'X-Client-ID' => @client_id,
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
        },
        body: order_data.to_json
      )
      
      @logger.info("Order request sent: #{response.code}")
      
      if response.success?
        @logger.info("Order created successfully: #{response.body}")
        parse_order_response(response)
      else
        @logger.error("Order creation failed: #{response.body}")
        handle_error(response)
      end
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Network error: #{e.message}")
      raise "Network error occurred: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "/orders/#{order_id}",
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
          'X-Client-ID' => @client_id
        }
      )
      
      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to get order status: #{response.body}")
        handle_error(response)
      end
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Network error: #{e.message}")
      raise "Network error occurred: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_order_params(params)
    required_fields = [:restaurant_id, :customer_address, :customer_phone, :customer_name, 
                      :items, :delivery_address]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields - params.keys
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Validate that items is an array
    if !params[:items].is_a?(Array) || params[:items].empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Items must be a non-empty array"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_order_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    {
      order_id: data['id'],
      status: data['status'],
      estimated_delivery_time: data['estimated_delivery_time'],
      courier_info: data['courier']
    }
  end
  
  def handle_error(response)
    error_data = JSON.parse(response.body) rescue {}
    error_message = error_data['message'] || response.body
    raise "API Error (#{response.code}): #{error_message}"
  end
end

require 'httparty'

class GlovoOrder
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.glovoapp.com'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end
  
  def order_delivery(
    pickup_address,
    delivery_address,
    items,
    delivery_time = nil,
    notes = nil
  )
    # Validate required parameters
    raise ArgumentError, "Pickup address is required" if pickup_address.nil? || pickup_address.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Delivery address is required" if delivery_address.nil? || delivery_address.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Items are required" if items.nil? || items.empty?
    
    # Prepare the request payload
    payload = {
      pickup: {
        address: pickup_address,
        city: "Kyiv"
      },
      delivery: {
        address: delivery_address,
        city: "Kyiv"
      },
      items: items,
      deliveryTime: delivery_time || "ASAP",
      notes: notes
    }
    
    # API request
    response = self.class.post(
      '/orders',
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise StandardError, "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise StandardError, "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 404
      raise StandardError, "Not Found: Endpoint not available"
    when 500..599
      raise StandardError, "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise StandardError, "Unexpected error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

require 'active_model'

# Order model representing an order to be exported
class Order
  include ActiveModel::Model
  
  attr_accessor :id, :customer_name, :customer_tax_id, :order_date, 
                :items, :total_amount, :currency, :payment_method
  
  validates :id, :customer_name, :customer_tax_id, :order_date, 
            :items, :total_amount, :currency, presence: true
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    super(attributes)
    self.items ||= []
    self.order_date = Date.parse(order_date) if order_date.is_a?(String)
  end
  
  def valid_items?
    items.all? { |item| item.valid? }
  end
  
  def total_amount_with_vat
    # Assuming 20% VAT for Ukrainian businesses
    total_amount * 1.20
  end
end

# Order item model
class OrderItem
  include ActiveModel::Model
  
  attr_accessor :name, :quantity, :unit_price, :vat_rate, :total
  
  validates :name, :quantity, :unit_price, presence: true
  validates :quantity, :unit_price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    super(attributes)
    self.vat_rate ||= 20
    self.total = quantity * unit_price
  end
  
  def vat_amount
    total * (vat_rate / 100.0)
  end
  
  def total_with_vat
    total + vat_amount
  end
end

# BAS Exporter class
class BasExporter
  attr_reader :orders, :company_info
  
  def initialize(company_info = {})
    @orders = []
    @company_info = {
      name: company_info[:name] || "Company Name",
      tax_id: company_info[:tax_id] || "",
      address: company_info[:address] || "",
      bank_account: company_info[:bank_account] || "",
      bank_name: company_info[:bank_name] || ""
    }
  end
  
  def add_order(order)
    @orders << order if order.valid? && order.valid_items?
  end
  
  def export_to_xml
    xml = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.root("xmlns" => "http://bas.com.ua/schema") do
        xml.header do
          xml.company_name company_info[:name]
          xml.tax_id company_info[:tax_id]
          xml.export_date Date.today.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
          xml.export_time Time.now.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        end
        
        xml.orders do
          orders.each do |order|
            xml.order do
              xml.id order.id
              xml.date order.order_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
              xml.customer_name order.customer_name
              xml.customer_tax_id order.customer_tax_id
              xml.payment_method order.payment_method || "cash"
              
              xml.items do
                order.items.each do |item|
                  xml.item do
                    xml.name item.name
                    xml.quantity item.quantity
                    xml.unit_price item.unit_price
                    xml.vat_rate item.vat_rate
                    xml.total item.total
                    xml.vat_amount item.vat_amount
                    xml.total_with_vat item.total_with_vat
                  end
                end
              end
              
              xml.total_amount order.total_amount
              xml.total_amount_with_vat order.total_amount_with_vat
              xml.currency order.currency
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.to_xml
  end
  
  def export_to_csv
    CSV.generate do |csv|
      # Header row
      csv << ["Order ID", "Date", "Customer", "Tax ID", "Items", 
              "Total Amount", "Total with VAT", "Currency", "Payment Method"]
      
      orders.each do |order|
        items_summary = order.items.map { |item| "#{item.name}(#{item.quantity})" }.join("; ")
        
        csv << [

class KeyCrmService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['KEYCRM_API_URL']

    self.class.default_timeout 30
    self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['KEYCRM_API_TOKEN']}",
                       'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  end

  def create_order(order)
    payload = {
      customer: {
        name: order.customer_name,
        email: order.customer_email
      },
      items: order.items.map do |item|
        {
          product_name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          price: item[:price]
        }
      end,
      total_amount: order.total_amount
    }

    response = self.class.post('/orders', body: payload.to_json)

    if response.success?

Ось розв’язок завдання на Ruby для перевірки особи користувача через Onfido за документом і селфі. Код включає `Gemfile` з необхідними гемами та реалізацію програми.

---

## ✅ 1. **Gemfile**

```ruby
source "https://rubygems.org"

gem "onfido", "~> 2.0"
gem "dotenv", "~> 2.8"
```

> **Примітка:** `onfido` — це офіційний Ruby гем для інтеграції з Onfido API. `dotenv` використовується для завантаження змінних оточення з `.env`.

---

## ✅ 2. **.env**

Створіть файл `.env` у корені проекту:

```env
ONFIDO_API_TOKEN=your_api_token_here
ONFIDO_REGION=eu # або us, au
```

> Замініть `your_api_token_here` на справжній токен з Onfido.

---

## ✅ 3. **main.rb** — Основна реалізація

```ruby
require 'onfido'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Налаштування Onfido API
Onfido.configure do |config|
  config.api_token = ENV['ONFIDO_API_TOKEN']
  config.region = ENV['ONFIDO_REGION'] || 'eu'
end

# Створюємо клієнт
onfido = Onfido::Client.new

# ID користувача (використовується для створення заявки)
user_id = "user_id_here" # Замініть на справжній user_id з Onfido

# 1. Створюємо заявку (check) для перевірки особи
begin
  check = onfido.create_check(
    applicant_id: user_id,
    report_names: ["document", "facial_similarity"] # Документ та селфі
  )
  puts "Check created: #{check.id}"
rescue Onfido::Error => e
  puts "Error creating check: #{e.message}"
  exit
end

# 2. Завантажуємо документ (наприклад, паспорт)
document = onfido.upload_document(
  applicant_id: user_id,
  file: File.open("path/to/document.jpg"),
  document_type: "passport"
)

puts "Document uploaded: #{document.id}"

# 3. Завантажуємо селфі
selfie = onfido.upload_selfie(
  applicant_id: user_id,
  file: File.open("path/to/selfie.jpg")
)

puts "Selfie uploaded: #{selfie.id}"

# 4. Очікуємо результати перевірки (опціонально)
puts "Waiting for check results..."
sleep(10) # Зачекати 10 секунд перед перевіркою результатів

# 5. Отримуємо результати перевірки
begin
  results = onfido.find_check(check.id)
  puts "Check status: #{results.status}"
  puts "Report results: #{results.reports.map(&:name)}"
rescue Onfido::Error => e
  puts "Error fetching check: #{e.message}"
end
```

1. Встановіть геми:

```

2. Запустіть скрипт:

ruby main.rb
```

class Order < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user

  validates :total_amount, presence: true
  validates :status, presence: true

  def sync_with_keycrm
    return if status == 'synced'

    client = KeyCRMClient.new
    response = client.create_order(self)

    if response.success?
      update(status: 'synced', keycrm_id: response.data['id'])

    end

## 🌐 3. Клієнт для KeyCRM API (`app/services/key_crm_client.rb`)

```ruby
# app/services/key_crm_client.rb
require 'httparty'

class KeyCRMClient
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://api.keycrm.com/v1'

  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['KEYCRM_API_TOKEN']}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def create_order(order)
    response = self.class.post('/orders', headers: @headers, body: {
      customer_id: order.user.keycrm_customer_id,
      items: order.line_items.map { |item|
        {
          product_id: item.product.keycrm_product_id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          price: item.price
        }
      },
      total_amount: order.total_amount
    }.to_json)

    OpenStruct.new(
      success?: response.success?,
      data: response.parsed_response,
      error: response.error
    )
  end
end
```

### 3. Додавання OmniAuth Strategies

Додайте до моделі `User` підтримку OmniAuth:

```ruby
# app/models/user.rb

class User < ApplicationRecord
  devise :database_authenticatable, :registerable,
         :recoverable, :rememberable, :validatable,
         :omniauthable, omniauth_providers: %i[google_oauth2 apple]

  def self.from_omniauth(auth)
    where(provider: auth.provider, uid: auth.uid).first_or_create do |user|
      user.email = auth.info.email
      user.password = Devise.friendly_token[0, 20]
      user.first_name = auth.info.first_name
      user.last_name = auth.info.last_name
      user.image = auth.info.image
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/controllers/users/omniauth_callbacks_controller.rb

class Users::OmniauthCallbacksController < Devise::OmniauthCallbacksController
  def google_oauth2
    handle_omniauth('google_oauth2')
  end

  def apple
    handle_omniauth('apple')
  end

  def failure
    redirect_to root_path
  end

  private

  def handle_omniauth(provider)
    @user = User.from_omniauth(request.env["omniauth.auth"])

    if @user.persisted?
      sign_in_and_redirect @user, event: :authentication
      set_flash_message(:notice, :success, kind: provider.capitalize) if is_navigational_format?
    else
      session["devise.#{provider}_data"] = request.env["omniauth.auth"]
      redirect_to new_user_registration_url
    end
  end
end

      email: email,

      address: {

        country: 'GBR',
        postcode: 'SW1A 1AA'
      }
    )
    
    puts "Created applicant: #{applicant.id}"
    applicant

    puts "Error creating applicant: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  # Upload document for verification
  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_type, file_path)
    file = File.open(file_path, 'rb')
    
    document = @onfido.document.create(
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      document_type: document_type,
      file: file
    )
    
    file.close
    puts "Uploaded document: #{document.id}"
    document
  rescue Onfido::Error => e
    puts "Error uploading document: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

    file = File.open(file_path, 'rb')

      file: file

    file.close
    puts "Uploaded selfie: #{selfie.id}"

    puts "Error uploading selfie: #{e.message}"
    nil

    check = @onfido.check.create(

      document_id: document_id
    )
    
    puts "Created document check: #{check.id}"

require 'json'
require 'faraday'

# Налаштування DocuSign
DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_ID = ENV['DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_ID']
DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_SECRET = ENV['DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_SECRET']
DOCUSIGN_IMPERSONATION_USER_ID = ENV['DOCUSIGN_IMPERSONATION_USER_ID']
DOCUSIGN_BASE_URL = 'https://demo.docusign.net/restapi' # або 'https://www.docusign.net/restapi' для продуку
DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID = ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID']

# Створення клієнта DocuSign
def create_docusign_client
  api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(DOCUSIGN_BASE_URL)
  api_client.add_default_header('Authorization', "Bearer #{get_access_token}")
  DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.default.api_client = api_client
end

# Отримання токена доступу
def get_access_token
  # Для простоти використовуємо OAuth2 з "Authorization Code" flow
  # В реальному додатку можна використовувати refresh token і зберігати токен у сессії/базі

  # Якщо потрібно запустити спочатку токен через OAuth2:
  # Використовуйте DocuSign OAuth2 авторизацію
  # Наприклад, через код для отримання токена із DocuSign

  # Поки що припустимо, що токен вже отриманий або зберігається в ENV
  ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN']
end

# Відправка документа на підписання
def send_envelope(file_path, email, name)
  create_docusign_client

  # Створення документа
  document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new(
    document_base64: Base64.encode64(File.read(file_path)),
    name: File.basename(file_path),
    document_id: '1'
  )

  # Створення підпису
  signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new(
    email: email,
    name: name,
    recipient_id: '1',
    routing_order: '1'
  )

  # Створення поля підпису
  sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new(
    document_id: '1',
    page_number: '1',
    recipient_id: '1',
    tab_label: 'SignHereTab',
    x_position: '100',
    y_position: '100'
  )

  # Додаємо поле підпису до підпису
  signer.tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new(sign_here_tabs: [sign_here])

  # Створення об'єкта envelope (договір)
  envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
    email_subject: 'Please sign this document',
    documents: [document],
    recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new(signers: [signer]),
    status: 'sent'
  )

  # Відправка
  envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new
  envelope_summary = envelopes_api.create_envelope(DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID, envelope_definition)

  puts "Envelope sent! Envelope ID: #{envelope_summary.envelope_id}"
  envelope_summary.envelope_id
end

# Завантаження підписаного документа
def download_signed_document(envelope_id, output_path)
  create_docusign_client

  envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new
  pdf = envelopes_api.get_document(DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID, envelope_id, 'combined')

  File.open(output_path, 'wb') do |f|
    f.write(pdf)
  end

  puts "Signed document downloaded to #{output_path}"
end

  output_path = 'signed_contract.pdf'

  envelope_id = send_envelope(file_path, email, name)
  download_signed_document(envelope_id, output_path)
end

```ruby
# onfido_verification.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class OnfidoVerification
  include HTTParty
  base_uri "https://api.onfido.com/v3"

  def initialize
    @headers = {
      "Authorization" => "Token token=#{ENV['ONFIDO_API_TOKEN']}",
      "Content-Type" => "application/json"
    }
  end

  def create_applicant(first_name, last_name)
    response = self.class.post(
      "/applicants",
      headers: @headers,
      body: {
        first_name: first_name,
        last_name: last_name
      }.to_json
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_path)
    file = File.open(document_path, 'rb')
    response = self.class.post(
      "/documents",
      headers: @headers.merge("Content-Type" => "multipart/form-data"),
      body: {
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        document_type: "passport",
        file: file
      }
    )

    file.close
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def upload_selfie(applicant_id, selfie_path)
    file = File.open(selfie_path, 'rb')
    response = self.class.post(
      "/images",
      headers: @headers.merge("Content-Type" => "multipart/form-data"),
      body: {
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        image_type: "selfie",
        file: file
      }
    )

    file.close
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def create_check(applicant_id, document_id, selfie_id)
    response = self.class.post(
      "/checks",
      headers: @headers,
      body: {
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        report_ids: ["document", "facial_similarity"].map(&:to_s),
        tags: ["verification"]
      }.to_json
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def get_check_result(check_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/checks/#{check_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end

# Приклад використання:
if __FILE__ == $0
  onfido = OnfidoVerification.new

  applicant = onfido.create_applicant("John", "Doe")
  applicant_id = applicant["id"]

  document = onfido.upload_document(applicant_id, "passport.jpg")
  document_id = document["id"]

  selfie = onfido.upload_selfie(applicant_id, "selfie.jpg")
  selfie_id = selfie["id"]

  check = onfido.create_check(applicant_id, document_id, selfie_id)
  check_id = check["id"]

  puts "Check created with ID: #{check_id}"

  # Отримати результат перевірки (може бути не миттєвим)
  result = onfido.get_check_result(check_id)
  puts "Check result: #{result['status']}"
end

require 'httparty'

require 'json'

class OFACChecker
  include HTTParty

  # Налаштування базової URL API OFAC (приклад, якщо є публічний API)
  base_uri 'https://api.ofac.treasury.gov'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['OFAC_API_KEY']
  end

  def check_person(name:, country: nil)
    # Формуємо запит до API OFAC
    options = {
      query: {
        name: name,
        country: country
      },
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }

# app/models/concerns/encryptable.rb
module Encryptable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  class_methods do
    def encryptable(*attributes)
      attributes.each do |attr|
        define_method("#{attr}=") do |value|
          encrypted_value = encrypt_value(value)
          super(encrypted_value)
        end

        define_method(attr) do
          encrypted_value = read_attribute(attr)
          decrypt_value(encrypted_value)
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def encrypt_value(value)
      return nil if value.nil?
      
      # Generate a random IV (Initialization Vector)
      iv = OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(16)
      
      # Create cipher
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-CBC')
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.iv = iv
      
      # Encrypt the value
      encrypted = cipher.update(value.to_s) + cipher.final
      
      # Combine IV and encrypted data
      combined = iv + encrypted
      
      # Base64 encode for storage
      Base64.encode64(combined)
    end

    def decrypt_value(encrypted_value)
      return nil if encrypted_value.nil?
      
      # Decode from Base64
      combined = Base64.decode64(encrypted_value)
      
      # Extract IV and encrypted data
      iv = combined[0..15]
      encrypted = combined[16..-1]
      
      # Create cipher
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-CBC')
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.iv = iv
      
      # Decrypt the value
      cipher.update(encrypted) + cipher.final
    end
  end
end

# app/models/user.rb

class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_secure_password

  validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true

  def otp_secret
    read_attribute(:otp_secret) || generate_otp_secret
  end

  def generate_otp_secret
    secret = ROTP::Base32.random_base32
    update_column(:otp_secret, secret)
    secret
  end

  def otp_uri
    issuer = Rails.application.class.module_parent_name
    ROTP::TOTP.new(otp_secret, issuer: issuer).provisioning_uri(email)
  end

  def verify_otp(token)
    totp = ROTP::TOTP.new(otp_secret)
    totp.verify(token, drift_window: 1)
  end
end

class TwoFactorController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :require_otp_setup, except: [:setup, :verify_setup]

  def setup
    @user = current_user
    @qr_code_uri = @user.otp_uri
  end

  def verify_setup
    token = params[:token]
    if current_user.verify_otp(token)
      session[:otp_verified] = true
      redirect_to root_path, notice: '2FA успішно налаштовано!'
    else
      flash.now[:alert] = 'Невірний код. Спробуйте ще раз.'
      render :setup
    end
  end

  def disable
    current_user.update(otp_secret: nil)
    session.delete(:otp_verified)
    redirect_to root_path, notice: '2FA вимкнено.'
  end

  private

  def require_otp_setup
    redirect_to setup_two_factor_path unless session[:otp_verified]
  end
end

### 1. First, create the encryption module:

```ruby
# lib/encrypted_attributes.rb
require 'openssl'
require 'aes-256-gcm'
require 'base64'
require 'securerandom'

module EncryptedAttributes
  class EncryptionError < StandardError; end
  
  class << self
    def encrypt(value, key = nil)
      return nil if value.nil?
      
      key = key || default_key
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-GCM')
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = key
      
      encrypted = cipher.update(value.to_s) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag
      
      {
        encrypted_data: Base64.encode64(encrypted),
        auth_tag: Base64.encode64(tag),
        iv: Base64.encode64(cipher.iv)
      }
    end
    
    def decrypt(encrypted_data, auth_tag, iv, key = nil)
      return nil if encrypted_data.nil?
      
      key = key || default_key
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-GCM')
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = key
      cipher.iv = Base64.decode64(iv)
      cipher.auth_tag = Base64.decode64(auth_tag)
      
      decrypted = cipher.update(Base64.decode64(encrypted_data)) + cipher.final
      decrypted
    end
    
    def default_key
      # In production, use Rails.application.secret_key_base or environment variable
      ENV['ENCRYPTION_KEY'] || 'this_is_a_32_byte_key_for_aes_256_gcm__123456789012'
    end
    
    def generate_key
      SecureRandom.hex(32) # 32 bytes = 256 bits
    end
  end
end

      @encrypted_attributes << attribute_name
      
      # Define getter and setter methods
      define_method("#{attribute_name}_encrypted") do
        instance_variable_get("@#{attribute_name}_encrypted")
      end
      
      define_method("#{attribute_name}_encrypted=") do |value|
        instance_variable_set("@#{attribute_name}_encrypted", value)
      end
      
      # Define the main attribute getter
      define_method(attribute_name) do
        encrypted_value = send("#{attribute_name}_encrypted")
        return nil if encrypted_value.nil?
        
        # Check if it's a hash (from encryption) or a string (legacy)
        if encrypted_value.is_a?(Hash) && encrypted_value.key?(:encrypted_data)
          EncryptedAttributes.decrypt(
            encrypted_value[:encrypted_data],
            encrypted_value[:auth_tag],
            encrypted_value[:iv]
          )
        elsif encrypted_value.is_a?(String) && encrypted_value.include?('encrypted_data')
          # Handle legacy format if needed
          begin
            parsed = JSON.parse(encrypted_value)
            EncryptedAttributes.decrypt(
              parsed['encrypted_data'],
              parsed['auth_tag'],
              parsed['iv']
            )
          rescue JSON::ParserError
            # If parsing fails, return as-is
            encrypted_value
          end
        else
          encrypted_value
        end
      end
      
      # Define the main attribute setter
      define_method("#{attribute_name}=") do |value|
        # Only encrypt if the value is not nil
        if value.nil?
          instance_variable_set("@#{attribute_name}", nil)
          send("#{attribute_name}_encrypted=", nil)
        else
          encrypted_data = EncryptedAttributes.encrypt(value)
          instance_variable_set("@#{attribute_name}", value)
          send("#{attribute_name}_encrypted=", encrypted_data)
        end
      end
      
      # Add before_save callback to save encrypted data
      before_save do
        encrypted_value = send(attribute_name)
        if encrypted_value != instance_variable_get("@#{attribute_name}")
          send("#{attribute_name}=", encrypted_value)
        end
      end
    end
    
    def encrypted_attributes
      @encrypted_attributes || []
    end
  end

  # Include the encrypted attributes in the model
  def encrypted_attribute_names
    self.class.encrypted_attributes
  end

### 1. Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rails', '~> 7.0'

### 2. Модель (приклад)

Припустимо, у нас є модель `User` з полями:

- `passport_number` (номер паспорта)
- `birth_date` (дата народження)

```ruby
# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  # Зашифровані поля
  encrypts :passport_number, :birth_date

  # Використання encrypts автоматично шифрує та дешифрує поля
end
```

### 3. Встановлення шифрувальних гемів

Для цього завдання використовуємо гем `encryptor` або `active_support` з `attr_encrypted`.

#### Варіант 1: Використання `attr_encrypted`

```ruby
# Gemfile
