# diia_push_notification.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

class DiiaPushNotification
  include HTTParty

  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(api_key:, base_url: 'https://api.diia.gov.ua/partner')
    @api_key = api_key
    @base_url = base_url
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  # Send push notification to a single user
  def send_notification(user_id:, title:, body:, data: {}, device_token: nil)
    payload = build_notification_payload(
      user_id: user_id,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      device_token: device_token
    )

    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/notifications", 
                              body: payload.to_json,
                              headers: auth_headers)

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send push notification to multiple users
  def send_bulk_notifications(notifications_data)
    responses = []
    
    notifications_data.each do |data|
      begin
        response = send_notification(**data)
        responses << { user_id: data[:user_id], status: 'success', response: response }
      rescue => e
        responses << { user_id: data[:user_id], status: 'error', error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    responses
  end

  # Send notification with device token directly
  def send_direct_notification(device_token:, title:, body:, data: {})
    payload = build_direct_notification_payload(
      device_token: device_token,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data
    )

    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/notifications/direct",
                              body: payload.to_json,
                              headers: auth_headers)

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get notification status
  def get_notification_status(notification_id)
    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/notifications/#{notification_id}",
                            headers: auth_headers)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get user notifications history
  def get_user_notifications_history(user_id, limit: 10)
    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/users/#{user_id}/notifications/history?limit=#{limit}",
                            headers: auth_headers)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_notification_payload(user_id:, title:, body:, data:, device_token: nil)
    payload = {
      user_id: user_id,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        data: data
      }
    }

    payload[:device_token] = device_token if device_token

    payload
  end

  def build_direct_notification_payload(device_token:, title:, body:, data: {})
    {
      device_token: device_token,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        data: data
      }
    }
  end

  def auth_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    @logger.info("API Response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")

    case response.code
    when 200..201
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise StandardError, "Unauthorized access: #{response.body}"
    when 403
      raise StandardError, "Forbidden access: #{response.body}"
    when 404
      raise StandardError, "Resource not found: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise StandardError, "Rate limit exceeded: #{response.body}"
    when 500..599
      raise StandardError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise StandardError, "Unexpected response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# diia_push_notification.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class DiiaPushNotificationService
  include HTTParty

  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(api_key:, base_url:, logger: nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @base_url = base_url
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end

  # Send push notification to single user
  def send_notification(user_id, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{@base_url}/notifications",
        body: build_notification_payload(user_id, title, body, data, options),
        headers: build_headers
      )

      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to send notification to user #{user_id}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  # Send push notification to multiple users
  def send_bulk_notifications(user_ids, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    results = {}
    user_ids.each do |user_id|
      begin
        results[user_id] = send_notification(user_id, title, body, data, options)
      rescue => e
        results[user_id] = { success: false, error: e.message }
      end
    end
    results
  end

  # Send notification with device tokens directly
  def send_to_tokens(device_tokens, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{@base_url}/notifications/batch",
        body: build_batch_payload(device_tokens, title, body, data, options),
        headers: build_headers
      )

      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to send batch notification to tokens: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  # Get notification status
  def get_notification_status(notification_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/notifications/#{notification_id}",
      headers: build_headers
    )
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_notification_payload(user_id, title, body, data, options)
    payload = {
      user_id: user_id,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      options: options
    }.compact

    # Add default options if not provided
    payload[:options] ||= {}
    payload[:options][:priority] ||= 'high'
    payload[:options][:time_to_live] ||= 3600

    payload
  end

  def build_batch_payload(device_tokens, title, body, data, options)
    {
      device_tokens: device_tokens,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      options: options
    }.compact
  end

  def build_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..201
      parse_json_response(response.body)
    when 400
      raise ArgumentError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise SecurityError, "Unauthorized access: #{response.body}"
    when 403
      raise SecurityError, "Forbidden: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise StandardError, "Rate limit exceeded: #{response.body}"
    when 500..599
      raise StandardError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise StandardError, "Unexpected response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def parse_json_response(body)
    JSON.parse(body)
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    body
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class BinotelCall
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api'.freeze

  def initialize(account_id, api_key, api_secret)
    @account_id = account_id
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
  end

  def make_voice_call(caller_number, recipient_number, message_text = nil, message_file_url = nil)
    # Prepare the request parameters
    params = {
      'account_id' => @account_id,
      'api_key' => @api_key,
      'api_secret' => @api_secret,
      'caller' => caller_number,
      'callee' => recipient_number,
      'type' => 'call'
    }

    # Add message content if provided
    if message_text
      params['text'] = message_text
    elsif message_file_url
      params['file_url'] = message_file_url
    end

    # Make the API request
    response = self.class.post('/call/', {
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    })

    process_response(response)
  end

  def make_call_with_ivr(caller_number, recipient_number, ivr_menu_id)
    params = {
      'account_id' => @account_id,
      'api_key' => @api_key,
      'api_secret' => @api_secret,
      'caller' => caller_number,
      'callee' => recipient_number,
      'type' => 'ivr_call',
      'ivr_menu' => ivr_menu_id
    }

    response = self.class.post('/call/', {
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    })

    process_response(response)
  end

  private

  def process_response(response)
    begin
      parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if parsed_response['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          call_id: parsed_response['call_id'],
          message: parsed_response['message'] || 'Call initiated successfully'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: parsed_response['error'] || 'Call failed',
          details: parsed_response
        }
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Invalid API response format',
        raw_response: response.body
      }
    end
  end
end

require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'

class InvoiceGenerator
  def initialize(invoice_data, file_path)
    @invoice_data = invoice_data
    @file_path = file_path
  end

  def generate
    Prawn::Document.generate(@file_path) do |pdf|
      pdf.text "Рахунок", size: 20, style: :bold
      pdf.move_down 20

      pdf.text "Клієнт: #{@invoice_data[:client_name]}"
      pdf.text "Адреса: #{@invoice_data[:client_address]}"
      pdf.text "Дата: #{@invoice_data[:date]}"
      pdf.move_down 20

      # Таблиця позицій
      table_data = [
        ["Назва", "Кількість", "Ціна", "Сума"]
      ]

      @invoice_data[:items].each do |item|
        table_data << [
          item[:name],
          item[:quantity],
          "$#{item[:price]}",
          "$#{item[:quantity] * item[:price]}"
        ]
      end

      # Підсумок
      total = @invoice_data[:items].sum { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:price] }
      vat = total * 0.2  # Припустимо 20% ПДВ
      grand_total = total + vat

      table_data << ["", "", "Підсумок:", "$#{total}"]
      table_data << ["", "", "ПДВ (20%):", "$#{vat}"]
      table_data << ["", "", "Загалом:", "$#{grand_total}"]

      pdf.table(table_data, cell_style: { size: 12 }) do
        row(0).style(bold: true)
        row(-1).style(bold: true)
        row(-2).style(bold: true)
        row(-3).style(bold: true)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'alpha_vantage'
require 'json'

# Встановлюємо API ключ від Alpha Vantage
api_key = 'YOUR_ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY' # Замініть на ваш дійсний ключ
client = AlphaVantage::Client.new(api_key: api_key)

ticker = 'AAPL' # Приклад тікера

begin
  # Отримуємо історичні дані за 20 днів
  response = client.time_series_daily(symbol: ticker, outputsize: 'compact')

  # Витягуємо дати та ціни закриття
  data = response['Time Series (Daily)']
  prices = data.map { |date, info| info['4. close'].to_f }.reverse

  # Обчислюємо 20-денне ковзне середнє
  moving_average = calculate_moving_average(prices, 20)

  puts "20-денне ковзне середнє для #{ticker}:"
  puts moving_average.round(2)

rescue => e
  puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
end

def calculate_moving_average(prices, window)
  return nil if prices.length < window

  averages = []
  prices.each_cons(window) do |window_prices|
    averages << window_prices.sum / window
  end

  averages.last # Повертаємо останнє ковзне середнє
end
```

3. Запустіть скрипт:

   ```

# card_validator.rb

require 'active_model'

class CreditCardValidator
  include ActiveModel::Validations

  attr_accessor :number

  validates :number, presence: true
  validates :number, format: { with: /\A\d+\z/, message: "має містити лише цифри" }
  validates :number, length: { in: 13..19, message: "має містити від 13 до 19 цифр" }

  def initialize(number)
    @number = number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Видаляє пробіли
  end

  def valid?
    super && luhn_valid?
  end

  def system
    return nil unless valid?

    case @number
    when /^4/ then 'Visa'
    when /^5[1-5]/, /^2[2-7]/ then 'MasterCard'
    when /^3[47]/ then 'American Express'
    when /^6(?:011|5)/ then 'Discover'
    when /^35/ then 'JCB'
    else 'Невідома система'
    end
  end

  private

  def luhn_valid?
    digits = @number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.odd?
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        sum += digit
      end
    end
    sum % 10 == 0
  end
end

        currency: order_data['currency']
      },

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

# Встановіть свій API-ключ з Alpha Vantage
API_KEY = 'YOUR_API_KEY'
BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'

def fetch_stock_data(symbol)
  url = "#{BASE_URL}?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=#{symbol}&apikey=#{API_KEY}&outputsize=compact"
  response = HTTParty.get(url)
  data = response.parsed_response

  if data['Error Message']
    puts "Помилка: #{data['Error Message']}"
    return nil
  end

  data['Time Series (Daily)']
end

def calculate_ma(prices, period = 20)
  ma_values = []

  prices.each_with_index do |price, index|
    if index >= period - 1
      window = prices[(index - period + 1)..index]
      average = window.sum / period.to_f
      ma_values << average
    else
      ma_values << nil
    end
  end

  ma_values
end

def main
  symbol = 'AAPL' # Змініть на потрібний тікер

  data = fetch_stock_data(symbol)

  if data
    # Витягуємо дати та ціни
    dates = data.keys.sort.reverse
    prices = dates.map { |date| data[date]['4. close'].to_f }

    # Обчислюємо 20-денне ковзне середнє
    ma = calculate_ma(prices, 20)

    puts "20-денне ковзне середнє для #{symbol}:"
    dates.zip(ma).each do |date, ma_val|
      next if ma_val.nil?
      puts "#{date}: #{ma_val.round(2)}"
    end
  else
    puts "Не вдалося отримати дані для #{symbol}"
  end
end

main

# stock_analyzer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class StockAnalyzer
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end
  
  def get_historical_prices(ticker, outputsize: 'compact')
    # Fetch daily adjusted prices from Alpha Vantage
    response = self.class.get('/', query: {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY_ADJUSTED',
      symbol: ticker,
      outputsize: outputsize,
      apikey: @api_key
    })
    
    if response['Note']
      raise "API Limit Reached: #{response['Note']}"
    end
    
    if response['Error Message']
      raise "API Error: #{response['Error Message']}"
    end
    
    # Extract and parse the time series data
    time_series = response['Time Series (Daily)']
    return [] if time_series.nil?
    
    # Convert to array of hashes with dates as keys
    prices = time_series.map do |date, data|
      {
        date: Date.parse(date),
        close: data['4. close'].to_f,
        volume: data['6. volume'].to_i
      }
    end
    
    # Sort by date (newest first)
    prices.sort_by { |price| price[:date] }.reverse
  end
  
  def calculate_moving_average(prices, days: 20)
    return [] if prices.length < days
    
    averages = []
    
    (days-1...prices.length).each do |i|
      # Get the last 'days' number of prices
      recent_prices = prices[(i-days+1)..i]
      
      # Calculate the average
      average = recent_prices.sum { |price| price[:close] } / days.to_f
      
      averages << {
        date: prices[i][:date],
        average: average
      }
    end
    
    averages
  end
  
  def analyze_stock(ticker)
    puts "Fetching historical prices for #{ticker}..."
    prices = get_historical_prices(ticker)
    
    if prices.empty?
      puts "No data found for #{ticker}"
      return nil
    end
    
    puts "Got #{prices.length} price records"
    
    # Calculate 20-day moving average
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, days: 20)
    
    puts "Calculated #{moving_averages.length} moving averages"
    
    # Display results
    puts "\nRecent 20-day moving averages:"
    puts "Date\t\tClose\t\t20-Day MA"
    puts "-" * 40
    
    # Show last 10 averages
    moving_averages.last(10).each do |avg|
      price = prices.find { |p| p[:date] == avg[:date] }
      puts "#{avg[:date]}\t#{price[:close].round(2)}\t\t#{avg[:average].round(2)}"
    end
    
    {
      ticker: ticker,
      prices: prices,
      moving_averages: moving_averages
    }
  end
end

class CardValidator
  # Визначення типів карток за префіксами
  CARD_TYPES = {
    '4' => 'Visa',
    '51' => 'MasterCard',
    '52' => 'MasterCard',
    '53' => 'MasterCard',
    '54' => 'MasterCard',
    '55' => 'MasterCard',
    '34' => 'American Express',
    '37' => 'American Express'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(card_number)
    @card_number = card_number.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Видаляємо пробіли
  end

  def valid?
    return false unless @card_number.match?(/^\d+$/)
    return false unless @card_number.length >= 13 && @card_number.length <= 19

    luhn_valid?
  end

  def card_type
    return nil unless valid?

    CARD_TYPES.each do |prefix, type|
      return type if @card_number.start_with?(prefix)
    end

    'Unknown'
  end

  private

  def luhn_valid?
    digits = @card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    reverse_digits = digits.reverse

    reverse_digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.odd?
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        sum += digit
      end
    end

    sum % 10 == 0
  end
end
```

# lib/credit_card_validator.rb
require 'active_model'

class CreditCardValidator
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  include ActiveModel::Attributes

  attr_accessor :number, :name, :expiry_month, :expiry_year, :cvv

  validates :number, presence: true, format: { with: /\A\d+\z/, message: "must contain only digits" }
  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :expiry_month, presence: true, inclusion: { in: 1..12, message: "must be between 1 and 12" }
  validates :expiry_year, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: Date.current.year }
  validates :cvv, presence: true, format: { with: /\A\d{3,4}\z/, message: "must be 3 or 4 digits" }

  def initialize(attributes = {})
    @number = attributes[:number]
    @name = attributes[:name]
    @expiry_month = attributes[:expiry_month]
    @expiry_year = attributes[:expiry_year]
    @cvv = attributes[:cvv]
  end

  def valid?
    super && valid_card_number?
  end

  def brand
    return nil unless valid_number?
    
    case @number
    when /^4/
      'Visa'
    when /^5[1-5]/, /^2[2-7]/
      'MasterCard'
    when /^3[47]/
      'American Express'
    when /^6(?:011|5)/
      'Discover'
    when /^35/
      'JCB'
    else
      'Unknown'
    end
  end

  def valid_number?
    @number && luhn_valid?(@number)
  end

  private

  def luhn_valid?(number)
    # Remove spaces and check if all characters are digits
    digits = number.gsub(/\s/, '')
    return false unless digits.match?(/\A\d+\z/)

    # Convert to array of integers
    digit_array = digits.chars.map(&:to_i)
    
    # Apply Luhn algorithm
    sum = 0
    digit_array.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.odd?
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        sum += digit
      end
    end
    
    sum % 10 == 0
  end

  def valid_card_number?
    return false unless @number
    
    # Remove spaces for validation
    clean_number = @number.gsub(/\s/, '')
    
    # Check length based on card type
    case brand
    when 'Visa'
      clean_number.length == 13 || clean_number.length == 16
    when 'MasterCard'
      clean_number.length == 16
    when 'American Express'
      clean_number.length == 15
    when 'Discover'
      clean_number.length == 16
    when 'JCB'
      clean_number.length == 16
    else
      # Generic validation for unknown or other types
      clean_number.length >= 13 && clean_number.length <= 19
    end
  end
end

# card_validator.rb
require 'active_model'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class CreditCardValidator < ActiveModel::EachValidator
  def validate_each(record, attribute, value)
    return if value.blank?
    
    card = CreditCard.new(value)
    
    unless card.valid?
      record.errors.add(attribute, options[:message] || "is not a valid credit card number")
    end
    
    unless card.brand
      record.errors.add(attribute, options[:message] || "is not a recognized credit card brand")
    end
  end

class CreditCard
  include ActiveModel::Model
  attr_accessor :number
  
  validates :number, presence: true
  
  BRANDS = {
    /^4/ => 'visa',
    /^5[1-5]/ => 'mastercard',
    /^3[47]/ => 'amex',
    /^6(?:011|5)/ => 'discover',
    /^35/ => 'jcb',
    /^30[0-5]/ => 'diners_club',
    /^36/ => 'diners_club',
    /^38/ => 'diners_club'
  }.freeze
  
  def initialize(number)
    @number = number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
  end
  
  def valid?
    luhn_valid? && length_valid?
  end
  
  def brand
    return nil unless valid?
    
    BRANDS.each do |pattern, brand|
      return brand if @number.match?(pattern)
    end
    
    nil
  end
  
  def masked_number
    return nil unless @number.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
    return @number if @number.length <= 4
    
    "#{@number[0..3]}****#{@number[-4..-1]}"
  end
  
  private
  
  def luhn_valid?
    return false unless @number.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
    
    digits = @number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.odd?
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        sum += digit
      end
    end
    
    sum % 10 == 0
  end
  
  def length_valid?
    case @number
    when /^4/ then @number.length == 13 || @number.length == 16
    when /^5[1-5]/ then @number.length == 16
    when /^3[47]/ then @number.length == 15
    when /^6(?:011|5)/ then @number.length == 16
    when /^35/ then @number.length == 16
    when /^30[0-5]/ then @number.length == 14
    when /^36/ then @number.length == 14
    when /^38/ then @number.length == 14
    else @number.length >= 13 && @number.length <= 19
    end
  end
end

def create_invoice(client, invoice_data)
  invoice = QuickBooks::Model::Invoice.new
  invoice.CustomerRef = QuickBooks::Model::Ref.new(

    name: invoice_data[:customer_name]

Here's a complete solution for fetching historical stock prices from Alpha Vantage and computing a 20-day moving average.

## Implementation

```ruby
# stock_analyzer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class StockAnalyzer
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end
  
  def get_historical_prices(ticker, output_size: 'compact')
    # Fetch historical daily prices from Alpha Vantage
    response = self.class.get('/', query: {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: ticker,
      outputsize: output_size,
      apikey: @api_key
    })
    
    if response['Error Message']
      raise "API Error: #{response['Error Message']}"
    elsif response['Note']
      puts "Warning: #{response['Note']}"
    end
    
    response['Time Series (Daily)']
  end
  
  def calculate_moving_average(prices, window_size = 20)
    # Convert to array of price objects with dates
    price_data = prices.map do |date, data|
      {
        date: Date.parse(date),
        close: data['4. close'].to_f
      }
    end
    
    # Sort by date (ascending)
    price_data.sort_by! { |entry| entry[:date] }
    
    # Calculate moving average
    moving_averages = []
    
    price_data.each_with_index do |entry, index|
      # Get the window of data points
      window_start = [0, index - window_size + 1].max
      window_data = price_data[window_start..index]
      
      # Calculate average if we have enough data points
      if window_data.length >= window_size
        average = window_data.sum { |d| d[:close] } / window_size.to_f
        moving_averages << {
          date: entry[:date],
          close: entry[:close],
          moving_average: average
        }
      end
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end
  
  def analyze_stock(ticker, window_size = 20)
    puts "Fetching historical data for #{ticker}..."
    prices = get_historical_prices(ticker)
    
    if prices.nil? || prices.empty?
      puts "No data available for #{ticker}"
      return nil
    end
    
    puts "Calculating #{window_size}-day moving average..."
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, window_size)
    
    puts "Analysis complete!"
    puts "=" * 50
    
    # Display recent data
    recent_data = moving_averages.last(5)
    puts "Recent #{window_size}-day moving averages:"
    puts "Date\t\t\tClose\t\tMA"
    puts "-" * 50
    
    recent_data.each do |data|
      puts "#{data[:date]}\t\t#{data[:close].round(2)}\t\t#{data[:moving_average].round(2)}"
    end
    
    # Return the full results for further processing
    moving_averages
  end
end

# Main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  # You need to get a free API key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key
  API_KEY = ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY'] || 'YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
  
  if API_KEY == 'YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
    puts "Please set your Alpha Vantage API key in the ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY environment variable"
    puts "Get a free key at: https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key"
    exit 1
  end
  
  # Example usage
  ticker = ARGV[0] || 'AAPL'
  
  analyzer = StockAnalyzer.new(API_KEY)
  
  begin
    results = analyzer.analyze_stock(ticker)
    
    if results && !results.empty?
      puts "\nSummary:"
      puts "Latest price: #{results.last[:close].round(2)}"
      puts "Latest #{results.length > 20 ? 20 : results.length}-day MA: #{results.last[:moving_average].round(2)}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end

    invoice[:qb_sync_token] = saved_invoice.sync_token
    invoice[:exported_at] = Time.now

  validates :due_date, presence: true

  scope :synced_with_xero, -> { where.not(xero_invoice_id: nil) }
  scope :unpaid, -> { where(status: %w[draft submitted]) }

  def generate_invoice_number
    return if invoice_number.present?

    self.invoice_number = "INV-#{Time.current.strftime('%Y%m%d')}-#{SecureRandom.hex(4).upcase}"
  end

  def send_to_xero!
    xero_service = XeroService.new
    response = xero_service.create_invoice(self)
    
    if response.success?
      update!(
        xero_invoice_id: response.data.invoice_id,
        status: :submitted,
        xero_synced_at: Time.current
      )
      true
    else
      errors.add(:base, "Failed to send to Xero: #{response.error}")
      false
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    errors.add(:base, "Error sending to Xero: #{e.message}")
    false
  end

  def update_xero_status!
    return unless xero_invoice_id.present?

    xero_service = XeroService.new
    response = xero_service.get_invoice_status(xero_invoice_id)
    
    if response.success?
      update_payment_status(response.data.status)
      true
    else
      errors.add(:base, "Failed to fetch status from Xero: #{response.error}")
      false
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    errors.add(:base, "Error updating Xero status: #{e.message}")
    false
  end

  private

  def update_payment_status(xero_status)
    case xero_status.downcase
    when 'paid'
      update_column(:status, :paid)
    when 'draft'
      update_column(:status, :draft)
    when 'submitted'
      update_column(:status, :submitted)
    end
  end

    end

    api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(client)

    xero_invoice = response.invoice

    case xero_invoice.status

      invoice.update(status: 'paid')
    when 'DRAFT'
      invoice.update(status: 'draft')
    when 'SENT'
      invoice.update(status: 'sent')
    end

  end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class CheckboxClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['CHECKBOX_API_URL']

  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    @auth = {
      username: ENV['CHECKBOX_LOGIN'],
      password: ENV['CHECKBOX_PASSWORD']
    }
  end

  def login
    response = self.class.post('/auth/login', body: { login: @auth[:username], password: @auth[:password] }.to_json, headers: @headers)
    if response.success?
      @token = response.parsed_response['token']
      @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@token}"
    else
      raise "Login failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def create_receipt(items, customer_email: nil)
    receipt_data = {
      device_id: ENV['CHECKBOX_DEVICE_ID'],
      items: items,
      customer: customer_email ? { email: customer_email } : nil
    }

    response = self.class.post('/receipts', body: receipt_data.to_json, headers: @headers)

    if response.success?
      puts "Чек успішно створено: #{response.body}"
      response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "Помилка створення чека: #{response.body}"
      raise "Receipt creation failed"
    end
  end
end

class PaymentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :verify_liqpay_signature, only: [:callback]

  def create
    # Приклад формування запиту до LiqPay
    amount = params[:amount].to_f
    order_id = SecureRandom.uuid

    liqpay = LiqPay.new(ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'], ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'])

    data = {
      action: 'charge',
      amount: amount,
      currency: 'UAH',
      order_id: order_id,
      description: 'Оплата послуги',
      sandbox: 1 # Використовувати sandbox режим для тестування
    }

    result = liqpay.api('request', data)

    redirect_to result['url']
  end

  def callback
    # Обробка відповіді від LiqPay
    status = params[:status]
    amount = params[:amount]
    order_id = params[:order_id]
    signature = params[:signature]

    render json: { status: 'ok' }
  end

  private

  def verify_liqpay_signature
    # Перевірка підпису LiqPay
    signature = params[:signature]
    data = params[:data]

    # Декодуємо base64 дані

# app/controllers/liqpay_controller.rb
class LiqpayController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  def create
    # Create payment request
    payment_params = payment_params_hash
    
    # Initialize LiqPay client
    liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      private_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    )
    
    # Prepare payment data
    payment_data = {
      amount: payment_params[:amount],
      currency: payment_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      description: payment_params[:description] || 'Payment description',
      order_id: payment_params[:order_id],
      result_url: payment_params[:result_url] || liqpay_result_url,
      server_url: payment_params[:server_url] || liqpay_callback_url
    }
    
    # Generate payment URL
    payment_url = liqpay.api('process', payment_data)
    
    if payment_url.is_a?(String)
      redirect_to payment_url
    else
      render json: { error: 'Failed to create payment' }, status: :bad_request
    end
  end

  def callback
    begin
      # Get the raw POST data
      raw_data = request.raw_post
      signature = request.headers['HTTP_LIQPAY_SIGNATURE']
      
      # Verify the signature
      if verify_liqpay_signature(raw_data, signature)
        # Parse the JSON data
        data = JSON.parse(raw_data)
        
        # Process the payment status
        order_id = data['order_id']
        status = data['status']
        amount = data['amount']
        currency = data['currency']
        transaction_id = data['transaction_id']
        
        # Update your order/payment model here
        order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
        if order
          order.update!(
            payment_status: status,
            amount: amount,
            currency: currency,
            transaction_id: transaction_id,
            paid_at: Time.current
          )
        end
        
        # Return success response
        render json: { status: 'ok' }, status: :ok
      else
        render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: :unauthorized
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      render json: { error: 'Invalid JSON data' }, status: :bad_request
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error "LiqPay callback error: #{e.message}"
      render json: { error: 'Internal server error' }, status: :internal_server_error
    end
  end

  private

  def payment_params_hash
    {
      amount: params[:amount].to_f,
      currency: params[:currency],
      description: params[:description],
      order_id: params[:order_id],
      result_url: params[:result_url],
      server_url: params[:server_url]
    }
  end

  def verify_liqpay_signature(data, signature)
    liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      private_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    )
    
    # Verify signature using the same method as LiqPay service
    expected_signature = liqpay.base64_encode(
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(
        'sha256',
        liqpay.private_key,
        data
      )
    )
    
    # Compare signatures (case insensitive)
    expected_signature == signature
  end
end

```ruby
# lib/checkbox_receipt.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class CheckboxReceipt
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_url:, api_token:, logger: nil)
    @api_url = api_url
    @api_token = api_token
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    
    # Set the base URI for API calls
    self.class.base_uri(@api_url)
    
    # Add authentication header
    self.class.headers('Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}")
  end
  
  # Issue a fiscal receipt for an online payment
  def issue_receipt(payment_data, receipt_items)
    begin
      # Validate required data
      validate_payment_data(payment_data)
      validate_receipt_items(receipt_items)
      
      # Prepare receipt data
      receipt_data = build_receipt_data(payment_data, receipt_items)
      
      # Send to Checkbox API
      response = post('/api/v1/receipts', body: receipt_data.to_json)
      
      if response.success?
        @logger.info("Receipt issued successfully: #{response['id']}")
        return {
          success: true,
          receipt_id: response['id'],
          receipt_data: response
        }
      else
        error_msg = "Failed to issue receipt: #{response['error'] || response.body}"
        @logger.error(error_msg)
        return {
          success: false,
          error: error_msg
        }
      end
      
    rescue => e
      error_msg = "Exception occurred while issuing receipt: #{e.message}"
      @logger.error(error_msg)
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error_msg
      }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_payment_data(payment_data)
    required_fields = %w[amount currency payment_method transaction_id]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields - payment_data.keys
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required payment data fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Validate numeric amount
    unless payment_data[:amount].is_a?(Numeric)
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be numeric"
    end
    
    # Validate currency (basic check)
    unless payment_data[:currency].is_a?(String) && payment_data[:currency].length == 3
      raise ArgumentError, "Currency must be a 3-character ISO code"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_receipt_items(items)
    unless items.is_a?(Array) && !items.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Receipt items must be a non-empty array"
    end
    
    items.each_with_index do |item, index|
      required_fields = %w[description price quantity]
      missing_fields = required_fields - item.keys
      
      unless missing_fields.empty?
        raise ArgumentError, "Item #{index} missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      end
      
      # Validate numeric values
      unless item[:price].is_a?(Numeric) && item[:quantity].is_a?(Numeric)
        raise ArgumentError, "Item #{index} price and quantity must be numeric"
      end
      
      # Validate non-negative quantities and prices
      unless item[:quantity] >= 0 && item[:price] >= 0
        raise ArgumentError, "Item #{index} quantity and price must be non-negative"
      end
    end
  end
  
  def build_receipt_data(payment_data, receipt_items)
    {
      "receipt": {
        "type": "sale",
        "items": receipt_items.map do |item|
          {
            "description": item[:description],
            "price": item[:price],
            "quantity": item[:quantity],
            "vat_rate": item[:vat_rate] || "20.00"  # Default VAT rate
          }
        end,

            "type": payment_data[:payment_method],
            "amount": payment_data[:amount],
            "currency": payment_data[:currency]

        },
        "metadata": {
          "transaction_id": payment_data[:transaction_id],
          "payment_method": payment_data[:payment_method],
          "payment_provider": payment_data[:payment_provider] || "online"
        }
      }
    }
  end

# app.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class CheckboxReceiptIssuer
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = {
      api_base_url: ENV['CHECKBOX_API_URL'] || 'https://api.checkbox.com',
      api_key: ENV['CHECKBOX_API_KEY'],
      cash_register_id: ENV['CHECKBOX_CASH_REGISTER_ID'],
      receipt_template_id: ENV['CHECKBOX_RECEIPT_TEMPLATE_ID'],
      logger: Logger.new(STDOUT)
    }.merge(config)
    
    # Validate required configuration
    validate_config!
  end
  
  def issue_receipt(payment_data)
    @logger.info("Processing receipt for payment: #{payment_data[:payment_id]}")
    
    # Create receipt payload
    receipt_data = build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    
    # Send to Checkbox API
    response = post_receipt(receipt_data)
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Receipt issued successfully: #{response['id']}")
      {
        success: true,
        receipt_id: response['id'],
        receipt_url: response['url']
      }
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to issue receipt: #{response.body}")
      {
        success: false,
        error: response.body
      }
    end
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error issuing receipt: #{e.message}")
    {
      success: false,
      error: e.message
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_config!
    required_keys = [:api_key, :cash_register_id]
    missing_keys = required_keys.select { |key| @config[key].nil? || @config[key].empty? }
    
    unless missing_keys.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required configuration: #{missing_keys.join(', ')}"
    end
  end
  
  def build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    {
      cash_register_id: @config[:cash_register_id],
      template_id: @config[:receipt_template_id],
      items: build_receipt_items(payment_data[:items]),
      customer: build_customer_info(payment_data[:customer]),
      payment_methods: build_payment_methods(payment_data[:payment_methods]),
      metadata: {
        payment_id: payment_data[:payment_id],
        order_id: payment_data[:order_id],
        timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
      }
    }
  end
  
  def build_receipt_items(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        name: item[:name],
        price: item[:price],
        quantity: item[:quantity] || 1,
        tax_group: item[:tax_group] || 'standard'
      }
    end
  end
  
  def build_customer_info(customer)
    return nil unless customer
    
    {
      name: customer[:name],
      email: customer[:email],
      phone: customer[:phone],
      tax_id: customer[:tax_id]
    }
  end
  
  def build_payment_methods(payment_methods)
    payment_methods.map do |method|
      {
        type: method[:type],
        amount: method[:amount],
        currency: method[:currency] || 'UAH'
      }
    end
  end
  
  def post_receipt(receipt_data)
    self.class.post(
      "#{@config[:api_base_url]}/receipts",
      body: receipt_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@config[:api_key]}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
  end
end

class PaymentHandler
  def initialize(receipt_issuer = nil)
    @receipt_issuer = receipt_issuer || CheckboxReceiptIssuer.new
  end
  
  def handle_payment_success(payment_data)
    @logger.info("Payment success event received: #{payment_data[:payment_id]}")
    
    # Validate payment data
    unless valid_payment_data?(payment_data)
      @logger.error("Invalid payment data received")
      return { success: false, error: "Invalid payment data" }
    end
    
    # Issue fiscal receipt
    result = @receipt_issuer.issue_receipt(payment_data)
    
    if result[:success]
      @logger.info("Receipt issued successfully for payment: #{payment_data[:payment_id]}")
      {
        success: true,
        message: "Receipt issued successfully",
        receipt_id: result[:receipt_id],
        receipt_url: result[:receipt_url]
      }
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to issue receipt for payment: #{payment_data[:payment_id]}")
      { success: false, error: result[:error] }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def valid_payment_data?(payment_data)
    payment_data[:payment_id] &&
    payment_data[:items] &&
    payment_data[:payment_methods] &&
    !payment_data[:items].empty?
  end
end

# Helper methods
def calculate_signature(params, secret_key)
  # Sort parameters by key
  sorted_params = params.sort_by { |k, v| k.to_s }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
  
  # Create HMAC-SHA256 hash
  OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', secret_key, sorted_params)
end

def base64_encode(data)
  [data].pack('m0').gsub(/\s/, '')
end

def base64_decode(data)
  [data].unpack('m')[0]
end

def verify_signature(params, expected_signature, secret_key)
  # Calculate the signature from the received parameters
  calculated_signature = calculate_signature(params, secret_key)
  
  # Base64 encode the calculated signature
  calculated_base64 = base64_encode(calculated_signature)
  
  # Compare signatures (use constant time comparison to prevent timing attacks)
  calculated_base64 == expected_signature
end

require 'json'

SECRET_KEY = ENV['FONDY_SECRET_KEY'] || 'your_secret_key'

# Формування підпису для запиту
def generate_signature(params, secret_key)
  # Сортуємо параметри за ключами
  sorted_params = params.sort_by { |k, _| k }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
  # Формуємо підпис
  OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', secret_key, sorted_params)
end

# Перевірка підпису відповіді від Fondy
def verify_signature(params, secret_key)
  signature = params['signature']
  return false unless signature

  expected_signature = generate_signature(params.reject { |k, _| k == 'signature' }, secret_key)
  decoded_signature = Base64.decode64(signature)
  decoded_signature == expected_signature
end

    response_url: 'http://localhost:4567/success'
  }

  # Генеруємо підпис

  # Формуємо форму для редіректу на Fondy
  form_data = params.merge(signature: signature).map { |k, v| "<input type='hidden' name='#{k}' value='#{v}'>" }.join("\n")

  params = request.params

require 'rqrcode'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'
require 'dry/validation'
require 'dry/types'

module UkrainianPaymentQR
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  # QR code version according to NBU standard
  VERSION = '1.0'.freeze

  # Required fields for NBU QR payment standard
  REQUIRED_FIELDS = %i[
    recipient_name
    recipient_account
    recipient_bank_code
    amount
    purpose
  ].freeze

  # Validation rules for payment data
  Validation = Dry::Validation.Schema do
    required(:recipient_name).filled(:string)
    required(:recipient_account).filled(:string)
    required(:recipient_bank_code).filled(:string)
    required(:amount).filled(:decimal)
    required(:purpose).filled(:string)
    
    optional(:recipient_uaedrpo).maybe(:string)
    optional(:recipient_city).maybe(:string)
    optional(:recipient_address).maybe(:string)
    optional(:currency).maybe(:string)
    optional(:payment_id).maybe(:string)
    optional(:comment).maybe(:string)
  end

  class QRGenerator
    include Dry::Types.module

    # Generate NBU compliant QR code
    def self.generate_qr_code(payment_data, options = {})
      # Validate input data
      result = Validation.call(payment_data)
      if result.success?
        payment_data = result.to_h
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid payment data: #{result.errors.to_h}"
      end

      # Prepare QR data according to NBU standard
      qr_data = build_qr_data(payment_data)
      
      # Generate QR code
      qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_data, level: :m)
      qr
    end

    # Build QR data string according to NBU specification
    def self.build_qr_data(payment_data)
      # Format: version|recipient_name|recipient_account|recipient_bank_code|amount|purpose|currency|payment_id
      # From NBU specification, fields are separated by semicolon
      fields = [
        VERSION,
        payment_data[:recipient_name],
        payment_data[:recipient_account],
        payment_data[:recipient_bank_code],
        payment_data[:amount].to_s,
        payment_data[:purpose],
        payment_data[:currency] || 'UAH',
        payment_data[:payment_id] || '',
        payment_data[:recipient_uaedrpo] || '',
        payment_data[:recipient_city] || '',
        payment_data[:recipient_address] || '',
        payment_data[:comment] || ''
      ]
      
      fields.join('|')
    end

    # Generate QR code as PNG image
    def self.generate_qr_png(payment_data, options = {})
      qr = generate_qr_code(payment_data, options)
      
      # Create a PNG image with custom options
      size = options[:size] || 300
      color = options[:color] || 'black'
      background = options[:background] || 'white'
      
      qr.as_png(
        size: size,
        color: color,
        fill: background
      )
    end
  end

  class PaymentData
    attr_reader :recipient_name, :recipient_account, :recipient_bank_code,
                :amount, :purpose, :recipient_uaedrpo, :recipient_city,
                :recipient_address, :currency, :payment_id, :comment

    def initialize(attributes = {})
      @recipient_name = attributes[:recipient_name]
      @recipient_account = attributes[:recipient_account]
      @recipient_bank_code = attributes[:recipient_bank_code]
      @amount = attributes[:amount]
      @purpose = attributes[:purpose]
      @recipient_uaedrpo = attributes[:recipient_uaedrpo]
      @recipient_city = attributes[:recipient_city]
      @recipient_address = attributes[:recipient_address]
      @currency = attributes[:currency] || 'UAH'
      @payment_id = attributes[:payment_id]
      @comment = attributes[:comment]
    end

    def to_hash

        recipient_name: @recipient_name,
        recipient_account: @recipient_account,
        recipient_bank_code: @recipient_bank_code,
        amount: @amount,
        purpose: @purpose,

        recipient_city: @recipient_city,
        recipient_address: @recipient_address,
        currency: @currency,
        payment_id: @payment_id,
        comment: @comment
      }
    end
  end

def generate_signature(data)
  # Sort parameters alphabetically
  sorted_data = data.sort_by { |key, _| key.to_s }
  
  # Convert to string with merchant_id first, then sorted parameters
  string_to_sign = [data[:merchant_id]].concat(
    sorted_data.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }
  ).join('&')
  
  # Generate HMAC-SHA256 hash
  OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', FONDY_SECRET_KEY, string_to_sign)
end

# Helper method to verify signature
def verify_signature(data)
  # Extract signature from data
  expected_signature = data['signature']
  
  # Remove signature from data for verification
  data_without_signature = data.dup
  data_without_signature.delete('signature')
  
  # Generate signature from remaining data
  generated_signature = generate_signature(data_without_signature)
  
  # Convert to hex for comparison
  expected_hex = expected_signature.is_a?(String) ? expected_signature : Base64.encode64(expected_signature).strip
  generated_hex = Base64.encode64(generated_signature).strip
  
  # Compare signatures (using secure comparison)
  secure_compare(expected_hex, generated_hex)
end

# Secure string comparison to prevent timing attacks
def secure_compare(a, b)
  return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
  return false if a.length != b.length
  
  result = 0
  (0...a.length).each do |i|
    result |= a[i].ord ^ b[i].ord
  end
  result == 0
end

  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'.freeze

    @merchant_id = merchant_id

  end

  # Оплата частинами
  def pay_in_parts(order_id, amount, parts_count)
    part_amount = amount / parts_count.to_f

    parts = (1..parts_count).map do |i|
      {
        order_id: "#{order_id}_part_#{i}",
        amount: part_amount.round(2),
        description: "Часткова оплата замовлення #{order_id}, частина #{i}/#{parts_count}"

        merchant_id: @merchant_id,

        order_id: payment_data[:order_id],
        amount: payment_data[:amount],
        description: payment_data[:description]
      }.to_json,

    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Успішна оплата: #{payment_data[:order_id]} - #{payment_data[:amount]} грн"
      response.parsed_response
    else

    end
  end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class LiqPayP2P
  include HTTParty

  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(public_key, private_key, sandbox: false)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
    @base_url = sandbox ? 'https://sandbox.liqpay.ua/api' : 'https://www.liqpay.ua/api'
  end

  # P2P payout to Ukrainian card
  def payout(amount, card_number, description = '', recipient_name = '')
    # Validate required parameters
    raise ArgumentError, 'Amount is required' if amount.nil? || amount <= 0
    raise ArgumentError, 'Card number is required' if card_number.nil? || card_number.empty?
    
    # Prepare the request data
    data = {
      version: 3,
      amount: amount,
      currency: 'UAH',
      description: description,
      recipient: card_number,
      recipient_name: recipient_name,
      paytypes: 'card'
    }

    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data)
    
    # Prepare final payload
    payload = {
      public_key: @public_key,
      action: 'p2p',
      amount: amount,
      currency: 'UAH',
      description: description,
      recipient: card_number,
      recipient_name: recipient_name,
      paytypes: 'card',
      signature: signature
    }

    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/p2p", 
                              body: payload.to_json,
                              headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

    # Parse and return response
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    # Convert data to string format
    data_str = data.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    
    # Add private key to the string
    data_str_with_key = "#{@private_key}#{data_str}#{@private_key}"
    
    # Generate SHA-256 hash and encode to base64
    OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.base64digest(data_str_with_key)
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    begin
      parsed = JSON.parse(response.body)
      return parsed
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      # If JSON parsing fails, return raw response
      return { error: 'Invalid response format', raw: response.body }
    end
  end
end

    end
  end

    request_data = {

      payment_id: payment_id

    response = self.class.post('/status', body: request_data.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

  end

  # Payout to Ukrainian card using LiqPay P2P API
  def payout_to_card(amount, card_number, recipient_name, description = nil)
    # Validate input
    raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be positive" unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise ArgumentError, "Card number is required" unless card_number&.length&.>= 10
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipient name is required" unless recipient_name&.length&.> 0

    # Prepare parameters for LiqPay API
    params = {
      action: 'p2p',
      amount: amount.to_f.round(2),
      currency: 'UAH',
      card: card_number,
      description: description || "Payout to #{recipient_name}",
      version: '3'
    }

    # Add recipient name to params
    params[:recipient_name] = recipient_name if recipient_name

    begin
      # Make API call to LiqPay
      response = @liqpay.api('payment/pay', params)
      
      # Handle response
      if response['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
          amount: response['amount'],
          currency: response['currency'],
          message: 'Payout successful'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: response['error_message'] || 'Unknown error',
          message: response['message'] || 'Payout failed'
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message,
        message: 'API request failed'
      }
    end
  end

  # Get payout status by transaction ID
  def get_payout_status(transaction_id)
    return nil if transaction_id.nil? || transaction_id.empty?
    
    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('payment/status', {
        transaction_id: transaction_id
      })
      
      if response['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          status: response['status'],
          amount: response['amount'],
          currency: response['currency'],
          date: response['date'],
          description: response['description']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: response['error_message'] || 'Unknown error'
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

    return false if card_number.nil? || card_number.empty?

    # Check if it's a valid Ukrainian card format (16 digits)

  end

require 'fedex'
require 'json'
require 'open-uri'
require 'fileutils'

class FedExShipment
  # Initialize with your FedEx credentials
  def initialize(account_number, meter_number, key, password, test_mode: false)
    @client = Fedex::Client.new(
      account_number: account_number,
      meter_number: meter_number,
      key: key,
      password: password,
      test_mode: test_mode
    )
  end

  # Create a shipment and return the response
  def create_shipment(sender, recipient, package_weight, package_dimensions = nil)
    # Create FedEx addresses
    sender_address = Fedex::Address.new(
      street_lines: [sender[:street]],
      city: sender[:city],
      state: sender[:state],
      postal_code: sender[:postal_code],
      country_code: sender[:country]
    )

    recipient_address = Fedex::Address.new(
      street_lines: [recipient[:street]],
      city: recipient[:city],
      state: recipient[:state],
      postal_code: recipient[:postal_code],
      country_code: recipient[:country]
    )

    # Create the package
    package = Fedex::Package.new(
      weight: package_weight,
      dimensions: package_dimensions
    )

    # Create the request
    request = Fedex::ShipmentRequest.new(
      service_type: Fedex::ShipmentRequest::ServiceType::FEDEX_GROUND,
      packaging_type: Fedex::ShipmentRequest::PackagingType::YOUR_PACKAGING,
      shipper: Fedex::Party.new(address: sender_address),
      recipient: Fedex::Party.new(address: recipient_address),
      packages: [package],
      shipping_charges_payment: Fedex::Payment.new(
        payment_type: Fedex::Payment::PaymentType::SENDER,
        payor: Fedex::Party.new(address: sender_address)
      ),
      label_response_options: Fedex::LabelResponseOptions.new(
        image_type: Fedex::ImageType::PDF
      )
    )

    # Process the shipment
    response = @client.process_shipment(request)

    if response.success?
      {
        tracking_number: response.tracking_number,
        label_url: response.label_url,
        status: 'success'
      }
    else
      {
        errors: response.errors,
        status: 'failed'
      }
    end
  end

  # Download the label as PDF
  def download_label(label_url, destination_path)
    begin
      # Ensure the destination directory exists
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(destination_path))

      # Download the PDF
      File.open(destination_path, 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(open(label_url).read)
      end

      true
    rescue => e
      false
    end
  end
end

```ruby
require 'fedex'
require 'base64'
require 'open-uri'
require 'tempfile'

# Configuration for FedEx API
class FedExShipper
  def initialize
    # Replace these with your actual FedEx credentials
    @credentials = {
      key: 'YOUR_FEDEX_KEY',
      password: 'YOUR_FEDEX_PASSWORD',
      account_number: 'YOUR_FEDEX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER',
      meter_number: 'YOUR_FEDEX_METER_NUMBER'
    }

    @client = FedEx::Client.new(
      key: @credentials[:key],
      password: @credentials[:password],
      account_number: @credentials[:account_number],
      meter_number: @credentials[:meter_number]
    )
  end

  def create_shipment(sender, recipient, package_details, service_type = 'FEDEX_GROUND')
    # Create the shipment request
    request = FedEx::ShipmentRequest.new
    request.service_type = service_type
    request.packaging_type = 'YOUR_PACKAGING_TYPE' # e.g., 'FEDEX_BOX', 'FEDEX_PAK', 'FEDEX_TUBE', 'FEDEX_ENVELOPE'

    # Set sender information
    request.sender = FedEx::Party.new(
      address: FedEx::Address.new(
        street_lines: [sender[:address_line1], sender[:address_line2]],
        city: sender[:city],
        state: sender[:state],
        postal_code: sender[:postal_code],
        country_code: sender[:country_code]
      )
    )

    # Set recipient information
    request.recipient = FedEx::Party.new(
      address: FedEx::Address.new(
        person_name: recipient[:name],
        street_lines: [recipient[:address_line1], recipient[:address_line2]],
        city: recipient[:city],
        state: recipient[:state],
        postal_code: recipient[:postal_code],
        country_code: recipient[:country_code]
      )
    )

    # Set package details
    request.requested_shipping_package_detail = {
      type: package_details[:type],
      weight: package_details[:weight],
      dimensions: package_details[:dimensions]
    }

    # Create the shipment
    response = @client.process_shipment(request)

    if response.success?
      tracking_number = response.tracking_number

      # Download the label as PDF
      label_url = response.label_url
      label_pdf = download_pdf(label_url)

      # Return both the tracking number and the PDF
      { tracking_number: tracking_number, label_pdf: label_pdf }
    else
      raise "FedEx API Error: #{response.errors.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  private

  def download_pdf(url)

Now, create a file named `etsy_api_client.rb`:

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyAPIClient
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3/'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ETSY_API_KEY']
    @shop_id = ENV['ETSY_SHOP_ID']
    @access_token = ENV['ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN']
  end

  # Fetch shop listings
  def fetch_listings(limit: 100, offset: 0)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}application/listings?shop_id=#{@shop_id}&limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}"

    response = get_with_auth(url)
    response.parsed_response['results'] || []
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error fetching listings: #{e.message}"
    []
  end

  # Fetch orders
  def fetch_orders(limit: 100, offset: 0, min_created: nil, max_created: nil)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}application/orders?shop_id=#{@shop_id}&limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}"

    url += "&min_created=#{min_created}" if min_created
    url += "&max_created=#{max_created}" if max_created

    response = get_with_auth(url)
    response.parsed_response['results'] || []
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error fetching orders: #{e.message}"
    []
  end

  private

  def get_with_auth(url)
    options = {
      query: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        access_token: @access_token
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    }

    self.class.get(url, options)
  end
end
```

# fedex_shipper.rb

require 'fedex'
require 'fileutils'

class FedExShipper
  # FedEx API credentials (you should store these securely in environment variables)
  def initialize
    @client_id = ENV['FDEX_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['FDEX_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @account_number = ENV['FDEX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER']
    @meter_number = ENV['FDEX_METER_NUMBER']
    @key = ENV['FDEX_KEY']
    @password = ENV['FDEX_PASSWORD']

    @fedex = Fedex::Shipment::Service.new(
      client_id: @client_id,
      client_secret: @client_secret,
      account_number: @account_number,
      meter_number: @meter_number,
      key: @key,
      password: @password
    )
  end

  # Create and send a FedEx shipment
  def create_shipment(sender, recipient, package, service_type)
    shipment = {
      service: service_type,
      packaging: 'YOUR_PACKAGING_TYPE', # e.g., 'FEDEX_BOX', 'FEDEX_PAK', 'FEDEX_TUBE', etc.
      shipping_charges_payment: {
        payment_type: 'SENDER',
        payor: {
          responsible_party: {
            account_number: @account_number
          }
        }
      }
    }

    shipment[:shipper] = build_address(sender)
    shipment[:recipient] = build_address(recipient)
    shipment[:package] = build_package(package)

    response = @fedex.create_shipment(shipment)

    if response.success?
      {
        tracking_number: response.tracking_number,
        label_pdf: download_label_pdf(response.label_urls.first),
        message: 'Shipment created successfully'
      }
    else
      {
        error: response.errors,
        message: 'Failed to create shipment'
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_address(address_info)
    {
      name: address_info[:name],
      address: {
        street_lines: [address_info[:address1], address_info[:address2]].compact,
        city: address_info[:city],
        state: address_info[:state],
        postal_code: address_info[:postal_code],
        country_code: address_info[:country_code]
      },
      phone_number: address_info[:phone]
    }
  end

  def build_package(package_info)
    {
      sequence_number: 1,
      weight: {
        units: package_info[:weight_units] || 'LB',
        value: package_info[:weight]
      },
      dimensions: {
        length: package_info[:length],
        width: package_info[:width],
        height: package_info[:height],
        units: package_info[:dimension_units] || 'IN'
      }
    }
  end

  def download_label_pdf(label_url)
    require 'open-uri'
    require 'tempfile'

    filename = "fedex_label_#{Time.now.to_i}.pdf"
    filepath = File.join('labels', filename)

    FileUtils.mkdir_p('labels') unless Dir.exist?('labels')

    begin
      File.open(filepath, 'wb') do |f|
        f.write(open(label_url).read)
      end
      filepath
    rescue => e
      raise "Failed to download label: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid amount" if amount.nil? || amount.to_f <= 0
    
    # Create payment record

      customer_name: customer_info[:name],
      customer_email: customer_info[:email],
      customer_phone: customer_info[:phone],
      installment_plan: installment_plan[:plan],
      installment_count: installment_plan[:count].to_s,
      payment_method: 'installment'
    )

      clientName: customer_info[:name],

      clientPhone: customer_info[:phone],

      timestamp: Time.now.to_i

    request_data[:signature] = signature

    response = self.class.post("#{@api_url}/payment/create", 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }

      }

  def sign_request(data)

    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', @merchant_password, message)
  end

# Configuration for thumbnails

  { size: '100x100', suffix: '_small' },
  { size: '300x300', suffix: '_medium' },
  { size: '800x800', suffix: '_large' }
].freeze

class S3ImageUploader
  def initialize(file, product_id)
    @file = file
    @product_id = product_id
    @original_filename = generate_filename
  end

  def upload
    upload_original
    create_thumbnails
  end

  def public_urls
    {
      original: "#{CDN_BASE_URL}/#{@original_filename}",
      thumbnails: THUMBNAIL_SIZES.map do |thumbnail|
        {
          size: thumbnail[:size],
          url: "#{CDN_BASE_URL}/#{@original_filename.split('.').first}#{thumbnail[:suffix]}.#{@file.extension}"
        }
      end
    }
  end

  private

  def upload_original
    S3_CLIENT.put_object(
      bucket: S3_BUCKET,
      key: @original_filename,
      body: @file.tempfile,
      acl: 'public-read'
    )
  end

  def create_thumbnails
    THUMBNAIL_SIZES.each do |thumbnail|
      thumbnail_filename = "#{@original_filename.split('.').first}#{thumbnail[:suffix]}.#{@file.extension}"

      image = MiniMagick::Image.read(@file.tempfile.path)
      image.resize thumbnail[:size]
      image.write("/tmp/#{thumbnail_filename}")

      S3_CLIENT.put_object(
        bucket: S3_BUCKET,
        key: thumbnail_filename,
        body: File.open("/tmp/#{thumbnail_filename}"),
        acl: 'public-read'
      )
    end
  end

  def generate_filename
    "#{SecureRandom.uuid}_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{@file.original_filename}"
  end
end

    item.quantity += quantity
    item.save
  end

  end

require 'mini_magick'

# Налаштування S3
S3_BUCKET = 'ваш-bucket-ime'
S3_REGION = 'ваш-регіон' # наприклад, 'us-east-1'
S3_ACCESS_KEY = 'ваш-access-key'
S3_SECRET_KEY = 'ваш-secret-key'

Aws.config.update(
  region: S3_REGION,
  credentials: Aws::Credentials.new(S3_ACCESS_KEY, S3_SECRET_KEY)
)

s3 = Aws::S3::Resource.new

# Кінець CDN (наприклад, CloudFront)
CDN_URL = 'https://ваш-cdn-endpoint.cloudfront.net'

# Маршрут для завантаження зображень
post '/upload' do
  if params[:image] && params[:image][:tempfile]
    tempfile = params[:image][:tempfile]
    filename = params[:image][:filename]

    # Завантаження на S3
    obj = s3.bucket(S3_BUCKET).object("originals/#{filename}")
    obj.upload_file(tempfile.path)

    # Генерація мініатюр
    generate_thumbnails(filename)

    { status: 'success', original_url: "#{CDN_URL}/originals/#{filename}" }.to_json
  else
    { error: 'No image provided' }.to_json
  end
end

# Метод для генерації мініатюр
def generate_thumbnails(filename)
  original_path = "tmp/#{filename}" # тимчасовий файл
  original_url = "originals/#{filename}"

  # Завантажте оригінал з S3 у тимчасовий файл
  s3.bucket(S3_BUCKET).object(original_url).get(response_target: original_path)

  # Генеруємо мініатюри різних розмірів
  sizes = [
    { size: '100x100', prefix: 'thumbs/' },
    { size: '300x300', prefix: 'medium/' },
    { size: '800x800', prefix: 'large/' }
  ]

  sizes.each do |size_config|
    thumbnail_path = "tmp/#{size_config[:prefix]}#{filename}"
    MiniMagick::Image.open(original_path) do |img|
      img.resize size_config[:size]
      img.write thumbnail_path
    end

    # Завантаження мініатюри на S3
    s3.bucket(S3_BUCKET).object("#{size_config[:prefix]}#{filename}").upload_file(thumbnail_path)
  end

  # Очищення тимчасових файлів
  File.delete(original_path) if File.exist?(original_path)
  sizes.each do |size_config|
    File.delete("tmp/#{size_config[:prefix]}#{filename}") if File.exist?("tmp/#{size_config[:prefix]}#{filename}")
  end
end

# Запуск сервера (якщо потрібно)
__END__

```ruby
# lib/etsy_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'oj'

class EtsyClient
  include HTTParty
  format :json
  parser Oj

  # Etsy API base URL
  base_uri 'https://openapi.etsy.com'

  # API version
  API_VERSION = 'v3'

  # Initialize with API key and optional parameters
  def initialize(api_key, shop_id: nil, timeout: 30, retries: 3)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_id = shop_id
    @timeout = timeout
    @retries = retries
  end

  # Make a GET request to the Etsy API
  def get(path, params = {})
    make_request(:get, path, params)
  end

  # Make a POST request to the Etsy API
  def post(path, body = {})
    make_request(:post, path, {}, body)
  end

  private

  def make_request(method, path, query_params = {}, body = {})
    # Add API key to query parameters
    query_params[:api_key] = @api_key

    # Add shop_id if provided
    query_params[:shop_id] = @shop_id if @shop_id

    response = self.class.send(method) do |request|
      request.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      request.headers['Accept'] = 'application/json'
      request.timeout = @timeout
      request.retries = @retries
      request.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@api_key}" if method == :post
    end

    response = response.send(method, "#{API_VERSION}#{path}", query: query_params, body: body.to_json)

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      response.parsed_response
    when 400
      raise EtsyClientError, "Bad request: #{response.message}"
    when 401
      raise EtsyClientError, "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 403
      raise EtsyClientError, "Forbidden: Insufficient permissions"
    when 404
      raise EtsyClientError, "Not found: #{response.message}"
    when 429
      raise EtsyClientError, "Too many requests. Rate limit exceeded."
    when 500..599
      raise EtsyClientError, "Server error: #{response.message}"
    else
      raise EtsyClientError, "Unknown error: #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end

# Custom error class
class EtsyClientError < StandardError; end

## Implementation

### 1. Configuration

Create `config/initializers/aws.rb`:

```ruby
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'aws-sdk-cloudfront' if ENV['AWS_CLOUDFRONT_MANAGEMENT']

# Configure AWS S3
Aws.config.update(
  region: ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1',
  credentials: Aws::Credentials.new(
    ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
    ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
  )
)

# S3 Client
S3_CLIENT = Aws::S3::Client.new

# S3 Bucket (create one with public read permissions)
S3_BUCKET = Aws::S3::Bucket.new(ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME'] || 'your-bucket-name')

# CDN Configuration (CloudFront)
CDN_DOMAIN = ENV['CDN_DOMAIN'] # e.g., 'd123456789.cloudfront.net'
CDN_ENABLED = !ENV['CDN_ENABLED'].nil? && ENV['CDN_ENABLED'].downcase == 'true'
```

### 2. Image Uploader Service

Create `services/image_uploader.rb`:

```ruby
require 'image_processing'
require 'mini_magick'

class ImageUploader
  def initialize(file, product_id, options = {})
    @file = file
    @product_id = product_id
    @options = {
      thumbnail_sizes: [80, 160, 320, 640], # in pixels (width)
      quality: 85,
      format: :jpg
    }.merge(options)
  end

  def upload
    # Generate filenames
    @original_filename = generate_filename("original_#{@product_id}")
    @thumbnail_filenames = @options[:thumbnail_sizes].map do |size|
      generate_filename("thumbnail_#{@product_id}_#{size}")
    end

    # Upload original image
    upload_to_s3(@file, @original_filename)

    # Generate and upload thumbnails
    @options[:thumbnail_sizes].each_with_index do |size, index|
      thumbnail = thumbnail_version(@file, size)
      upload_to_s3(thumbnail, @thumbnail_filenames[index])
    end

    # Return public URLs
    {
      original: public_url(@original_filename),
      thumbnails: @thumbnail_filenames.map { |filename| public_url(filename) }
    }
  end

  private

  def generate_filename(base)
    "#{base}_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.uuid}.#{file_extension}"
  end

  def file_extension
    @file.original_filename.split('.').last.downcase
  end

  def upload_to_s3(file, key)
    S3_CLIENT.put_object(
      bucket: S3_BUCKET.name,
      key: key,
      body: file.read,
      content_type: file.content_type,
      acl: 'public-read'
    )
  end

  def public_url(key)
    if CDN_ENABLED && CDN_DOMAIN
      "https://#{CDN_DOMAIN}/#{key}"
    else
      "https://#{S3_BUCKET.name}.s3.amazonaws.com/#{key}"
    end
  end

  def thumbnail_version(image_file, size)
    file = MiniMagick::Image.read(image_file.path)
    file.resize "#{size}x#{size}^"
    file.gravity "center"
    file.extent "#{size}x#{size}"
    file.quality @options[:quality]
    file.format @options[:format].to_s
    file.tempfile
  end
end
```

## 2. Create an Image model

```ruby
# app/models/image.rb
class Image < ApplicationRecord
  has_one_attached :file

  after_commit :upload_to_s3, on: :create
  after_commit :generate_thumbnails, on: :create

  def file_url
    file.service_url
  end

  def thumbnail_url(size = :medium)
    thumbnail(size).service_url
  end

  private

  def upload_to_s3
    file.attach(io: file.blob.download, filename: file.blob.filename)
  end

  def generate_thumbnails
    sizes = {
      small: [100, 100],
      medium: [300, 300],
      large: [800, 800]
    }

    sizes.each do |name, dimensions|
      create_thumbnail(name, dimensions)
    end
  end

  def create_thumbnail(name, dimensions)
    temp_image = MiniMagick::Image.read(file.blob.download)

    # Resize with aspect ratio preservation
    temp_image.resize dimensions.join('x')

    # Save to a temp file
    temp_file = Tempfile.new([file.blob.filename, file.blob.content_type])

    begin
      temp_image.write(temp_file.path)

      # Create a variant for the thumbnail
      variant = file.variant(resize: dimensions)
      variant.save!

      # Generate a URL for the thumbnail
      thumbnail_url(name, variant)
    ensure
      temp_file.close
      temp_file.unlink
    end
  end

  def thumbnail_url(size, variant)
    variant.service_url
  end
end
```

## Gemfile

## Реалізація

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyAPI
  include HTTParty

  # Базовий URL для API Etsy
  base_uri 'api.etsy.com'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ETSY_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['ETSY_API_SECRET']
    @access_token = ENV['ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN']
  end

  # Отримання оголошень (listings) магазину
  def get_listings(shop_id, limit = 40, offset = 0, keywords: nil)
    path = "/v3/listings/active"
    path += "?limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}"

    if shop_id.present?
      path += "&shop_id=#{shop_id}"
    end

    if keywords.present?
      path += "&keywords=#{keywords}"
    end

    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-API-KEY' => @api_key
    }

    self.class.get(path, headers: headers)

    # Розбиваем ответ на части и возвращаем только нужные данные
    response = JSON.parse(self.response.body)

    {
      listings: response['results'].map do |listing|
        {
          id: listing['listing_id'],
          title: listing['title'],
          price: listing['price'],
          quantity: listing['quantity'],
          url: listing['url'],
          image: listing['Images'].first['url_170x135'] if listing['Images'].any?
        }
      end,
      count: response['count'],
      params: response['pagination']
    }
  end

  # Отримання замовлень магазину
  def get_orders(shop_id, limit = 40, offset = 0, status: nil)
    path = "/v3/orders"
    path += "?limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}"

# Ruby Implementation for Product Recommendation with Collaborative Filtering

Here's a complete implementation for recommending related products based on past orders using collaborative filtering.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'sqlite3', '~> 1.4'
gem 'activerecord', '~> 6.1'
gem 'matrix', '~> 2.6'
gem 'nmatrix', '~> 0.0.21'
```

Run `bundle install` to install these dependencies.

## Implementation

```ruby
# config/database.yml
# SQLite configuration for development
development:
  adapter: sqlite3
  database: db/development.sqlite3
  pool: 5
  timeout: 5000

# models/order.rb
class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :order_items
  belongs_to :customer
end

# models/customer.rb
class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
end

# models/product.rb
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :order_items
  has_many :orders, through: :order_items
end

# models/order_item.rb
class OrderItem < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :order
  belongs_to :product
end

# lib/recommender.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'nmatrix'

class Recommender
  def initialize
    @user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix
  end

  def recommend_for(user_id, product_id, limit = 5)
    if @user_product_matrix.nil? || @user_product_matrix.empty?
      puts "Not enough data for recommendations"
      return []
    end

    # Convert to NMatrix for efficient calculations
    nmatrix = NMatrix.from_a(@user_product_matrix.to_a)

    # Get the user's row
    user_row = nmatrix[user_id, true]

    # Calculate cosine similarity between this user and all other users
    similarities = []
    nmatrix.each_row_with_index do |row, other_user_id|
      next if other_user_id == user_id

      similarity = cosine_similarity(user_row, row)
      similarities << { user_id: other_user_id, similarity: similarity }
    end

    # Sort by similarity (descending)
    similarities.sort_by! { |h| -h[:similarity] }

    # Get the top N similar users
    top_users = similarities.take(limit)

    # Find products this user hasn't bought but similar users have
    recommended_products = {}

    top_users.each do |similar_user|
      similar_user_products = @user_product_matrix[similar_user[:user_id]].each_with_index.with_object({}) do |(count, product_id), hash|
        hash[product_id] = count if count > 0
      end

      similar_user_products.each do |product_id, count|
        if @user_product_matrix[user_id][product_id] == 0
          recommended_products[product_id] ||= 0
          recommended_products[product_id] += (count * similar_user[:similarity])
        end
      end
    end

    # Sort recommendations by score (descending)
    recommended_products.sort_by { |_, score| -score }.take(limit).map(&:first)
  end

  private

  def build_user_product_matrix
    # Get all customers
    customers = Customer.all
    return [] if customers.empty?

    # Get all products
    products = Product.all
    return [] if products.empty?

    # Initialize a matrix of zeros
    matrix = Matrix.zero(customers.size, products.size)

    # Populate the matrix with order counts
    OrderItem.group(:order_id, :product_id).count.each do |(order_id, product_id), count|
      order = Order.find(order_id)
      customer_index = customers.index(order.customer)
      product_index = products.index(Product.find(product_id))

      matrix[customer_index, product_index] = count if customer_index && product_index
    end

    matrix
  end

  def cosine_similarity(v1, v2)
    dot_product = 0.0
    magnitude_v1 = 0.0
    magnitude_v2 = 0.0

    v1.each_with_index do |val1, i|
      val2 = v2[i]
      dot_product += val1 * val2
      magnitude_v1 += val1 ** 2
      magnitude_v2 += val2 ** 2
    end

    denominator = Math.sqrt(magnitude_v1) * Math.sqrt(magnitude_v2)
    denominator.zero? ? 0.0 : (dot_product / denominator)
  end
end

# Usage example
